/* ===== 10.11 · TCVREC — קולות מוקלטים מראש, בתוך המשחק: קולות של Gemini (גוגל, הקולות המוכנים) — קול אחד קבוע לכל דמות (קול 2).
   רובו-שאול וגרסאותיו יצאו מהמשחק. ההקלטות — TCVREC_DATA בחלק הקודם (Ogg Opus מונו), נוצרות ב-W/deliver/2026-11-10/voice2/tools.
   אין שרת ואין רשת — הקול עובד בכל מחשב. שורה בלי הקלטה, או הקלטה שלא נטענת — קול הדפדפן.
   - TCVOICE.speak עובר דרך כאן: לשורה של דמות שיש לה קול מוקלט (לפי הבחירה — modes) — מההקלטה (WebAudio, דרך העוצמה וההשתקה של TCSND);
     כל שורה אחרת — קול הדפדפן כמו קודם.
   - שורה אחת בכל רגע: ההקלטה מחכה לסוף הדיבור של הדפדפן, והדפדפן מחכה לסוף ההקלטה (כמו התור של speechSynthesis).
     הכתובית עוקבת: onstart כשההקלטה מתחילה, onend כשהיא נגמרת (029c — L.on / L.done); המוזיקה יורדת מתחת (029c — TCSND.duck).
   - ההקלטות מפוענחות רק כשנכנסים להצגה / לסרט / להודעה, ומשתחררות כשיוצאים (אין פענוח בעליית המשחק).
   - אם ההקלטה לא נטענת — קול הדפדפן; ואם גם אין — הכתובית לפי הזמן. ההצגה ממשיכה בזמן שלה בכל מקרה.
   - הבחירה (בבדיקת הקולות, F9 ← אירועים): הבחירות שבנתונים (modes) או "כבוי" — נשמרת בדפדפן (localStorage ‏tcVrec). כל דמות תמיד באותו קול. ===== */
var TCVREC=(function(){
 const D=(typeof TCVREC_DATA!=='undefined'&&TCVREC_DATA)||{lines:{},voices:{},modes:{},names:{}};
 const MODES=D.modes||{},VOICES=D.voices||{},NAMES=D.names||{};
 const st={n:0,bytes:D.bytes||0,played:0,ended:0,fail:0,fallback:0,timed:0,queued:0,decoded:0,released:0,bufBytes:0,bufN:0,phone:0,err:null,log:[],mode:D.defMode||Object.keys(MODES)[0]||'off'};
 for(const t in D.lines||{})st.n+=Object.keys(D.lines[t]).length;
 try{const m=localStorage.getItem('tcVrec');if(m&&(m==='off'||MODES[m]))st.mode=m}catch(e){}
 const vInfo=id=>VOICES[id]||{name:id};
 /* the voice of a line: the character's voice in the chosen mode; over — a line that has its recording in another voice (a cut that failed) */
 const voiceFor=(who,text)=>{if(st.mode==='off')return null;const M=MODES[st.mode]||{};return (text!=null&&M.over&&M.over[text])||(M.cast||{})[who]||null};
 const rec=(text,vid)=>{const L=D.lines&&D.lines[text];return L&&vid?L[vid]||null:null};
 const recFor=(who,text)=>rec(text,voiceFor(who,text));
 const phoneVoice=()=>st.mode==='off'?null:((MODES[st.mode]||{}).phone||D.phone||null);
 function setMode(m){if(m!=='off'&&!MODES[m])m=D.defMode||'off';st.mode=m;try{localStorage.setItem('tcVrec',m)}catch(e){}return m}

 const bytesOf=b=>b?b.length*b.numberOfChannels*4:0;
 /* ---------- the buffers: decoded on entering, released on leaving ---------- */
 const BUF=new Map();   /* text|voice → {p: Promise<AudioBuffer|null>, b} */
 function ab64(s){const bin=atob(s),u=new Uint8Array(bin.length);for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)u[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);return u.buffer}
 function load(text,vid){const k=vid+'|'+text,e0=BUF.get(k);if(e0)return e0.p;const R=rec(text,vid),c=ac();if(!R||!c)return Promise.resolve(null);
  const e={p:null,b:null};BUF.set(k,e);
  e.p=new Promise(res=>{let done=false;const ok=b=>{if(done)return;done=true;if(BUF.get(k)===e){e.b=b;st.decoded++;st.bufN++;st.bufBytes+=bytesOf(b)}res(b)},bad=er=>{if(done)return;done=true;st.fail++;st.err='decode: '+String(er&&er.message||er||'').slice(0,80);if(BUF.get(k)===e)BUF.delete(k);res(null)};
   try{const r=c.decodeAudioData(ab64(R[1]),ok,bad);if(r&&r.catch)r.catch(bad)}catch(er){bad(er)}});
  return e.p}
 function release(){let n=0;for(const [k,e] of [...BUF]){BUF.delete(k);if(e.b){st.bufBytes-=bytesOf(e.b);st.bufN--;n++}}st.released+=n;return n}
 /* ---------- one recording: plays into the master of TCSND (its volume and its mute), or into a destination of its own (the phone, the test) ---------- */
 function playRec(job){const c=ac();job.state='load';
  const go=b=>{if(job.dead)return;if(!b||!c){fallback(job);return}
   const start=()=>{if(job.dead)return;try{const s=c.createBufferSource(),g=c.createGain();s.buffer=b;g.gain.value=job.gain!=null?job.gain:1;s.connect(g);
     g.connect(job.dest||(typeof TCAUDIO!=='undefined'&&TCAUDIO.busFor&&TCAUDIO.busFor(TCSND.st.ctx)||{}).voice||TCSND.st.master||c.destination);   /* int288 (המיזוג עם opening): הערוץ "קולות ודיבור" של TCAUDIO, במקום TCSND.st.master לבד */job.src=s;job.g=g;job.dur=b.duration;
     s.onended=()=>{if(job.dead)return;job.endW=performance.now();finish(job)};
     s.start();job.state='play';job.t0W=performance.now();st.played++;
     try{job.cb&&job.cb.onstart&&job.cb.onstart()}catch(e){}}catch(e){st.err=String(e&&e.message||e).slice(0,120);fallback(job)}};
   /* the context runs only after a click (the browser's policy): wait up to 1.5 s, else the browser's voice */
   if(c.state==='running')start();else{try{c.resume()}catch(e){}const w0=performance.now();const wait=()=>{if(job.dead)return;if(c.state==='running'){start();return}if(paused&&!job.own){setTimeout(wait,120);return}if(performance.now()-w0>1500){fallback(job);return}setTimeout(wait,60)};wait()}};
  const e=BUF.get(job.vid+'|'+job.text);if(e&&e.b)go(e.b);else load(job.text,job.vid).then(go)}
 /* the line could not play from the recording: the browser's voice, else the subtitle by the time */
 function fallback(job){if(job.dead)return;st.fallback++;job.state='fb';
  if(job.own){try{job.onfail&&job.onfail()}catch(e){}finish(job);return}
  const cb=job.cb||{},ok=base.speak(job.text,job.who,job.role,job.vol,{t:cb.t,rate:cb.rate,onstart(){try{cb.onstart&&cb.onstart()}catch(e){}},onend(){finish(job)}});
  if(!ok){st.timed++;try{cb.onstart&&cb.onstart()}catch(e){}const ms=1000*Math.max(1.2,String(job.text).length/13/(cb.rate||1));job.tm=setTimeout(()=>finish(job),ms)}}
 function finish(job){if(job.fin)return;job.fin=true;st.ended++;try{job.src&&job.src.disconnect();job.g&&job.g.disconnect()}catch(e){}
  if(job.state==='play'&&st.log.length<400){const e=job.endW||performance.now();st.log.push({text:String(job.text).slice(0,40),who:job.who||'',vid:job.vid,dur:+(job.dur||0).toFixed(3),startW:+job.t0W.toFixed(1),endW:+e.toFixed(1),lateMs:+((e-job.t0W)-job.dur*1000).toFixed(1),own:!!job.own})}
  try{job.cb&&job.cb.onend&&job.cb.onend()}catch(e){}
  if(job.own){if(ph===job){ph=null;release()}}else if(cur===job){cur=null;pump()}}
 function kill(job){if(!job)return;job.dead=true;clearTimeout(job.tm);try{job.src&&job.src.stop()}catch(e){}try{job.src&&job.src.disconnect();job.g&&job.g.disconnect()}catch(e){}}
 /* ---------- the queue of the shows: one line at a time, recording or browser ---------- */
 const base={speak:TCVOICE.speak,stop:TCVOICE.stop,pause:TCVOICE.pause,resume:TCVOICE.resume,voiceOf:TCVOICE.voiceOf};
 let Q=[],cur=null,paused=false,tm=0,ph=null;
 const ttsBusy=()=>{try{return !!(window.speechSynthesis&&(speechSynthesis.speaking||speechSynthesis.pending))}catch(e){return false}};
 function pump(){clearTimeout(tm);if(paused||cur||!Q.length)return;const j=Q[0];
  if(j.rec&&ttsBusy()&&!(j.w0&&performance.now()-j.w0>8000)){j.w0=j.w0||performance.now();tm=setTimeout(pump,60);return}   /* waits for the browser's line (at most 8 s) */
  Q.shift();cur=j;
  if(j.rec)playRec(j);
  else{const cb=j.cb||{},ok=base.speak(j.text,j.who,j.role,j.vol,{t:cb.t,rate:cb.rate,onstart(){try{cb.onstart&&cb.onstart()}catch(e){}},onend(e){try{cb.onend&&cb.onend(e)}catch(er){}if(cur===j){cur=null;pump()}}});if(!ok&&cur===j){cur=null;pump()}}}
 TCVOICE.speak=function(text,who,role,vol,cb){
  const vid=voiceFor(who,text),r=!!rec(text,vid);
  if(!r&&!cur&&!Q.length)return base.speak(text,who,role,vol,cb);   /* no recording, nothing waiting — exactly as before */

/* ===== TCSVG · כלל 17 במשחק עצמו (11.11.2026): הלוגואים שנכתבו כ-SVG מצוירים בקנבס, בלי תמונה =====
   עד היום (030 LOGO_SVG, ‏032 logo(), ‏058 G7_LOGO_PICK) מחרוזת ה-SVG נטענה לתוך Image דרך כתובת data, ומשם drawImage. עכשיו — אותה מחרוזת
   מפורקת פעם אחת (DOMParser) לרשימה של צורות: path / circle / ellipse / rect בתוך g, עם transform, fill, stroke, stroke-width, opacity,
   stroke-linecap ו-stroke-linejoin (כל מה שיש בלוגואים האלה), ומצוירת בנתיבים (Path2D) לתוך קנבס. הקנבס נכנס לאותו מקום שבו עמדה התמונה,
   ולכן כל מי שמצייר את הלוגו (drawImage) לא משתנה. על הקנבס נשמרת מחרוזת המקור (__tcSvg) — לפיה 074n מזהה את הלוגו הישן ומחליף אותו. */
var TCSVG=(function(){const C=new Map(),stats={compiled:0,canvases:0,err:null};
 function tf(m,t){if(!t)return m;const re=/(translate|scale|rotate|matrix|skewX|skewY)\s*\(([^)]*)\)/g;let q;while((q=re.exec(t))){const a=q[2].split(/[\s,]+/).filter(Boolean).map(Number);
   if(q[1]==='translate')m=m.translate(a[0]||0,a[1]||0);else if(q[1]==='scale')m=m.scale(a[0],a.length>1?a[1]:a[0]);
   else if(q[1]==='rotate'){if(a.length>=3)m=m.translate(a[1],a[2]).rotate(a[0]).translate(-a[1],-a[2]);else m=m.rotate(a[0])}
   else if(q[1]==='matrix')m=m.multiply(new DOMMatrix(a.slice(0,6)));else if(q[1]==='skewX')m=m.skewX(a[0]);else if(q[1]==='skewY')m=m.skewY(a[0])}return m}
 function num(n,k,d){const v=parseFloat(n.getAttribute(k));return Number.isFinite(v)?v:d}
 function shape(n){const t=n.tagName.toLowerCase(),p=new Path2D();
  if(t==='path')return new Path2D(n.getAttribute('d')||'');
  if(t==='circle'){p.arc(num(n,'cx',0),num(n,'cy',0),num(n,'r',0),0,Math.PI*2);return p}
  if(t==='ellipse'){p.ellipse(num(n,'cx',0),num(n,'cy',0),num(n,'rx',0),num(n,'ry',0),0,0,Math.PI*2);return p}
  if(t==='rect'){const x=num(n,'x',0),y=num(n,'y',0),w=num(n,'width',0),h=num(n,'height',0);let rx=num(n,'rx',NaN),ry=num(n,'ry',NaN);if(!Number.isFinite(rx))rx=Number.isFinite(ry)?ry:0;if(!Number.isFinite(ry))ry=rx;rx=Math.min(rx,w/2);ry=Math.min(ry,h/2);
   if(rx>0||ry>0){p.moveTo(x+rx,y);p.lineTo(x+w-rx,y);p.ellipse(x+w-rx,y+ry,rx,ry,0,-Math.PI/2,0);p.lineTo(x+w,y+h-ry);p.ellipse(x+w-rx,y+h-ry,rx,ry,0,0,Math.PI/2);p.lineTo(x+rx,y+h);p.ellipse(x+rx,y+h-ry,rx,ry,0,Math.PI/2,Math.PI);p.lineTo(x,y+ry);p.ellipse(x+rx,y+ry,rx,ry,0,Math.PI,Math.PI*1.5);p.closePath()}else p.rect(x,y,w,h);return p}
  return null}
 function walk(el,m,st,ops){for(const n of el.children){const t=n.tagName.toLowerCase();const s={fill:n.getAttribute('fill')??st.fill,stroke:n.getAttribute('stroke')??st.stroke,sw:num(n,'stroke-width',st.sw),
   lc:n.getAttribute('stroke-linecap')??st.lc,lj:n.getAttribute('stroke-linejoin')??st.lj,op:st.op*num(n,'opacity',1)},mm=tf(m,n.getAttribute('transform'));
   if(t==='g'||t==='svg'){walk(n,mm,s,ops);continue}const p=shape(n);if(p)ops.push({m:mm,p,s})}}
 function compile(svg){let c=C.get(svg);if(c)return c;const root=new DOMParser().parseFromString(String(svg),'image/svg+xml').documentElement;
  const vb=String(root.getAttribute('viewBox')||'').split(/[\s,]+/).map(Number);let v=[0,0,num(root,'width',100),num(root,'height',100)];if(vb.length===4&&vb.every(Number.isFinite))v=vb;
  const ops=[];walk(root,new DOMMatrix(),{fill:'#000',stroke:'none',sw:1,lc:'butt',lj:'miter',op:1},ops);c={v,ops};C.set(svg,c);stats.compiled++;return c}
 /* draw the SVG into the box (x, y, w, h) of a 2D context — the viewBox in the middle of the box, as an SVG picture is drawn (xMidYMid meet) */
 function render(g,svg,x,y,w,h){const c=compile(svg),[vx,vy,vw,vh]=c.v,k=Math.min(w/vw,h/vh),ox=x+(w-vw*k)/2,oy=y+(h-vh*k)/2;g.save();g.translate(ox,oy);g.scale(k,k);g.translate(-vx,-vy);const base=g.getTransform(),ga=g.globalAlpha;
  for(const o of c.ops){g.setTransform(base.multiply(o.m));const s=o.s;g.globalAlpha=ga*s.op;if(s.fill&&s.fill!=='none'){g.fillStyle=s.fill;g.fill(o.p)}if(s.stroke&&s.stroke!=='none'&&s.sw>0){g.strokeStyle=s.stroke;g.lineWidth=s.sw;g.lineCap=s.lc||'butt';g.lineJoin=s.lj||'miter';g.stroke(o.p)}}
  g.restore()}
 /* a canvas in place of the old picture: the same SVG at px × (px · h / w) */
 function canvas(svg,px){try{const c=compile(svg),[,,vw,vh]=c.v,W=Math.max(1,Math.round(px||256)),H=Math.max(1,Math.round(W*vh/vw)),cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=W;cv.height=H;render(cv.getContext('2d'),svg,0,0,W,H);cv.__tcSvg=String(svg);stats.canvases++;return cv}catch(e){stats.err=String(e&&e.message||e).slice(0,200);return null}}
 return{compile,render,canvas,stats}})();
// ===== v1.32 · B4 Dense Neighbourhood — foundation (GATE-15). Canonical library assets only. =====
/* ============================================================================================
   BLD40 · the buildings of Turbo City, drawn new for every zone (R-38) — 1.11.2026.
   The bar (the owner, 1.11 01:27): at least the detail of the 29.10 sample (the market with its window full of goods), and the shops far
   beyond it. Nothing is taken from the old buildings or their samples; the plumbing (the projection, the cast-shadow hull, the capped
   picture cache) follows BLD38 so the game's hooks stay the same.

   The view (as the cars, the people and the street kit): world x east, y south, z up, 10 px = 1 m; screen = (x, y − K·z), K = 0.6.
   Seen: every roof (its plan lifted by K·z) and every SOUTH-facing wall (a band K·z tall); east / west walls are edge-on.
   One sun (R-08): a point at height z throws its shadow z·(0.25, 0.32) — 0.41 of the height, toward the south-east.
   Directions (R-10): rot 0 — the front faces south (the camera sees the front); rot 2 — the front faces north (the camera sees the back);
   rot 1 / 3 — the front faces west / east (the camera sees a side). Only the directions a placement asks for are ever drawn.
   R-09: the picture covers the ground north of the footprint up to K × the height — BLD40.band() / BLD40.check() as in BLD38.
   Night: make(id, rot, res, true) — lit windows, lit signs, the shop's inside glowing.

   API   BLD40.make(id, rot, res, night) → {cv, ox, oy, w, h, bytes, H, foot}  ·  BLD40.draw(ctx, x, y, id, rot, res, night)

         BLD40.ready() — true when the brand logos (SVG pictures) are loaded; make() before that draws the sign without the logo.

  /* ---------------- small helpers ---------------- */
  function hx(h) { var n = parseInt(h.slice(1), 16); return [n >> 16, n >> 8 & 255, n & 255]; }
  function toHex(a) { return '#' + a.map(function (v) { v = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(v))); return (v < 16 ? '0' : '') + v.toString(16); }).join(''); }
  function sh(h, f) { var a = hx(h), m = f < 0 ? 0 : 255, k = Math.abs(f); return toHex(a.map(function (v) { return v + (m - v) * k; })); }   // toward white (f > 0) or black (f < 0)
  function mix(a, b, t) { var A = hx(a), B = hx(b); return toHex(A.map(function (v, i) { return v + (B[i] - v) * t; })); }
  function rgba(h, a) { var c = hx(h); return 'rgba(' + c[0] + ',' + c[1] + ',' + c[2] + ',' + a + ')'; }
  function lg(c, x0, y0, x1, y1, s) { var g = c.createLinearGradient(x0, y0, x1, y1); for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) g.addColorStop(i / (s.length - 1), s[i]); return g; }
  function rg(c, x, y, r, s) { var g = c.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) g.addColorStop(i / (s.length - 1), s[i]); return g; }
  function R(c, f, x, y, w, h) { if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return; c.fillStyle = f; c.fillRect(x, y, w, h); }
  function P(c, p, f) { c.beginPath(); for (var i = 0; i < p.length; i++) { if (i) c.lineTo(p[i][0], p[i][1]); else c.moveTo(p[i][0], p[i][1]); } c.closePath(); c.fillStyle = f; c.fill(); }
  function L(c, x0, y0, x1, y1, col, w) { c.strokeStyle = col; c.lineWidth = w || 1; c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(x0, y0); c.lineTo(x1, y1); c.stroke(); }
  function E(c, x, y, rx, ry, f) { c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(x, y, Math.max(rx, .01), Math.max(ry, .01), 0, 0, 6.2832); c.fillStyle = f; c.fill(); }
  function RR(c, x, y, w, h, r, f) { c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(x + r, y); c.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r); c.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r); c.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r); c.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r); c.closePath(); c.fillStyle = f; c.fill(); }
  function hash(i, j, k) { var h = (i * 73856093 ^ j * 19349663 ^ (k || 0) * 83492791) >>> 0; h = Math.imul(h ^ h >>> 15, 2246822507) >>> 0; h = Math.imul(h ^ h >>> 13, 3266489909) >>> 0; return ((h ^ h >>> 16) >>> 0) % 10000 / 10000; }
  function hull(Pt) {
    var p = Pt.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a[0] - b[0] || a[1] - b[1]; }); if (p.length < 3) return p;
    var cr = function (o, a, b) { return (a[0] - o[0]) * (b[1] - o[1]) - (a[1] - o[1]) * (b[0] - o[0]); }, lo = [], up = [], i;
    for (i = 0; i < p.length; i++) { while (lo.length >= 2 && cr(lo[lo.length - 2], lo[lo.length - 1], p[i]) <= 0) lo.pop(); lo.push(p[i]); }
    for (i = p.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { while (up.length >= 2 && cr(up[up.length - 2], up[up.length - 1], p[i]) <= 0) up.pop(); up.push(p[i]); }
    up.pop(); lo.pop(); return lo.concat(up);
  }
  function mk(w, h) { if (typeof OffscreenCanvas !== 'undefined') return new OffscreenCanvas(w, h); var c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h; return c; }
  // the cast shadow of a box (x0, y0)-(x1, y1) of height hz metres on the ground (or on a roof at zb): one shape, added to the current path
  function shadowBox(c, x0, y0, x1, y1, hz, zb) { var d = (hz) * M, o = (zb || 0) * M * K; var p = hull([[x0, y0], [x1, y0], [x1, y1], [x0, y1], [x0 + SX * d, y0 + SY * d], [x1 + SX * d, y0 + SY * d], [x1 + SX * d, y1 + SY * d], [x0 + SX * d, y1 + SY * d]]);
    c.moveTo(p[0][0], p[0][1] - o); for (var i = 1; i < p.length; i++) c.lineTo(p[i][0], p[i][1] - o); c.closePath(); }

  var LOGO = {}, LOGO_N = 0, LOGO_COL = { tools: ['#3f444a', '#f2c230'], fuel: ['#0b2a55', '#f5953a'] };   // bld45: the plate in the brand's two colours
  if (typeof TCSVG !== 'undefined' && typeof document !== 'undefined') Object.keys(LOGO_SVG).forEach(function (k) { var cv = TCSVG.canvas(LOGO_SVG[k], 256); if (cv) { LOGO[k] = cv; LOGO_N++; } });   /* r17 · כלל 17: קנבס מאותו SVG (029z TCSVG), לא תמונה */

  /* ---------------- the wall: F = {x0, x1, yb (the screen line of the wall's foot), h, seed, night} ---------------- */
  function Y(F, z) { return F.yb - z * M * K; }
  var NIGHT_SKY = '#0f1a26';
  // the sky's light on a south wall (the sun is north-west): a gentle vertical gradient, lighter up high
  function wallFill(c, F, x0, x1, z0, z1, col) { var y0 = Y(F, z1), y1 = Y(F, z0); if (F.night) col = mix(col, '#1c2633', .72); R(c, lg(c, 0, y0, 0, y1, [sh(col, .05), col, sh(col, -.06)]), x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0); }
  var MAT = {
    // Jerusalem-like stone: ashlar courses 0.5 m tall, blocks 0.9–1.4 m long, each block its own tone, a fine joint
    stone: function (c, F, x0, x1, z0, z1, col) {
      col = col || '#e3d5b8'; wallFill(c, F, x0, x1, z0, z1, col);
      var ch = .5 * M * K, row = 0;
      for (var y = Y(F, z0); y > Y(F, z1) + .1; y -= ch, row++) {
        var yt = Math.max(Y(F, z1), y - ch), x = x0 - (row % 2) * 6;
        while (x < x1) { var bw = 9 + hash(row, Math.round(x), F.seed) * 6, xa = Math.max(x, x0), xb = Math.min(x + bw, x1), t = hash(Math.round(x), row, 7 + F.seed);
          if (xb > xa) { R(c, F.night ? 'rgba(0,0,0,' + (t * .08).toFixed(3) + ')' : (t > .5 ? 'rgba(255,248,230,' + ((t - .5) * .22).toFixed(3) + ')' : 'rgba(120,96,60,' + ((.5 - t) * .16).toFixed(3) + ')'), xa, yt, xb - xa, y - yt);
            R(c, F.night ? 'rgba(0,0,0,.18)' : 'rgba(140,118,84,.28)', xb - .25, yt, .25, y - yt); }
          x += bw; }
        R(c, F.night ? 'rgba(0,0,0,.2)' : 'rgba(150,126,90,.32)', x0, yt, x1 - x0, .3);
      }
    },
    // smooth render (plaster) with a faint trowel texture
    render: function (c, F, x0, x1, z0, z1, col) { col = col || '#f1eee7'; wallFill(c, F, x0, x1, z0, z1, col);
      for (var i = 0; i < (x1 - x0) * (Y(F, z0) - Y(F, z1)) / 90; i++) { var a = hash(i, F.seed, 3), b = hash(F.seed, i, 5); R(c, a > .5 ? 'rgba(255,255,255,.09)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,.035)', x0 + a * (x1 - x0), Y(F, z1) + b * (Y(F, z0) - Y(F, z1)), 2.2, .5); } },
    // vertical metal cladding panels (the market, the gym)
    metal: function (c, F, x0, x1, z0, z1, col) { col = col || '#c9ced2'; wallFill(c, F, x0, x1, z0, z1, col);
      for (var x = x0; x < x1; x += 3.2) { R(c, F.night ? 'rgba(0,0,0,.15)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.22)', x, Y(F, z1), .9, Y(F, z0) - Y(F, z1)); R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.08)', x + 2.6, Y(F, z1), .5, Y(F, z0) - Y(F, z1)); } },
    // wood-look slats (the clinic's accents)
    wood: function (c, F, x0, x1, z0, z1) { wallFill(c, F, x0, x1, z0, z1, '#a8774a');
      for (var x = x0 + .6; x < x1; x += 1.6) { var t = hash(Math.round(x * 3), 1, F.seed); R(c, F.night ? 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)' : (t > .5 ? 'rgba(255,220,170,.18)' : 'rgba(70,40,15,.18)'), x, Y(F, z1), 1.1, Y(F, z0) - Y(F, z1)); } },
    concrete: function (c, F, x0, x1, z0, z1, col) { col = col || '#d3d1cb'; wallFill(c, F, x0, x1, z0, z1, col);
      for (var x = x0 + 12; x < x1; x += 24) R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.07)', x, Y(F, z1), .5, Y(F, z0) - Y(F, z1));
      for (var z = z0 + 1.2; z < z1; z += 1.2) R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.05)', x0, Y(F, z), x1 - x0, .4); }
  };
  // a horizontal band (a floor slab edge, a cornice) at height z, t metres thick, projecting a little
  function band(c, F, x0, x1, z, t, col) { var y = Y(F, z + t); col = F.night ? mix(col, '#202a36', .7) : col; R(c, col, x0 - .5, y, x1 - x0 + 1, t * M * K); R(c, 'rgba(255,255,255,.35)', x0 - .5, y, x1 - x0 + 1, .45); R(c, 'rgba(10,15,20,.16)', x0, y + t * M * K, x1 - x0, 1.2); }

  /* ---------------- windows, doors and what hangs on a wall ---------------- */
  // glass: the sky's reflection by day (a lighter top, a diagonal streak); by night — lit (warm, a curtain shape) or dark
  function glass(c, F, x, y, w, h, s, o) {
    o = o || {};
    if (F.night) {
      var lit = o.lit != null ? o.lit : s < .62;
      if (lit && o.inside) { o.inside(c, x, y, w, h); R(c, 'rgba(255,236,190,.12)', x, y, w, h); return true; }
      if (lit) { var warm = s < .3 ? ['#ffe2a6', '#f4b860'] : s < .5 ? ['#fff1cf', '#ffd27d'] : ['#e8f2ff', '#bcd2ef'];
        R(c, lg(c, 0, y, 0, y + h, warm), x, y, w, h);
        if (s > .12 && h > 4) { R(c, 'rgba(120,70,30,.28)', x, y, w * (.18 + s * .2), h); }   // a curtain drawn to one side
      } else R(c, lg(c, 0, y, 0, y + h, ['#1d2a38', '#121b26']), x, y, w, h);
      return lit;
    }
    R(c, lg(c, 0, y, 0, y + h, o.tint || ['#b9d3e3', '#6f93ad', '#3e5d76']), x, y, w, h);
    c.save(); c.beginPath(); c.rect(x, y, w, h); c.clip();
    P(c, [[x + w * .15, y], [x + w * .15 + h * .5, y], [x + w * .15 - h * .1, y + h], [x + w * .15 - h * .6, y + h]], 'rgba(255,255,255,.28)');
    P(c, [[x + w * .62, y], [x + w * .62 + h * .18, y], [x + w * .62 - h * .3, y + h], [x + w * .62 - h * .48, y + h]], 'rgba(255,255,255,.13)');
    if (o.inside) o.inside(c, x, y, w, h);
    else if (s > .55 && h > 4) R(c, s > .8 ? 'rgba(240,236,224,.55)' : 'rgba(200,170,140,.4)', x + w * (s > .8 ? .62 : 0), y, w * .38, h);   // a curtain
    c.restore();
    return false;
  }
  // a window on the wall: x, w in px; z0 (the sill) and hz (the height) in metres. o: {frame, shutter (0..1 down), box, sill, ac, plant, seed}
  function win(c, F, x, w, z0, hz, o) {
    o = o || {}; var y0 = Y(F, z0 + hz), h = hz * M * K, s = hash(Math.round(x), Math.round(z0 * 10), F.seed + (o.seed || 0)), fr = o.frame || '#eef0ef';
    R(c, 'rgba(20,24,30,.30)', x - .6, y0 - .6, w + 1.2, h + 1.4);                                   // the reveal (the wall's thickness, in shade)
    R(c, F.night ? '#3a4350' : fr, x, y0, w, h);                                                     // the frame
    var gx = x + .9, gy = y0 + .8, gw = w - 1.8, gh = h - 1.5, lit = false;
    var dn = o.shutter != null ? o.shutter : (s > .7 ? .25 + (s - .7) * 2.2 : s < .08 ? 1 : 0);        // the roller shutter: how far it is down
    if (F.night && !o.noShutter && s > .86) dn = 1;
    if (gh > 0) {
      var panes = o.panes || (w > 14 ? 2 : 1), pw = gw / panes;
      for (var i = 0; i < panes; i++) { var l = glass(c, F, gx + i * pw + (i ? .35 : 0), gy, pw - (i ? .35 : 0), gh, (s + i * .37) % 1, { lit: F.night ? (o.lit != null ? o.lit : s < .62) : null, inside: o.inside }); lit = lit || l; if (i) R(c, F.night ? '#2c343e' : fr, gx + i * pw - .35, gy, .7, gh); }
      if (o.transom && gh > 6) R(c, F.night ? '#2c343e' : fr, gx, gy + gh * .3, gw, .5);
      if (!o.noShutter && dn > 0) {                                                                  // the slats, down from the box
        var sh_ = gh * Math.min(1, dn); R(c, F.night ? '#4b525c' : (o.shutterCol || '#d9dbd8'), gx, gy, gw, sh_);
        for (var yy = gy + .9; yy < gy + sh_; yy += .9) R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.12)', gx, yy, gw, .25);
        R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.18)', gx, gy + sh_ - .3, gw, .3);
      }
    }
    if (!o.noShutter && o.box !== false) { R(c, F.night ? '#3d4550' : (o.boxCol || '#f3f3ef'), x - .4, y0 - 1.8, w + .8, 1.8); R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.12)', x - .4, y0 - .25, w + .8, .25); }   // the shutter box
    if (o.sill !== false) { R(c, F.night ? '#4a5260' : (o.sillCol || '#f6f2e8'), x - 1, y0 + h, w + 2, 1.1); R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.2)', x - .6, y0 + h + 1.1, w + 1.2, .7); }
    if (o.ac && s > .45) acUnit(c, F, x + w * (s > .7 ? .55 : .05), z0 - .75);
    if (o.plant && s > .25 && s < .5) plantPot(c, x + w * .2, y0 + h - .2, s);
    return lit;
  }
  function acUnit(c, F, x, z) { var y = Y(F, z); R(c, 'rgba(10,14,20,.25)', x + .8, y + .8, 8.4, 5.2); R(c, F.night ? '#59616b' : '#ecebe6', x, y, 8.4, 5); R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.1)', x, y + 4.3, 8.4, .7); E(c, x + 2.8, y + 2.5, 2, 1.7, F.night ? '#2e343b' : '#9ea5a9'); E(c, x + 2.8, y + 2.5, .7, .6, '#5d656b'); for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.18)', x + 5.4 + i * .65, y + 1, .3, 3); R(c, '#b9bcbd', x + 8.4, y + 1.5, 1.2, .5); }
  function plantPot(c, x, y, s) { R(c, '#b0643c', x, y - 2, 3.2, 2.2); E(c, x + 1.6, y - 3, 2.6, 2, s > .35 ? '#4f8a3c' : '#6aa04a'); E(c, x + 1, y - 3.6, 1.2, 1, '#86b862'); if (s > .4) E(c, x + 2.3, y - 3.4, .6, .5, '#e65a7a'); }
  function downpipe(c, F, x, z1) { var y0 = Y(F, z1); R(c, F.night ? '#4a5058' : '#c6c9c8', x, y0, 1.2, F.yb - y0); R(c, 'rgba(255,255,255,.4)', x, y0, .4, F.yb - y0); for (var y = y0 + 12; y < F.yb; y += 18) R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)', x - .2, y, 1.6, .5); }
  // a glazed door (or a pair): the frame, the glass, a handle; a canopy above if asked
  function door(c, F, x, w, hz, o) { o = o || {}; var y0 = Y(F, hz), h = hz * M * K;
    R(c, 'rgba(15,20,26,.35)', x - .8, y0 - .8, w + 1.6, h + .8); R(c, o.frame || '#5e676f', x, y0, w, h);
    var n = o.leaves || (w > 14 ? 2 : 1), lw = (w - 1.6) / n;
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { glass(c, F, x + .8 + i * lw + .3, y0 + .8, lw - .6, h - .8, .2 + i * .3, { lit: F.night ? true : null, tint: ['#a8c4d6', '#5f8099', '#2f4a60'], inside: o.inside }); R(c, '#cfd4d6', x + .8 + i * lw + (i ? 1.2 : lw - 2), y0 + h * .45, .7, h * .18); }
    if (o.solid) { R(c, o.solid, x + .8, y0 + .8, w - 1.6, h - .8); for (var j = 0; j < 4; j++) R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.1)', x + .8, y0 + 2 + j * h / 5, w - 1.6, .4); }
    R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.35)', x - .5, F.yb - .6, w + 1, .6);
  }
  // a cantilevered canopy over a door: its top face (the depth d metres toward the camera) and its edge; light under it at night
  function canopy(c, F, x, w, z, d, col, o) { o = o || {}; var y = Y(F, z), dp = d * M;
    if (F.night) R(c, rg(c, x + w / 2, y + 6, w * .7, ['rgba(255,243,196,.45)', 'rgba(255,243,196,0)']), x - w * .3, y, w * 1.6, z * M * K);
    R(c, 'rgba(10,14,20,.22)', x + 2, y + 2, w, Math.min(z * M * K, 10));                            // its shadow on the wall
    if (o.glassTop) { P(c, [[x, y], [x + w, y], [x + w, y + dp - 1.2], [x, y + dp - 1.2]], F.night ? 'rgba(150,180,200,.18)' : 'rgba(205,228,240,.28)'); for (var gi = 1; gi < 6; gi++) R(c, 'rgba(90,100,110,.55)', x + gi * w / 6, y, .4, dp - 1.2); }
    else P(c, [[x, y], [x + w, y], [x + w, y + dp - 1.2], [x, y + dp - 1.2]], F.night ? mix(col, '#1a2230', .6) : sh(col, .08));   // the top, toward the camera
    R(c, F.night ? mix(col, '#1a2230', .5) : sh(col, -.18), x, y + dp - 1.2, w, 1.4);                 // the front edge
    if (o.cables) { L(c, x + 1, y + dp - 1, x + 1, y - 9, '#6d757c', .4); L(c, x + w - 1, y + dp - 1, x + w - 1, y - 9, '#6d757c', .4); }
    if (o.lights) for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) E(c, x + w * (i + .5) / 3, y + dp, .8, .4, F.night ? '#fff3c8' : '#d8dbd8');
  }
  // a balcony: a slab projecting d metres toward the camera at height z, a railing, and life on it
  function balcony(c, F, x, w, z, d, o) {
    o = o || {}; var y = Y(F, z), dp = d * M, s = hash(Math.round(x), Math.round(z * 10), F.seed + 11), rh = 1.05 * M * K;
    R(c, 'rgba(10,15,20,.20)', x, y - 1.2, w, 1.2);                                                  // the wall's shade right above the slab
    P(c, [[x, y], [x + w, y], [x + w, y + dp], [x, y + dp]], F.night ? '#2a313b' : (o.floor || '#d8d2c6'));   // the floor, seen from above
    R(c, F.night ? 'rgba(0,0,0,.2)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,.07)', x, y, w, dp * .35);                          // the inner corner's shade
    // what stands on it (seen from above, before the railing)
    if (s < .3 && w > 18) { R(c, '#c9c2b3', x + w * .55, y + 2, 7, 4.2); E(c, x + w * .55 + 2, y + 5.5, 1.2, .8, '#8b7f6c'); E(c, x + w * .55 + 6, y + 5.5, 1.2, .8, '#8b7f6c'); }   // a table and two chairs
    if (s > .6) { var px = x + 2 + (s - .6) * 10; E(c, px + 2, y + dp - 4, 2.6, 2, '#4f8a3c'); E(c, px + 1.4, y + dp - 4.8, 1.3, 1.1, '#7fb35c'); }   // a big plant
    if (o.laundry !== false && s > .38 && s < .55) {                                                 // the laundry rack, a few clothes
      var lx = x + w * .2, cols = ['#d94f4f', '#3c78c2', '#f2f2f2', '#e8c14f', '#5aa36a'];
      L(c, lx, y - 4.2, lx + 9, y - 4.2, '#9aa0a4', .35); for (var k = 0; k < 4; k++) R(c, cols[(k + Math.round(s * 10)) % 5], lx + .6 + k * 2.2, y - 4.2, 1.6, 2.2 + (k % 2));
    }
    // the slab edge and the railing (glass in a thin frame, or a solid parapet)
    R(c, F.night ? '#3a434e' : (o.edge || '#f4f1ea'), x - .3, y + dp - 1.3, w + .6, 1.6);
    var ry = y + dp - 1.3 - rh;
    if (o.rail === 'solid') { R(c, F.night ? '#363f4a' : (o.railCol || '#f1ede4'), x, ry, w, rh); R(c, 'rgba(255,255,255,.4)', x, ry, w, .5); R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.12)', x, ry + rh - .8, w, .8); }
    else if (o.rail === 'bars') { R(c, F.night ? '#4a525c' : '#59636b', x, ry, w, .55); for (var bx = x + .8; bx < x + w; bx += 1.5) R(c, F.night ? '#3e4650' : '#69737a', bx, ry, .35, rh); }
    else { R(c, F.night ? 'rgba(120,150,180,.18)' : 'rgba(200,225,238,.42)', x, ry, w, rh); R(c, 'rgba(255,255,255,.35)', x, ry, w, .45); R(c, F.night ? '#5a626c' : '#9ba4aa', x, ry - .3, w, .5); L(c, x + w * .3, ry + rh, x + w * .3 + 3, ry, 'rgba(255,255,255,.35)', .5); }
    R(c, 'rgba(10,14,20,.18)', x, y + dp + .3, w, 1.8);                                              // the slab's soffit shade on the wall below
  }

  // a loggia (recessed balcony): in the 3/4 view one sees its floor through the opening, the door at the back, the rail at the facade line
  function loggia(c, F, x, w, z, o) {
    o = o || {}; var hz = o.h || 2.75, y0 = Y(F, z + hz), y1 = Y(F, z), h = y1 - y0, s = hash(Math.round(x), Math.round(z * 10), F.seed + 23), N = F.night;
    R(c, N ? '#151b22' : '#5f6a73', x, y0, w, h);                                                       // the back wall in deep shade
    var lit = N && s < .55;
    R(c, N ? (lit ? lg(c, 0, y0, 0, y0 + h * .5, ['#ffe0a0', '#e9b764']) : '#1d2630') : lg(c, 0, y0, 0, y0 + h * .45, ['#8fb0c4', '#4f6d82']), x + w * .12, y0 + .6, w * .76, h * .42);   // the sliding door's glass, high in the opening
    R(c, N ? '#2a323c' : '#d3cdbf', x, y0 + h * .44, w, h * .56);                                       // the floor, seen from above
    R(c, lg(c, 0, y0, 0, y0 + h * .6, ['rgba(0,0,0,.35)', 'rgba(0,0,0,0)']), x, y0, w, h * .6);          // the soffit's shade
    if (s > .55) { E(c, x + w * (.2 + (s - .55)), y0 + h * .62, 2.4, 1.8, N ? '#24402b' : '#4f8a3c'); E(c, x + w * (.2 + (s - .55)) - .6, y0 + h * .55, 1.2, 1, N ? '#2f5236' : '#7fb35c'); }
    if (s > .2 && s < .4) { R(c, '#c9c2b3', x + w * .55, y0 + h * .5, 6, 3.4); }                       // a small table
    if (o.laundry !== false && s > .4 && s < .55) { var cols = ['#d94f4f', '#3c78c2', '#f2f2f2', '#e8c14f', '#5aa36a']; L(c, x + w * .15, y0 + h * .3, x + w * .6, y0 + h * .3, '#9aa0a4', .35); for (var k = 0; k < 4; k++) R(c, cols[(k + Math.round(s * 10)) % 5], x + w * .17 + k * 2.2, y0 + h * .3, 1.6, 2.2 + (k % 2)); }
    var rh = 1.05 * M * K, ry = y1 - rh;                                                                // the rail on the facade line
    if (o.rail === 'solid') { R(c, N ? '#363f4a' : (o.railCol || '#f3efe6'), x, ry, w, rh); R(c, 'rgba(255,255,255,.45)', x, ry, w, .5); }
    else if (o.rail === 'bars') { R(c, N ? '#4a525c' : '#59636b', x, ry, w, .55); for (var bx = x + .7; bx < x + w; bx += 1.4) R(c, N ? '#3e4650' : '#6b757c', bx, ry, .32, rh); }
    else { R(c, N ? 'rgba(120,150,180,.16)' : 'rgba(205,228,240,.38)', x, ry, w, rh); R(c, N ? '#5a626c' : '#aab3b8', x, ry - .2, w, .55); L(c, x + w * .25, y1, x + w * .25 + 2.6, ry, 'rgba(255,255,255,.4)', .45); }
    R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)', x - .4, y0, .8, h); R(c, 'rgba(255,255,255,.25)', x + w - .4, y0, .8, h);    // the opening's edges
    R(c, N ? '#3a434e' : (o.edge || '#f6f2ea'), x - .6, y1 - .2, w + 1.2, 1.1);                        // the slab edge
  }

  /* ---------------- the roof ---------------- */
  // a flat roof: the membrane, the parapet (seen from above as a rim, its inner face lit), the drains; R = [x0, y0, x1, y1] the footprint
  function flatRoof(c, Rc, h, o) { o = o || {}; var y0 = Rc[1] - h * M * K, w = Rc[2] - Rc[0], d = Rc[3] - Rc[1], N = o.night, col = mix(o.col || '#c9ccc8', '#7f878c', .52);   // bld41: the roof one tone darker than the walls
    o = Object.assign({}, o, { rim: mix(o.rim || '#efede6', '#bdb7aa', .35) });
    R(c, N ? mix(col, '#1a222c', .75) : lg(c, Rc[0], y0, Rc[2], y0 + d, [sh(col, .06), col, sh(col, -.04)]), Rc[0], y0, w, d);
    if (!N) { for (var x = Rc[0] + 18; x < Rc[2] - 2; x += 18) R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.07)', x, y0 + 2, .6, d - 4);      // the membrane's seams
      for (var gi = 0; gi < w * d / 22; gi++) { var gx = Rc[0] + 3 + hash(gi, 7, Rc[0] | 0) * (w - 6), gy = y0 + 3 + hash(gi, 11, Rc[1] | 0) * (d - 6); R(c, gi % 3 ? 'rgba(0,0,0,.09)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.16)', gx, gy, 1, 1); } }   // bld41: the gravel grain
    var pw = o.parapet || 2.2;
    R(c, N ? '#3b4450' : (o.rim || '#efede6'), Rc[0], y0 - 1, w, pw + 1); R(c, N ? '#3b4450' : (o.rim || '#efede6'), Rc[0], y0, pw, d); R(c, N ? '#3b4450' : (o.rim || '#efede6'), Rc[2] - pw, y0, pw, d); R(c, N ? '#353d48' : sh(o.rim || '#efede6', -.06), Rc[0], y0 + d - pw, w, pw);
    R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.10)', Rc[0] + pw, y0 + pw, w - 2 * pw, 1.6); R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.07)', Rc[0] + pw, y0 + pw, 1.4, d - 2 * pw);    // the parapet's shade on the roof (the sun is north-west)
    R(c, N ? 'rgba(255,255,255,.05)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.55)', Rc[0], y0 - 1, w, .6);
    E(c, Rc[0] + pw + 3, y0 + d - pw - 3, 1.2, .8, 'rgba(0,0,0,.35)'); E(c, Rc[2] - pw - 3, y0 + d - pw - 3, 1.2, .8, 'rgba(0,0,0,.35)');
    c.strokeStyle = N ? 'rgba(0,0,0,.5)' : 'rgba(46,52,58,.62)'; c.lineWidth = .9; c.strokeRect(Rc[0] + .45, y0 - .55, w - .9, d - .1);   // bld41: the crisp edge
    return y0;
  }
  function tileRoof(c, Rc, h, rg, N, base0) { var ov = 5, x0 = Rc[0] - ov, x1 = Rc[2] + ov, y0 = Rc[1] - ov - h * M * K, y1 = Rc[3] + ov - h * M * K, r = (y1 - y0) / 2, t = rg * M * K, ym = (y0 + y1) / 2 - t;
    var A = [x0, y0], B = [x1, y0], C = [x1, y1], D = [x0, y1], Pp = [x0 + r, ym], Q = [x1 - r, ym], base = base0 || '#b65f3d', dk = function (col) { return N ? mix(col, '#1b222c', .72) : col; };
    c.save(); c.fillStyle = 'rgba(14,20,28,.22)'; c.fillRect(Rc[0], Rc[3] - h * M * K, Rc[2] - Rc[0], 2.2); c.restore();                     // the eave's shade on the wall below
    var face = function (pts, col, rows) { c.save(); c.beginPath(); pts.forEach(function (p, i) { if (i) c.lineTo(p[0], p[1]); else c.moveTo(p[0], p[1]); }); c.closePath(); c.fillStyle = dk(col); c.fill(); c.clip();
      if (!N) { var ya = Math.min.apply(null, pts.map(function (p) { return p[1]; })), yb = Math.max.apply(null, pts.map(function (p) { return p[1]; })), xa = Math.min.apply(null, pts.map(function (p) { return p[0]; })), xb = Math.max.apply(null, pts.map(function (p) { return p[0]; }));
        if (rows) { var k = 0; for (var y = yb - 2.6; y > ya; y -= 2.6, k++) { R(c, 'rgba(60,20,8,.22)', xa, y, xb - xa, .55); for (var x = xa + (k % 2) * 2.2; x < xb; x += 4.4) R(c, 'rgba(60,20,8,.12)', x, y - 2, .45, 2); R(c, 'rgba(255,220,190,.10)', xa, y - 1.9, xb - xa, .5); } }
        else { for (var x2 = xa + 2.6; x2 < xb; x2 += 2.6) R(c, 'rgba(60,20,8,.16)', x2, ya, .5, yb - ya); } }
      c.restore(); };
    face([A, B, Q, Pp], mix(base, '#e7a27c', .38), 1);       // the north slope, in the sun
    face([A, Pp, D], mix(base, '#e7a27c', .22), 0);          // the west hip, in the sun
    face([B, C, Q], mix(base, '#3a1a0e', .3), 0);            // the east hip, in the shade
    face([D, C, Q, Pp], mix(base, '#3a1a0e', .12), 1);       // the south slope — the one the camera sees most
    L(c, Pp[0], Pp[1], Q[0], Q[1], N ? '#5a4036' : '#e9b597', 1.6); L(c, Pp[0], Pp[1] + .9, Q[0], Q[1] + .9, 'rgba(60,20,8,.35)', .5);   // the ridge cap
    [[A, Pp], [D, Pp], [B, Q], [C, Q]].forEach(function (e) { L(c, e[0][0], e[0][1], e[1][0], e[1][1], N ? '#4f382f' : '#d9987a', .9); });
    L(c, D[0], D[1], C[0], C[1], N ? '#2b2420' : '#6e3420', 1.1); R(c, N ? '#3a3f45' : '#9aa1a6', D[0] + 2, D[1] + .5, C[0] - D[0] - 4, .9);   // the gutter
    c.strokeStyle = N ? 'rgba(0,0,0,.5)' : 'rgba(58,26,14,.55)'; c.lineWidth = .8; c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(A[0], A[1]); c.lineTo(B[0], B[1]); c.lineTo(C[0], C[1]); c.lineTo(D[0], D[1]); c.closePath(); c.stroke();
    var vx = Q[0] - r * .4, vy = (Q[1] + C[1]) / 2; R(c, dk('#8b8f93'), vx, vy - 6, 2.2, 6); R(c, dk('#5f6468'), vx - .4, vy - 6.6, 3, 1);   // a vent pipe
    return ym; }
  // a box standing on the roof (a stair room, a tank, a unit): x, y in world px of its NW corner on the roof plane, w × d px, from z0, hz m tall
  function roofRoomBox(c, x, y, w, d, z0, hz, col, N) { var r = rbox(c, x, y, w, d, z0, hz, col, N);
    R(c, N ? '#3a434e' : sh(col, .14), x, r.top - .8, w, 1.6); R(c, N ? '#3a434e' : sh(col, .14), x, r.top, 1.4, d); R(c, N ? '#3a434e' : sh(col, .14), x + w - 1.4, r.top, 1.4, d);   // its own parapet
    R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.08)', x + 1.4, r.top + .8, w - 2.8, 1.4);
    rbox(c, x + w * .62, y + d * .3, 6, 5, z0 + hz, .7, '#b8bec2', N); E(c, x + w * .62 + 3, y + d * .3 - (z0 + hz + .7) * M * K + 2.5, 1.8, 1.2, N ? '#2a3038' : '#6f787e');   // a vent
    antenna(c, x + w * .25, y + d * .7, z0 + hz, N);
    for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) R(c, N ? '#39414a' : '#e2e0da', x + 6 + i * 1.6, r.face + hz * M * K + 1 + i * 4.2, 9, 3.6);   // the pavers from its door
    return r; }
  function rbox(c, x, y, w, d, z0, hz, col, N, shadowA) {
    var b = y - z0 * M * K, t = y - (z0 + hz) * M * K;
    c.save(); c.fillStyle = 'rgba(14,20,28,' + (shadowA || .22) + ')'; c.beginPath(); shadowBox(c, x, y, x + w, y + d, hz, z0); c.fill(); c.restore();
    R(c, N ? mix(col, '#1a222c', .65) : sh(col, .1), x, t, w, d);                                     // the top
    R(c, N ? mix(col, '#1a222c', .75) : sh(col, -.12), x, t + d, w, hz * M * K);                      // the south face
    R(c, 'rgba(255,255,255,.35)', x, t, w, .5);
    return { top: t, face: t + d, b: b };
  }
  // the solar water heaters (a white tank lying above two tilted collectors) — one per flat, in tidy rows
  function solarHeater(c, x, y, z, N) {
    var b = y - z * M * K;
    c.save(); c.fillStyle = 'rgba(14,20,28,.2)'; c.beginPath(); shadowBox(c, x, y, x + 16, y + 14, 1.6, z); c.fill(); c.restore();

    R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)', x + 1, b + 1.5, 14, 3.4); RR(c, x, b - 1.6, 16, 5.4, 2.6, N ? '#59616b' : lg(c, 0, b - 1.6, 0, b + 3.8, ['#ffffff', '#e4e6e5', '#bfc4c6']));   // the tank
    R(c, N ? '#3c434b' : '#9da3a6', x + 2, b + 3.8, .7, 1.6); R(c, N ? '#3c434b' : '#9da3a6', x + 13.3, b + 3.8, .7, 1.6);
  }
  function antenna(c, x, y, z, N) { var b = y - z * M * K; L(c, x, b, x, b - 16, N ?   function skylight(c, x, y, z, w, d, N) { var b = y - z * M * K; c.save(); c.fillStyle = 'rgba(14,20,28,.15)'; c.beginPath(); shadowBox(c, x, y, x + w, y + d, .5, z); c.fill(); c.restore();

  function pvArray(c, x, y, z, cols, rows, N) { for (var j = 0; j < rows; j++) for (var i = 0; i < cols; i++) { var px = x + i * 11, py = y + j * 9, b = py - z * M * K;

  /* ---------------- on the ground in front (the plot) ---------------- */

  function paving(c, x, y, w, d, N, col) { R(c, N ? '#2b323a' : (col || '#cfcac0'), x, y, w, d); if (!N) { for (var i = x + 6; i < x + w; i += 6) R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.05)', i, y, .35, d); for (var j = y + 6; j < y + d; j += 6) R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.05)', x, j, w, .35); } }

'#2a4630' : '#86c068'); }

  /* ---------------- the brand sign (option ג: the tag, the name in a serif, an orange rule) ---------------- */
  function brandSign(c, F, cx, z, name, key, o) {
    o = o || {}; var y = Y(F, z), fs = o.fs || 12, h = fs * 1.55;
    c.font = '700 ' + fs + 'px ' + SERIF; var tw = c.measureText(name).width, lw = h * .95, w = tw + lw + fs * 1.1, x0 = cx - w / 2, y0 = y - h / 2;
    if (F.night) R(c, rg(c, cx, y, w * .8, ['rgba(120,230,160,.35)', 'rgba(120,230,160,0)']), cx - w, y - h * 2, w * 2, h * 4);
    R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.3)', x0 + 1, y0 + 1.6, w, h);
    RR(c, x0, y0, w, h, 2.2, F.night ? '#26a35c' : '#1e7a42'); R(c, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (F.night ? .25 : .18) + ')', x0 + 1, y0 + .8, w - 2, h * .35);
    R(c, '#f2a33a', x0 + 2, y0 + h - 2.4, w - 4, 1.4);
    c.fillStyle = F.night ? '#ffffff' : '#ffffff'; c.textAlign = 'center'; c.textBaseline = 'middle'; c.direction = 'rtl';
    c.fillText(name, x0 + fs * .45 + tw / 2, y0 + h * .48);
    var lx = x0 + w - lw - fs * .3, ly = y0 + (h - lw) / 2;
    if (LOGO[key]) c.drawImage(LOGO[key], lx, ly, lw, lw); else { RR(c, lx, ly, lw, lw, 2, '#f2a33a'); }
  }
  /* p577 (8): the signs' check — every sign as it is drawn is kept in pixels, and compared with the end of the building's picture */
  var SIGNQA = { on: false, list: [],
    add: function (c, x, y, w, h, t) { try { var m = c.getTransform(), X0 = Math.floor(m.a * x + m.c * y + m.e), Y0 = Math.floor(m.b * x + m.d * y + m.f), W = Math.ceil(w * m.a) + 1, Hh = Math.ceil(h * m.d) + 1;
        var cw = c.canvas.width, chh = c.canvas.height, x0 = Math.max(0, X0), y0 = Math.max(0, Y0), x1 = Math.min(cw, X0 + W), y1 = Math.min(chh, Y0 + Hh);
        if (x1 - x0 < 2 || y1 - y0 < 2) { SIGNQA.list.push({ t: t, clip: true }); return; }
        SIGNQA.list.push({ t: t, r: [x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0], cut: (x0 > X0 || y0 > Y0 || x1 < X0 + W || y1 < Y0 + Hh), d: c.getImageData(x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0).data }); } catch (e) { SIGNQA.list.push({ t: t, err: String(e) }); } },
    check: function (c) { return SIGNQA.list.map(function (s) { if (!s.r) return { t: s.t, f: s.clip ? 1 : 0, clip: !!s.clip, err: s.err || null };
        var d = c.getImageData(s.r[0], s.r[1], s.r[2], s.r[3]).data, n = 0, tot = d.length / 4;
        for (var i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) { if (Math.abs(d[i] - s.d[i]) + Math.abs(d[i + 1] - s.d[i + 1]) + Math.abs(d[i + 2] - s.d[i + 2]) > 60) n++; }
        return { t: s.t, f: +(n / tot).toFixed(3), clip: !!s.cut }; }); } };
  function textSign(c, x, y, t, fs, bg, fg, N, font) { c.font = '700 ' + fs + 'px ' + (font || SANS); var w = c.measureText(t).width + fs; if (bg) { R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.28)', x - w / 2 + .8, y - fs * .75 + 1, w, fs * 1.5); RR(c, x - w / 2, y - fs * .75, w, fs * 1.5, 1.5, N ? sh(bg, .1) : bg); }
    c.fillStyle = fg; c.textAlign = 'center'; c.textBaseline = 'middle'; c.direction = 'rtl'; c.fillText(t, x, y + .3); if (SIGNQA.on) SIGNQA.add(c, x - w / 2, y - fs * .75, w, fs * 1.5, t); return w; }

  /* ---------------- the market's inside, seen through the glass: the back wall of shelves, the aisles' ends, the lights ---------------- */
  var GOODS = ['#e2483d', '#f0b429', '#3f8fd2', '#55a84f', '#f07f2f', '#ffffff', '#9c5bd1', '#e85d9c', '#2fb3a8', '#d9d14a'];
  function marketInside(N) { return function (c, x, y, w, h) {
    R(c, N ? '#fff9ec' : '#f2efe6', x, y, w, h);                                                       // the bright inside
    R(c, N ? 'rgba(255,255,255,.9)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.75)', x, y, w, h * .1);                       // the ceiling's light panels
    for (var lx = x + 3; lx < x + w; lx += 12) R(c, N ? '#ffffff' : '#fdfdfb', lx, y + h * .02, 7, h * .05);
    var sy0 = y + h * .14, sh0 = h * .46;                                                             // the shelves on the back wall: 5 rows of goods
    R(c, '#d8d3c6', x, sy0, w, sh0);
    for (var r = 0; r < 5; r++) { var ry = sy0 + r * sh0 / 5; R(c, '#9aa1a6', x, ry + sh0 / 5 - .6, w, .6);
      for (var gx = x; gx < x + w; gx += 1.6) { var t = hash(Math.round(gx * 2), r, 9); R(c, GOODS[Math.floor(t * GOODS.length)], gx, ry + .4 + (t > .8 ? .5 : 0), 1.3, sh0 / 5 - 1.2 - (t > .8 ? .5 : 0)); } }
    for (var ax = x + 4; ax < x + w - 6; ax += 16) {                                                   // the aisles' end caps toward the window
      var top = y + h * .5, ah = h * .38; R(c, '#c9c3b5', ax, top, 9, ah); R(c, '#e04a3c', ax, top - 2.4, 9, 2.4);

    }
    R(c, 'rgba(60,60,60,.14)', x, y + h * .9, w, h * .1);                                             // the floor
  }; }

  /* ================= the B4 types (bld40-2): the sizes of the lots of exp34/b4/b4_v3.json, as factories ================= */
  function scl(Wp, v, base) { return v * Wp / (base || 320); }     // a position drawn for the original type, moved to a block Wp px wide
  function outOf(x, w, skip) { if (!skip) return x; if (x + w > skip[0] - 6 && x < skip[1] + 6) return (x + w / 2 < (skip[0] + skip[1]) / 2) ? skip[0] - 8 - w : skip[1] + 8; return x; }
  function heaterCols(Wp, gap0, gap1, skip) { var a = []; for (var x = 8; x + 16 <= Wp - 8; x += 23) { if (x + 16 > gap0 && x < gap1) continue; if (skip && x + 16 > skip[0] - 4 && x < skip[1] + 4) continue; a.push(x); } return a; }
  function deck(c, x, y, w, d, N) { R(c, N ? '#3a3430' : '#b78c60', x, y, w, d); for (var j = y + 2; j < y + d; j += 2.4) R(c, N ? 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)' : 'rgba(90,55,25,.22)', x, j, w, .35); }
  function pergola(c, x, y, w, d, z, N) { var b = z * M * K, hz = 2.6, up = hz * M * K, col = N ? '#4a3c30' : '#8d6640';
    c.save(); c.fillStyle = 'rgba(14,20,28,.16)'; for (var i = 0; i <= 6; i++) { var bx = x + i * w / 6; c.fillRect(bx + SX * hz * M, y - b + SY * hz * M, 1.4, d); } c.restore();   // the beams' shadows on the deck
    R(c, col, x - .6, y - b - up, 1.4, up); R(c, col, x + w - .8, y - b - up, 1.4, up); R(c, col, x - .6, y + d - b - up, 1.4, up); R(c, col, x + w - .8, y + d - b - up, 1.4, up);   // the posts
    R(c, sh(col, .1), x - 1, y - b - up - 1, w + 2, 1.4); R(c, sh(col, .1), x - 1, y + d - b - up - 1, w + 2, 1.4);
    for (var k = 0; k <= 6; k++) R(c, col, x + k * w / 6 - .5, y - b - up - 1, 1.1, d + 1.4); }
  function roofPlants(c, x, y, w, d, z, N) { var b = z * M * K; for (var i = 0; i < w / 6; i++) { E(c, x + 3 + i * 6, y - b + 2.5, 2.8, 2.2, N ? '#22392a' : (i % 2 ? '#4d8a3e' : '#61a04a')); E(c, x + 3 + i * 6, y + d - b - 2.5, 2.8, 2.2, N ? '#22392a' : (i % 2 ? '#5f9b48' : '#4d8a3e')); } }

  // ---- the long block, any length: N1 (30 m, stone), N0 (40 m, render over a stone base) ----
  // bld41 (1.11, B3 v5): solar panels on the south slope of a hip roof (the same geometry as tileRoof)
  function pvPanels(c, Rc, h, rg, N) { var ov = 5, x0 = Rc[0] - ov, x1 = Rc[2] + ov, y0 = Rc[1] - ov - h * M * K, y1 = Rc[3] + ov - h * M * K, r = (y1 - y0) / 2, ym = (y0 + y1) / 2 - rg * M * K;
    var ya = ym + (y1 - ym) * .22, yb = y1 - (y1 - ym) * .16, cols = 3, rows = 2, ph = (yb - ya) / rows;
    for (var j = 0; j < rows; j++) { var yy = ya + j * ph, t = (yy - ym) / (y1 - ym), half = (x1 - x0) / 2 - r * (1 - t) - 3, cx = (x0 + x1) / 2, pw = Math.min(9, 2 * half / cols);
      for (var i = 0; i < cols; i++) { var px = cx - cols * pw / 2 + i * pw; R(c, N ? '#1b2533' : '#24364f', px + .4, yy + .4, pw - .8, ph - .9); if (!N) { R(c, 'rgba(160,190,225,.28)', px + .6, yy + .6, pw - 1.2, .6); for (var k = 1; k < 3; k++) R(c, 'rgba(200,215,235,.18)', px + .4 + k * (pw - .8) / 3, yy + .4, .3, ph - .9); } } } }
  // bld41 (1.11, B3 v5): a small private house — 2 floors, the door to one side (o.dl: on the left), a porch roof, a skin and a roof of its own
  function houseType(o) {
    var W = o.W, D = o.D, NF = o.nf || 2, gh = 3.1, fh = 3.05, HH = gh + (NF - 1) * fh, RG = o.flat ? 0 : +(D * .26).toFixed(2), rnd = o.mat === 'render';
    var wallC = o.wall || (rnd ? '#f2ede2' : '#e3d5b6'), shut = o.shut || '#dcdcd6', frame = o.frame || '#eef0ef', dl = !!o.dl, zf = function (f) { return f ? gh + (f - 1) * fh : 0; };
    function mat(c, F, x0, x1, front) { var col = front ? wallC : mix(wallC, '#a89c86', .1);
      if (rnd) { MAT.render(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, col); MAT.stone(c, F, x0, x1, 0, .6, o.plinth || '#c9b993'); band(c, F, x0, x1, .55, .12, '#efe8da'); }
      else MAT.stone(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, col); }
    function mx(Wx, a, w) { return dl ? a : Wx - a - w; }   // a position from the door's side
    return {
      he: o.he, use: 'res', W: W, D: D, floors: NF, gh: gh, fh: fh, q: .45,   // the roof drawn shorter than on the blocks (the owner 09:49: "the roofs a bit too big")
      masses: function () { return o.flat ? [{ x: 0, y: 0, w: W, d: D, h: HH, main: true }] : [{ x: 0, y: 0, w: W, d: D, h: HH, main: true, tile: true, ridge: RG }]; },
      roof: function (c, Rc, h, m, N) {
        if (!o.flat) { tileRoof(c, Rc, h, RG, N, o.roof); if (o.pv) pvPanels(c, Rc, h, RG, N); return; }
        flatRoof(c, Rc, h, { night: N, col: '#d3d2cc', rim: '#f4efe4' }); var X = Rc[0], Yr = Rc[1], wp = Rc[2] - Rc[0], dp = Rc[3] - Rc[1];
        solarHeater(c, X + (dl ? wp - 26 : 8), Yr + Math.min(8, dp * .2), h, N); rbox(c, X + (dl ? 10 : wp - 22), Yr + dp * .6, 11, 8, h, .5, '#b7bdc1', N); },
      wall: function (c, F, m, side) {
        var x0 = F.x0, x1 = F.x1, Wx = x1 - x0, N = F.night, front = side === 'S', wo = { shutterCol: shut, frame: frame };
        mat(c, F, x0, x1, front);
        if (NF > 1) band(c, F, x0, x1, gh - .12, .2, rnd ? '#fbf8f1' : '#efe6d3');
        if (o.flat) band(c, F, x0, x1, F.h - .3, .4, rnd ? '#ffffff' : '#f2ebdc');
        if (side === 'E' || side === 'W') { for (var f = 0; f < NF; f++) win(c, F, x0 + Wx * .5 - 6, 12, zf(f) + 1, 1.3, Object.assign({ seed: f + (side === 'E' ? 3 : 7) }, wo)); downpipe(c, F, side === 'E' ? x1 - 2.2 : x0 + 1, F.h); return; }

        // the front (south) — ground floor: the door, the living-room window, the kitchen window

        door(c, F, dx, dw, 2.1, { solid: N ? '#3a3027' : (o.door || '#7b4b2a') }); R(c, '#d9c58e', dx + (dl ? dw - 2.6 : 1.8), Y(F, 1.05), .8, .8);   // the door and its handle
        canopy(c, F, dx - 3, dw + 6, 2.5, .9, o.porch || '#8a5a3e', {});                                  // the little porch roof

        textSign(c, dx + (dl ? dw + 7.5 : -8.5), Y(F, 1.55), o.no || '5', 2.3, '#2f4a6a', '#ffffff', N);   // the house number
        // the upper floor: two bedroom windows; over the door a small balcony, or a window
        for (var f2 = 1; f2 < NF; f2++) { var z = zf(f2);
          win(c, F, lx + 2, lw - 4, z + .95, 1.4, Object.assign({ panes: 2, seed: 60 + f2, ac: f2 === 1 }, wo)); win(c, F, kx - 1, kw + 2, z + .95, 1.4, Object.assign({ seed: 62 + f2 }, wo));
          if (o.bal) { win(c, F, dx, dw + 1, z + .1, 2.15, Object.assign({ noShutter: false, panes: 1, seed: 64 }, wo)); balcony(c, F, dx - 3, dw + 7, z, .9, { rail: 'bars', laundry: false }); }
          else win(c, F, dx + 1, dw - 1, z + 1.05, 1.25, Object.assign({ seed: 66 + f2 }, wo)); }
        downpipe(c, F, x0 + 1, F.h); downpipe(c, F, x1 - 2.2, F.h);
      },
      ground: function (c, foot, rot, N, ph) { if (rot !== 0) return; var Wf = foot[0], Df = foot[1], dx = dl ? Wf * .09 : Wf - Wf * .09 - 11;
        if (!ph) { paving(c, dx - 3, Df, 17, 7, N, '#d6cfc0'); return; }
        planter(c, dl ? dx + 16 : dx - 20, Df + 6, 14, N); if (o.binStore) { var bx = dl ? Wf - 32 : 2; R(c, N ? '#4a3c30' : '#a78058', bx, Df + 1, 30, 1.2); } else bins(c, dl ? Wf - 30 : 4, Df + 6, N); }
    };
  }
  // bld41 (1.11, B3 v5.1 — the uses table: "a row of terraced houses, its yard and parking behind"): n houses of w metres in one row, 2 floors,
  // one tiled roof; each house its own door, porch roof, number and windows; the party walls as light lines, the doors in alternating colours
  function rowType(o) {
    var n = o.n, uw = o.uw, W = n * uw, D = o.D, gh = 3.1, fh = 3.05, HH = gh + fh, RG = +(D * .26).toFixed(2), doors = ['#7b4b2a', '#41545e', '#5d6b3c', '#8a3b2e'];
    return {
      he: o.he, use: 'res', W: W, D: D, floors: 2, gh: gh, fh: fh, q: .45, units: n,
      masses: function () { return [{ x: 0, y: 0, w: W, d: D, h: HH, main: true, tile: true, ridge: RG }]; },
      roof: function (c, Rc, h, m, N) { tileRoof(c, Rc, h, RG, N, o.roof); },
      wall: function (c, F, m, side) {
        var x0 = F.x0, x1 = F.x1, Wx = x1 - x0, N = F.night, wo = { shutterCol: '#dcdcd6' };
        if (side === 'E' || side === 'W') { MAT.render(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, mix(o.wall, '#a89c86', .1)); for (var f = 0; f < 2; f++) win(c, F, x0 + Wx * .5 - 6, 12, (f ? gh : 0) + 1, 1.3, Object.assign({ seed: f }, wo)); return; }
        MAT.render(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, side === 'S' ? o.wall : mix(o.wall, '#a89c86', .1)); MAT.stone(c, F, x0, x1, 0, .6, '#c9b993'); band(c, F, x0, x1, gh - .12, .2, '#fbf8f1');
        var u = Wx / n;
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { var ux = x0 + i * u;
          if (i) R(c, N ? 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)' : 'rgba(120,105,85,.35)', ux - .4, Y(F, F.h), .8, F.h * M * K);   // the party wall
          if (side !== 'S') { win(c, F, ux + u * .2, u * .26, 1, 1.35, Object.assign({ seed: 20 + i }, wo)); win(c, F, ux + u * .56, u * .26, gh + 1, 1.35, Object.assign({ seed: 30 + i }, wo)); continue; }
          var dx = ux + u * .12, lw = u * .42;
          door(c, F, dx, 10, 2.1, { solid: N ? '#3a3027' : doors[i % doors.length] }); canopy(c, F, dx - 3, 17, 2.5, .9, '#8a5a3e', {});
          textSign(c, dx + 17, Y(F, 1.55), String(o.no0 + 2 * i), 2.3, '#2f4a6a', '#ffffff', N);
          win(c, F, ux + u * .48, lw, .55, 1.8, Object.assign({ panes: 2, seed: 41 + i }, wo));
          win(c, F, dx, 13, gh + .95, 1.4, Object.assign({ seed: 60 + i }, wo)); win(c, F, ux + u * .5, lw - 2, gh + .95, 1.4, Object.assign({ panes: 2, seed: 62 + i, ac: i % 2 === 0 }, wo));
        }
        downpipe(c, F, x0 + 1, F.h); downpipe(c, F, x1 - 2.2, F.h);
      },
      ground: function (c, foot, rot, N, ph) { if (rot !== 0) return; var Wf = foot[0], Df = foot[1], u = Wf / n;
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (!ph) paving(c, i * u + u * .12 - 3, Df, 17, 7, N, '#d6cfc0'); else planter(c, i * u + u * .55, Df + 6, 14, N); } }
    };
  }
  function aptType(o) {
    var W = o.W, D = o.D, Wp = W * M, Dp = D * M, gh = 3.3, fh = 3.15, rr = { x: W / 2 - 2.3, y: D * .44, w: 4.6, d: 4.2 }, skip = o.skip || null, NF = o.nf || 5, HH = gh + (NF - 1) * fh, RG = o.tile ? +(D * .27).toFixed(2) : 0;
    var bays = Math.max(4, Math.round(W / 5.3)); if (bays % 2) bays++;
    var c0 = bays / 2 - 1, c1 = bays / 2, last = bays - 1, zf = function (f) { return f ? gh + (f - 1) * fh : 0; }, rnd = o.mat === 'render';
    function mat(c, F, x0, x1, front) { if (rnd) { MAT.render(c, F, x0, x1, 3.3, F.h, front ? '#f5f2eb' : '#f2efe8'); MAT.stone(c, F, x0, x1, 0, 3.3, '#d9c8a6'); band(c, F, x0, x1, 3.15, .3, '#ffffff'); }
      else { MAT.stone(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, front ? '#e6d8bb' : '#e2d4b6'); R(c, F.night ? '#2e3540' : '#f3efe6', x0, Y(F, .9), x1 - x0, .9 * M * K); } }
    return {
      he: o.he, use: 'res', W: W, D: D, floors: NF, gh: gh, fh: fh,
      masses: function () { return o.tile ? [{ x: 0, y: 0, w: W, d: D, h: HH, main: true, tile: true, ridge: RG }] : [{ x: 0, y: 0, w: W, d: D, h: HH, main: true }, { x: rr.x, y: rr.y, w: rr.w, d: rr.d, h: HH + 2.7, roofRoom: true }]; },
      roof: function (c, Rc, h, m, N) { if (o.tile) { tileRoof(c, Rc, h, RG, N); return; } flatRoof(c, Rc, h, { night: N, col: '#cfd0cb', rim: '#f2ece0' }); var X = Rc[0], Yr = Rc[1], wp = Rc[2] - Rc[0], dp = Rc[3] - Rc[1];
        var cols = heaterCols(wp, wp * .37, wp * .6, skip); for (var i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) for (var r2 = 0; r2 < (dp > 96 ? 2 : 1); r2++) solarHeater(c, X + cols[i], Yr + (dp > 96 ? 14 : 7) + r2 * 26, h, N);
        antenna(c, X + outOf(scl(wp, 120), 4, skip), Yr + dp * .72, h, N); dish(c, X + outOf(scl(wp, 104), 6, skip), Yr + dp * .78, h, N); dish(c, X + outOf(scl(wp, 222), 6, skip), Yr + dp * .81, h, N);
        hvac(c, X + outOf(Math.min(scl(wp, 236), wp - 46), 40, skip), Yr + dp * .64, h, 40, 14, N); rbox(c, X + outOf(scl(wp, 70), 9, skip), Yr + dp * .72, 9, 9, h, .4, '#a9b0b5', N); },
      roofRoom: function (c, x, y, w, d, z0, hz, N) { var r = roofRoomBox(c, x, y, w, d, z0, hz, rnd ? '#f1eee7' : '#ece6d8', N); door(c, { yb: r.face + hz * M * K, night: N, seed: 3 }, x + 8, 10, 2.1, { solid: N ? '#3a414a' : '#8a939a' }); acUnit(c, { yb: r.face + hz * M * K, night: N }, x + 24, 1.2); },
      wall: function (c, F, m, side) {
        var x0 = F.x0, x1 = F.x1, Wx = x1 - x0, N = F.night;
        if (side === 'E' || side === 'W') { mat(c, F, x0, x1, false); for (var f = 0; f < NF; f++) { win(c, F, x0 + 14, 14, zf(f) + .9, 1.45, { ac: true, seed: f }); win(c, F, x1 - 34, 14, zf(f) + .9, 1.45, { seed: f + 9 }); } band(c, F, x0, x1, F.h - .25, .45, '#f4efe4'); return; }
        var front = side === 'S'; mat(c, F, x0, x1, front);
        var bw = Wx / bays;
        for (var f2 = 1; f2 < NF; f2++) band(c, F, x0, x1, zf(f2) - .12, .24, rnd ? '#ffffff' : '#f1ebdf');
        for (var b = 0; b < bays; b++) { var bx = x0 + b * bw;
          for (var f3 = 0; f3 < NF; f3++) { var z0 = zf(f3);
            if (front) {
              if (b === c0 || b === c1) { if (f3 === 0) continue;
                if (b === c0) { win(c, F, bx + bw - 12, 24, z0 + .35, 2.5, { noShutter: true, panes: 2, frame: '#dcd7cb', seed: 70 + f3, lit: N ? true : null }); win(c, F, bx + 6, 12, z0 + .95, 1.45, { ac: true, seed: 50 + f3 }); }
                else win(c, F, bx + bw - 20, 12, z0 + .95, 1.45, { ac: true, seed: 40 + f3 });
                continue; }
              if ((b === 0 || b === last) && f3 > 0) { loggia(c, F, bx + 4, bw - 8, z0, { rail: 'glass' }); continue; }
              win(c, F, bx + 6, bw * .5, z0 + .95, 1.45, { ac: true, plant: true, seed: b * 5 + f3 }); win(c, F, bx + bw * .68, bw * .2, z0 + 1.25, 1.15, { seed: b * 9 + f3, panes: 1 });
            } else {
              if (f3 > 0 && (b === 0 || b === c0 || b === c1 || b === last)) { loggia(c, F, bx + 3, bw - 6, z0, { rail: b % 2 ? 'solid' : 'glass', railCol: rnd ? '#ffffff' : '#efe9dc' }); continue; }
              win(c, F, bx + 7, bw * .42, z0 + .95, 1.45, { ac: true, plant: true, seed: b * 3 + f3 }); win(c, F, bx + bw * .62, bw * .26, z0 + .95, 1.45, { seed: b * 7 + f3 + 1 });
            }
          }
        }
        if (!front) for (var f4 = 1; f4 < NF; f4++) for (var q = 1; q < last; q++) if (q !== c0 && q !== c1 && (q === 1 || q === last - 1 || (q % 2 && bays > 6))) balcony(c, F, x0 + q * bw + 6, bw - 12, zf(f4), .9, { rail: 'bars' });
        if (front) {
          var lx = x0 + c0 * bw + 6, lw = 2 * bw - 12;
          R(c, N ? '#283039' : '#d9d3c4', lx - 2, Y(F, 3.2), lw + 4, 3.2 * M * K);
          win(c, F, lx + 4, lw / 2 - 18, .35, 2.4, { noShutter: true, panes: 2, frame: '#5e676f', lit: true, seed: 5 }); win(c, F, lx + lw / 2 + 14, lw / 2 - 18, .35, 2.4, { noShutter: true, panes: 2, frame: '#5e676f', lit: true, seed: 6 });
          door(c, F, lx + lw / 2 - 10, 20, 2.1, { leaves: 2, inside: function (cc, x, y, w, h) { R(cc, N ? 'rgba(255,240,200,.6)' : 'rgba(220,214,200,.55)', x, y + h * .5, w, h * .5); } });
          canopy(c, F, lx + lw / 2 - 22, 44, 3.05, 1.2, '#6c757c', { glassTop: true, lights: true }); textSign(c, lx + lw / 2 + 28, Y(F, 2.9), o.no || '12', 3.6, '#2f4a6a', '#ffffff', N);
        }
        downpipe(c, F, x0 + 1.5, F.h); downpipe(c, F, x1 - 2.7, F.h); if (!o.tile) band(c, F, x0, x1, F.h - .25, .45, rnd ? '#ffffff' : '#f4efe4');
      },
      ground: function (c, foot, rot, N, ph) { var Wf = foot[0], Df = foot[1], s = function (v) { return scl(Wf, v); };
        if (!ph) { paving(c, 0, Df, Wf, 16, N); return; }
        for (var i = 0; i < Wf / 55; i++) E(c, 14 + i * 55, Df + 24, 6, 3.6, N ? '#22392a' : '#5d9447');
        if (rot === 0) { planter(c, s(100), Df + 13, 24, N); planter(c, s(196), Df + 13, 24, N); bikeRack(c, s(30), Df + 12, 5, N); bins(c, Math.min(s(262), Wf - 30), Df + 13, N); bench(c, s(62), Df + 14, N); }
        else { bench(c, s(120), Df + 13, N); bench(c, s(200), Df + 13, N); tree(c, s(40), Df + 22, 9, N); tree(c, s(280), Df + 22, 10, N); bins(c, s(150), Df + 12, N); }
      }
    };
  }

  // ---- the L (N3): a bar of 5 floors on the south and a wing of 3 floors at its east end, north of it, with a roof terrace ----

  function garageType(o) {
    var W = o.W, D = o.D, H = o.H || 3.4, n = o.n, rnd = o.mat !== 'stone';
    return {
      he: o.he, use: 'res', W: W, D: D, floors: 1, q: .45,
      masses: function () { return [{ x: 0, y: 0, w: W, d: D, h: H, main: true }]; },
      roof: function (c, Rc, h, m, N) { if (o.glass) { c.save(); c.globalAlpha = .34; }   /* citysvc (כלל 15, D‑622): תחנת כיבוי 2 — גג שקוף מעל התאים, הכבאיות נראות */ flatRoof(c, Rc, h, { night: N, col: o.roofCol || '#cfcac0', rim: '#ece6da', parapet: .5 }); if (o.glass) c.restore();
        if (o.pv) pvArray(c, Rc[0] + 8, Rc[1] + 8, h, Math.max(1, Math.floor((Rc[2] - Rc[0] - 16) / 11)), Math.max(1, Math.floor((Rc[3] - Rc[1] - 16) / 9)), N); },
      wall: function (c, F, m, side) { var x0 = F.x0, x1 = F.x1, Wx = x1 - x0, N = F.night, col = side === 'S' ? o.wall : mix(o.wall, '#a89c86', .1);
        if (rnd) MAT.render(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, col); else MAT.stone(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, col);
        band(c, F, x0, x1, F.h - .25, .3, '#fbf8f1');
        if (side !== 'S') { win(c, F, x0 + Wx * .5 - 5, 10, 1.3, .9, { noShutter: true, seed: 3 }); door(c, F, x0 + Wx * .5 + 9, 10, 2.1, { frame: '#3d464d' }); return; }   /* p493: דלת להולכי רגל */
        if (o.sign) textSign(c, x0 + Wx * .5, Y(F, H - .5), o.sign, 2.4, o.signBg || '#1f4f7a', '#ffffff', N);
        var dw = o.dw || 26, gap = (Wx - n * dw) / (n + 1), hz = o.hz || 2.3, hp = hz * M * K;   // bld44: שערים גבוהים לכבאיות
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { var bx = x0 + gap + i * (dw + gap);

          R(c, N ? '#4b545e' : (o.door || '#c9ccc9'), bx, Y(F, hz), dw, hp);
          for (var k = 1; k < 8; k++) R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.13)', bx, Y(F, hz) + k * hp / 8, dw, .35);
          if (N) R(c, 'rgba(255,236,190,.18)', bx, Y(F, .4), dw, .4 * M * K); }
        R(c, N ? '#fff3c4' : '#d8d4c8', x0 + Wx - 6, Y(F, 2.6), 1.2, 1.5); },
      ground: function (c, foot, rot, N, ph) { if (rot !== 0 || ph) return; paving(c, 0, foot[1], foot[0], 12, N, '#cfc8ba'); }
    };
  }

  // ====== bld45 (2.11 · C4 ו-D4): התעשייה, הלוגיסטיקה, תחנת הכיבוי 2, ארגז הכלים ודלק טורבו 2 ======
  // the brand plate in the brand's own colours (brandSign is the market's green one): the logo at the right, the name in Hebrew
  function brandPlate(c, F, cx, z, name, key, o) {
    o = o || {}; var y = Y(F, z), fs = o.fs || 9, h = fs * 1.6, col = LOGO_COL[key] || ['#2f363c', '#ffffff'];
    c.font = '800 ' + fs + 'px ' + SANS; var tw = c.measureText(name).width, lw = h * .92, w = tw + lw + fs * 1.2, x0 = cx - w / 2, y0 = y - h / 2;
    if (F.night) R(c, rg(c, cx, y, w * .8, ['rgba(255,236,190,.32)', 'rgba(255,236,190,0)']), cx - w, y - h * 2, w * 2, h * 4);
    R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.3)', x0 + 1, y0 + 1.4, w, h);
    RR(c, x0, y0, w, h, 2, F.night ? sh(col[0], .12) : col[0]); R(c, 'rgba(255,255,255,.14)', x0 + 1, y0 + .8, w - 2, h * .3);
    R(c, col[1], x0 + 2, y0 + h - 2.2, w - 4, 1.2);
    c.fillStyle = col[1]; c.textAlign = 'center'; c.textBaseline = 'middle'; c.direction = 'rtl'; c.fillText(name, x0 + fs * .5 + tw / 2, y0 + h * .5);
    var lx = x0 + w - lw - fs * .25, ly = y0 + (h - lw) / 2;
    if (LOGO[key]) c.drawImage(LOGO[key], lx, ly, lw, lw); else { E(c, lx + lw / 2, ly + lw / 2, lw / 2, lw / 2, col[1]); }
  }
  // the dock door of a warehouse: the black seal, the sectional door (its bottom at the platform, 1.2 m), the two bumpers, the yellow edge, the dock light
  function dockDoor(c, F, x, w, open, N) {
    var z0 = 1.2, zt = 4.0, y0 = Y(F, zt + .25), y1 = Y(F, 0);
    R(c, N ? '#0e1114' : '#1d2125', x - 2.2, y0, w + 4.4, Y(F, z0 - .1) - y0);                                 // the seal around the door
    if (open) { R(c, N ? '#2a2318' : '#3a342b', x, Y(F, zt), w, (zt - z0) * M * K); R(c, N ? 'rgba(255,214,140,.5)' : 'rgba(255,214,140,.18)', x + 2, Y(F, zt - .4), w - 4, (zt - z0 - .6) * M * K); }   // open: the lit inside
    else { R(c, N ? '#4c545c' : '#c4c9cc', x, Y(F, zt), w, (zt - z0) * M * K); for (var k = 1; k < 7; k++) R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.14)', x, Y(F, zt) + k * (zt - z0) * M * K / 7, w, .4); }
    R(c, '#2a2d30', x + 2, Y(F, z0 - .1), 3, .5 * M * K); R(c, '#2a2d30', x + w - 5, Y(F, z0 - .1), 3, .5 * M * K);      // the rubber bumpers
    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) { R(c, i % 2 ? '#1d1f22' : '#f2c230', x - 2.2, Y(F, z0) + i * 1.1, 1.4, 1.1); R(c, i % 2 ? '#1d1f22' : '#f2c230', x + w + .8, Y(F, z0) + i * 1.1, 1.4, 1.1); }
    R(c, '#6b7176', x - .5, Y(F, z0), w + 1, .8);                                                                   // the leveler's lip
    R(c, N ? '#ffe9a8' : '#9aa1a6', x + w / 2 - 1.5, Y(F, zt + .6), 3, 1.2);                                      // the dock light
  }
  function hazardStripe(c, F, x0, x1, z) { for (var x = x0; x < x1; x += 4) R(c, ((x - x0) / 4) % 2 < 1 ? '#f2c230' : '#2a2d30', x, Y(F, z + .35), 4, .35 * M * K); }
  function whType(o) {
    var W = o.W, D = o.D, H = o.H || 8;
    return {
      he: o.he, use: 'work', W: W, D: D, floors: 1, q: .45,
      masses: function () { return [{ x: 0, y: 0, w: W, d: D, h: H, main: true }]; },
      roof: function (c, Rc, h, m, N) { flatRoof(c, Rc, h, { night: N, col: o.roofCol || '#c3c8cb', rim: '#e6e9ea', parapet: .4 });
        var y0 = Rc[1] - h * M * K, d = Rc[3] - Rc[1];
        for (var x = Rc[0] + 16; x < Rc[2] - 14; x += 34) { R(c, N ? 'rgba(255,230,170,.18)' : 'rgba(176,206,222,.75)', x, y0 + 7, 7, d - 14); R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.12)', x + 7, y0 + 7, 1, d - 14); }   // the skylight strips
        if (W > 25) { hvac(c, Rc[2] - 34, Rc[1] + 10, h, 18, 10, N); hvac(c, Rc[0] + 22, Rc[3] - 22, h, 14, 9, N); } },
      wall: function (c, F, m, side) { var x0 = F.x0, x1 = F.x1, Wx = x1 - x0, N = F.night;
        MAT.metal(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, side === 'S' ? (o.wall || '#d8dde0') : mix(o.wall || '#d8dde0', '#8f979c', .14));
        R(c, N ? '#545b62' : '#a7adb1', x0, Y(F, 1.0), Wx, 1.0 * M * K);                                           // the concrete plinth
        band(c, F, x0, x1, F.h - .9, .6, o.accent || '#2f5f9e');
        if (side !== 'S') { for (var x = x0 + 10; x < x1 - 18; x += 26) win(c, F, x, 14, F.h - 2.6, 1.0, { noShutter: true, panes: 3, frame: '#59636b', seed: 21 });
          if (o.sign && Wx > 70) textSign(c, x0 + Wx * .5, Y(F, F.h - 1.9), o.sign, 5.5, o.signBg || '#2f5f9e', '#ffffff', N); return; }   // the name on the side the camera sees too
        var n = o.docks || 0, dw = o.dw || 30, pitch = o.pitch || 55, span = n * dw + (n - 1) * (pitch - dw), sx = o.dockFrom != null ? x0 + o.dockFrom : x0 + (Wx - span) / 2;
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) dockDoor(c, F, sx + i * pitch, dw, (o.open || []).indexOf(i) >= 0, N);
        if (o.roller) { var rx = o.roller < 0 ? x1 + o.roller : x0 + o.roller; R(c, N ? '#1d232a' : '#4a4f55', rx - 1, Y(F, 4.6), 42, 4.6 * M * K); R(c, N ? '#4b545e' : '#bfc5c9', rx, Y(F, 4.5), 40, 4.5 * M * K);
          for (var k = 1; k < 10; k++) R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.12)', rx, Y(F, 4.5) + k * 4.5 * M * K / 10, 40, .35); hazardStripe(c, F, rx - 1, rx + 41, 0); }
        var px = o.pdoor != null ? (o.pdoor < 0 ? x1 + o.pdoor : x0 + o.pdoor) : x1 - 18;
        door(c, F, px, 10, 2.1, { frame: '#3d464d', solid: o.pdoorSolid ? '#6f7f8c' : null }); canopy(c, F, px - 3, 15, 2.8, .9, '#3d464d', {});
        if (o.office) { var ox = px < x0 + Wx / 2 ? px + 14 : px - 46; win(c, F, ox, 34, 1.2, 2.2, { noShutter: true, panes: 4, frame: '#2f363c', seed: 5, lit: N ? true : null }); win(c, F, ox, 34, 4.4, 2.2, { noShutter: true, panes: 4, frame: '#2f363c', seed: 6, lit: N ? true : null }); }
        if (o.key) brandPlate(c, F, x0 + Wx * (o.signAt || .5), F.h - 1.9, o.sign, o.key, { fs: o.fs || 8 });
        else if (o.sign) textSign(c, x0 + Wx * (o.signAt || .5), Y(F, F.h - 1.9), o.sign, o.fs || 6.5, o.signBg || '#2f5f9e', '#ffffff', N); },
      ground: function (c, foot, rot, N, ph) { }
    };
  }

  /* ---------------- the model, the drawing order, the picture ---------------- */
  function rotRect(r, W, D, m) { var x = m.x, y = m.y, w = m.w, d = m.d, Q;
    if (r === 0) Q = [x, y, w, d]; else if (r === 2) Q = [W - x - w, D - y - d, w, d]; else if (r === 1) Q = [D - y - d, x, d, w]; else Q = [y, W - x - w, d, w];
    return [Q[0] * M, Q[1] * M, (Q[0] + Q[2]) * M, (Q[1] + Q[3]) * M]; }
  var SIDE = ['S', 'E', 'N', 'W'];   // the mass's own side that faces the world's south, for rot 0..3
  function model(id, rot) { var T = TYPES[id]; if (!T) throw new Error('BLD40: unknown type ' + id);
    var ms = T.masses().map(function (m, i) { return Object.assign({ i: i, R: rotRect(rot, T.W, T.D, m) }, m); });
    var fw = rot & 1 ? T.D : T.W, fd = rot & 1 ? T.W : T.D, H = Math.max.apply(null, ms.map(function (m) { return m.h + (m.ridge || 0); }));
    var q = T.q || API.Q, yS = fd * M; ms.forEach(function (m) { m.R = [m.R[0], yS - q * (yS - m.R[1]), m.R[2], yS - q * (yS - m.R[3])]; }); QY = q;   /* bld41: the roof depth × Q */
    return { T: T, rot: rot, ms: ms, foot: [fw * M, fd * M], H: H }; }
  function render(c, Mo, N) {
    var T = Mo.T, rot = Mo.rot, side = SIDE[rot];
    if (T.ground) T.ground(c, Mo.foot, rot, N, 0);
    c.save(); c.fillStyle = N ? 'rgba(4,8,14,.25)' : 'rgba(14,20,28,.30)'; c.beginPath();                // the cast shadows of every mass, one pass
    Mo.ms.forEach(function (m) { if (!m.roofRoom) shadowBox(c, m.R[0], m.R[1], m.R[2], m.R[3], m.h + (m.ridge || 0) * .6, 0); }); c.fill('nonzero'); c.restore();
    var host = Mo.ms.filter(function (m) { return m.main; })[0] || Mo.ms[0];
    Mo.ms.filter(function (m) { return !m.roofRoom; }).sort(function (a, b) { return a.R[3] - b.R[3] || a.h - b.h; }).forEach(function (m) {
      var Rc = m.R, F = { x0: Rc[0], x1: Rc[2], yb: Rc[3], h: m.h, seed: m.i * 7 + rot + 1, night: N };
      if (m.tile) { T.wall(c, F, m, side); T.roof(c, Rc, m.h, m, N); } else { T.roof(c, Rc, m.h, m, N); T.wall(c, F, m, side); }
      R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)', Rc[0], F.yb - .8, Rc[2] - Rc[0], .8);
    });
    Mo.ms.filter(function (m) { return m.roofRoom; }).forEach(function (m) { var Rc = m.R; T.roofRoom(c, Rc[0], Rc[1], Rc[2] - Rc[0], Rc[3] - Rc[1], host.h, m.h - host.h, N); });
    if (T.ground) T.ground(c, Mo.foot, rot, N, 1);
  }
  function extents(Mo) { var x0 = -8, y0 = 0, x1 = Mo.foot[0] + 8, y1 = Mo.foot[1] + 40;
    Mo.ms.forEach(function (m) { var Rc = m.R, hz = (m.h + (m.ridge || 0) + 3) * M; y0 = Math.min(y0, Rc[1] - hz * K - 18); x1 = Math.max(x1, Rc[2] + SX * m.h * M + 6); y1 = Math.max(y1, Rc[3] + SY * m.h * M + 6); });
    return [Math.floor(x0), Math.floor(y0), Math.ceil(x1), Math.ceil(y1)]; }
  var CACHE = new Map(), BYTES = 0, STATS = { made: 0, ms: 0, evicted: 0 }, QY = 1;
  function qy(y, Df) { return y >= Df ? y : Df - QY * (Df - y); }   // bld41: a ground point inside the footprint, drawn with the building's depth
  function cacheGet(k) { var e = CACHE.get(k); if (e) { CACHE.delete(k); CACHE.set(k, e); } return e; }
  function cachePut(k, e) { CACHE.set(k, e); BYTES += e.bytes; var cap = API.budgetMB * 1048576; while (BYTES > cap && CACHE.size > 1) { var k0 = CACHE.keys().next().value; if (k0 === k) break; BYTES -= CACHE.get(k0).bytes; CACHE.delete(k0); STATS.evicted++; } }
  var API = {
    version: VERSION, K: K, SUN: { x: SX, y: SY }, budgetMB: 24, skyLit: false, Q: .55,

    info: function (id) { var Mo = model(id, 0); return { id: id, he: Mo.T.he, W: Mo.T.W, D: Mo.T.D, H: Mo.H, floors: Mo.T.floors }; },
    ready: function () { return LOGO_N >= Object.keys(LOGO_SVG).length; },

      var t0 = (typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : 0), Mo = model(id, rot), X = extents(Mo), w = X[2] - X[0], h = X[3] - X[1];

      e = { cv: cv, ox: -X[0], oy: -X[1], w: w, h: h, res: res, bytes: cv.width * cv.height * 4, H: Mo.H, foot: Mo.foot };
      STATS.made++; STATS.ms += (typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : 0) - t0; cachePut(key, e); return e;
    },
    draw: function (ctx, x, y, id, rot, res, night) { var e = API.make(id, rot, res, night); ctx.drawImage(e.cv, x - e.ox, y - e.oy, e.w, e.h); return e; },
    /* p577 (8): every sign of the given buildings (by type and rotation), day and night — the share of its pixels drawn over after it */
    signAudit: function (list) { var out = [];
      (list || []).forEach(function (q) { [false, true].forEach(function (N) { try { var Mo = model(q.type, q.rot | 0), X = extents(Mo), w = X[2] - X[0], h = X[3] - X[1], cv = mk(Math.ceil(w * 2), Math.ceil(h * 2)), c = cv.getContext('2d');
          c.setTransform(2, 0, 0, 2, -X[0] * 2, -X[1] * 2); SIGNQA.list = []; SIGNQA.on = true; render(c, Mo, N); SIGNQA.on = false;
          SIGNQA.check(c).forEach(function (s) { out.push({ id: q.id, zone: q.zone, type: q.type, rot: q.rot | 0, night: N ? 1 : 0, sign: s.t, hidden: s.f, clip: s.clip }); }); SIGNQA.list = [];
        } catch (e) { SIGNQA.on = false; out.push({ id: q.id, zone: q.zone, type: q.type, err: String(e && e.message || e) }); } }); });
      return out; },
    band: function (id, rot) { var Mo = model(id, rot | 0), d = Math.max.apply(null, Mo.ms.map(function (m) { return K * (m.h + (m.ridge || 0)) * M + 5 - m.R[1]; }));   /* bld41: the ridge and the overhang */ return [0, -d, Mo.foot[0], d]; },
    check: function (id, rot, x, y, rects) { var b = API.band(id, rot), B = [x + b[0], y + b[1], b[2], b[3]], hits = [];
      (rects || []).forEach(function (r) { if (r.x < B[0] + B[2] && r.x + r.w > B[0] && r.y < B[1] + B[3] && r.y + r.h > B[1]) hits.push(r.id || r.kind || '?'); });
      return { ok: !hits.length, band: B, hits: hits }; },
    stats: function () { return { pictures: CACHE.size, MB: +(BYTES / 1048576).toFixed(2), made: STATS.made, ms: +STATS.ms.toFixed(1), evicted: STATS.evicted, budgetMB: API.budgetMB }; },
    clear: function () { CACHE.clear(); BYTES = 0; }
  };
  (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis).BLD40 = API;

   wall and gate, the helipad (L7–L8) — and what moves there (D‑339): the pools' water, the gardener's mower, the gate that opens for the
   player's car, the helicopter's rotor. ground(ctx, D, N) under the buildings; live(ctx, D, now, N) every frame. */
(function () {
  function disc(ctx, x, y, r, c) { ctx.fillStyle = c; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill(); }
  function pools(D) { return (D.pools || []).concat(D.lvPool ? [D.lvPool] : []); }

    var T = D.turn;
    if (T) { var x = T.c[0], y = T.c[1];
      disc(ctx, x, y, T.r, '#cdc8bc'); disc(ctx, x, y, T.ra, '#4b5057');
      ctx.fillStyle = '#4b5057'; ctx.fillRect(3062, 2230, 96, 110);                                  // v2 (the owner 14:57): the street runs into the circle — no sidewalk across its mouth

  // p540 (הבעלים 10:36 — "המנגל צריך שילך ויחזור מהבית ישים דברים יוריד"): the barbecue of C3-V2 as a story of 5.5 min — out of the side door

  function bbqU(t) { return ((t % BBQT) + BBQT) % BBQT; }
  function bbqState(u) { var sm = function (v) { v = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v)); return v * v * (3 - 2 * v); }, D0 = BBQ.door, T0 = BBQ.table, G0 = BBQ.grill;
    var go = function (a, b, f, act, hold) { var g = sm(f), L = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]); return { x: a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * g, y: a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * g, h: Math.atan2(b[1] - a[1], b[0] - a[0]), act: act, d: L * g, hold: hold }; };

    var s = { p: null, lid: 0, fire: 0, meat: 0, tray: 0, tongs: 0 };
    if (u < 6) s.p = go(D0, T0, u / 6, 'carry', 'tray');
    else if (u < 9) { s.p = at(T0, -Math.PI / 2, u < 7.5 ? 'tray' : null); s.tray = u < 7.5 ? 0 : 1; }
    else if (u < 11) { s.p = go(T0, G0, (u - 9) / 2, 'walk'); s.tray = 1; }
    else if (u < 113) { s.p = at(G0, -Math.PI / 4 + (u > 18 ? .35 * Math.sin(u * .21) : 0), null); s.lid = u < 12 ? u - 11 : 1; s.tray = u < 16.5 ? 1 : 3; s.tongs = 1;
      s.fire = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (u - 12.5) / 10)); s.meat = u < 16.5 ? 0 : u < 110 ? 1 + Math.min(1, (u - 16.5) / 90) : 0; if (u >= 110) s.tray = 2; }
    else if (u < 116) { s.p = at(G0, -Math.PI / 4, null); s.lid = 1 - (u - 113) / 3; s.tray = 2; s.tongs = 1; }

    else if (u < 124) { s.p = go(T0, D0, (u - 118) / 6, 'carry', 'food'); s.tongs = 1; }
    else if (u < 140) { s.tongs = 1; }

    return s; }

/* p545 (the owner 2.11 18:24 — the C3 upgrade): the helicopter of villa 4 takes off and lands now and then; a man washes his car with a water jet;
