// the asset at the airport scale (as aptBuildSpec: APT_GS / res) — any type, also the ones without a spec entry yet (LG, HC)
function g77AcInfo(id){const C=g77AcInfo.c||(g77AcInfo.c={});if(C[id])return C[id];const a=TurboCity.get(id);if(!a)return null;const sc=APT_GS/(a.res||1),I=TurboCity.info(id,{scale:sc,rot:0}),an={};for(const q of I.an)if(an[q[0]]===undefined)an[q[0]]=[q[1],q[2]];return C[id]={sc,w:I.w,h:I.h,fp:I.fp,an}}
// the anchors of a type, relative to the nose gear: [forward (+ towards the nose), lateral (+ right)] — the frame of apttAcGeom
function g77Anchors(id){const C=g77Anchors.c||(g77Anchors.c={});if(C[id])return C[id];const S=g77AcInfo(id),D=G77_ANCH_DEF[id];if(!S||!D)return null;
 const fp=S.fp,L=fp[2],fw=fp[3],nx=fp[0]+L,cy=fp[1]+fw/2,an=S.an,ng=an['Nose Gear']||[fp[0]+L*.83,cy],rel=(x,y)=>[+(x-ng[0]).toFixed(1),+(y-ng[1]).toFixed(1)],at=(u,s,k=1)=>rel(nx-u*L,cy+s*k*fw/2),out={};
 for(const [n,u,s] of D.doors)out[n]=at(u,s,s?1:0);
 for(const [n,u,s] of D.belly)out[n]=at(u,s,.92);
 if(D.gpu!==false)out['Ground Power']=at(D.gpu,1,.35);if(D.water!==false)out['Water']=at(D.water,1,.45);if(D.waste!==false)out['Waste']=at(D.waste,1,.45);
 const tL=an['Left Wing'],tR=an['Right Wing'],mg=an['Main Gear'];
 if(tL&&tR&&mg&&!/AC-HL/.test(id)){out['Fuel L']=rel(mg[0]+(tL[0]-mg[0])*D.fuel,cy+(tL[1]-cy)*D.fuel);out['Fuel R']=rel(mg[0]+(tR[0]-mg[0])*D.fuel,cy+(tR[1]-cy)*D.fuel)}
 else out['Fuel']=at(D.fuel,1,1);
 out['Nose Gear']=[0,0];out._L=+L.toFixed(1);out._fw=+fw.toFixed(1);out._span=tL&&tR?+(tR[1]-tL[1]).toFixed(1):null;out._nose=+(nx-ng[0]).toFixed(1);out._tail=+(fp[0]-ng[0]).toFixed(1);
 return C[id]=out}
// the anchors' audit: on the fuselage skin (doors), inside the footprint, L / R mirrored, the bridge door (L1) = the sim's Door
function g77AnchorAudit(){const issues=[];let n=0;for(const id of Object.keys(G77_ANCH_DEF)){const A=g77Anchors(id),S=g77AcInfo(id);if(!A||!S){issues.push(id+' missing');continue}
  const hw=A._fw/2,ng=S.an['Nose Gear'];
  for(const [k,p] of Object.entries(A)){if(k[0]==='_')continue;n++;if(p[0]>A._nose+.5||p[0]<A._tail-.5)issues.push(id+' '+k+' off the fuselage length');
   if(/^Door|Cargo Door|Crew Door/.test(k)&&k!=='Nose Cargo Door'&&Math.abs(Math.abs(p[1])-hw)>.6)issues.push(id+' '+k+' not on the skin');
   if(/Fuel/.test(k)&&A._span&&Math.abs(p[1])>A._span/2)issues.push(id+' '+k+' outside the wing')}
  for(const [k,p] of Object.entries(A)){const m=k.match(/^Door L(\d)$/);if(m){const q=A['Door R'+m[1]];if(q&&Math.abs(q[0]-p[0])>A._L*.06)issues.push(id+' Door L/R'+m[1]+' not abreast')}}
  const d=S.an['Door'];if(d&&ng){const L1=A['Door L1']||A['Main Deck Cargo Door'];if(L1&&Math.hypot(L1[0]-(d[0]-ng[0]),L1[1]-(d[1]-ng[1]))>1.2)issues.push(id+' L1 ≠ the sim Door')}}
 return{ok:!issues.length,types:Object.keys(G77_ANCH_DEF).length,anchors:n,issues:issues.slice(0,12)}}
// ==== D-60 — the clearance check from the code =============================================================================================
function g77GeomAny(id){const S=g77AcInfo(id);if(!S)return null;const a=S.an,ng=a['Nose Gear'],fp=S.fp,tL=a['Left Wing'],tR=a['Right Wing'],tl=a['Tail'],nose=a['Nose'];
 return{F:[fp[0]-ng[0],fp[0]+fp[2]-ng[0],fp[1]-ng[1],fp[1]+fp[3]-ng[1]],half:tL&&tR?(tR[1]-tL[1])/2:fp[3]/2,wx:tL?tL[0]-ng[0]:0,nose:nose?nose[0]-ng[0]:fp[0]+fp[2]-ng[0],tail:tl?tl[0]-ng[0]:fp[0]-ng[0],L:fp[2],fw:fp[3]}}
// a parked aircraft heading south (th +π/2: the nose to +y): boxes in world coords — fuselage, full wing span band, tail
function g77ParkBoxes(id,cx,ngy){const g=g77GeomAny(id);if(!g)return null;const hwW=g.half,wy=ngy+g.wx;

// audit of the Ramp Services Park East: bays on the apron paving, south of the service-road band, clear (≥6 px) of every bridge-stand aircraft
// shape, of the GLN lane body and of the P4 push-back sweep; every chore stop is inside a bay that accepts the vehicle, and the vehicle fits
function goRspAudit(){
 const issues=[],A=aptReady(),R=RSP_E,rects=R.bays.map(rspBayRect),obb=r=>apttObb((r.x0+r.x1)/2,(r.y0+r.y1)/2,0,[-(r.x1-r.x0)/2,(r.x1-r.x0)/2,-(r.y1-r.y0)/2,(r.y1-r.y0)/2],'V',r.id);
 const AP=APT_APRON;
 for(const r of rects){
  {const Yd=G77_YARD;if(r.x0<Yd.x0||r.x1>Yd.x1||r.y0<Yd.y0||r.y1>Yd.y1)issues.push(r.id+':off-yard')}   // GATE-77 S5c: the yard beside the tower
  if(r.y1>RSP_E.lane-10.5-6)issues.push(r.id+':yard-lane');if(r.x1>AF.GLN-11-6)issues.push(r.id+':gln-lane');
  for(const b of F2_RAMP_C.bays.filter(b=>b.kind==='AB')){const y0=G77_YARD.busYc-41,y1=G77_YARD.busYc+41;if(r.x0<b.x+b.w/2&&r.x1>b.x-b.w/2&&r.y0<y1+6&&r.y1>y0-6)issues.push(r.id+':bus-bay '+b.id)}
  for(const s of A.stands.filter(s=>s.tpl==='bridge'))for(const ac of s.accepts)for(const e of aplEnv(ac,s.ngx,s.ngy,s.th))if(e.L!=='W'&&apttObbHit(obb(r),e,6))issues.push(r.id+':stand '+s.id+'/'+ac.slice(3,5));
  // push-back sweep of P4 (every accepted type): fuselage and tail boxes never touch a bay (vehicles may stand under a wing, never under a fuselage)
  const pL=A.stands.find(s=>s.id==='P4');if(pL)for(const ac of pL.accepts){const D=aoDepLegs(pL,ac),P=D.push,g=apttAcGeom(ac);if(!P)continue;for(let t=0;t<=P.dur;t+=.5){const p=P.pose(t);for(const box of[g.F,g.T])if(apttObbHit(obb(r),apttObb(p[0],p[1],p[2],box,'F',ac),6)){issues.push(r.id+':P4-push-sweep '+ac.slice(3,5)+'@'+t.toFixed(1));break}}}
 }
 for(let i=0;i<rects.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<rects.length;j++)if(rects[i].x0<rects[j].x1&&rects[i].x1>rects[j].x0&&rects[i].y0<rects[j].y1+8&&rects[i].y1>rects[j].y0-8)issues.push('bays-too-close');
 for(const type of(RSP_E.bays.length?['SH','MX']:[])){const v={type};const D=afChoreDest(v,0);if(!D){issues.push(type+':no-chore');continue}   // GATE-77 S6r · M5e: no chore bays (D-113); the cleaning vans make none (M5d)
  const b=R.bays.find(q=>q.id===D.bay),end=D.inn[D.inn.length-1];if(!b||!b.for.includes(type)){issues.push(type+':wrong-bay');continue}
  if(Math.abs(end[0]-(b.x??R.x))>.5||Math.abs(end[1]-b.yc)>.5)issues.push(type+':stop-outside-bay');
  const asset={SH:'G7-SH',MX:'VS-TW-01',SVC:'VS-GS-01'}[type],fp=APTT_SPEC.veh[asset].fp;if(fp[2]>b.len-4||fp[3]>R.w-2)issues.push(type+':does-not-fit '+b.id)}
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:[...new Set(issues)].slice(0,12),bays:rects};
}

const CARGO_W={lane:700,band:[560,720],x0:5010,x1:5990,c3:{cx:5700,ngy:480}};   // S3b: west cargo service band + lane; C3 reserve (S4)
// ---------- AIR-28 · parked / idle vehicles never stand in a drive path -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Home bays of the terminal-side fleet (baggage pockets A/B/C, apron-bus pocket S) as rectangles, plus every other home footprint for the audit.
function afHomeRects(zone){const A=APL;return A.bays.filter(b=>(!zone||b.zone===zone)&&b.occupied!==false).map(b=>({id:b.id,x0:b.x0,x1:b.x1,y0:b.y0,y1:b.y1}))}
// Tug released at the nose of a pushed-back aircraft (on taxilane L): it drives south to the service road.  The straight column is used when it
// clears every F2 home bay by ≥4 px; otherwise the tug side-steps (jog at y 540–590, north of the pockets) to the nearest clear column.
function afTugBack(t){
 const L=AF.L,GLS=AF.GLS,hw=APTT_SPEC.veh['LV-PT-01'].fp[3]/2+7,homes=afTugBack.h||(afTugBack.h=afHomeRects('F2')),x0=t[0];
 const clear=x=>!homes.some(r=>x+hw>r.x0&&x-hw<r.x1);
 let x=x0;if(!clear(x0)){for(let d=6;d<=90;d+=6){if(clear(x0-d)){x=x0-d;break}if(clear(x0+d)){x=x0+d;break}}}
 const blk=homes.filter(r=>x0+hw>r.x0&&x0-hw<r.x1),yTop=blk.length?Math.min(...blk.map(r=>r.y0)):645,j0=Math.min(540,yTop-55),j1=Math.min(590,yTop-5);
 return Math.abs(x-x0)<.5?[[x0,t[1],0],[x0,L,30],[GLS,L,26]]:[[x0,t[1],0],[x0,j0,18],[x,j1,18],[x,L,14],[GLS,L,26]];
}
// AIR-28 audit (static): every home footprint lies inside its marked bay and off every through lane — the terminal service road L, the GLINK
// corridor, the hardstand lanes, the G2 yard lanes and spine — and off the deterministic tug-return columns of every bridge stand.
function goIdleAudit(){
 aptReady();const issues=[],A=APL,Lr=APL.lanes,hit=(a,b,m=0)=>a.x0<b.x1+m&&a.x1>b.x0-m&&a.y0<b.y1+m&&a.y1>b.y0-m;
 const lanes=[{id:'SERVICE-ROAD-L',x0:6004,x1:7236,y0:AF.L-12,y1:AF.L+12},{id:'GLINK',x0:AF.GLN-12,x1:AF.GLS+12,y0:APT_Y.TS,y1:AF.HE+10},
  {id:'HARD-LANE-W',x0:AF.GLN,x1:Lr.wOut,y0:AF.HW-11,y1:AF.HW+11},{id:'HARD-LANE-E',x0:AF.GLN,x1:Lr.wIn,y0:AF.HE-11,y1:AF.HE+11},
  {id:'YARD-SPINE-W',x0:Lr.wOut-11,x1:Lr.wIn+11,y0:AF.HW,y1:Lr.O2+11},{id:'YARD-LANE-I',x0:Lr.wIn,x1:Lr.spineIn,y0:Lr.I-11,y1:Lr.I+11},
  {id:'YARD-LANE-O2',x0:Lr.wOut,x1:Lr.spineOut,y0:Lr.O2-11,y1:Lr.O2+11},{id:'YARD-SPINE-E',x0:Lr.spineIn-11,x1:Lr.spineOut+11,y0:AF.HE,y1:1500}];
 const tug=[];for(const sd of A.stands.filter(q=>q.tpl==='bridge'))for(const ac of sd.accepts){const D=aoDepLegs(sd,ac),g=apttAcGeom(ac),off=g.nose+9+afPtHx(),p=D.push.pose(D.push.dur),c=Math.cos(p[2]),sn=Math.sin(p[2]),pts=afTugBack([p[0]+c*off,p[1]+sn*off]),hw=APTT_SPEC.veh['LV-PT-01'].fp[3]/2;
  for(let i=1;i<pts.length-1;i++){const a=pts[i-1],b=pts[i];tug.push({id:'TUG-'+sd.id+'/'+ac.slice(3,5),x0:Math.min(a[0],b[0])-hw,x1:Math.max(a[0],b[0])+hw,y0:Math.min(a[1],b[1]),y1:Math.max(a[1],b[1])})}}
 let bodyOut=0,onLane=0,onTug=0;
 for(const f of A.fleet){
  const b=A.bays.find(q=>q.id===f.bay);if(!b)continue;const v={id:f.id,type:f.type,asset:f.asset},sh=[];apttShapes(afTrackOf(v,[]),[b.x,b.yc,b.th,0,1],sh,null);
  for(const q of sh){const r={x0:q.x0,x1:q.x1,y0:q.y0,y1:q.y1};
   if(r.x0<b.x0-1.5||r.x1>b.x1+1.5||r.y0<b.y0-1.5||r.y1>b.y1+1.5){bodyOut++;issues.push(v.id+':body-outside-bay '+b.id)}
   for(const l of lanes)if(hit(r,l)){onLane++;issues.push(v.id+':idle-on '+l.id)}
   for(const l of tug)if(hit(r,l,4)){onTug++;issues.push(v.id+':idle-in '+l.id)}}}
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:[...new Set(issues)].slice(0,16),bodyOutsideBay:bodyOut,idleOnServiceRoad:onLane,idleInTugColumn:onTug,lanes:lanes.length,tugColumns:tug.length};
}
// AIR-28 audit (dynamic): sandbox run; every moving vehicle shape is tested against every OTHER vehicle's home footprint (whether that vehicle is at
// home or not — a home bay must never be a drive path).  parkedIdleLaneOverlap = number of 0.5 s samples that touch a foreign home footprint.
function goIdleOpsQa(minutes=20,seed=777){
 if(!APTT_SPEC){APTT_SPEC=aptBuildSpec();APTT_C=aptBuildC()}
 return aoSandbox(()=>{AO.keep=true;aoInit(0,seed);const T=minutes*60;for(let t=0;t<=T;t+=1)aoStep(t);
  const homes=AO.fleet.map(v=>{const sh=[];apttShapes(v.tr0,v.home,sh,null);return{v:v.id,bay:v.bay.id,sh}});const by={};let n=0;
  for(const v of AO.fleet)for(const k of v.hist.concat(v.tasks)){const S=k.tr.seq;for(let t=0;t<S.dur;t+=.5){const p=S.at(t);if(!p)continue;const sh=[];apttShapes(k.tr,p,sh,t);
   for(const h of homes){if(h.v===v.id)continue;let x=false;for(const a of sh){for(const b of h.sh)if(a.x0<b.x1+2&&a.x1>b.x0-2&&a.y0<b.y1+2&&a.y1>b.y0-2&&apttObbHit(a,b,2)){x=true;break}if(x)break}
    if(x){n++;const key=h.bay+'<-'+v.id+':'+(k.role||'');by[key]=(by[key]||0)+1}}}}
  const st=goIdleAudit();
  return{ok:n===0&&st.ok,seed,minutes,parkedIdleLaneOverlap:n,idleOnServiceRoad:st.idleOnServiceRoad,bodyOutsideBay:st.bodyOutsideBay,where:Object.entries(by).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,8),tasks:AO.fleet.reduce((q,v)=>q+v.hist.length+v.tasks.length,0)};
 });
}

// ==== GATE-77 S6b-a · D-111: the fuel trucks fill up at the fuel depot (APT-FUEL) before they park =====================================
const S6B_DEPOT={on:true,x:8275,y:1050,th:-Math.PI/2,pump:[8252,1052],tankGauge:[8240,972,10,50],fillPt:{x0:8150,y0:950,x1:8300,y1:972},base:90,draw:.55,tau:900,fillMin:14,fillMax:36,fillK:.75,fills:0};
function s6bFillDur(hold){const D=S6B_DEPOT;return Math.max(D.fillMin,Math.min(D.fillMax,Math.round(hold*D.fillK)))}
// the fill leg of a fuel truck's task (start offset, duration), cached on the task
function s6bFillOf(k){if(k._fill!==undefined)return k._fill;let o=0,r=null;const L=k.tr&&k.tr.seq&&k.tr.seq.legs;if(L)for(const l of L){if(l.kind==='fill'){r=[o,l.dur];break}o+=l.dur}return k._fill=r}
// the depot gauge (%): every truck fill draws it down (draw × seconds), the pipe brings it back (τ); deterministic in the airport clock
function s6bDepotLevel(t){const D=S6B_DEPOT;if(typeof AO==='undefined'||!AO.fleet)return D.base;const L=D.led||(D.led=new Map());if(D.lastT!=null&&t<D.lastT-5)L.clear();D.lastT=t;   // a small ledger: finished tasks leave v.tasks

 let def=0;for(const [key,[a,d]] of L){const e=a+d;if(t-e>D.tau*4){L.delete(key);continue}if(t<a)continue;const got=D.draw*d*Math.min(1,(t-a)/Math.max(1,d));def+=t<=e?got:got*Math.exp(-(t-e)/D.tau)}
 return Math.max(8,Math.min(100,D.base-def))}

// ---------- placing a task in the reservation table --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// extra = {sh, from}: shapes of the parked aircraft that are not (yet) in the table from slice `from` on; the task must clear them until kEnd
function afExtraOk(sm,s,extra,kEnd){
 if(!extra)return true;
 const k0=Math.max(0,extra.from-s),k1=Math.min(sm.K-1,kEnd);
 for(let k=k0;k<=k1;k++){const A=sm.S[k];for(let i=0;i<A.length;i++)for(const b of extra.sh)if(aoC(A[i],b))return false}
 return true;
}
function afSearch(v,trk,sm,sMin,sMax,extra,kEnd){
 let s=sMin;const dur=trk.seq.dur;
 for(let it=0;it<80&&s<=sMax;it++){
  // 1. the vehicle itself must be free (cheap): jump over its own tasks
  let moved=true;
  while(moved){moved=false;const t0=aoT(s);for(const k of v.tasks)if(t0<k.t1+AF.GAP&&t0+dur>k.t0-AF.GAP){s=Math.max(s+1,aoSlUp(k.t1+AF.GAP));moved=true;break}}
  if(s>sMax)return -1;
  // 2. the track must fit in the reservation table
  const s2=aoSearch(sm,s,sMax);if(s2<0)return -1;
  if(s2!==s){s=s2;continue}                       // moved: the vehicle's own availability must be re-checked at the new start
  // 3. the parked aircraft (not yet in the table beyond `from`): later starts only overlap it more, so a failure is final
  return afExtraOk(sm,s,extra,kEnd)?s:-1;
 }
 return -1;
}function* afSearchG(v,trk,sm,sMin,sMax,extra,kEnd){
 let s=sMin;const dur=trk.seq.dur;
 for(let it=0;it<80&&s<=sMax;it++){
  if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())yield 0;
  // 1. the vehicle itself must be free (cheap): jump over its own tasks
  let moved=true;
  while(moved){moved=false;const t0=aoT(s);for(const k of v.tasks)if(t0<k.t1+AF.GAP&&t0+dur>k.t0-AF.GAP){s=Math.max(s+1,aoSlUp(k.t1+AF.GAP));moved=true;break}}
  if(s>sMax)return -1;
  // 2. the track must fit in the reservation table
  const s2=yield* aoSearchG(sm,s,sMax);if(s2<0)return -1;
  if(s2!==s){s=s2;continue}                       // moved: the vehicle's own availability must be re-checked at the new start
  // 3. the parked aircraft (not yet in the table beyond `from`): later starts only overlap it more, so a failure is final
  return afExtraOk(sm,s,extra,kEnd)?s:-1;
 }
 return -1;
}
function afCommit(v,trk,sm,s,role,meta){
 aoCommit(sm,s);
 const t0=aoT(s),task=Object.assign({t0,t1:t0+trk.seq.dur,tr:trk,role},meta||{});
 v.tasks.push(task);v.tasks.sort((a,b)=>a.t0-b.t0);
 AO.LOG.push(()=>{const i=v.tasks.indexOf(task);if(i>=0)v.tasks.splice(i,1)});
 AF.stats.tasks++;
 return task;
}
const afSEarliest=()=>aoSlUp(AO.t+.6);
// flexible task (baggage, fuel): the work position is reached at tNom or later

// ==== GATE-77 S6b-d · p164 · D-170: the stock ledger allows gaps (not append-only) ========================================================
G77_FI.gaps=true;G77_FI.brk=true;   // GATE-77 S6c · p167
function* g77FiTryG(v,D,ac,hold,tNom,maxD,bestS,extra){const F=G77_FI,C=F.T[v.type],cap=C.cap,up=g77FiUp(ac,v.type),lim=Math.max(F.min*cap,C.keep||0);
 const T=v.tasks.filter(k=>k.fi).sort((a,b)=>a.t0-b.t0);let res=null;
 for(let g=0;g<=T.length;g++){
  const L0=g===0?(v.fiL!=null?v.fiL:cap):T[g-1].fi.after,w0=g===0?-Infinity:T[g-1].t1+AF.GAP,w1=g<T.length?T[g].t0-AF.GAP:Infinity;
  for(const lm of (lim>F.min*cap+1e-6?[lim,F.min*cap]:[lim])){   /* K-161 · p274: the refill after the task (keep) only when it fits; otherwise the old rule */
  const pre=L0<up-1e-6,before=pre?cap:L0,left=before-up,post=left<lm-1e-6,after=post?cap:left;
  const fi={up,L0,before,left,after,pre,post,fillPre:pre?cap-L0:0,fillPost:post?cap-left:0,free:w0};
  let ok=true,Lc=after;const upd=[];
  for(let j=g;j<T.length;j++){const q=T[j].fi,b2=q.pre?cap:Lc,l2=b2-q.up;if(b2<q.up-1e-6||(!q.post&&l2<F.min*cap-1e-6)){ok=false;break}
   const a2=q.post?cap:l2;upd.push([q,{L0:Lc,before:b2,left:l2,after:a2}]);Lc=a2}
  if(!ok)continue;
  const B=afBuild(v,D,hold,{fi}),sm=(yield* aoSampG(B.trk,aoSeqLeg(B.trk.seq)));
  const sNom=Math.max(aoSlUp(tNom-B.dOut),afSEarliest(),w0>-1e9?aoSlUp(w0):0);
  let sMax=(G77_FI.brk?Math.max(aoSlUp(tNom-B.dOut),afSEarliest()):sNom)+aoSl(maxD);if(bestS!=null)sMax=Math.min(sMax,bestS-1);if(res)sMax=Math.min(sMax,res.s-1);if(w1<Infinity)sMax=Math.min(sMax,aoSl(w1-B.trk.seq.dur));
  if(sMax<sNom)continue;
  const s=(yield* afSearchG(v,B.trk,sm,sNom,sMax,extra,Math.round((B.dOut+B.hold+16)/AO.DT)));
  if(s<0)continue;res={s,sNom,sReq:Math.max(aoSlUp(tNom-B.dOut),afSEarliest()),B,sm,fi,upd};break}}
 return res}
function g77FiApply(upd){if(!upd)return;for(const [q,val] of upd){const old={L0:q.L0,before:q.before,left:q.left,after:q.after};Object.assign(q,val);AO.LOG.push(()=>{Object.assign(q,old)})}}
function* afServeG(role,sd,ac,tNom,hold,maxD,meta,extra){
 const D=afDest(role,sd,ac);if(!D){AF.last='nodest '+role+' '+sd.id+' '+ac;return null}
 let best=null;
 for(const v of (role==='bag'?f2BagCandidates(sd,6):g77Cands(role,sd,5))){
  if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())yield 0;                      // nothing of this call is committed yet: safe to continue next frame
  if(G77_FI.on&&G77_FI.gaps&&(role==='fuel'||role==='wat'||role==='lav')&&G77_FI.T&&G77_FI.T[v.type]){   // GATE-77 S6b-d · p164: the ledger with gaps
   const r=(yield* g77FiTryG(v,D,ac,hold,tNom,maxD,best?best.s:null,extra));
   if(!r){const key=role+':fi-none';AF.fails[key]=(AF.fails[key]||0)+1;continue}
   if(!best||r.s<best.s)best={v,B:r.B,sm:r.sm,s:r.s,fi:r.fi,upd:r.upd};
   if(r.s-(G77_FI.brk?r.sReq:r.sNom)<=aoSl(6))break;   // GATE-77 S6c · p167: on time = from the request, not from the truck's free time
   continue}
  const fi=(role==='fuel'||role==='wat'||role==='lav')?g77FiPlan(v,ac):null;   // GATE-77 S6b-d · p160 · D-170
  const B=role==='bag'?f2BagBuild(v,sd,ac,hold,(meta&&meta.kind)||'arr',meta&&meta.code):afBuild(v,D,hold,fi?{fi}:{}),sm=(yield* aoSampG(B.trk,aoSeqLeg(B.trk.seq)));
  const sNom=Math.max(aoSlUp(tNom-B.dOut),afSEarliest(),fi&&fi.free>-1e9?aoSlUp(fi.free):0);
  const W_=meta&&meta.win;let sLo=sNom,sHi=best?best.s-1:sNom+aoSl(maxD);if(W_){const sMax=aoSl(W_[1]-B.hold-B.dOut);sLo=Math.max(aoSlUp(W_[0]-B.dOut),afSEarliest(),Math.min(sNom,sMax-aoSl(W_[2]||0)));sHi=Math.min(best?best.s-1:sMax,sMax);if(sHi<sLo){const key=role+':win';AF.fails[key]=(AF.fails[key]||0)+1;continue}}   /* GATE-77P · p218 · K-148 */
  const s=(yield* afSearchG(v,B.trk,sm,sLo,sHi,extra,Math.round((B.dOut+B.hold+16)/AO.DT)));
  if(s<0){const w=aoWhy(sm,sNom);const key=role+':'+(w?w.b.replace(/\d+/g,'#'):'busy/none');AF.fails[key]=(AF.fails[key]||0)+1;
   if(AO.diagF){AF.fd=AF.fd||[];if(AF.fd.length<400)AF.fd.push({role,sd:sd.id,ac,v:v.id,sNom,t:+aoT(sNom).toFixed(1),w,k:w?w.k:null,leg:w&&B.trk.seq.legAt(w.k*.25)?B.trk.seq.legAt(w.k*.25).leg.kind:null,at:w&&B.trk.seq.at(w.k*.25)?B.trk.seq.at(w.k*.25).slice(0,2).map(Math.round):null})}continue}
  if(!best||s<best.s)best={v,B,sm,s,fi};
  if(s-(G77_FI.brk&&fi?Math.max(aoSlUp(tNom-B.dOut),afSEarliest()):sNom)<=aoSl(6))break;   // GATE-77 S6c · p167
 }

 const task=afCommit(best.v,best.B.trk,best.sm,best.s,role,Object.assign({code:meta&&meta.code,at:aoT(best.s)+best.B.dOut},meta));
 if(best.upd)g77FiApply(best.upd);   // GATE-77 S6b-d · p164: the tasks after the gap
 if(best.fi){task.fi=best.fi;G77_FI.stats.tasks++;if(best.fi.pre)G77_FI.stats.pre++;if(best.fi.post)G77_FI.stats.post++}   // GATE-77 S6b-d · p160: the ledger
 return{t0:task.t0,end:task.t1,at:task.at,done:task.at+best.B.hold,v:best.v,task};
}
function afServe(...a){const sl=AO.sliced;AO.sliced=false;const g=afServeG(...a);let r;do{r=g.next()}while(!r.done);AO.sliced=sl;return r.value}
// task coupled to the aircraft's pushback / departure: prepared once, tried for every candidate push slice sP.
//   role 'tug' : opts {push, lead:seconds the tug waits at the nose before the push, off}
//   role 'bag' : opts {hold, before:seconds before the push at which the baggage train reaches the aircraft}
function afCouple(role,sd,ac,opts){
 const D=afDest(role,sd,ac);if(!D)return null;
 const cands=[],bfs=opts.befores||[opts.before];
 for(const v of (role==='bag'?f2BagCandidates(sd,6):g77Cands(role,sd,role==='tug'&&G77_NB.on?6:3))){
  let B;
  if(role==='tug'){B=afBuild(v,D,0,{hold0:opts.lead,push:opts.push,off:opts.off});const h=aoSlUp(B.dOut+opts.lead)*AO.DT-B.dOut;if(h-opts.lead>1e-9)B=afBuild(v,D,0,{hold0:h,push:opts.push,off:opts.off})}
  else B=role==='bag'?f2BagBuild(v,sd,ac,opts.hold,'dep',opts.code):afBuild(v,D,opts.hold);
  cands.push({v,B,sm:aoSamp(B.trk,aoSeqLeg(B.trk.seq))});
 }
 if(!cands.length)return null;
 if(role==='tug'&&G77_NB.on)cands.sort((a,b)=>a.B.dOut-b.B.dOut);   // GATE-77 S6b-c · p157: the nearest tug first (the near tug park)
 const leads=c=>role==='tug'?[aoSlUp(c.B.dOut+opts.lead)]:bfs.map(bf=>aoSlUp(c.B.dOut+bf));
 return{
  role,cands,
  minSP(){let m=1e9;for(const c of this.cands)for(const l of leads(c))m=Math.min(m,afSEarliest()+l);return m},   // earliest push slice any vehicle could serve
  jump:1,pend:[],
  try(sP){
   const R=AF.rj;this.pend=[];this.jump=1;
   const bfx=role==='bag'&&G77_BLW&&G77_BLW.on&&S6R_BW.w?bfs.concat(g77BlwList()):bfs;   // GATE-77 S7-a · p190: + the end of the loader's stay
   for(const bf of (role==='tug'?[0]:bfx.keys()))for(const c of this.cands){
    const bw_=bfx[bf],bv=role==='tug'?0:(bw_&&typeof bw_==='object'?g77BlwBf(c,sP,bw_.w):bw_);if(bv==null&&bw_&&typeof bw_==='object')continue;
    const lead=role==='tug'?leads(c)[0]:aoSlUp(c.B.dOut+bv);
    const sT0=sP-lead,se=afSEarliest();
    if(sT0<se){R.early++;this.pend.push(se-sT0);continue}
    if(opts.win&&!opts.win(aoT(sT0)+c.B.dOut,aoT(sT0)+c.B.dOut+(c.B.hold||0))){R.win=(R.win||0)+1;this.pend.push(1);continue}
    const t0=aoT(sT0);
    if(!afFreeAt(c.v,t0,t0+c.B.dur)){R.busy++;this.pend.push(afBusyShift(c.v,t0,c.B.dur));continue}
    const kk=aoFreeK(c.sm,sT0);
    if(kk>=0){R.shape++;this.pend.push({a:AO._ca,base:sT0+kk});continue}
    this.pend=[];{if(bfx[bf]&&typeof bfx[bf]==='object')G77_BLW.n++;const tk=afCommit(c.v,c.B.trk,c.sm,sT0,role,{code:opts.code});tk.s6rAt=aoT(sT0)+c.B.dOut;tk.s6rDone=tk.s6rAt+(c.B.hold||0);return tk}
   }
   return null;
  },
  // lower bound (slices) for the next push slice that could work for any candidate: call after the failed attempt has been rolled back
  jumpNow(){
   let m=1e9;
   for(const q of this.pend){
    if(typeof q==='number'){m=Math.min(m,q);continue}
    let d=1;while(d<4000&&aoBlocked(q.a,q.base+d))d++;m=Math.min(m,d);
   }
   return m===1e9?1:Math.max(1,m);
  }
 };
}function* afCoupleG(role,sd,ac,opts){
 const D=afDest(role,sd,ac);if(!D)return null;
 const cands=[],bfs=opts.befores||[opts.before];
 for(const v of (role==='bag'?f2BagCandidates(sd,6):g77Cands(role,sd,role==='tug'&&G77_NB.on?6:3))){
  if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())yield 0;
  let B;
  if(role==='tug'){B=afBuild(v,D,0,{hold0:opts.lead,push:opts.push,off:opts.off});const h=aoSlUp(B.dOut+opts.lead)*AO.DT-B.dOut;if(h-opts.lead>1e-9)B=afBuild(v,D,0,{hold0:h,push:opts.push,off:opts.off})}
  else B=role==='bag'?f2BagBuild(v,sd,ac,opts.hold,'dep',opts.code):afBuild(v,D,opts.hold);
  cands.push({v,B,sm:(yield* aoSampG(B.trk,aoSeqLeg(B.trk.seq)))});
 }
 if(!cands.length)return null;
 if(role==='tug'&&G77_NB.on)cands.sort((a,b)=>a.B.dOut-b.B.dOut);   // GATE-77 S6b-c · p157: the nearest tug first (the near tug park)
 const leads=c=>role==='tug'?[aoSlUp(c.B.dOut+opts.lead)]:bfs.map(bf=>aoSlUp(c.B.dOut+bf));
 return{
  role,cands,
  minSP(){let m=1e9;for(const c of this.cands)for(const l of leads(c))m=Math.min(m,afSEarliest()+l);return m},   // earliest push slice any vehicle could serve
  jump:1,pend:[],
  try(sP){
   const R=AF.rj;this.pend=[];this.jump=1;
   const bfx=role==='bag'&&G77_BLW&&G77_BLW.on&&S6R_BW.w?bfs.concat(g77BlwList()):bfs;   // GATE-77 S7-a · p190: + the end of the loader's stay
   for(const bf of (role==='tug'?[0]:bfx.keys()))for(const c of this.cands){
    const bw_=bfx[bf],bv=role==='tug'?0:(bw_&&typeof bw_==='object'?g77BlwBf(c,sP,bw_.w):bw_);if(bv==null&&bw_&&typeof bw_==='object')continue;
    const lead=role==='tug'?leads(c)[0]:aoSlUp(c.B.dOut+bv);
    const sT0=sP-lead,se=afSEarliest();
    if(sT0<se){R.early++;this.pend.push(se-sT0);continue}
    if(opts.win&&!opts.win(aoT(sT0)+c.B.dOut,aoT(sT0)+c.B.dOut+(c.B.hold||0))){R.win=(R.win||0)+1;this.pend.push(1);continue}
    const t0=aoT(sT0);
    if(!afFreeAt(c.v,t0,t0+c.B.dur)){R.busy++;this.pend.push(afBusyShift(c.v,t0,c.B.dur));continue}
    const kk=aoFreeK(c.sm,sT0);
    if(kk>=0){R.shape++;this.pend.push({a:AO._ca,base:sT0+kk});continue}
    this.pend=[];{if(bfx[bf]&&typeof bfx[bf]==='object')G77_BLW.n++;const tk=afCommit(c.v,c.B.trk,c.sm,sT0,role,{code:opts.code});tk.s6rAt=aoT(sT0)+c.B.dOut;tk.s6rDone=tk.s6rAt+(c.B.hold||0);return tk}
   }
   return null;
  },
  // lower bound (slices) for the next push slice that could work for any candidate: call after the failed attempt has been rolled back
  jumpNow(){
   let m=1e9;
   for(const q of this.pend){
    if(typeof q==='number'){m=Math.min(m,q);continue}
    let d=1;while(d<4000&&aoBlocked(q.a,q.base+d))d++;m=Math.min(m,d);
   }
   return m===1e9?1:Math.max(1,m);
  }
 };
}
// slices by which a start has to move later so that the vehicle's own tasks no longer overlap
function afBusyShift(v,t0,dur){let m=1;for(const k of v.tasks)if(t0<k.t1+AF.GAP&&t0+dur>k.t0-AF.GAP)m=Math.max(m,aoSlUp(k.t1+AF.GAP-t0));return m}

// ---------- chores (support vehicles) --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function afChores(now){
 for(const v of AO.fleet){
  if(!RSP_E.bays.length||(v.type!=='SH'&&v.type!=='MX'))continue;   // GATE-77 S6r · M5d: the cleaning vans make no chores (QA-88) · M5e: no chore bays
  if(v.nextChore==null){v.nextChore=now+aoR(20,150);continue}
  if(now+AO.H<v.nextChore)continue;
  const k=Math.floor(AO.rng()*3),D=afChoreDest(v,k),hold=aoR(...D.hold),tReq=Math.max(v.nextChore,now+2);
  const B=afBuild(v,D,hold),sm=aoSamp(B.trk,aoSeqLeg(B.trk.seq));
  const s0=Math.max(aoSlUp(tReq),afSEarliest()),s=afSearch(v,B.trk,sm,s0,s0+aoSl(120));
  if(s>=0){afCommit(v,B.trk,sm,s,'chore',{code:v.id});v.nextChore=aoT(s)+B.dur+aoR(150,420)}
  else v.nextChore=now+aoR(30,90);
 }
}function* afChoresG(now){
 for(const v of AO.fleet){
  if(!RSP_E.bays.length||(v.type!=='SH'&&v.type!=='MX'))continue;   // GATE-77 S6r · M5d · M5e
  if(v.nextChore==null){v.nextChore=now+aoR(20,150);continue}
  if(now+AO.H<v.nextChore)continue;
  if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())yield 0;
  const k=Math.floor(AO.rng()*3),D=afChoreDest(v,k),hold=aoR(...D.hold),tReq=Math.max(v.nextChore,now+2);
  const B=afBuild(v,D,hold),sm=(yield* aoSampG(B.trk,aoSeqLeg(B.trk.seq)));
  const s0=Math.max(aoSlUp(tReq),afSEarliest()),s=(yield* afSearchG(v,B.trk,sm,s0,s0+aoSl(120)));
  if(s>=0){afCommit(v,B.trk,sm,s,'chore',{code:v.id});v.nextChore=aoT(s)+B.dur+aoR(150,420)}
  else v.nextChore=now+aoR(30,90);
 }
}
function afPrune(now){
 for(const v of AO.fleet){
  while(v.tasks.length&&v.tasks[0].t1<now-2){const k=v.tasks.shift();if(k.fi)v.fiL=k.fi.after;if(AO.keep)v.hist.push(k)}
 }
}
// ---------- poses for the renderer -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function afPose(v,t){
 for(const k of v.tasks)if(t>=k.t0&&t<k.t1){const p=k.tr.seq.at(t-k.t0);if(p)return{pose:p,tr:k.tr,task:k}}
 return{pose:v.home,tr:v.tr0,task:null};
}
function afState(v,t){
 const r=afPose(v,t);if(!r.task)return'IDLE';
 const l=r.task.tr.seq.legAt(t-r.task.t0);const kd=l?l.leg.kind:'';
 return kd==='out'||kd==='mid'?'DISPATCHED':kd==='back'?'RETURNING':kd==='push'?'ATTACHED':kd==='mu'?'BAG_MAKEUP':'SERVICING';
}
function afActors(now,out){
 for(const v of AO.fleet){const r=afPose(v,now);out.push({kind:'veh',id:v.asset,nm:v.id,pose:r.pose,tr:r.tr,f:null,v,lt:r.task?now-r.task.t0:null})}
 return out;
}
// ---------- verification helpers (used by aoVerify) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function afShapes(t,moving,idle){
 for(const v of AO.fleet){
  const r=afPose(v,t),out=[];apttShapes(r.tr,r.pose,out,r.task?t-r.task.t0:null);
  const dst=r.task?moving:idle;for(const s of out)dst.push(s);
 }
}
function afCheck(add,t0,t1){
 for(const v of AO.fleet){
  const all=v.hist.concat(v.tasks).filter(k=>k.t1>=t0&&k.t0<=t1);
  for(let i=0;i<all.length;i++){
   const k=all[i],L=k.tr.seq.legs;
   if(i&&all[i-1].t1+AF.GAP-1e-6>k.t0)add('FLEET overlap '+v.id,k.t0);
   for(let j=0;j+1<L.length;j++){
    const a=L[j].pose(L[j].dur),b=L[j+1].pose(0);
    if(!a||!b)continue;
    if(Math.hypot(a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1])>1.5||Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(a[2]-b[2]),Math.cos(a[2]-b[2])))>.05)add('TELEPORT '+v.id+' leg '+j+'→'+(j+1)+' ('+L[j].kind+'→'+L[j+1].kind+')',k.t0);
   }
   const p0=L[0].pose(0),pe=L[L.length-1].pose(L[L.length-1].dur),h=v.home;
   if(Math.hypot(p0[0]-h[0],p0[1]-h[1])>1.5||Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(p0[2]-h[2]),Math.cos(p0[2]-h[2])))>.05)add('FLEET '+v.id+' does not start in its bay',k.t0);
   if(Math.hypot(pe[0]-h[0],pe[1]-h[1])>1.5||Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(pe[2]-h[2]),Math.cos(pe[2]-h[2])))>.05)add('FLEET '+v.id+' does not end in its bay',k.t1);
   // never faded
   const n=Math.ceil(k.tr.seq.dur/.5);for(let q=0;q<=n;q++){const p=k.tr.seq.at(Math.min(q*.5,k.tr.seq.dur-1e-6));if(p&&p[4]!==1){add('FLEET alpha<1 '+v.id,k.t0+q*.5);break}}
  }
 }
}

// ====================================================================================================================================
// v1.94 · AIRPORT B — OPS CORE.  Space-time reservation planner.
// Every flight is planned in full the moment it is admitted: each leg (approach+landing+taxi-in, park, pushback, taxi-out, hold-short,
// line-up+take-off) is placed at the earliest time at which its swept shapes (and its taxi-segment / stand / runway tokens) do not
// intersect anything already reserved.  A leg that cannot be placed waits (queue / hold) — nothing is ever teleported or overlapped.
// Needs apt_prim_v194.js (primitives) + globals APTT_SPEC, APTT_C.   DOM free: the same file runs in Node (QA) and in the game.
// ====================================================================================================================================
const AO={stepCapMs:3,chJob:null,sliced:false,useClock:false,DT:.25,M:6,SEP:3,LA:4,H:45,MAXQ:360,MAXW:360,keep:false,hist:[],work:0,job:null,budget:150,lead:22,
 cfg:{turn:[130,300],gap:[25,170],gaDwell:[200,600],gaGap:[60,260],cgDwell:[150,330],cgGap:[60,220],heliDwell:[100,300],heliAway:[40,110],bag1:9,fuel:14,bag2:58,disc:4,holdShort:3,clear:4,maxHold:15,holdAim:5,ms:2.5,demand:+(typeof process!=='undefined'&&process.env&&process.env.DEMAND||.6)},
 B:new Map(),ST:[],LOG:[],flights:[],nid:1,t:0,seed:1,rng:null,stands:[],dbg:[],
 stats:{planned:0,failed:0,recovered:0,queued:0,maxQueue:0,pruned:0,planMs:0,why:{}}};
var aoSl=t=>Math.round(t/AO.DT), aoT=s=>s*AO.DT, aoSlUp=t=>Math.ceil(t/AO.DT-1e-9);
function aoRng(seed){let s=seed>>>0;return()=>{s=(s+0x6D2B79F5)>>>0;let t=s;t=Math.imul(t^t>>>15,t|1);t^=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,t|61);return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296}}
const aoR=(a,b)=>a+(b-a)*AO.rng();
const aoRI=(a,b)=>Math.round(aoR(a,b));
function aoDbg(ev,o){const e={t:+AO.t.toFixed(2),ev,...o};AO.dbg.push(e);if(AO.dbg.length>400)AO.dbg.shift();if(ev!=='plan'){AO.evt=AO.evt||[];AO.evt.push(e);if(AO.evt.length>300)AO.evt.shift()}if(ev!=='plan'&&typeof Dbg!=='undefined'&&Dbg&&Dbg.event)try{Dbg.event('airport',ev,o)}catch(_){}}

// ---------- taxi-segment / link / junction tokens (a plane holds every token its fuselage touches; tokens are held 'LA' seconds ahead) -----
function aoToks(){
 if(AO.TK)return AO.TK;
 const C=APTT_C,X=APTT_X,T=C.TWY,ty0=T.cy-T.w/2,ty1=T.cy+T.w/2,rb=C.RWY.cy+C.RWY.w/2;

 const out=[];
 for(const [n,x] of [['1',X.A1],['2',X.A2],['3',X.A3]])out.push(mk('LNK'+n,x-55,x+55,rb,ty0),mk('J'+n,x-55,x+55,ty0,ty1));

  mk('JG',7215,7305,ty0,ty1),mk('GL',7215,7305,APT_Y.LS,1000),mk('TW4',7305,X.A3-55,ty0,ty1),mk('TW5',X.A3+55,T.x1+40,ty0,ty1));
 g73Tokens(mk,out);

}
function aoTokensOf(F){const o=[];for(const T of aoToks())if(F.x0<=T.x1&&F.x1>=T.x0&&F.y0<=T.y1&&F.y1>=T.y0&&apttObbHit(F,T.o,0))o.push(T.k);return o}

// ---------- sampling: a leg placed at slice s covers slices s .. s+K-1; shapes depend only on the local time -------------------------------
function aoSamp(tr,leg,o={}){
 const dt=AO.DT,K=Math.ceil(leg.dur/dt-1e-9)+1,S=new Array(K),rw=new Uint8Array(K),isAc=tr.kind==='ac',tk=new Array(K);
 let rwFirst=-1,rwLast=-1;
 for(let k=0;k<K;k++){
  const p=leg.pose(Math.min(k*dt,leg.dur)),out=[];
  tk[k]=null;
  if(p){
   apttShapes(tr,p,out,Math.min(k*dt,leg.dur));
   if(isAc){
    let onR=false;const ks=new Set();
    for(const s of out){
     if(s.L==='A')onR=true;
     else if(s.L==='F'){for(const q of aoTokensOf(s))ks.add(q);if(s.y0<APT_Y.RS+12&&s.y1>APT_Y.RN-12&&s.x1>4000&&s.x0<8500)onR=true}
    }
    if(onR){rw[k]=1;if(rwFirst<0)rwFirst=k;rwLast=k}
    tk[k]=ks;
   }
  }
  S[k]=out;
 }
 // runway lock: ± SEP seconds around every slice on / over the runway strip
 const mm=Math.round(AO.SEP/dt);
 if(isAc&&rwFirst>=0){const m2=new Uint8Array(K);for(let k=0;k<K;k++)if(rw[k])for(let j=Math.max(0,k-mm);j<Math.min(K,k+mm+1);j++)m2[j]=1;
  const R=Object.assign({},aoRB(),{t:tr.nm+'-R'});for(let k=0;k<K;k++)if(m2[k])S[k].push(R)}
 let rk=null,rs=null;
 if(isAc&&rwFirst>=0){rk=[];rs=[];for(let k=0;k<K;k++){const A=S[k];for(let i=0;i<A.length;i++)if(A[i].L==='R'){rk.push(k);rs.push(A[i]);break}}}
 // tokens, reserved LA seconds before they are first needed
 if(isAc){const la=Math.round(AO.LA/dt);const add=Array.from({length:K},()=>new Set());
  for(let k=0;k<K;k++)if(tk[k])for(const q of tk[k])for(let j=Math.max(0,k-la);j<=k;j++)add[j].add(q);
  for(let k=0;k<K;k++)for(const q of add[k])S[k].push({L:'S',k:q,t:tr.nm});
  if(o.stand){const kf=Math.max(0,Math.round((o.standFrom||0)/dt)),kt=o.standTo!=null?Math.min(K,Math.round(o.standTo/dt)+1):K;for(let k=kf;k<kt;k++)S[k].push({L:'S',k:'ST:'+o.stand,t:tr.nm})}}
 {const SQ=leg.seq;if(tr.kind==='veh'&&SQ&&SQ.legs&&typeof g2GatePath==='function'&&typeof APL!=='undefined'){for(let li=0;li<SQ.legs.length;li++){const g=SQ.legs[li].g2;if(!g||g.at!=='gate'||!(g.n>0))continue;const b=APL.bays.find(q=>q.fleetId===tr.nm);if(!b)break;   /* GATE-77 S6b · p148 · K-108: the passengers at the bus gate */
  const L0=SQ.st[li],Ld=SQ.legs[li].dur,P0=g2GatePath(b),pts=g.gate==='load'?P0.slice().reverse():P0,segs=[];let acc=0;for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++){const l=Math.hypot(pts[i][0]-pts[i-1][0],pts[i][1]-pts[i-1][1]);if(l>.01)segs.push([pts[i-1],pts[i],acc,acc+l]);acc+=l}
  const W=G2_WALK;for(let k=Math.max(0,Math.floor(L0/dt));k<K&&k*dt<=L0+Ld;k++){const tau=k*dt-L0;if(tau<0)continue;const d1=Math.min(acc,(tau-W.pre)*W.v),d0=Math.max(0,(tau-W.pre-(g.n-1)*W.gap)*W.v);if(d1<=0||d0>=acc||d1<d0)continue;
   for(const q of segs){const a=q[0],e2=q[1],s0=q[2],s1=q[3],u0=Math.max(d0,s0),u1=Math.min(d1,s1);if(u1<u0)continue;const L=s1-s0,ax=a[0]+(e2[0]-a[0])*(u0-s0)/L,ay=a[1]+(e2[1]-a[1])*(u0-s0)/L,bx=a[0]+(e2[0]-a[0])*(u1-s0)/L,by=a[1]+(e2[1]-a[1])*(u1-s0)/L,hl=Math.hypot(bx-ax,by-ay)/2+1;
    const o2=apttObb((ax+bx)/2,(ay+by)/2,Math.atan2(e2[1]-a[1],e2[0]-a[0]),[-hl,hl,-1,1],'P',tr.nm+'-pax');o2.own=tr.nm;S[k].push(o2)}}}}}

 return g76XMark({K,S,dur:leg.dur,rwFirst,rwLast,rk,rs,M});
}function* aoSampG(tr,leg,o={}){

function aoC(a,b){

 return apttConflict(a,b,m);
}
// ---------- the reservation table: slice -> shapes ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ==== p376 · the planner's hot loops skip what cannot collide — the same answer by construction: skip, or run the original code ==========
// aoFreeK: windows of 2^lg samples, window j = [j·2^lg−1, (j+1)·2^lg−1), window 0 = [0, 2^lg−1): each yield sample of aoFreeKG
// (k & 31 === 31; lg ≤ 5) opens a window, so what a window looks at is never kept across a yield.
// Can collide (aoC): a token (S) only with a token of the same key, a runway lock (R) only with a lock; any other pair only after a box
// test — m (statics, the slice), 3 (the mid-slice body vs the passengers), AO.M (g77IhHit): a box that misses the union grown by
// max(m,AO.M,3)+1 misses every shape in it (the +1 absorbs the rounding of the other forms of the test; a NaN box never misses).
var AO_FW={on:true,lg:3,win:0,wok:0,sk:0,skip:0,hs:0,hskip:0},AO_FWC=new WeakMap();
const AO_FWN={},AO_FWX={};   // the window's one t: none (g77IhHit is false for all its shapes) / more than one
// once per leg (legs and their shapes are not changed after aoSamp): per sample the union box of its box shapes and of its mid-slice body,
// its token keys, its lock; per window the union, the token keys, the locks, `bad` (a shape that is not a token / lock without a finite
// box: the window is never OK) and `it` (the one t of its box shapes)
function aoFwGet(sm){const lg=Math.max(1,Math.min(5,AO_FW.lg|0));let W=AO_FWC.get(sm);if(W&&W.lg===lg)return W;
 const K=sm.K,S=sm.S,M=sm.M,nw=(K>>lg)+1,I=Infinity,rs=new Uint8Array(K),tk=new Array(K).fill(null),
  sx0=new Float64Array(K),sx1=new Float64Array(K),sy0=new Float64Array(K),sy1=new Float64Array(K),bad=new Uint8Array(nw),rw=new Uint8Array(nw),tw=new Array(nw).fill(null),it=new Array(nw).fill(AO_FWN),
  x0=new Float64Array(nw).fill(I),x1=new Float64Array(nw).fill(-I),y0=new Float64Array(nw).fill(I),y1=new Float64Array(nw).fill(-I);
 for(let k=0;k<K;k++){const A=S[k],j=(k+1)>>lg;let bx0=I,bx1=-I,by0=I,by1=-I,T=null;
  if(A.length){   // an empty sample: the original skips it before its slice and its mid-slice body are looked at
   for(let i=0;i<A.length;i++){const a=A[i],L=a.L;if(L==='S'){(T||(T=new Set())).add(a.k);continue}if(L==='R'){rs[k]=rw[j]=1;continue}
    if(!(a.x0<=a.x1&&a.y0<=a.y1)){bad[j]=1;continue}it[j]=it[j]===AO_FWN||it[j]===a.t?a.t:AO_FWX;
    if(a.x0<bx0)bx0=a.x0;if(a.x1>bx1)bx1=a.x1;if(a.y0<by0)by0=a.y0;if(a.y1>by1)by1=a.y1}
   const Mk=M&&M[k];if(Mk)for(let i=0;i<Mk.length;i++){const a=Mk[i];if(!(a.x0<=a.x1&&a.y0<=a.y1)){bad[j]=1;continue}if(a.x0<bx0)bx0=a.x0;if(a.x1>bx1)bx1=a.x1;if(a.y0<by0)by0=a.y0;if(a.y1>by1)by1=a.y1}
   if(T){const U=tw[j]||(tw[j]=new Set());for(const q of T)U.add(q)}
   if(bx0<x0[j])x0[j]=bx0;if(bx1>x1[j])x1[j]=bx1;if(by0<y0[j])y0[j]=by0;if(by1>y1[j])y1[j]=by1}
  tk[k]=T;sx0[k]=bx0;sx1[k]=bx1;sy0[k]=by0;sy1[k]=by1}
 W={lg,rs,tk,sx0,sx1,sy0,sy1,bad,rw,tw,it,x0,x1,y0,y1};AO_FWC.set(sm,W);return W}
// can a shape of `bk` collide with shapes of union box (x0..y1, already grown), token keys T, locks R?
function aoFwAny(bk,n,x0,x1,y0,y1,T,R){
 if(T||R){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const b=bk[i],L=b.L;if(L==='S'){if(T&&T.has(b.k))return true;continue}if(L==='R'){if(R)return true;continue}if(!(x0>b.x1||x1<b.x0||y0>b.y1||y1<b.y0))return true}return false}
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const b=bk[i];if(x0>b.x1||x1<b.x0||y0>b.y1||y1<b.y0)continue;const L=b.L;if(L==='S'||L==='R')continue;return true}   // no token / lock here: tokens and locks there cannot collide
 return false}
// window j is OK when it has no `bad` shape and neither a static (ST[0..ns), as the caller reads them) nor an idle vehicle can collide with any of its samples
function aoFwWin(W,j,m,ST,ns){AO_FW.win++;if(W.bad[j])return false;

// sample k of an OK window cannot collide when no shape of its slice can collide with it (no slice: nothing to collide with)
function aoFwSlice(W,k,bk,nb,m){AO_FW.sk++;if(nb){const E=Math.max(m,3)+1;if(aoFwAny(bk,nb,W.sx0[k]-E,W.sx1[k]+E,W.sy0[k]-E,W.sy1[k]+E,W.tk[k],W.rs[k]))return false}AO_FW.skip++;return true}
// aoHoldLimit: the hold shapes are the same at every slice — their union box grown by m+1, their token keys, their locks (null: a shape without a finite box)

function aoSearch(sm,sMin,sMax,hold,after){

  if(k<0){
   if(after){const e=s+sm.K-1,c=aoHoldLimit(after.sh,e,e+after.len);
    if(c<e+after.len){
     if(AO._hperm)return -1;                      // the parked aircraft would sit on a permanent obstacle
     const h=AO._hs;let c2=c+1;while(c2<c+4000&&aoBlocked(h,c2))c2++;
     s=Math.max(s+1,c2-(sm.K-1));continue}}
   return s}
  // jump over the whole stretch during which the blocking shape stays blocked
  const a=AO._ca,base=s+k;let d=1;if(G77_IH&&G77_IH.last&&G77_IH.w===AO.work){G77_IH.last=false;G77_IH.jump++;d=Math.max(1,Math.min(4000,G77_IH.until-base))}else while(d<4000&&aoBlocked(a,base+d))d++;
  s+=d;
 }
 return -1;
}function* aoSearchG(sm,sMin,sMax,hold,after){
 let lim=sMax;if(hold){lim=Math.min(lim,(yield* aoHoldLimitG(hold.sh,hold.from,sMax+1)))}
 for(let s=sMin;s<=lim;){
  if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())yield 0;
  const k=(yield* aoFreeKG(sm,s));
  if(k<0){
   if(after){const e=s+sm.K-1,c=(yield* aoHoldLimitG(after.sh,e,e+after.len));
    if(c<e+after.len){
     if(AO._hperm)return -1;                      // the parked aircraft would sit on a permanent obstacle
     const h=AO._hs;let c2=c+1;while(c2<c+4000&&aoBlocked(h,c2)){c2++;if((c2&511)===0&&AO.sliced&&aoOver())yield 0}
     s=Math.max(s+1,c2-(sm.K-1));continue}}
   return s}
  // jump over the whole stretch during which the blocking shape stays blocked
  const a=AO._ca,base=s+k;let d=1;if(G77_IH&&G77_IH.last&&G77_IH.w===AO.work){G77_IH.last=false;G77_IH.jump++;d=Math.max(1,Math.min(4000,G77_IH.until-base))}else while(d<4000&&aoBlocked(a,base+d)){d++;if((d&511)===0&&AO.sliced&&aoOver())yield 0}
  s+=d;
 }
 return -1;
}

function g77StaticBlock(sd,ac,role){

 try{const D=afDest(role,sd,ac),v=D&&AO.ST&&AO.ST.length?(g77Cands(role,sd,1)||[])[0]:null;

    for(const a of out){for(const b of AO.ST)if(b.L!=='S'&&aoC(a,b)){r=b.t;break}if(r)break}}}}catch(e){r=null}

function g77StandSvc(sd,ac){

  catering:R(apron||ga,has('cat')),cleaning:R(apron,has('cln')),water:R(apron,has('wat')),lavatory:R(apron||ga,has('lav')),gpu:bridge?R(true,true):cargo?(G77_STAGE>=4?R(true,has('gpu')):Object.assign(R(true,false),{st:4})):R(apron||ga,has('gpu')),belt:R(apron,has('belt')),highloader:R(cargo||bridge,G77_STAGE>=4&&cargo&&has('hl')),marshal:R(true,false),chocks:R(true,false),cargo:R(cargo,G77_STAGE>=4&&cargo)}}
// one row of the matrix: compatible? which services, from which stage; quantities
function g77Match(sd,ac){
 const P=g77Prof(sd,ac),r={stand:sd.id,ac,role:g77Role(sd,ac),accepts:(sd.accepts||[]).includes(ac),cls:P?P.cls:0,standCls:g77StandCls(sd),svc:{},missing:[],later:[],ok:false};
 if(!P){r.why='no-profile';return r}
 const S=g77StandSvc(sd,ac);
 for(const k of P.svc){const q=S[k]||{reach:false,now:false},st=q.st||G77_SVC[k].st;r.svc[k]=!q.reach?'no':q.now?'ok':'S'+Math.max(2,st);if(!q.reach)r.missing.push(k);else if(!q.now)r.later.push(k)}
 r.ok=r.accepts&&!r.missing.length;r.why=!r.accepts?'stand-does-not-accept':r.missing.length?'service-cannot-reach:'+r.missing.join(','):'ok';
 if(r.missing.length){const bl=[];for(const k of r.missing){const b=k==='push'?g77StaticBlock(sd,ac,'tug'):k==='fuel'?g77StaticBlock(sd,ac,'fuel'):null;if(b)bl.push(k+'→'+g77StaticStand(b))}if(bl.length){r.blocked=bl;r.why+=' (static parking: '+bl.join(', ')+')'}}
 return r}
// ---- quantities (AIR-38 / 39 / 44): from the flight code (deterministic), by aircraft size ---------------------------------------------------
function g77Hash(s){let h=2166136261;for(const ch of String(s))h=Math.imul(h^ch.charCodeAt(0),16777619)>>>0;return h}
// AIR-38: two aircraft of different sizes never carry the same number — the low end of a type starts above the high end of the next smaller one
const G77_PAXR=(()=>{const L=Object.entries(G77_AC).filter(([k,P])=>P.seats>0&&P.role!=='cargo').sort((a,b)=>a[1].seats-b[1].seats),r={};let hi=0;
 for(const [k,P] of L){const mn=Math.max(hi+1,Math.round(P.seats*.62)),mx=Math.max(mn,Math.round(P.seats*.95));r[k]={floor:hi+1,min:mn,max:mx};hi=mx}return r})();

function g77Dwell(sd,ac,code){const k=sd.kind==='pax'?'pax':sd.kind==='cargo'?'cargo':'ga',base=aoR(...(k==='pax'?AO.cfg.turn:k==='cargo'?AO.cfg.cgDwell:AO.cfg.gaDwell));

// ---- Best-Fit (AIR-36): a smaller stand that takes the same type in the same role and is free now ------------------------------------------
function g77FreeState(s2,now){if(!s2.live)return'not-live';if(s2.indoor)return'indoor';if(s2.busy)return'busy';for(const f of AO.flights)if(f.stand===s2.id&&(f.tGone??f.t1)>now)return'occupied:'+f.code;return'free'}
function g77Free(s2,now){return g77FreeState(s2,now)==='free'}
// every smaller stand that takes the same type in the same role, with its state at decision time (recorded on the flight → audited)
function g77SmallerState(sd,ac,now){const role=g77Role(sd,ac),c=g77StandCls(sd),out=[];for(const s2 of AO.stands){if(s2===sd||s2.kind==='heli'||!(s2.accepts||[]).includes(ac)||g77Role(s2,ac)!==role)continue;
  if(g77StandCls(s2)<c&&g77Match(s2,ac).ok)out.push([s2.id,g77FreeState(s2,now)])}return out}
function g77SmallerFree(sd,ac,now){return g77SmallerState(sd,ac,now).filter(x=>x[1]==='free').map(x=>x[0])}
function g77Choose(sd,now){
 const l=sd.accepts.filter(a=>aoFits(sd,a)&&g77Match(sd,a).ok);if(!l.length)return null;
 const fit=l.filter(a=>!g77SmallerFree(sd,a,now).length);
 if(!fit.length)return null;
 const lgOk=fit.includes('AC-LG-01')&&fit.length>1,rest=lgOk?fit.filter(a=>a!=='AC-LG-01'):fit,ac=lgOk&&AO.rng()<.25?'AC-LG-01':rest[Math.floor(AO.rng()*rest.length)];if(g77Prof(sd,ac).cls<g77StandCls(sd))AO.stats.bfOver=(AO.stats.bfOver||0)+1;AO.bfLast={at:now,ac,c:g77SmallerState(sd,ac,now)};return ac}
// ---- Best-Fit audit (AIR-36 / QA-54): every assignment re-checked against its decision record ---------------------------------------------
function g77BestFitAudit(fl){
 fl=fl||AO.hist.concat(AO.flights);const byCode=new Map();for(const f of fl){const l=byCode.get(f.code);if(l)l.push(f);else byCode.set(f.code,[f])}   // GA registrations can repeat
 const r={n:0,over:0,free:0,occ:0,occOk:0,occUnk:0,busy:0,off:0,issues:[]};
 for(const f of fl){if(!f.bfC||f.heli||f.never)continue;r.n++;const c=g77StandCls(f.sd),pc=(g77Prof(f.sd,f.ac)||{}).cls||0;if(pc<c)r.over++;
  for(const [id,s] of f.bfC){
   if(s==='free'){r.free++;r.issues.push('WASTE '+f.code+' '+f.ac.slice(3,5)+'@'+f.stand+' while '+id+' free');continue}
   if(s==='busy'){r.busy++;continue}
   if(s==='not-live'||s==='indoor'){r.off++;continue}
   if(s.startsWith('occupied:')){r.occ++;const L=byCode.get(s.slice(9));if(!L){r.occUnk++;continue}
    if(!L.some(g=>g.stand===id&&g.t1>f.bfAt))r.issues.push('CLAIM '+f.code+': '+id+' '+s+' not true at '+(+f.bfAt).toFixed(1));else r.occOk++}}}
 r.ok=!r.issues.length;return r}
// ---- the stand profile row (AIR-35): access, sides, pushback ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function g77Access(sd,ac){const P=g77Prof(sd,ac)||{};if(sd.kind==='heli')return'מנחת — הליכה';if(sd.kind==='maint')return'האנגר — גרירה פנימה';if(sd.kind==='cargo')return'רחבת מטען';
 if(sd.tpl==='bridge')return'שרוול';if(g2Remote(sd,ac))return'מדרגות + אוטובוס';return P.role==='ga'?'הליכה רגלית (GA)':'הליכה רגלית'}
function g77Push(sd,ac){if(sd.kind==='heli')return'המראה אנכית';if(sd.kind==='maint')return'גרירה';const ps=!!AO_PUSH[sd.tpl];return!ps?'יציאה קדימה':aoNeedTug(sd,ac)?'דחיפה לאחור עם גורר':'יציאה לאחור בכוח המנוע'}
// ---- one full turnaround of a type at a stand, in a sandbox (QA-54): an empty airport (the static parking stays), this stand only ----------
const G77_VROLE=x=>x.role||(x.task&&x.task.role)||(x.v&&x.v.role)||'?';
function g77Turn(id,ac,seed,xo){
 if(!APTT_SPEC){APTT_SPEC=aptBuildSpec();APTT_C=aptBuildC()}
 return aoSandbox(()=>{
  AO.keep=true;aoInit(0,seed||777);for(const s of AO.stands){s.init=null;s.next=Infinity}
  const sd=AO.stands.find(s=>s.id===id),t0w=performance.now();let P=null;
  if(sd.kind==='heli')P=AO.flights.find(f=>f.stand===id&&!f.never&&f.heli)||null;
  let tries=0;const whys=[];
  if(sd.kind!=='heli'){for(;tries<4&&!P;tries++){const w0=Object.assign({},AO.stats.why);P=aoPlanVisit(sd,AO.lead+5+tries*AO.H,Object.assign({ac,bfC:[],bfAt:0},xo||{}));
   if(!P){let why='?';for(const k in AO.stats.why)if((AO.stats.why[k]||0)>(w0[k]||0))why=k;whys.push(why)}}
   if(!P)return{ok:false,why:'plan-failed:'+whys.join(','),tries,issues:['PLAN '+whys.join(',')]}}
  if(!P)return{ok:false,why:'no-heli-plan',issues:['PLAN heli']};
  const seq=P.states.map(s=>s[1]),issues=[];
  const need=sd.kind==='heli'?['ON_BLOCK','TAXI_OUT','DEPARTED']:['INBOUND','TAXI_IN','ON_BLOCK','TURNAROUND_READY','DEPARTED'];
  let last=-1,lt=-Infinity;for(const n of need){const i=seq.indexOf(n);if(i<0){issues.push('SEQ missing '+n);continue}if(i<last)issues.push('SEQ order '+n);last=i}
  for(const s of P.states){if(s[0]<lt-1e-6)issues.push('SEQ time');lt=s[0]}
  const roles={};for(const x of P.vt||[]){const k=G77_VROLE(x);roles[k]=(roles[k]||0)+1}
  const m=g77Match(sd,ac),prof=g77Prof(sd,ac)||{svc:[]},q=P.q||g77Quant(sd,ac,P.code),bridge=sd.tpl==='bridge'&&!P.nb,remote=g2Remote(sd,ac);
  // every mandatory service that works today was delivered
  for(const k of prof.svc){if(m.svc[k]!=='ok')continue;
   if(k==='bags'){const want=Math.max(1,q.bagsA.trips)+Math.max(1,q.bagsD.trips);if((roles.bag||0)<want)issues.push('MISSING bags '+(roles.bag||0)+'/'+want)}
   else if(k==='fuel'){if(!roles.fuel)issues.push('MISSING fuel')}
   else if(k==='push'){if(AO_PUSH[sd.tpl]&&aoNeedTug(sd,ac)&&!roles.tug)issues.push('MISSING tug')}
   else if(k==='pax'){if(bridge&&!(P.pax&&P.pax.count>0))issues.push('MISSING bridge passengers');if(P.nb&&!(P.nb.arr&&P.nb.dep))issues.push('MISSING bus passengers');if(remote&&!P.g2)issues.push('MISSING bus')}
   else if(k==='cargo'&&G77_STAGE>=4){const n=Math.ceil((q.cargoU||0)/3)*2;if((roles.cgo||0)<n)issues.push('MISSING cargo trips '+(roles.cgo||0)+'/'+n)}
   else if(k==='marshal'){if(!P.crew||!P.crew.walkers.length)issues.push('MISSING marshal')}
   else if(k==='chocks'){if(!P.crew||!P.crew.items.some(i=>i.k==='chock'))issues.push('MISSING chocks')}
   else if(G77_ROLE_OF[k]&&!(k==='gpu'&&sd.tpl==='bridge')&&g77Need(P.code,k,ac)&&!roles[G77_ROLE_OF[k]]&&!(k==='catering'&&roles.cats))issues.push('MISSING '+k)}   // GATE-77 S7-a · p185: the van (cats) serves the catering of the small ones

  // and nothing it must not get (AIR-46 / 48)
  const role=prof.role;
  if((role==='cargo'||role==='ga'||role==='heli'||role==='maint')&&(roles.bag||P.g2||(P.pax&&P.pax.count)))issues.push('WRONG passenger/baggage service for '+role);
  if(role==='heli'&&(P.vt||[]).length)issues.push('WRONG vehicle at a helipad');
  if(role==='pax'&&q.paxA<1)issues.push('QTY no passengers');
  if(G77_FX.on)for(const h of g77FixedHits(P))issues.push(h);   // GATE-77 S6c · p172 · D-180: QA-54 + the fixed objects
  const v=aoVerify(P.t0,Math.min(P.t1,P.t0+3600));for(const i of v.issues)issues.push('CONFLICT '+i);
  if(G77_STAGE>=3&&P.crew){const ca=g77CrewAudit([P],P.t0,Math.min(P.t1,P.t0+3600));for(const i of ca.issues)issues.push('CREW '+i)}
  return{ok:!issues.length,code:P.code,mode:P.nb?'bus':P.g2?'remote':(P.bridgeAt?'bridge':'own'),catQ:typeof s6rCatQa==='function'?s6rCatQa([P]):null,seq:seq.join('>'),roles,pax:q.paxA+'/'+q.paxD,bags:q.bagsA.trips+'/'+q.bagsD.trips,carts:q.bagsA.carts+'/'+q.bagsD.carts,
   dwell:P.tOB!=null&&P.tPush!=null?Math.round(P.tPush-P.tOB):null,dur:Math.round(Math.min(P.t1,P.t0+3600)-P.t0),tries:tries||1,retryWhy:whys,paxDrawn:P.pax?P.pax.count:(P.g2?'bus':null),issues:issues.slice(0,8),ms:Math.round(performance.now()-t0w)}
 })}
// ---- the QA-54 table: every live aircraft type × every specific stand ------------------------------------------------------------------------
function g77Stands(){return AO.stands&&AO.stands.length?AO.stands:aoMakeStands()}
function g77LiveTypes(st){const s=new Set();for(const sd of st)for(const a of sd.accepts||[])if(G77_AC[a])s.add(a);return Object.keys(G77_AC).filter(a=>s.has(a))}
function g77Matrix(o={}){
 const st=g77Stands(),types=g77LiveTypes(st),rows=[];
 for(const sd of st)for(const ac of types){
  const m=g77Match(sd,ac),P=g77Prof(sd,ac)||{},q=g77Quant(sd,ac,'QA54-'+sd.id+'-'+ac.slice(3,5));
  const row={stand:sd.id,kind:sd.kind,live:!!sd.live,ac,type:P.name,role:m.role,cls:m.cls,standCls:m.standCls,accepts:m.accepts,compatible:m.ok,why:m.why,svc:m.svc,later:m.later,missing:m.missing,
   pax:q.paxA+'/'+q.paxD,bags:q.bagsA.carts+'/'+q.bagsD.carts+' עגלות · '+q.bagsA.trips+'/'+q.bagsD.trips+' נסיעות',cargoU:q.cargoU,access:m.accepts?g77Access(sd,ac):'',push:m.accepts?g77Push(sd,ac):'',
   sides:m.accepts&&sd.kind!=='heli'&&sd.kind!=='maint'?{pax:sd.door==='R'?'ימין':'שמאל',svc:sd.door==='R'?'שמאל':'ימין'}:null,
   bestFitFirst:m.accepts?g77SmallerState(sd,ac,-1).map(x=>x[0]):[]};
  if(!m.accepts)row.result='לא מורשה';
  else if(!m.ok)row.result='חסום — שירות לא מגיע (לא מוקצה)';
  else if(!sd.live)row.result='חניה קבועה — העמדה לא פעילה בשלב זה';
  else if(o.turn===false)row.result='תואם';
  else{row.turn=g77Turn(sd.id,ac,o.seed);row.result=row.turn.ok?'PASS':'FAIL';if(o.qa87!==false&&typeof s6rNoBridge==='function'&&s6rNoBridge(APL.stands.find(s=>s.id===sd.id)||sd,ac)&&!s6rBusOnly(sd.id,ac))row.turnB=g77Turn(sd.id,ac,o.seed,{nbOff:true})}   // GATE-77 S6r · M5c · QA-87
  rows.push(row)}
 const T=rows.filter(r=>r.turn);
 return{stage:G77_STAGE,types:types.length,stands:st.length,rows,compatible:rows.filter(r=>r.compatible).length,turns:T.length,pass:T.filter(r=>r.turn.ok).length,fail:T.filter(r=>!r.turn.ok).map(r=>r.stand+':'+r.ac.slice(3,5)+' '+r.turn.issues.slice(0,2).join(';')),qa87:o.turn===false?null:g77Qa87(rows)}}
// GATE-77 S6r · M5c · QA-87: the forced coverage — every compatible aircraft × stand × each of its service modes (the bridge stands P2 / P3:
// the bus, and the bridge for a type that may take either), in a forced visit ('bring now'), not what a seed happened to draw. Per visit:
// the visit passes (QA-54), the mode is the one asked for, the catering platform's end ≤ 2 px from its door (K-82), a belt where the type
// needs one (D-108); per bridge stand: the power pit exists and the cable starts in it (K-81). "נבדקו X / Y" — X / Y = 100 %.
function g77Qa87(rows){const out={tested:0,total:0,pass:0,fails:[],pits:{}};
 for(const r of rows){if(!r.turn)continue;const sdx=APL.stands.find(s=>s.id===r.stand)||{id:r.stand},nb=typeof s6rNoBridge==='function'&&s6rNoBridge(sdx,r.ac),bo=nb&&typeof s6rBusOnly==='function'&&s6rBusOnly(r.stand,r.ac);
  const modes=[['default',r.turn,nb?'bus':null]];if(nb&&!bo)modes.push(['bridge',r.turnB,'bridge']);
  for(const [name,t,exp] of modes){out.total++;if(!t){out.fails.push(r.stand+':'+r.ac.slice(3,5)+'/'+name+' not run');continue}out.tested++;const why=[];
   if(!t.ok)why.push(...(t.issues||[]).slice(0,2));
   if(exp&&t.mode!==exp)why.push('mode '+t.mode+' ≠ '+exp);
   if(t.catQ&&t.catQ.jobs>0&&!t.catQ.ok)why.push('catering miss '+t.catQ.maxMiss);
   if(sdx.tpl==='bridge'&&t.mode==='bridge'&&typeof s6rBeltAc==='function'&&s6rBeltAc(sdx,r.ac)&&!(t.roles&&t.roles.belt))why.push('no belt');
   if(t.mode==='remote'&&S6A_BELT[r.ac]&&!(t.roles&&t.roles.belt))why.push('no belt (remote)');   // GATE-77 S6r · M5d: P5 / P6 — a belt where the type needs one
   if(why.length)out.fails.push(r.stand+':'+r.ac.slice(3,5)+'/'+name+' '+why.join('; '));else out.pass++}}
 for(const sd of APL.stands){if(sd.tpl!=='bridge')continue;const p=s6rPit(sd,null);out.pits[sd.id]=!!p;out.total++;out.tested++;if(p)out.pass++;else out.fails.push(sd.id+' no power pit')}
 out.text='נבדקו '+out.tested+' / '+out.total;out.ok=out.total>0&&out.tested===out.total&&out.pass===out.total;return out}

// GATE-77 S6r · T2 · QA-88 (6): three four-engine jets at P1–P3 within minutes
function g77Force3(seed){if(!APTT_SPEC){APTT_SPEC=aptBuildSpec();APTT_C=aptBuildC()}return aoSandbox(()=>{AO.keep=true;aoInit(0,seed||777);for(const s of AO.stands){s.init=null;s.next=Infinity}
 const out=[],t0=AO.lead+5;
 ['P2','P3'].forEach((id,i)=>{const sd=AO.stands.find(s=>s.id===id),tq=t0+i*90;   /* p406: the RJ100 is not P1's (rule 3) */let P=null,tries=0;const why=[];for(;tries<3&&!P;tries++){const w0=Object.assign({},AO.stats.why);P=aoPlanVisit(sd,tq+tries*AO.H,{ac:'AC-QJ-01',bfC:[],bfAt:0});if(!P){for(const k in AO.stats.why)if((AO.stats.why[k]||0)>(w0[k]||0))why.push(k)}}
  out.push({stand:id,ok:!!P,tries,code:P&&P.code,tReq:Math.round(tq),tOB:P&&P.tOB!=null?Math.round(P.tOB):null,delay:P&&P.tOB!=null?Math.round(P.tOB-tq):null,mode:P?(P.nb?'bus':(P.bridgeAt?'bridge':'other')):null,busWait:P&&P.nb&&P.nb.arr?Math.round(P.nb.arr.at-(P.tOB+G77_CHOCK+5)):null,why:why.slice(0,3),nbWhy:AF.nbWhy||null})});
 const v=aoVerify(0,3600),cr=g77CrewAudit(AO.flights,0,3600);
 const bwMax=Math.max(0,...out.map(o=>o.busWait||0)),ok=out.every(o=>o.ok)&&out.filter(o=>o.stand!=='P1').every(o=>o.mode==='bus')&&bwMax<=120&&v.ok&&cr.ok;   // p139: + the bus wait ≤ 120 s (AIR-58)
 return{seed:seed||777,out,verify:v.ok,vIssues:v.issues.slice(0,4),crew:cr.ok,crewIssues:cr.issues.slice(0,3),busWaitMax:bwMax,ok}})}
// GATE-77 S6r · M5c · QA-88: the ground-service capacity report (the sandbox run of tools/s6r/qa_capacity.js, now in the registry) +
// the AIR-58 verdict per service (wait mean ≤ 30 s, max ≤ 120 s) and the turboprop / QJ at the bridge stands (s6rNbStats)
function g77Capacity(seed,SEC){const t0w=performance.now();const r=aoSandbox(()=>{
      if (!APTT_SPEC) { APTT_SPEC = aptBuildSpec(); APTT_C = aptBuildC() }
      AO.keep = true; aoInit(0, seed); for (let t = 0; t <= SEC; t += 1) aoStep(t);
      const all = AO.hist.concat(AO.flights).filter(f => !f.never && f.tOB != null && f.tOB <= SEC);
      const fx = all.filter(f => !f.heli), he = all.filter(f => f.heli);
      const by = (arr, k) => { const m = {}; for (const x of arr) { const key = k(x); m[key] = (m[key] || 0) + 1 } return m };
      const mean = a => a.length ? +(a.reduce((p, q) => p + q, 0) / a.length).toFixed(1) : null, mx = a => a.length ? +Math.max(...a).toFixed(1) : null;
      // aircraft
      const types = by(fx, f => f.ac), stands = by(fx, f => f.stand), dwell = {};
      for (const f of fx) { const d = (f.tPush ?? f.t1) - f.tOB; (dwell[f.ac] || (dwell[f.ac] = [])).push(d) }
      const dwellM = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(dwell).map(([k, a]) => [k, [mean(a), mx(a)]]));
      // services planned per visit (svcQ: nominal vs actual)
      const svc = {};
      for (const f of fx) for (const q of f.svcQ || []) { const s = svc[q.svc] || (svc[q.svc] = { n: 0, wait: [], hold: [], byAc: {} }); s.n++; s.wait.push(Math.max(0, q.at - q.nom)); s.hold.push(q.done - q.at); s.byAc[f.ac] = (s.byAc[f.ac] || 0) + 1 }
      // fuel / bags / tug from the visit's vehicle tasks
      for (const f of fx) for (const x of f.vt || []) { const r = x.role || (x.task && x.task.role); if (!r) continue; const k = 'vt:' + r, s = svc[k] || (svc[k] = { n: 0, wait: [], hold: [], byAc: {} }); s.n++; s.byAc[f.ac] = (s.byAc[f.ac] || 0) + 1;
        if (r === 'fuel' && x.at != null) { const nom = f.tOB + AO.cfg.fuel + G77_CHOCK + g77ChockExtra(f.ac); s.wait.push(Math.max(0, x.at - nom)); if (x.done != null) s.hold.push(x.done - x.at) } }
      // buses (remote P5 / P6 and the bridge stands P2 / P3)
      const bus = { remote: 0, nb: 0, waitArr: [], waitDep: [], pax: 0, trips: 0 };
      for (const f of fx) { for (const [k, r] of [['remote', f.g2], ['nb', f.nb]]) { if (!r) continue; bus[k]++; bus.trips += 2; bus.pax += (r.arr ? r.arr.n : 0) + (r.dep ? r.dep.n : 0); if (r.arr) bus.waitArr.push(Math.max(0, r.arr.at - (f.tOB + G77_CHOCK + 5))) } }
      const svcOut = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(svc).map(([k, s]) => [k, { n: s.n, perH: +(s.n * 3600 / SEC).toFixed(1), waitMean: mean(s.wait), waitMax: mx(s.wait), holdMean: mean(s.hold), byAc: s.byAc }]));
      // the fleet: per type
      const fleet = {};
      for (const v of AO.fleet) {
        const F = fleet[v.type] || (fleet[v.type] = { n: 0, tasks: 0, busy: 0, work: 0, drive: 0, ev: [], roles: {} }); F.n++;
        for (const k of v.hist.concat(v.tasks)) { if (k.t0 > SEC) continue; const t1 = Math.min(k.t1, SEC); F.tasks++; F.busy += t1 - k.t0; F.ev.push([k.t0, 1], [t1, -1]); F.roles[k.role] = (F.roles[k.role] || 0) + 1;
          const L = k.tr && k.tr.seq ? k.tr.seq.legs : []; for (const l of L) { const atAc = l.kind === 'svc' || (l.kind === 'hold' && (l.label === 'svc' || l.at === 'ac' || (l.g2 && l.g2.at === 'ac'))); if (atAc) F.work += l.dur; else if (l.kind !== 'hold' && l.kind !== 'absent') F.drive += l.dur } }
      }
      const fleetOut = {};
      for (const [k, F] of Object.entries(fleet)) { F.ev.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0] || a[1] - b[1]); let c = 0, pk = 0; for (const e of F.ev) { c += e[1]; pk = Math.max(pk, c) }
        fleetOut[k] = { n: F.n, tasks: F.tasks, perH: +(F.tasks * 3600 / SEC).toFixed(1), util: +(F.busy / (F.n * SEC)).toFixed(2), peak: pk, workShare: F.busy ? +(F.work / F.busy).toFixed(2) : 0, driveShare: F.busy ? +(F.drive / F.busy).toFixed(2) : 0, roles: F.roles } }
      return { seed, sec: SEC, flights: fx.length, perH: +(fx.length * 3600 / SEC).toFixed(1), heli: he.length, types, stands, dwell: dwellM,
        failed: AO.stats.failed, why: AO.stats.why, queued: AO.stats.queued, maxQueue: AO.stats.maxQueue && +AO.stats.maxQueue.toFixed(1),
        services: svcOut, bus: { remote: bus.remote, nb: bus.nb, trips: bus.trips, pax: bus.pax, waitArrMean: mean(bus.waitArr), waitArrMax: mx(bus.waitArr) },
        fleet: fleetOut, nb: s6rNbStats(all, SEC), ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0w) };
    });
 const over=[];for(const [k,q] of Object.entries(r.services||{})){if(q.waitMean==null)continue;if(q.waitMean>30||q.waitMax>120)over.push(k+' '+q.waitMean+' / '+q.waitMax)}
 r.air58={over,ok:!over.length};return r}
// GATE-77 S6r · M5c · QA-89: the bags and the belts in a run — bags unloaded / loaded (the visible transfers), belt jobs, bags at a belt
// aircraft with no belt loader at the hold (= 0, sampled every second), loaded by hand (the aircraft without a belt). The inventory (2) and
// save / load in the middle of a loading (3) — S7 (K-57).
function g77BagQa(seed,sec){return aoSandbox(()=>{if(!APTT_SPEC){APTT_SPEC=aptBuildSpec();APTT_C=aptBuildC()}AO.keep=true;aoInit(0,seed);let gap=0,gapAt=[];
 for(let t=0;t<=sec;t+=1){aoStep(t);if(t>=60&&typeof s6rBeltGapAt==='function'){const g=s6rBeltGapAt(t);if(g&&g.length){gap++;if(gapAt.length<4)gapAt.push(t+':'+g.slice(0,2).join(','))}}}
 let un=0,ld=0,trips={arr:0,dep:0},hand=0,beltJobs=0;const all=AO.hist.concat(AO.flights).filter(f=>!f.never&&!f.heli);
 for(const v of AO.fleet){for(const k of v.hist.concat(v.tasks)){if(k.t0>sec)continue;if(k.role==='belt')beltJobs++;if(k.role!=='bag')continue;const m=k.tr.seq.legs.find(l=>l.kind==='mu');const n=m&&m.f2?m.f2.n:0;
  if(k.tr.f2bag==='arr'){un+=n;trips.arr++}else if(k.tr.f2bag==='dep'){ld+=n;trips.dep++}
  const code=String(k.code||'').split('/')[0],f=all.find(q=>q.code===code);if(f&&!(f.vt||[]).some(x=>G77_VROLE(x)==='belt'))hand+=n}}
 return{seed,sec,unloaded:un,loaded:ld,trips,beltJobs,noBeltSeconds:gap,noBeltAt:gapAt,byHand:hand,ok:gap===0&&(un+ld)>0}})}

window.__TC_G77_MATRIX=o=>g77Matrix(o||{});
// ---- the cheap part for the world audits: the profiles, the quantity bands, every live stand has a compatible type, Best-Fit on the live state
function g77StaticAudit(){
 const st=g77Stands(),types=g77LiveTypes(st),issues=[];let rows=0,compat=0;
 const PAXSVC=['pax','bags','catering','cleaning','water','lavatory','belt'];
 for(const [k,P] of Object.entries(G77_AC).concat([['AC-TP-01(cargo)',G77_TP_CARGO]])){
  if(P.role==='cargo'&&P.svc.some(s=>PAXSVC.includes(s)))issues.push('PROFILE '+k+' cargo with passenger service');
  if(P.role==='ga'&&P.svc.some(s=>['bags','belt','highloader','cargo','cleaning','water','pax'].includes(s)))issues.push('PROFILE '+k+' GA with airline service');
  if(P.role==='pax'&&P.svc.includes('cargo'))issues.push('PROFILE '+k+' passenger with cargo chain');
  if(P.role==='pax'&&P.svc.includes('highloader')&&P.cls<6)issues.push('PROFILE '+k+' high loader below wide-body');   // GATE-77 S5c: the wide-body tri-jet (class 6)
  for(const s of P.svc)if(!G77_SVC[s])issues.push('PROFILE '+k+' unknown service '+s)}
 // quantities: bands never overlap between sizes; carts by size
 const L=Object.keys(G77_PAXR).sort((a,b)=>G77_AC[a].seats-G77_AC[b].seats);
 for(let i=1;i<L.length;i++)if(G77_PAXR[L[i]].min<=G77_PAXR[L[i-1]].max)issues.push('QTY overlap '+L[i-1]+'/'+L[i]);
 const cart=(ac,f)=>{let v=f==='min'?1e9:0;for(let i=0;i<60;i++){const c=g77Bags('Q'+i,ac,'arr').carts;v=f==='min'?Math.min(v,c):Math.max(v,c)}return v};
 if(cart('AC-PR-01','max')>1||cart('AC-BJ-01','max')>1)issues.push('QTY GA carts');
 if(cart('AC-TP-01','min')<1||cart('AC-TP-01','max')>2)issues.push('QTY regional carts');
 if(cart('AC-NB-01','min')<3)issues.push('QTY narrow-body carts');
 if(cart('AC-LG-01','min')<7)issues.push('QTY large carts');

function g77Mars(a,p,b){return!!(a&&b&&a.large&&g77MarsLock(a.id,p).has(b.id))}   /* p407 · R-29: by the envelope and the path (G77_MARS), not the name */
// ---- p407 · R-29: the large stand's locks, from the layout with the audit's own numbers (G73_REQ) — computed once. lock: 'P4|type' → the
// stands it closes while there; lane: the 'P4|type' whose tail closes lane L east (an apronSW stand's taxi out sweeps it). Lane L is
// forced open while the legs are made (the legs of a closed lane go by A3). The sweeps here step 0.5 s; g73StandAudit (0.25 s) is
// the authority: a pair it finds too close and not locked here fails it. ----
var G77_MARS=null;const G77_MARS_NONE=new Set();
function g77MarsCalc(){const M={lock:new Map(),lane:new Set(),locked:new Set(),gap:{},ok:false,ms:0},t0=performance.now(),fz=G77_LC_FORCE;G77_MARS=M;
 try{G77_LC_FORCE=false;aptReady();const R=G73_REQ,S=APL.stands.filter(s=>!s.indoor),env=(s,ac)=>{const v=g77StandView(s,ac);return aplEnv(ac,v.ngx,v.ngy,v.th)};
  const legs=(s,ac)=>{let a=null,D=null;try{a=aoArrLeg(s,ac);D=aoDepLegs(s,ac)}catch(e){return[]}return[['arr',a,a?Math.max(0,a.dur-45):0],['push',D&&D.push,0],['taxi',D&&D.taxi,0]]};
  const sweep=(s,ac,kinds,o,E)=>{let m=1e9;for(const [k,leg,ts] of legs(s,ac)){if(!leg||!kinds.includes(k))continue;for(let t=ts;t<=leg.dur;t+=.5){const p=leg.pose(t);if(!p||p[3]>2||Math.abs(o.ngx-p[0])>600||Math.abs(o.ngy-p[1])>600)continue;const me=aplEnv(ac,p[0],p[1],p[2]);for(const e of E){const g=g73EnvGap(me,e);if(g<m)m=g}}}return m};
  for(const L of S){if(!L.large)continue;for(const p of L.accepts){const key=L.id+'|'+p,eL=env(L,p),set=new Set();
   for(const b of S){if(b===L)continue;const dx=Math.abs(b.ngx-L.ngx),dy=Math.abs(b.ngy-L.ngy);if((dx>700||dy>700)&&Math.hypot(dx,dy)>=900)continue;
    const eb=b.accepts.map(q=>env(b,q)),need=L.tpl==='bridge'&&b.tpl==='bridge'?R.bridgeWing:R.margin,sw=b.tpl==='apronSW';
    let park=1e9;for(const e of eb){const g=g73EnvGap(eL,e);if(g<park)park=g}
    let path=1e9;if(b.live)for(const q of b.accepts)path=Math.min(path,sweep(b,q,sw?['arr','push']:['arr','push','taxi'],L,[eL]));
    if(L.live)path=Math.min(path,sweep(L,p,['arr','push','taxi'],b,eb));
    if(park<need||path<R.margin){set.add(b.id);M.locked.add(b.id);M.gap[key+'>'+b.id]=[+(park/A34_PXM).toFixed(1),+(path/A34_PXM).toFixed(1)]}
    if(sw&&b.live){let tx=1e9;for(const q of b.accepts)tx=Math.min(tx,sweep(b,q,['taxi'],L,[eL]));if(tx<R.margin){M.lane.add(key);M.gap[key+'>L']=M.gap[key+'>L']||[b.id,+(tx/A34_PXM).toFixed(1)]}}}
   M.lock.set(key,set)}}M.ok=true}
 catch(e){M.err=String(e&&e.message||e).slice(0,160);   // never unlocked by an error: the old pairs (the audit reports the error)
  M.lock.clear();M.lane.clear();M.locked.clear();for(const ac of ['AC-LG-01','AC-MW-01']){M.lock.set('P4|'+ac,new Set(['P3']));M.lane.add('P4|'+ac)}M.locked.add('P3')}
 finally{G77_LC_FORCE=fz}M.ms=Math.round(performance.now()-t0);return M}

function g77VMarg(b,s){let m=5;const n2=g77Slice(s+1);if(!n2)return m;let best=null,bd=1e9;for(const q of n2){if(q.L!=='V'||q.t!==b.t)continue;const d=Math.hypot(q.x-b.x,q.y-b.y);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=q}}
 if(!best||bd>40)return m;const dth=Math.abs(Math.atan2(b.s*best.c-b.c*best.s,b.c*best.c+b.s*best.s));return m+(bd+2*Math.sin(dth/2)*Math.hypot(b.hx,b.hy))/2}
function g77Busy(x,y,t){const f=t/AO.DT,s=Math.floor(f+1e-9);return g77Busy1(x,y,s)||(f-s>1e-6&&g77Busy1(x,y,s+1))}   // GATE-77 S6r · M5b · K-93: the slice before and the slice after (aoSl rounds)
function g77Busy1(x,y,s){const bk=g77Slice(s);if(!bk||!bk.length)return false;const a=apttObb(x,y,0,[-1.5,1.5,-1.5,1.5],'P','q'),Y=G77_YC,own=Y&&(!Y.rg||Y.noOwn)&&Y.code;
 for(let i=0;i<bk.length;i++){const b=bk[i],L=b.L;if(L!=='V'&&L!=='F'&&L!=='W'&&L!=='T')continue;if(own&&b.t===own)continue;let m=L==='F'||L==='W'?5:3;if(a.x0>b.x1+m+14||a.x1<b.x0-m-14||a.y0>b.y1+m+14||a.y1<b.y0-m-14)continue;if(L==='V')m=g77VMarg(b,s);if(a.x0>b.x1+m||a.x1<b.x0-m||a.y0>b.y1+m||a.y1<b.y0-m)continue;if(apttObbHit(a,b,m))return true}return false}   /* p141 · K-103 */
function g77SegOk(a,b,ts,d){return g77SegFree(a,b,ts,d)&&g77HoldFree(b,ts+d,ts+d+2)}
function g77SegFree(a,b,ts,d){const n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(d/AO.DT));for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const u=i/n;if(g77Busy(a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*u,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*u,ts+d*u))return false}return true}
function g77HoldFree(p,t0,t1){for(let t=t0;t<=t1+1e-9;t+=AO.DT)if(g77Busy(p[0],p[1],t))return false;return true}
function g77SegD(c,a,b){const dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1],l=dx*dx+dy*dy||1,u=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((c[0]-a[0])*dx+(c[1]-a[1])*dy)/l));return Math.hypot(a[0]+dx*u-c[0],a[1]+dy*u-c[1])}
// GATE-77 S6b · p143 · K-109: a waypoint is entered only if the walker can stand there until the next leg is free (or 60 s)
function g77NextOk(p,q,t1){if(!q)return true;const d=Math.hypot(q[0]-p[0],q[1]-p[1]);if(d<.5)return true;const dd=d/G77_WALK;for(let tw=t1;tw<=t1+60;tw+=1){if(g77SegFree(p,q,tw,dd))return true;if(!g77HoldFree(p,tw,tw+1))return false}return true}
function g77Go(w,pts,t0){let t=Math.max(t0,w.t),at=w.at;
 for(let pi=0;pi<pts.length;pi++){const p=pts[pi],nx=pts[pi+1]||null,d=Math.hypot(p[0]-at[0],p[1]-at[1]);if(d<.5)continue;const dur=d/G77_WALK;
  if(G77_YC&&AO.B.size&&!g77SegOk(at,p,t,dur)){const ux=(p[0]-at[0])/d,uy=(p[1]-at[1])/d,mx=(at[0]+p[0])/2,my=(at[1]+p[1])/2;let dt=null;
   for(const o of [20,-20,40,-40,64,-64]){const m=[mx-uy*o,my+ux*o],d1=Math.hypot(m[0]-at[0],m[1]-at[1])/G77_WALK,d2=Math.hypot(p[0]-m[0],p[1]-m[1])/G77_WALK;if(m[1]>APT_Y.LN-4&&m[1]<APT_Y.LS+4&&m[0]>G73_L.x0-10&&m[0]<G73_L.x1+10)continue;if(G77_STAIR.on&&(g77PplLane(m[0],m[1])||(!g77PplLane(at[0],at[1])&&g77SegLane(at,m))||(!g77PplLane(p[0],p[1])&&g77SegLane(m,p))))continue;if(APL.helis.some(h=>g77SegD([h.x,h.y],at,m)<h.r+8||g77SegD([h.x,h.y],m,p)<h.r+8))continue;if(g77SegFree(at,m,t,d1)&&g77SegOk(m,p,t+d1,d2)){dt=m;break}}
   if(dt){G77_YC.detours=(G77_YC.detours||0)+1;const t1=t+Math.hypot(dt[0]-at[0],dt[1]-at[1])/G77_WALK;w.legs.push({t0:t,t1,a:at,b:dt});t=t1;at=dt;const d2=Math.hypot(p[0]-at[0],p[1]-at[1]),t2=t+d2/G77_WALK;w.legs.push({t0:t,t1:t2,a:at,b:p});t=t2;at=p;continue}}
  let dd=dur;if(G77_YC&&AO.B.size){let ts=t,k=0,na=0;for(;k<300&&!(g77SegOk(at,p,ts,dd)&&g77NextOk(p,nx,ts+dd));k++){if(w.legs.length&&!g77HoldFree(at,ts,ts+1)){   /* GATE-77 S6r · M5d · p132: step aside, keep waiting */
     if(na<3){if(ts>t){w.legs.push({t0:t,t1:ts,a:at,b:at,hold:1});t=ts}w.t=t;w.at=at;if(g77Aside(w,t+20)){na++;at=w.at;t=w.t;ts=t;dd=Math.hypot(p[0]-at[0],p[1]-at[1])/G77_WALK;continue}}break}ts+=1}
   if(k<300&&!g77SegFree(at,p,ts,dd)){for(let j=0;j<300;j++){ts+=1;if(g77SegFree(at,p,ts,dd))break}}   /* GATE-77 S6b-a · p143 · K-107: keep waiting for a free crossing (≤ 300 s) */
   if(k>=300||!g77SegFree(at,p,ts,dd)){G77_YC.forced++;(G77_YC.fl||(G77_YC.fl=[])).push({t:+t.toFixed(1),ts:+ts.toFixed(1),k,a:at.map(Math.round),b:p.map(Math.round)})}if(ts>t){G77_YC.waits++;if(w.legs.length){if(G77_LG.on&&!g77HoldFree(at,t,ts)){w.t=t;w.at=at;if(g77Linger(w,ts,null,false,p)){at=w.at;dd=Math.hypot(p[0]-at[0],p[1]-at[1])/G77_WALK}else w.legs.push({t0:t,t1:ts,a:at,b:at,hold:1})}else w.legs.push({t0:t,t1:ts,a:at,b:at,hold:1})}t=ts}}   // GATE-77 S6b-c · p158 · D-166
  const t1=t+dd;w.legs.push({t0:t,t1,a:at,b:p});t=t1;at=p}
 w.t=t;w.at=at;return t}
function g77CrewCommit(C,tag){if(!C)return;for(const w of C.walkers){if(!w.legs.length)continue;const s0=aoSlUp(w.legs[0].t0),s1=aoSl(w.t);

// ==== GATE-77 S6b-c · part 4 · p158 · D-166: the crew never stands where a vehicle will pass — a space-time linger ======================
var G77_LG={on:true,R:45,cell:5,dt:.4,back:12,maxW:120,n:0,ok:0,fail:0,ms:0,why:{}};
function g77LgFail(k){G77_LG.fail++;G77_LG.why[k]=(G77_LG.why[k]||0)+1;return false}
function g77Linger(w,t1,face,mustHome,goTo){const T0=performance.now();G77_LG.n++;try{return g77Linger1(w,t1,face,mustHome,goTo)}finally{G77_LG.ms+=performance.now()-T0}}
// goTo: the next point — the linger may end on any free cell from which the walk there is clear at t1 (home first)
function g77Linger1(w,t1,face,mustHome,goTo){

  if(q[1]>APT_Y.LN-4&&q[1]<APT_Y.LS+4&&q[0]>G73_L.x0-10&&q[0]<G73_L.x1+10)ok=false;else if(G77_STAIR.on&&g77PplLane(q[0],q[1]))ok=false;else if(q[1]<APT_Y.TS+6&&q[0]>4790&&q[0]<8410)ok=false;
  else if(APL.helis.some(z=>Math.hypot(q[0]-z.x,q[1]-z.y)<z.r+8))ok=false;
  else{const a=apttObb(q[0],q[1],0,[-1.5,1.5,-1.5,1.5],'P','q');for(const b of B)if(apttObbHit(a,b,2)){ok=false;break}if(ok)for(const f of FO)if(apttObbHit(a,f,4)){ok=false;break}}
  st[i]=ok?1:2;return ok};
 const par=new Int16Array((n+1)*NC).fill(-1);let cur=[hI];par[hI]=hI;
 for(let s=1;s<=n;s++){const t=tA+s*dt,nx=[],o=s*NC;
  for(const ci of cur){const cx=ci%N;for(const d of [0,1,-1,N,-N]){if(d===1&&cx===N-1||d===-1&&cx===0)continue;const nj=ci+d;if(nj<0||nj>=NC||par[o+nj]!==-1)continue;if(!stOk(nj))continue;const q=pos(nj);if(g77Busy(q[0],q[1],t))continue;par[o+nj]=ci;nx.push(nj)}}
  if(!nx.length)return g77LgFail('boxed');cur=nx}

  for(const [ci] of cs)if(goOk(ci)){g=ci;break}}

  if(seq[e]===a){while(e<n&&seq[e+1]===a)e++;const p=pos(a);L.push({t0:tA+s*dt,t1:tA+e*dt,a:p,b:p.slice(),hold:1,face:a===hI?fc:null})}
  else{const d=seq[e]-a;while(e<n&&seq[e+1]-seq[e]===d)e++;L.push({t0:tA+s*dt,t1:tA+e*dt,a:pos(a),b:pos(seq[e])})}
  s=e}

function g77Hold(w,t1,face){if(!w.legs.length){w.t=Math.max(w.t,t1);return w.t}   // in the staff door until then

  w.legs.push({t0:w.t,t1,a:w.at,b:w.at,hold:1,face});w.t=t1}return w.t}
// GATE-77 S6r · M5b · K-93: a hold clear of the vehicles and the aircraft (the own one only while it moves: its crew works beside it parked)
function g77BusyVeh(x,y,t){const f=t/AO.DT,s=Math.floor(f+1e-9),a=apttObb(x,y,0,[-1.5,1.5,-1.5,1.5],'P','q');for(const z of [s,s+1]){const bk=g77Slice(z);if(!bk)continue;for(const b of bk){if(b.L!=='V')continue;if(a.x0>b.x1+17||a.x1<b.x0-17||a.y0>b.y1+17||a.y1<b.y0-17)continue;const m=g77VMarg(b,z);if(a.x0>b.x1+m||a.x1<b.x0-m||a.y0>b.y1+m||a.y1<b.y0-m)continue;if(apttObbHit(a,b,m))return true}}return false}   /* p141 · K-103 */
function g77HoldFreeV(p,t0,t1){for(let t=t0;t<=t1+1e-9;t+=AO.DT)if(g77Busy(p[0],p[1],t))return false;return true}   // the own aircraft only while it moves (g77Slice)
function g77Aside(w,t1){const at=w.at;for(const o of [[12,0],[-12,0],[0,12],[0,-12],[20,0],[-20,0],[0,20],[0,-20],[28,0],[-28,0],[0,28],[0,-28]]){const q=[at[0]+o[0],at[1]+o[1]],d=Math.hypot(o[0],o[1])/G77_WALK;

function g77HeliPost(sd){const p=sd.pad;if(!p||p.live===false)return null;

function g77WWSpot(main,pe,u,n,t1,tc){const sh=[],hit=(x,y,t)=>{if(g77Busy(x,y,t))return true;const a=main.tr.seq.at(t-main.t0);if(!a)return false;sh.length=0;apttShapes(main.tr,a,sh);const box=apttObb(x,y,0,[-1.5,1.5,-1.5,1.5],'P','w');for(const s of sh)if((s.L==='F'||s.L==='W'||s.L==='T')&&apttObbHit(box,s,8))return true;return false};

  for(let t=t1;t<=t1+dd&&ok;t+=.25){const q=dd?(t-t1)/dd:1;if(hit(pe[0]+(c[0]-pe[0])*q,pe[1]+(c[1]-pe[1])*q,t))ok=false}
  for(let t=t1+dd;t<=tc+1&&ok;t+=.5)if(hit(c[0],c[1],t))ok=false;
  if(ok)return c}
 return null}

function g77S3Audit(){
 const issues=[],st=g77Stands(),bld=apttBldShapes(),pt=(x,y)=>apttObb(x,y,0,[-1.5,1.5,-1.5,1.5],'P','a');let posts=0,heli=0,bridges=0;

  if(sd.kind==='heli'){const hp=g77HeliPost(sd);if(!hp){if(sd.pad&&sd.pad.live!==false)issues.push('no heli post '+sd.id);continue}heli++;
   for(const h of APL.helis)if(Math.hypot(hp.spot[0]-h.x,hp.spot[1]-h.y)<h.r+4)issues.push('heli spot '+sd.id+' in pad '+h.id);
   for(const q of [hp.p,...hp.via,hp.spot])if(inB(q[0],q[1]))issues.push('heli path '+sd.id+' in a building');continue}

  const post=g77CrewPost(sd);if(!post){issues.push('no crew post '+sd.id);continue}posts++;
  for(const q of [post.p,...post.via]){if(inB(q[0],q[1]))issues.push('post '+sd.id+' in a building');if(onL(q[0],q[1]))issues.push('post '+sd.id+' on the taxilane')}}
 if(typeof APT_STANDS!=='undefined'&&APTT_SPEC)for(const s of APT_STANDS){try{const sd={cx:s[2]},f=null;bridges++}catch(e){}}

function g77TugAt(tk){if(!tk||!tk.tr)return null;const q=tk.tr.seq;for(let s=0;s<q.dur;s+=.5){const l=q.legAt(s);if(l&&l.leg.kind!=='out'&&l.leg.kind!=='mid')return tk.t0+l.start}return null}
function g77FollowAt(tr,off,t){const p=tr.tr.seq.at(t-tr.t0)||tr.tr.seq.at(tr.tr.seq.dur-1e-6),c=Math.cos(p[2]),s=Math.sin(p[2]);return[p[0]+c*off[0]-s*off[1],p[1]+s*off[0]+c*off[1]]}
// the pose of a walker at time t: {x,y,face,walk,alpha} or null (in the staff door)
function g77WalkerAt(w,t){
 const L=w.legs;if(!L.length||t<L[0].t0||t>L[L.length-1].t1)return null;
 for(const q of L){if(t<q.t0||t>q.t1)continue;
  if(q.follow){const p=g77FollowAt(q.follow.tr,q.follow.off,t),p2=g77FollowAt(q.follow.tr,q.follow.off,t+.3),dx=p2[0]-p[0],dy=p2[1]-p[1];return{x:p[0],y:p[1],dx,dy,walk:Math.hypot(dx,dy)>.05}}
  const u=q.t1>q.t0?(t-q.t0)/(q.t1-q.t0):1,x=q.a[0]+(q.b[0]-q.a[0])*u,y=q.a[1]+(q.b[1]-q.a[1])*u;return{x,y,dx:q.b[0]-q.a[0],dy:q.b[1]-q.a[1],walk:!q.hold,face:q.face}}
 return null}

// ==== GATE-77 S6c · p169 · D-73: the marshaller's signals by phase; the ground crew a little bigger ====================================
var G77_MS={on:true,sc:.51,far:420,tSlow:6,tStop:1.5,turn:.1,n:{}};
function g77AcPoseAt(f,t){for(const r of f.tracks||[])if(r.tr&&r.tr.kind==='ac'){const a=r.tr.seq.at(t-r.t0);if(a)return a}return null}
// the phase from the time to on-block (the aircraft arrives fast and stops hard — by distance the signals would last a second each):
// in the stand area (≤ far px) "come ahead" (or "turn" while its heading is off the stand's), the last tSlow s "slow down", from tStop s
// before on-block "stop", after it "chocks in"; before that — waiting, the wands down
function g77MarshalPhase(f,t){const tOB=f.tOB!=null?f.tOB:f.t0;if(tOB!=null&&t>=tOB-G77_MS.tStop)return t<tOB+.8?'stop':'chocks';

 return Math.abs(dh)>G77_MS.turn?(dh>0?'right':'left'):'ahead'}
function g77MarshalSignal(f,p,t){const ph=g77MarshalPhase(f,t),x=p.x,y=p.y,k=Math.sin(t*5);G77_MS.n[ph]=(G77_MS.n[ph]||0)+1;
