 if(ph==='wait'){W(x-3,y-6,x-3.6,y-1.2);W(x+3,y-6,x+3.6,y-1.2)}                                                   // wands down at the sides
 else if(ph==='ahead'){const u=(k+1)/2;W(x-3,y-8,x-4.6+2.6*u,y-14+.8*u);W(x+3,y-8,x+4.6-2.6*u,y-14+.8*u)}          // both up, beckoning
 else if(ph==='left'||ph==='right'){const s=ph==='left'?-1:1,u=(k+1)/2;W(x+3*s,y-7,x+8*s,y-7.4);W(x-3*s,y-8,x-(4.6-2.6*u)*s,y-14+.8*u)}   // one out, one beckoning
 else if(ph==='slow'){const u=k*.9;W(x-3,y-6,x-6.5,y-2.6+u);W(x+3,y-6,x+6.5,y-2.6+u)}                               // low, patting
 else if(ph==='stop'){W(x-4.2,y-14,x+4.2,y-8.4);W(x+4.2,y-14,x-4.2,y-8.4)}                                          // crossed above the head
 else{const u=(k+1)*.5;W(x-6.2+u,y-5.2,x-1.8+u,y-5.2);W(x+6.2-u,y-5.2,x+1.8-u,y-5.2)}                              // chocks in: pointing inward
 ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()}

// chocks after on-block and away before the push; no service vehicle at the aircraft before the main chocks (QA-54 sequence)
let G77_VTC=null;function g77VT(v){let L=G77_VTC&&G77_VTC.get(v);if(!L){L=(v.hist||[]).concat(v.tasks);if(G77_VTC)G77_VTC.set(v,L)}return L}

// ==== GATE-77 S6b · p146: the passengers × the vehicle bodies (QA-90) and no aircraft appearing / vanishing in the world (AIR-69) ======
let G77_LR=null;
function g77LiveRects(){if(G77_LR&&G77_LR.length)return G77_LR;const all=MAP_CHUNKS.concat(typeof g72NorthRow==='function'?g72NorthRow():[]);   // the live zones, from the registry (WORLD-03: no fixed numbers)
 return G77_LR=WORLD_LIVE.map(z=>all.find(q=>q.id===z)).filter(Boolean).map(q=>({id:q.id,x0:q.x,y0:q.y,x1:q.x+q.w,y1:q.y+q.h}))}
function g77DrawBox(kind,id,p,noSh){const s=aptSpr(id),x=p[0],y=p[1],th=p[2],z=p[3]||0,c=Math.cos(th),n=Math.sin(th);let k,cs,sh;
 if(kind==='heli'){k=1+z/300;cs=[[-s.w/2,-s.h/2],[s.w/2,-s.h/2],[s.w/2,s.h/2],[-s.w/2,s.h/2]];sh=z>3?[x+z*.4,y+z*.5,s.w*.32]:null}
 else{k=1+z/420;cs=[[-s.ax,-s.ay],[s.w-s.ax,-s.ay],[s.w-s.ax,s.h-s.ay],[-s.ax,s.h-s.ay]];sh=z>3?[x+z*.32-s.w*.1*c,y+z*.42-s.w*.1*n,s.w*.36]:null}
 let x0=1e9,x1=-1e9,y0=1e9,y1=-1e9;for(const [u,v] of cs){const X=x+(u*c-v*n)*k,Y=y+(u*n+v*c)*k;if(X<x0)x0=X;if(X>x1)x1=X;if(Y<y0)y0=Y;if(Y>y1)y1=Y}
 if(sh&&!noSh){x0=Math.min(x0,sh[0]-sh[2]);x1=Math.max(x1,sh[0]+sh[2]);y0=Math.min(y0,sh[1]-sh[2]);y1=Math.max(y1,sh[1]+sh[2])}return[x0,y0,x1,y1]}
function g77EdgeAudit(fl,t0,t1){const R=[g77ViewR()],   /* GATE-77 S6b-c · p153 · K-113: all the camera can show, not the live zones */hit=b=>R.some(r=>b[0]<r.x1&&b[2]>r.x0&&b[1]<r.y1&&b[3]>r.y0),r={flights:0,samples:0,fade:0,appear:0,vanish:0,issues:[]},ev=[];
 for(const f of fl){if(f.never||!f.tracks||!f.tracks.length)continue;let first=null,last=null,n=0;
  for(const q of f.tracks){const tr=q.tr;if(!tr||!tr.seq||(tr.kind!=='ac'&&tr.kind!=='heli'))continue;n++;const kind=tr.kind==='heli'?'heli':'ac',e=q.t0+tr.seq.dur;
   if(!first||q.t0<first.t)first={t:q.t0,q,kind};if(!last||e>last.t)last={t:e,q,kind};
   for(let t=Math.max(t0,q.t0);t<=Math.min(t1,e);t+=.5){const p=tr.seq.at(t-q.t0);if(!p)continue;r.samples++;if(p[4]>=.999)continue;
    if(hit(g77DrawBox(kind,tr.id,p))){r.fade++;if(r.issues.length<8)r.issues.push('FADE '+f.code+' al '+p[4].toFixed(2)+' @'+t.toFixed(1)+' x '+Math.round(p[0]))}}}
  if(!n)continue;r.flights++;
  const at=(o,t)=>o.q.tr.seq.at(Math.min(o.q.tr.seq.dur-1e-3,Math.max(0,t-o.q.t0)));   // seq.at(dur) is null
  if(first&&first.t>t0+1e-6&&first.t<=t1){const p=at(first,first.t);if(p&&p[4]>.001&&hit(g77DrawBox(first.kind,first.q.tr.id,p)))ev.push({k:'appear',f,t:first.t,p})}
  if(last&&last.t<=t1-1){const p=at(last,last.t);if(p&&p[4]>.001&&hit(g77DrawBox(last.kind,last.q.tr.id,p)))ev.push({k:'vanish',f,t:last.t,p})}}
 for(const e of ev){const o=e.k==='appear'?'vanish':'appear';
  const chain=fl.some(g=>g!==e.f&&g.stand===e.f.stand&&g.tracks&&g.tracks.some(q=>{const tr=q.tr;if(!tr||!tr.seq)return false;const lt=e.t-q.t0;if(lt<-1||lt>tr.seq.dur+1)return false;const p=tr.seq.at(Math.min(tr.seq.dur-1e-3,Math.max(0,lt)));return p&&Math.hypot(p[0]-e.p[0],p[1]-e.p[1])<3}));
  if(chain||(e.k==='appear'&&e.f.init&&e.t<=t0+1))continue;r[e.k]++;if(r.issues.length<8)r.issues.push(e.k.toUpperCase()+' '+e.f.code+' @'+e.t.toFixed(1)+' ('+Math.round(e.p[0])+','+Math.round(e.p[1])+')')}
 {const V=g77ViewR();let lastI=-1e9;r.overlap=0;r.heliOverlap=0;r.airPairs=0;   // GATE-77 S6b-c · p153 · K-112: no two aircraft in the air overlap at one altitude in view
  for(let t=t0;t<=t1;t+=.5){const A=[];
   for(const f of fl){if(f.never||!f.tracks||t<(f.tDraw??f.t0)||t>=f.t1)continue;for(const q of f.tracks){const tr=q.tr;if(!tr||!tr.seq||(tr.kind!=='ac'&&tr.kind!=='heli'))continue;const p=tr.seq.at(t-q.t0);if(!p||!((p[3]||0)>8))continue;
    const kind=tr.kind==='heli'?'heli':'ac',b=g77DrawBox(kind,tr.id,p,1);if(b[2]<V.x0||b[0]>V.x1||b[3]<V.y0||b[1]>V.y1)continue;A.push({f,z:p[3],b})}}
   for(let i=0;i<A.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<A.length;j++){const a=A[i],c=A[j];if(a.f===c.f)continue;r.airPairs++;if(Math.abs(a.z-c.z)>=20)continue;
    if(a.b[0]<c.b[2]-2&&a.b[2]>c.b[0]+2&&a.b[1]<c.b[3]-2&&a.b[3]>c.b[1]+2){const hh=a.f.heli&&c.f.heli;if(hh)r.heliOverlap++;else r.overlap++;   // two helicopters: K-114 (their lanes and the pads, S6b-c part 3)
     if(t-lastI>3&&r.issues.length<12){r.issues.push((hh?'HELI-OVERLAP ':'OVERLAP ')+a.f.code+' × '+c.f.code+' @'+t.toFixed(1)+' ('+Math.round((a.b[0]+a.b[2])/2)+','+Math.round((a.b[1]+a.b[3])/2)+') z '+Math.round(a.z)+' / '+Math.round(c.z));lastI=t}}}}}
 r.view=g77ViewR();
 r.ok=!r.fade&&!r.appear&&!r.vanish&&!r.overlap;return r}
function g77PaxVehAudit(fl,t0,t1){const keep=G77_VTC;G77_VTC=new Map();const r={samples:0,pax:0,hits:0,issues:[]};
 try{for(let t=t0;t<=t1;t+=.5){const P=(typeof s6rNbPassengers==='function'?s6rNbPassengers(t,fl):[]).concat(g2RemotePassengers(t,fl));if(!P.length)continue;r.samples++;
  const sh=[];for(const v of AO.fleet){if(v.type==='MS')continue;let k=null;for(const q of g77VT(v))if(t>=q.t0&&t<q.t1){k=q;break}const o=[];
   if(k){const a=k.tr.seq.at(t-k.t0);if(a)apttShapes(k.tr,a,o,t-k.t0)}else if(v.tr0&&v.home)apttShapes(v.tr0,v.home,o,null);for(const s of o)if(s.L==='V'){s.vid=v.id;sh.push(s)}}
  for(const p of P){if(p.alpha<.99)continue;r.pax++;for(const s of sh){if(p.x<s.x0||p.x>s.x1||p.y<s.y0||p.y>s.y1)continue;const dx=p.x-s.x,dy=p.y-s.y,u=dx*s.c+dy*s.s,w=-dx*s.s+dy*s.c;
    if(Math.abs(u)<s.hx-1&&Math.abs(w)<s.hy-1){r.hits++;if(r.issues.length<8)r.issues.push('PAX '+p.flight+' '+p.phase+' ✕ '+s.vid+' @'+t.toFixed(1)+' ('+Math.round(p.x)+','+Math.round(p.y)+')');break}}}}}
 finally{G77_VTC=keep}r.ok=!r.hits;return r}

// ==== GATE-77 S6b-c · p151 · K-104: the vehicle bodies × the fences and the buildings, every 0.2 s ==================================
let G77_FO=null;
function g77FenceObbs(){if(G77_FO&&G77_FO.n===APT_FENCE_SEGS.length)return G77_FO;G77_FO=APT_FENCE_SEGS.map((f,i)=>{const [x1,y1,x2,y2]=f,L=Math.hypot(x2-x1,y2-y1)/2,o=apttObb((x1+x2)/2,(y1+y2)/2,Math.atan2(y2-y1,x2-x1),[-L,L,-1,1],'FN','F'+i);o.seg=f;return o});G77_FO.n=APT_FENCE_SEGS.length;return G77_FO}
function g77FenceAudit(t0,t1){const FO=g77FenceObbs(),B=apttBldShapes(),r={samples:0,fence:0,bld:0,issues:[],byVeh:{}};
 for(const v of AO.fleet){const T=(v.hist||[]).concat(v.tasks);let last=-1e9;
  for(const k of T){if(k.t1<t0||k.t0>t1)continue;for(let t=Math.max(t0,k.t0);t<Math.min(t1,k.t1);t+=.2){const p=k.tr.seq.at(t-k.t0);if(!p)continue;const sh=[];apttShapes(k.tr,p,sh,t-k.t0);r.samples++;
   for(const s of sh){if(s.L!=='V')continue;let hit=null;for(const f of FO){if(s.x0>f.x1||s.x1<f.x0||s.y0>f.y1||s.y1<f.y0)continue;if(apttObbHit(s,f,0)){hit=['fence',f];break}}
    if(!hit)for(const b of B){if(s.x0>b.x1||s.x1<b.x0||s.y0>b.y1||s.y1<b.y0)continue;if(apttObbHit(s,b,0)){hit=['bld',b];break}}
    if(hit){r[hit[0]]++;r.byVeh[v.id]=(r.byVeh[v.id]||0)+1;if(t-last>3&&r.issues.length<16){const q=k.tr.seq.legAt(t-k.t0);r.issues.push((hit[0]==='fence'?'FENCE ['+hit[1].seg.join(',')+']':'BLD '+hit[1].t)+' ✕ '+v.id+' @'+t.toFixed(1)+' ('+Math.round(p[0])+','+Math.round(p[1])+') '+(q&&q.leg.kind||''));last=t}break}}}}}
 r.ok=!r.fence&&!r.bld;return r}
function g77CrewAudit(fl,t0,t1){G77_VTC=new Map();
 fl=fl||AO.hist.concat(AO.flights);const r={flights:0,walkers:0,issues:[],samples:0,items:0};
 const moving=(f,t)=>{const q=f.tracks.find(q=>q.main);if(!q)return null;const a=q.tr.seq.at(t-q.t0),b=q.tr.seq.at(t-q.t0+.25);if(!a||!b)return null;return Math.hypot(a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1])>.01||Math.abs(a[2]-b[2])>.001?a:null};
 const act=fl.filter(f=>!f.heli&&f.tracks&&f.tracks.length);
 for(const f of fl){const C=f.crew;if(!C)continue;r.flights++;
  for(const w of C.walkers){r.walkers++;const L=w.legs;if(!L.length)continue;const a=L[0].a,b=L[L.length-1].follow?null:L[L.length-1].b;
   if(Math.hypot(a[0]-C.post[0],a[1]-C.post[1])>1)r.issues.push('POST-OUT '+f.code);if(b&&Math.hypot(b[0]-C.post[0],b[1]-C.post[1])>1)r.issues.push('POST-IN '+f.code);
   for(let t=Math.max(t0,L[0].t0);t<=Math.min(t1,L[L.length-1].t1);t+=.5){const p=g77WalkerAt(w,t);if(!p)continue;r.samples++;
    if(p.y<APT_Y.TS+4&&p.x>4800&&p.x<8400){r.issues.push('TAXIWAY '+f.code+' @'+t.toFixed(1));break}
    if(p.y>APT_Y.LN-2&&p.y<APT_Y.LS+2&&p.x>G73_L.x0-10&&p.x<G73_L.x1+10){r.issues.push('TAXILANE '+f.code+' crew#'+C.walkers.indexOf(w)+' @'+t.toFixed(1));break}
    const me={x0:p.x-1.5,x1:p.x+1.5,y0:p.y-1.5,y1:p.y+1.5},box=apttObb(p.x,p.y,0,[-1.5,1.5,-1.5,1.5],'P','crew');
    let hit=null;for(const g of act){if(t<g.t0||t>=g.t1)continue;const pose=moving(g,t);if(!pose)continue;const sh=[];apttShapes(g.tracks.find(q=>q.main).tr,pose,sh);for(const s of sh){if(s.L!=='F'&&s.L!=='W')continue;if(me.x0<=s.x1+4&&me.x1>=s.x0-4&&me.y0<=s.y1+4&&me.y1>=s.y0-4&&apttObbHit(box,s,4)){hit=g.code;break}}if(hit)break}
    if(hit){r.issues.push('SWEEP '+f.code+' crew#'+C.walkers.indexOf(w)+' ✕ '+hit+' @'+t.toFixed(1));break}
    for(const h of APL.helis){if(Math.hypot(p.x-h.x,p.y-h.y)<h.r+4){hit=h.id;break}}if(hit){r.issues.push('PAD '+f.code+' @'+hit+' '+t.toFixed(1));break}
    for(const v of AO.fleet){let k=null;for(const q of g77VT(v))if(t>=q.t0&&t<q.t1){k=q;break}if(!k)continue;const a=k.tr.seq.at(t-k.t0);if(!a||Math.abs(a[0]-p.x)>60||Math.abs(a[1]-p.y)>60)continue;
     const b=k.tr.seq.at(t-k.t0+.25);if(!b||(Math.hypot(a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1])<.01&&Math.abs(a[2]-b[2])<.001))continue;const sh=[];apttShapes(k.tr,a,sh,t-k.t0);
     for(const s of sh){if(s.L!=='V')continue;if(me.x0<=s.x1+2&&me.x1>=s.x0-2&&me.y0<=s.y1+2&&me.y1>=s.y0-2&&apttObbHit(box,s,2)){hit=v.id;break}}if(hit)break}
    if(hit){r.veh=(r.veh||0)+1;r.issues.push('VEH '+f.code+' crew#'+C.walkers.indexOf(w)+' ✕ '+hit+' @'+t.toFixed(1));break}}}
  if(!C.heli&&!f.parked){const m=C.walkers[0],h=m&&m.legs.find(q=>q.hold&&q.face==='ac');if(!h||h.t0>C.tOB-5)r.issues.push('MARSHAL-LATE '+f.code)}
  if(C.chockMain!=null&&f.bridgeAt&&f.bridgeAt[0]<C.chockMain)r.issues.push('BRIDGE-BEFORE-CHOCKS '+f.code);
  for(const it of C.items){if(it.t1==null)continue;let run=null;for(let t=Math.max(t0,it.t0);t<=Math.min(t1,it.t1)&&!run;t+=1){const box=apttObb(it.p[0],it.p[1],0,[-1.5,1.5,-1.5,1.5],'P','i');
    for(const v of AO.fleet){let k=null;for(const q of g77VT(v))if(t>=q.t0&&t<q.t1){k=q;break}if(!k)continue;const a=k.tr.seq.at(t-k.t0);if(!a||Math.abs(a[0]-it.p[0])>60||Math.abs(a[1]-it.p[1])>60)continue;const sh=[];apttShapes(k.tr,a,sh,t-k.t0);for(const q of sh)if(q.L==='V'&&apttObbHit(box,q,1)){run=v.id+' @'+t;break}if(run)break}}
   if(run)r.issues.push('ITEM-RUN '+f.code+' '+it.k+' ✕ '+run)}
  for(const it of C.items){r.items++;if(!f.parked&&it.t0<C.tOB-1e-6)r.issues.push('CHOCK-EARLY '+f.code);if(it.t1==null||it.t1>C.tPush+1e-6)r.issues.push('ITEM-LATE '+f.code+' '+it.k)}
  if(C.chockMain!=null)for(const x of f.vt||[]){if(x.at==null)continue;const at=x.at;if(x.role==='tug'||(x.task&&(x.task.role==='tug'||x.task.role==='fm')))continue;if(at<C.chockMain-.5){r.issues.push('BEFORE-CHOCKS '+f.code+' '+(x.role||(x.task&&x.task.role)));break}}}
 r.ok=!r.issues.length;r.issues=r.issues.slice(0,12);return r}
function aoFinish(P,mark,t0w){
 if(P.sd?.bridge&&P.bridgeAt)P.pax=f2PaxPlan(P);
 if(G77_STAGE>=3)P.crew=g77CrewPlan(P);   // GATE-77 S3: the ground crew of this visit
 // heli/ga/cargo continue
 AO.flights.push(P);AO.stats.planned++;AO.stats.planMs+=((typeof performance!=='undefined'?performance.now():Date.now())-t0w);
 aoDbg('plan',{code:P.code,stand:P.stand,kind:P.kind,t0:+P.t0.toFixed(1),t1:+P.t1.toFixed(1)});
 return P;
}

// ====================================================================================================================================
// helicopters: pad flights (visual: nothing else flies over the pads); chained so that the pad is never empty by accident
// ====================================================================================================================================
function aoHeliLegs(sd){
 const X=APTT_X,pad=sd.pad,pk=[pad.x,pad.y,0,0,1],ZC=65+25*g77HeliK(sd);   // GATE-77 S6b-c · p155 · K-114: the pad's cruise height
 const lift={kind:'lift',dur:4,pose:t=>[pad.x,pad.y,0,45*apttSm(t/4),1]};
 const XH=g77EdgeE()+110,extra=2*(XH-(X.END+40))/105;   // GATE-77 S6b · p144 · K-106: the helicopters leave / come in out of sight (D-147, WORLD-03); the extra flight comes out of the time away
 const outP=apttPath([[pad.x,pad.y],[Math.min(pad.x+120,XH-60),pad.y-30],[XH,pad.y-80]],[60]);
 const out=apttMove({kind:'heli',path:outP,prof:apttProf(outP.len,apttVfn(outP.len,{vmax:110,v0:12,v1:110,acc:30,dec:30})),mode:'tan',th0:0,blend:30,z:s=>45+(ZC-45)*apttSm(Math.min(1,s/300)),al:()=>1});out.t300=apttTof(out.prof,Math.min(300,outP.len));
 const inP=apttPath([[XH,pad.y-60],[Math.min(pad.x+140,XH-60),pad.y-18],[pad.x,pad.y]],[60]);
 const inn=apttMove({kind:'heli',path:inP,prof:apttProf(inP.len,apttVfn(inP.len,{vmax:100,v0:100,v1:8,acc:30,dec:30})),mode:'tan',th0:Math.PI,z:s=>45+(ZC-45)*(1-apttSm(Math.max(0,(s-(inP.len-300))/300))),al:()=>1});inn.t300=inn.dur-apttTof(inn.prof,Math.max(0,inP.len-300));
 const ie=inn.endPose();
 const yaw={kind:'yaw',dur:3,pose:t=>[pad.x,pad.y,apttAng(ie[2],0,apttSm(t/3)),45,1]};
 const land={kind:'land',dur:4,pose:t=>[pad.x,pad.y,0,45*(1-apttSm(t/4)),1]};
 return{pk,lift,out,inn,yaw,land,extra};
}

// ==== GATE-77 S6b-c · part 3 · p155 · K-114: the helicopters — a cruise height per pad, one at a time near the pads ======================
function g77HeliK(sd){const i=(typeof APL!=='undefined'&&APL.helis)?APL.helis.findIndex(h=>h.id===sd.id):-1;return Math.max(0,i)}
function g77HeliWins(t0,dwell,away,L){const tl=t0+dwell,wo=[tl-1,tl+L.lift.dur+(L.out.t300||4.5)+1],ti=tl+L.lift.dur+L.out.dur+Math.max(5,away-(L.extra||0)),te=ti+L.inn.dur,wi=[te-(L.inn.t300||4.5)-1,te+L.yaw.dur+L.land.dur+1];return[wo,wi]}
function aoPlanHeli(sd,t0,dwell,away){
 const L=aoHeliLegs(sd),code=aoCode(sd);AO.nid++;
 for(let it=0;it<60;it++){const w=g77HeliWins(t0,dwell,away,L);let c=0;   // GATE-77 S6b-c · p155 · K-114: one helicopter at a time near the pads
  for(const f of AO.flights){if(!f.heli||!f.hw||f.stand===sd.id)continue;for(const a of f.hw){if(a[0]<w[0][1]&&w[0][0]<a[1]){dwell+=a[1]-w[0][0]+.5;c=1;break}if(a[0]<w[1][1]&&w[1][0]<a[1]){away+=a[1]-w[1][0]+.5;c=1;break}}if(c)break}
  if(!c)break}
 const legs=[{kind:'hold',dur:dwell,pose:()=>L.pk},L.lift,L.out,apttGap(Math.max(5,away-(L.extra||0))),L.inn,L.yaw,L.land];   // GATE-77 S6b · p144: the visit keeps its length
 const seq=apttSeq(legs),tr={kind:'heli',id:sd.first,nm:code,seq};
 const P={code,ac:sd.first,sd,kind:'heli',stand:sd.id,tracks:[{t0,tr,main:true}],t0,t1:t0+seq.dur,states:[[t0,'ON_BLOCK'],[t0+dwell,'TAXI_OUT'],[t0+dwell+L.lift.dur,'DEPARTED']],tFree:t0+seq.dur,heli:true,init:true,hw:g77HeliWins(t0,dwell,away,L)};
 if(G77_STAGE>=3)P.crew=g77HeliCrew(P);AO.flights.push(P);AO.stats.planned++;aoDbg('plan',{code,stand:sd.id,kind:'heli',t0:+t0.toFixed(1),t1:+P.t1.toFixed(1)});return P;
}

// ====================================================================================================================================
// the runtime: demand, admission, pruning, queries
// ====================================================================================================================================
function aoInit(now,seed){
 AO.seed=seed||1;AO.rng=aoRng(AO.seed);AO.t0i=now;AO.pt=null;AO.stepDone=null;AO.mlv=null;/* GATE-77 S7-b · p196 */AO.job=null;AO.chJob=null;AO.workLimit=Infinity;AO.B.clear();AO.ST.length=0;AO.LOG.length=0;AO.flights.length=0;AO.dbg.length=0;AO.nid=1;AO.codeBump=0;G77_SH.ok=G77_SH.skip=G77_SH.noWin=0;G77_FM.ok=G77_FM.skip=G77_FM.noRoom=G77_FM.late=0;G77_FM.why={};G77_AMB.ok=G77_AMB.skip=G77_AMB.noWin=0;AO.t=now;AO.last=now;
 AO.stats={planned:0,failed:0,recovered:0,queued:0,maxQueue:0,pruned:0,planMs:0,why:{}};AO.g77Deck=[];AO.g77DeckR=[];AO.g77PoolOfs=0;AO.hist.length=0;
 AO.stands=aoMakeStands();AO.TK=null;AO.RBX=null;afInit();
 // static occupants first (long-term parking): everything else is planned around them
 for(const sd of AO.stands){
  sd.next=null;sd.busy=false;
  if(sd.indoor||sd.live||sd.empty)continue;                       // indoor maintenance bays: the aircraft stand inside the hangar (not drawn, not a reservation)
  if(sd.kind==='heli'){aoStaticHeli(sd,now);continue}
  aoPlanVisit(sd,now,{parked:true,tPark:now,ac:sd.first,never:true});
 }
 for(const sd of AO.stands){
  if(!sd.live||sd.indoor)continue;
  if(sd.kind==='heli'){const dw=aoR(...AO.cfg.heliDwell);const P=aoPlanHeli(sd,now,dw,aoR(...AO.cfg.heliAway));sd.next=P.t1;continue}
  if(AO.rng()<(sd.kind==='pax'?.92:.6)*Math.min(1,(sd.rate||1)+.1)){
   const dwell=sd.kind==='pax'?aoR(25,190):sd.kind==='cargo'?aoR(20,120):aoR(40,260);
   sd.init={dwell};sd.next=now;                      // planned as the first job of aoStep (sliced in the game, so loading never stalls)
  }else sd.next=now+aoR(10,70);
 }
}
const aoGap=sd=>aoR(...(sd.kind==='ga'||sd.kind==='ovf'?AO.cfg.gaGap:sd.kind==='cargo'?AO.cfg.cgGap:AO.cfg.gap))/((sd.rate||1)*AO.cfg.demand);
function aoStaticHeli(sd,now){
 const pk=[sd.pad.x,sd.pad.y,0,0,1],tr={kind:'heli',id:sd.first,nm:aoCode(sd),seq:apttSeq([{kind:'hold',dur:1e7,pose:()=>pk}])};AO.nid++;
 AO.flights.push({code:tr.nm,ac:sd.first,sd,kind:'heli',stand:sd.id,tracks:[{t0:now,tr,main:true}],t0:now,t1:Infinity,states:[[now,'ON_BLOCK']],never:true,init:true,heli:true});
}
function aoPrune(now){
 const cut=aoSl(now)-12;for(const k of AO.B.keys())if(k<cut)AO.B.delete(k);
 for(let i=AO.flights.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(AO.flights[i].t1<now-2){if(AO.keep)AO.hist.push(AO.flights[i]);AO.flights.splice(i,1);AO.stats.pruned++}
 afPrune(now);
}
function aoStep(now){
 if(!AO.rng)aoInit(now,1);
 if(now-AO.last>40||now<AO.last-1){aoDbg('time-jump',{from:AO.last,to:now});aoInit(now,AO.seed+1);return}  // tab slept / clock restarted: rebuild a safe state
 g76XSync();
 AO.t=now;AO.last=now;
 if(!AO.job)AO.LOG.length=0;
 aoPrune(now);if(typeof G77_MLV!=='undefined'&&G77_MLV.on&&!AO.job)g77MlvStep(now);   // GATE-77 S7-b · p196
 // work budget of this call (sliced mode: the game; tests run unsliced, with an infinite budget)
 AO.workLimit=AO.sliced?AO.work+AO.budget:Infinity;
 if(AO.useClock&&typeof performance!=='undefined')AO.deadline=performance.now()+AO.cfg.ms;
 if(AO.sliced&&typeof SIM_LOOP!=='undefined'&&SIM_LOOP.aoEnd!=null){if(SIM_LOOP.aoWork==null)SIM_LOOP.aoWork=AO.workLimit;else AO.workLimit=SIM_LOOP.aoWork;if(AO.useClock&&SIM_LOOP.aoEnd<AO.deadline)AO.deadline=SIM_LOOP.aoEnd;if(AO.useClock&&SIM_LOOP.sysT0){const c=SIM_LOOP.sysT0+AO.stepCapMs;if(c<AO.deadline)AO.deadline=c}}if(AO.sliced&&AO.useClock&&typeof g77AoFloor==='function')g77AoFloor();   /* GATE-77P · p241 */
 if(AO.chJob){if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())return;if(!AO.chJob.next().done)return;AO.chJob=null;AO.LOG.length=0}   // chores of an earlier call finish before a new plan (unsliced order)
 for(let guard=0;guard<40;guard++){
  if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())return;                        // nothing left of this step's budget
  if(!AO.job){
   const sd=aoDue(now);if(!sd)break;
   if(sd.kind==='heli'){const P=aoPlanHeli(sd,sd.next,aoR(...AO.cfg.heliDwell),aoR(...AO.cfg.heliAway));sd.next=P.t1;continue}
   const ini=sd.init;
   let acB=null;if(!ini){acB=sd.bring&&sd.accepts.includes(sd.bring)?sd.bring:sd.lgWant?g77LgPick(sd,now):sd.wideWant?'AC-MW-01':g77Choose(sd,now);if(acB==='AC-LG-01')sd.lgWant=true;if(acB==='AC-MW-01')sd.wideWant=true;if(acB&&sd.large&&g77MarsHas(sd.id,acB))sd.marsWant=acB;   /* p407 */if(!acB){sd.next=now+aoR(18,55);AO.stats.bfSkip=(AO.stats.bfSkip||0)+1;continue}}
   AO.job={sd,tReq:Math.max(sd.next,now+AO.lead),g:null};AO.job.g=ini?aoPlanG(sd,now,{parked:true,tPark:now,ac:sd.first,dwell:ini.dwell}):aoPlanG(sd,AO.job.tReq,{ac:acB,bfC:AO.bfLast&&AO.bfLast.c,bfAt:now});sd.busy=true;sd.init=null;AO.job.ini=!!ini;
  }
  const r=AO.job.g.next();
  if(!r.done)return;                                  // out of budget: continue in the next call (afChores waits)
  const {sd}=AO.job,P=r.value;AO.job0=AO.job;AO.job=null;sd.busy=false;
  if(P&&P.ac==='AC-LG-01'){sd.lgWant=false;sd.lgUntil=P.tFree+2}
  if(sd.bring&&P&&P.ac===sd.bring)sd.bring=null;   // GATE-77 S5c · D-94: the visit asked for in F9 is planned
  if(sd.wideWant&&P){sd.wideWant=false;if(P.ac==='AC-MW-01')sd.wideUntil=P.tFree+2}if(P&&sd.large){const H=sd.held||(sd.held={});H[P.ac]=Math.max(H[P.ac]||-1,P.tFree+2)}if(P)sd.marsWant=null;   /* p407 · R-29: every visit of the large stand (the opening's parked one too) holds its locks until free */   // GATE-77 S5c: its tail on lane L
  if(P)sd.next=P.tFree+aoGap(sd)-20;
  else if(AO.job0&&AO.job0.ini)sd.next=now+10;
  else{sd.next=now+AO.H+12;AO.stats.recovered++;aoDbg('recovery',{stand:sd.id,action:'retry-later'})}
  AO.LOG.length=0;
  if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())return;
 }
 if(AO.sliced){if(!AO.chJob)AO.chJob=afChoresG(now);if(!AO.chJob.next().done)return;AO.chJob=null}else afChores(now);AO.LOG.length=0;AO.stepDone=now;   /* GATE-77P-b · p206 */
}
// the stand whose next visit has been waiting the longest and is due for planning
function aoDue(now){
 let best=null;
 for(const sd of AO.stands){
  if(!sd.live||sd.next==null||sd.busy)continue;
  if(sd.id==='P2'&&g77P2Blocked(now))continue;   // AIR-20 SAFETY BLOCK
  if(g77MarsBy(sd,now))continue;   /* p407 · R-29: any stand a large stand's held type closes (today P3) */   // GATE-77 S5b · D-65: the large stand's SAFETY BLOCK
  if(now+AO.H<sd.next)continue;
  if(!best||sd.next<best.next)best=sd;
 }
 return best;
}
// poses of everything that exists at time `now`:  [{kind:'ac'|'veh'|'heli', id, nm, pose:[x,y,th,z,alpha], tr, f}]
function aoActors(now,out=[]){
 for(const f of AO.flights){
  if(now<(f.tDraw??f.t0)||now>=f.t1)continue;   /* GATE-77 S6b-c · p153 · K-113: the inbound is drawn */
  for(const q of f.tracks){
   const p=q.tr.seq.at(now-q.t0);if(!p)continue;
   out.push({kind:q.tr.kind==='heli'?'heli':'ac',id:q.tr.id,nm:q.tr.nm,pose:p,tr:q.tr,f});
  }
 }
 return afActors(now,out);
}
function aoBridge(standId,now){
 for(const f of AO.flights){if(f.stand===standId&&f.bridge&&now>=f.t0&&now<f.t1+1)return f.bridge(now)}
 return 0;
}
function aoStateOf(f,now){let s=null;for(const q of f.states){if(q[0]<=now)s=q[1];else break}return s}

// ====================================================================================================================================
// independent verification: re-samples the final tracks (not the reservation table) and checks everything the contract promises
// ====================================================================================================================================
function aoVerify(t0,t1,o={}){
 const dt=AO.DT,issues=[],bld=apttBldShapes(),seen=new Set(),add=(m,t)=>{if(!seen.has(m)){seen.add(m);issues.push(m+' @'+t.toFixed(1))}};
 const fl=AO.hist.concat(AO.flights).filter(f=>f.t1>=t0&&f.t0<=t1);
 let nSlices=0,maxSimul=0;
 // the fleet at rest in its bays: static, checked once against buildings and against each other
 {const idle=[];for(const v of AO.fleet){apttShapes(v.tr0,v.home,idle)}
  for(let i=0;i<idle.length;i++){for(const b of bld)if(apttConflict(idle[i],b))add('IDLE '+idle[i].t+' ✕ '+b.t,t0);for(let j=i+1;j<idle.length;j++)if(aoC(idle[i],idle[j]))add('IDLE '+idle[i].t+' ✕ '+idle[j].t,t0)}}
 for(let t=t0;t<=t1;t+=dt){
  const sh=[],idl=[];let simul=0;
  for(const f of fl){
   if(t<f.t0||t>=f.t1)continue;
   for(const q of f.tracks){
    const p=q.tr.seq.at(t-q.t0);if(!p)continue;
    if(q.tr.kind==='ac'){const la=q.tr.seq.legAt(t-q.t0);if(la&&(la.leg.kind==='inbound'||la.leg.kind==='outbound'))continue}   /* GATE-77 S6b-c · p153: drawn, not reserved */
    const out=[];apttShapes(q.tr,p,out);
    if(q.tr.kind==='ac'){
     simul++;
     const ks=new Set();let onR=false;
     for(const s of out){if(s.L==='F'){for(const k of aoTokensOf(s))ks.add(k);if(s.y0<APT_Y.RS+12&&s.y1>APT_Y.RN-12&&s.x1>4000&&s.x0<8500)onR=true}else if(s.L==='A')onR=true}
     for(const k of ks)out.push({L:'S',k,t:q.tr.nm});
     if(onR)out.push(Object.assign({},aoRB(),{t:q.tr.nm+'-R',rwy:q.tr.nm}));
    }
    for(const s of out)sh.push(s);
   }
  }
  afShapes(t,sh,idl);
  for(const s of AO.ST)sh.push(s);
  maxSimul=Math.max(maxSimul,simul);
  for(let i=0;i<sh.length;i++){
   const a=sh[i];
   if(a.L==='F'||a.L==='V')for(const b of bld)if(apttConflict(a,b)&&!g77MlvBldOk(a,b,t))add(a.t+' ✕ '+b.t,t);   /* GATE-77 S7-b · p196: the maintenance tug in its hangar's doorway */
   for(let j=i+1;j<sh.length;j++){const b=sh[j];
    if(a.L==='R'&&b.L==='R'&&a.t!==b.t){add('RUNWAY: '+a.t+' ✕ '+b.t,t);continue}
    if(aoC(a,b)){if(a.L==='S')add('TOKEN '+a.k+': '+a.t+' ✕ '+b.t,t);else add(a.t+'['+a.L+'] ✕ '+b.t+'['+b.L+']',t)}}
  }
  for(const a of idl)for(const b of sh)if(b.L!=='S'&&b.L!=='R'&&b.L!=='A'&&aoC(a,b))add('IDLE '+a.t+' ✕ '+b.t+'['+b.L+'] ('+Math.round(a.x)+','+Math.round(a.y)+')/('+Math.round(b.x)+','+Math.round(b.y)+')',t);
  nSlices++;
 }
 // continuity (no teleport) + state-machine legality
 for(const f of fl){
  for(const q of f.tracks){
   const L=q.tr.seq.legs;
   for(let i=0;i+1<L.length;i++){
    const a=L[i].pose(L[i].dur),b=L[i+1].pose(0);
    if(!a||!b)continue;
    if(Math.hypot(a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1])>1.5||Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(a[2]-b[2]),Math.cos(a[2]-b[2])))>.05)add('TELEPORT '+q.tr.nm+' leg '+i+'→'+(i+1)+' ('+L[i].kind+'→'+L[i+1].kind+')',f.t0);
   }
   // speed sanity
   if(q.tr.kind==='ac'&&!f.never){let prev=null;const T0=q.t0;for(let t=Math.max(t0,f.t0);t<Math.min(t1,f.t1);t+=dt){const p=q.tr.seq.at(t-T0);if(p&&prev){const sp=Math.hypot(p[0]-prev[0],p[1]-prev[1])/dt;if(sp>600)add('SPEED '+q.tr.nm+' '+sp.toFixed(0)+'px/s',t)}prev=p}}
  }
  if(!f.init){for(let i=1;i<f.states.length;i++){const a=f.states[i-1][1],b=f.states[i][1];if(!(AO_STATES[a]||[]).includes(b))add('STATE '+f.code+' '+a+'→'+b,f.states[i][0]);if(f.states[i][0]<f.states[i-1][0]-1e-6)add('STATE-TIME '+f.code,f.states[i][0])}}
 }
 afCheck(add,t0,t1);
 return{ok:issues.length===0,issues,slices:nSlices,flights:fl.length,maxSimul};
}
function aoHoldWhy(sh,from,cap){
 for(const a of sh)for(const b of AO.ST)if(aoC(a,b))return{s:from,a:a.t+a.L,b:b.t+b.L+(b.k||'')};
 for(let s=from;s<cap;s++){const bk=AO.B.get(s);if(!bk)continue;for(const a of sh)for(const b of bk)if(aoC(a,b))return{s,a:a.t+a.L+(a.k||''),b:b.t+b.L+(b.k||''),bx:+b.x?.toFixed(0),by:+b.y?.toFixed(0)}}
 return null}

// ====================================================================================================================================
// v1.94 · AIRPORT B — game glue: builds the spec from the library, runs the ops core on the game clock (sliced: never stalls a frame),
// paints the new airside surfaces (west apron, east block, perimeter road, G2 Ground Ops Yard, south heliport, stand markings) and draws
// aircraft / helicopters / the PERSISTENT ground-ops fleet / jet bridges.
// ====================================================================================================================================
var APTT_SPEC=null, APTT_C=null;
const APT_OPS={on:true,clk:0,last:null,ready:false,seed:19400,err:null,spr:{},frames:0,qa:null};
const APT_VS={'VS-GS-01':.5,'VS-TW-01':.5,'VS-FR-02':.62,'VS-AM-02':.44,'VS-PL-02':.37};   // S4: ambulance ≈7.5 m, police SUV ≈5 m at the airport scale                    // city vehicles reused as airside service vehicles (scale on top of the library game scale)
const aptVehGs=id=>TurboCity.gameScale(id)*(APT_VS[id]||1);
function aptBuildSpec(){
 const ac={},veh={};
 for(const id of['AC-NB-01','AC-RJ-01','AC-TP-01','AC-CG-01','AC-PR-01','AC-BJ-01','AC-HL-01','AC-HL-02','AC-LG-01','AC-QJ-01','AC-MW-01','AC-HL-04','AC-HL-05','AC-HL-06','AC-LT-01','AC-CN-01','AC-AM-01','AC-TB-01']){
  const a=TurboCity.get(id),sc=APT_GS/(a.res||1),I=TurboCity.info(id,{scale:sc,rot:0}),an={};
  for(const q of I.an)if(an[q[0]]===undefined)an[q[0]]=[q[1],q[2]];
  ac[id]={sc,w:I.w,h:I.h,fp:I.fp,an};
 }
 for(const id of['LV-PT-01','LV-BT-01','LV-FT-01','LV-SH-01','VS-GS-01','VS-TW-01','VS-FR-02','VS-AM-02','VS-PL-02']){
  const gs=aptVehGs(id),I=TurboCity.info(id,{scale:gs,rot:0}),an={};
  for(const q of I.an)if(an[q[0]]===undefined)an[q[0]]=[q[1],q[2]];
  veh[id]={gs,w:I.w,h:I.h,fp:I.fp,an};
 }
 veh['F2-MS']={gs:1,w:F2_MS.len,h:F2_MS.wid,fp:[0,0,F2_MS.len,F2_MS.wid],an:{}};
 {const G=g77GseDim();for(const id in G){const d=G[id];veh[id]={gs:1,w:d[0],h:d[1],fp:[0,0,d[0],d[1]],an:{}}}}   // GATE-77 S2: procedural service vehicles   // mobile stairs: procedural (no library asset)
 s6aRealize(veh);   // GATE-77 S6a M2: the library service vehicles at their real sizes
 const J=TurboCity.info('AP-JB-01',{scale:1,rot:3});
 return{ac,veh,jb:{w:J.w,h:J.h,fp:J.fp,an:J.an.map(q=>[q[0],q[1],q[2]])}};
}
function aptBuildC(){
 return{RWY:APT_RWY,TWY:APT_TWY,GA:APT_PARKED_GA,HELI:APT_HELIPADS,BRIDGE_Y:APT_BRIDGE_Y,
  stands:APT_STANDS.map(s=>({id:s.id,term:s.term,cx:s.cx,ng:s.ng,cy:s.cy,aircraft:s.aircraft,cargo:!!s.cargo,door:s.door,svcSide:s.svcSide})),
  bld:APT_BUILDINGS.map(b=>({id:b.id,x:b.x+b.info.fp[0],y:b.y+b.info.fp[1],w:b.info.fp[2],h:b.info.fp[3]}))};
}
function aptReady(){if(!APTT_SPEC){APTT_SPEC=aptBuildSpec();APTT_C=aptBuildC()}if(!APL)APL=aplBuild();return APL}
function aptOpsInit(){
 APTT_SPEC=aptBuildSpec();APTT_C=aptBuildC();APT_OPS.spr={};
 AO.sliced=true;AO.useClock=true;AO.budget=70;                      // the game plans in slices of ~70 reservation checks (a few ms) per frame
 aoInit(APT_OPS.clk,APT_OPS.seed);APT_OPS.ready=true;
}
// called once per rendered frame (idempotent for the same frame time); the airport clock stops while the game is paused
function aptOpsTick(now){
 if(!APT_OPS.on||APT_OPS.last===now)return;if(typeof G77_LDS!=='undefined'&&G77_LDS.job)return;   /* D-220 · p283: not while the airport loads */
 const dt=APT_OPS.last==null?0:Math.min(.1,Math.max(0,(now-APT_OPS.last)/1000));APT_OPS.last=now;
 if(typeof State!=='undefined'&&State.paused)return;
 APT_OPS.clk+=dt;APT_OPS.frames++;G76X.ofs=(now+(typeof SIM_BENCH_OFS!=='undefined'?SIM_BENCH_OFS:0))/1000-APT_OPS.clk;
 try{if(!APT_OPS.ready)aptOpsInit();{const t=performance.now();g77DetTick(APT_OPS.clk);const d=performance.now()-t;FS.used+=d;FS.stats.aoMs+=d}e1Watch(APT_OPS.clk);f1Watch(APT_OPS.clk);g1Watch(APT_OPS.clk)}catch(e){g77AoFail(e,'tick')}   /* p241 */
}

const aptTxt=(g,t,x,y,px,col,w=700)=>{g.fillStyle=col;g.font=w+' '+px+'px Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif';g.textAlign='center';g.textBaseline='middle';g.fillText(g77Heb(t),x,y)};   /* GATE-77P · p228 · D-196 */
function aptStandBox(s){ // bounding box of the largest accepted aircraft (full wing span)
 let m={x0:1e9,x1:-1e9,y0:1e9,y1:-1e9};
 for(const ac of s.accepts)for(const b of aplEnv(ac,s.ngx,s.ngy,s.th).map(aplBox)){m.x0=Math.min(m.x0,b.x0);m.x1=Math.max(m.x1,b.x1);m.y0=Math.min(m.y0,b.y0);m.y1=Math.max(m.y1,b.y1)}
 return m;
}
function aptPaintStand(g,s){
 if(s.indoor||s.tpl==='bridge'||s.tpl==='cargo')return;
 const b=aptStandBox(s),south=Math.abs(Math.sin(s.th))>.5;
 if(s.live===false&&Math.sin(s.th)<-.5){g.save();g.strokeStyle='rgba(244,242,232,.45)';g.lineWidth=1.2;g.setLineDash([5,6]);g.strokeRect(b.x0,b.y0,b.x1-b.x0,b.y1-b.y0);g.setLineDash([]);aptTxt(g,g77Show(s.id),s.ngx,b.y1+10,12,'rgba(244,242,232,.85)');aptTxt(g,'STATIC',s.ngx,b.y1+23,7,'rgba(244,242,232,.65)',600);g.restore();return}   // S3b: static row, nose north
 g.save();
 g.strokeStyle='rgba(244,242,232,.5)';g.lineWidth=1.3;g.setLineDash([9,7]);g.strokeRect(b.x0,b.y0,b.x1-b.x0,b.y1-b.y0);g.setLineDash([]);
 g.strokeStyle='#e0b93a';g.lineWidth=1.8;g.beginPath();
 if(south){g.moveTo(s.ngx,Math.min(b.y0,s.ngy-70));g.lineTo(s.ngx,s.ngy);g.moveTo(s.ngx-9,s.ngy+3);g.lineTo(s.ngx+9,s.ngy+3)}
 else{g.moveTo(s.ngx+80,s.ngy);g.lineTo(s.ngx,s.ngy);g.moveTo(s.ngx-3,s.ngy-9);g.lineTo(s.ngx-3,s.ngy+9)}
 g.stroke();
 if(south)aptTxt(g,g77Show(s.id),s.ngx,Math.min(b.y1+12,s.ngy+30),13,'rgba(244,242,232,.9)');
 else aptTxt(g,g77Show(s.id),s.ngx-22,s.ngy,12,'rgba(244,242,232,.9)');
 if(s.remote)aptTxt(g,'REMOTE',s.ngx,Math.min(b.y1+25,s.ngy+43),8,'rgba(244,242,232,.7)',600);
 g.restore();
}
function aptPaintRspE(g){

function aptSpr(id){
 let s=APT_OPS.spr[id];if(s)return s;
 if(id.startsWith('AC-')){const a=TurboCity.get(id),sc=APT_GS/(a.res||1),I=TurboCity.info(id,{scale:sc,rot:0}),ng=I.an.find(q=>q[0]==='Nose Gear');s=APT_OPS.spr[id]={sc,ax:ng?ng[1]:I.w/2,ay:ng?ng[2]:I.h/2,w:I.w,h:I.h}}
 else{const gs=aptVehGs(id),I=TurboCity.info(id,{scale:gs,rot:0});s=APT_OPS.spr[id]={gs,cx:I.fp[0]+I.fp[2]/2,cy:I.fp[1]+I.fp[3]/2,w:I.w,h:I.h}}
 return s;
}
function g77Reg(f){if(!f)return'';if(f.reg!=null)return f.reg;const s=String(f.code||f.id||'');if(/^4X-/.test(s))return f.reg=s;
 let h=2166136261;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++)h=Math.imul(h^s.charCodeAt(i),16777619)>>>0;const A='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPRSTUVWXYZ',k=f.ac==='AC-CG-01'||f.ac==='AC-HC-01'||f.ac==='AC-TB-01'?'C':f.ac==='AC-RJ-01'||f.ac==='AC-TP-01'?'A':'E';
 return f.reg='4X-'+k+A[h%25]+A[(h/25|0)%25]}   // GATE-77 S5b · D-72: the aircraft's own registration
function g77Livery(f){if(!f)return 0;if(f.lv==null){let h=0;const s=String(f.code||f.id||'');for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++)h=(h*31+s.charCodeAt(i))>>>0;f.lv=h%997}return f.lv}
const G77_MV=new WeakMap();function g77Moving(a,x,y){const k=a.f||a.tr;if(!k)return false;let m=G77_MV.get(k);if(!m){m={};G77_MV.set(k,m)}const id=a.id+(a.nm||''),p=m[id],now=APT_OPS.clk;m[id]=[x,y,now,p&&Math.hypot(x-p[0],y-p[1])>.02?now:(p?p[3]:-1e9)];return now-m[id][3]<1.5}

function g77GseDim(){return{'G7-BL':[56,15],'G7-CT':[63,19],'G7-GP':[22,12],'G7-LV':[42,16],'G7-WT':[45,17],'G7-GC':[22,12],'G7-HL':[60,22],'G7-CU':[25,11],'G7-SH':[56,17]}}   // GATE-77 S6a M2: real sizes (D-61)
// the yard bays they live in (built in GATE-73 S4 for the loaders, or reserve bays); ids / x / width unchanged (G73_LOCK)
// (a 52 px loader cannot turn into the west-end bays Y-BL1 / Y-BL2 between the spine and its neighbours: the water truck and the fifth
// pushback tug live there; the loaders take the two east tug bays Y-PT5 / Y-PT6)
function g77GseBayTable(){return{'Y-BL1':['WT','V-WT1','G7-WT'],'Y-BL2':['PT','V-PT5','LV-PT-01'],'Y-PT5':['BL','V-BL1','G7-BL'],'Y-RX1':['CT','V-CT1','G7-CT'],'Y-RX2':['CT','V-CT2','G7-CT'],
 'Y-BT1':['GP','V-GP1','G7-GP'],'Y-BT2':['GP','V-GP2','G7-GP'],'Y-BT3':['LV','V-LV1','G7-LV'],'Y-PT6':['MX','V-MX2','VS-TW-01'],'Y-MX2':['BL','V-BL2','G7-BL']}}
function g77GseBays(A){
 const T=g77GseBayTable();for(const b of A.bays){const q=T[b.id];if(!q)continue;b.kind=q[0];b.fleetId=q[1];b.asset=q[2];b.scale=1;b.occupied=true;delete b.reserve;
  if(q[0]==='GP'||q[0]==='LV')b.yc=1390;else if(b.row==='Y')b.yc=1355}
}

function g77UldBox(g,x,y,th,al,col){g.save();g.globalAlpha=al;g.translate(x,y);g.rotate(th);g.fillStyle='rgba(8,18,26,.3)';g.fillRect(-7,-5,15,11);

function g77UldCol(id){const h=g77Hash(id)%4;return['#c9ccd0','#d4c8a8','#b8c4cc','#cfd2c4'][h]}
// the ULD state of a train at local time lt: per dolly the ULD id or null, and the ULD in flight {k,u (0..1),dir,where}
function g77TrainUld(tr,lt){const cg=tr&&tr.cg;if(!cg||lt==null)return null;const ul=cg.ulds||[],n=cg.n,load=[];let fly=null;
 for(let k=0;k<n;k++)load.push(cg.kind==='in'?null:null);
 for(let k=0;k<n;k++){const evs=cg.ev.filter(e=>e.k===k);let on=false;for(const e of evs){if(lt>=e.t1){on=e.dir==='on'||e.dir==='off'?(e.dir==='on'):on}else if(lt>=e.t0)fly={k,u:(lt-e.t0)/(e.t1-e.t0),dir:e.dir,where:e.where}}
  load[k]=on?ul[k]:null}
 return{load,fly}}

  g.fillStyle='rgba(8,18,26,.22)';g.fillRect(-9,-5.5,20,13);g.fillStyle='#3b4249';g.fillRect(-10,-6.5,20,13);if(Camera.zoom>=.55){g.strokeStyle='#6b737a';g.lineWidth=.5;g.beginPath();for(let sx=-8;sx<9;sx+=2.4){g.moveTo(sx,-5.5);g.lineTo(sx,5.5)}g.stroke()}
  g.fillStyle='#22272d';g.fillRect(10,-1,4,2);g.restore();
  const u=st&&st.load[i];if(u&&!(st.fly&&st.fly.k===i))g77UldBox(g,q[0],q[1],q[2],al,g77UldCol(u))}

function g77FlyPath(task,f,q){const T=g77FlyTarget(task,f,q);if(f.where==='deck')return[[q[0],q[1]],T];const P=AO.flights.concat(AO.hist).find(z=>z.code===task.code),S=P&&P.cgo&&P.cgo.loop;if(!S||!S.hl)return[[q[0],q[1]],T];

// where an in-flight ULD goes: the high loader's rear deck (stand, CG) / the aircraft's door (TP) / the deck slot
function g77FlyTarget(task,f,q){if(f.where==='deck')return[G77_DK.x,q[1]];const P=AO.flights.concat(AO.hist).find(z=>z.code===task.code),S=P&&P.cgo&&P.cgo.loop;if(!S)return[q[0],q[1]];

// AIR-16 / 17: an amber beacon only while a service vehicle is on a task (dispatched, working, returning); at home / idle every light is off.
// The emergency fleet (ARFF / EMS / police) shows no lightbar without a response (none in S2).
function g77BeaconSet(){return g77BeaconSet.s||(g77BeaconSet.s=new Set(['PT','BT','FT','SH','SVC','MX','AB','MS','BL','CT','GP','LV','WT','PW','GC','HL','CU','FW','CS']))}   // GATE-77 S7-a · p185

function g77Lights(g,a,now){
 const v=a.v;if(!v||a.lt==null||!g77BeaconSet().has(v.type))return;
 if(Math.floor(now/420+(v.id.charCodeAt(v.id.length-1)%3)*.33)%2)return;
 const [x,y,th,,al]=a.pose,c=Math.cos(th),s=Math.sin(th),fx=(a.tr&&a.tr.hx?a.tr.hx:10)*.35;
 g.save();g.globalAlpha=al;g.fillStyle='rgba(255,170,30,.28)';g.beginPath();g.arc(x+c*fx,y+s*fx,3.6,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();
 g.fillStyle='#ffb12a';g.beginPath();g.arc(x+c*fx,y+s*fx,1.5,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();g.restore();
}

// ---- world audit (cheap): the S2 fleet and its bays, every S2 service works at every live compatible stand (cargo: S4), lights by state ----
function g77S2Audit(){
 aptReady();const issues=[],want={BL:4,CT:2,GP:G77_FP.on?3:2,LV:G77_FP.on?2:1,WT:1,SVC:G77_FP.on?3:2},n={};
 for(const f of APL.fleet){n[f.type]=(n[f.type]||0)+1;const b=APL.bays.find(q=>q.id===f.bay);if(!b)issues.push('FLEET '+f.id+' no bay');else if(b.kind!==f.type&&!(b.cs&&f.type==='CS'))issues.push('FLEET '+f.id+' in a '+b.kind+' bay')}   // GATE-77 S7-a · p185: the van — a guest in EM-EMS2

 for(const k in want)if(n[k]!==want[k])issues.push('FLEET '+k+' '+(n[k]||0)+'/'+want[k]);
 // the routes need the live fleet (afOf): with the airport not started yet (the audit at load) they are checked by the QA-54 tool
 const st=AO.fleet&&AO.fleet.length&&AO.stands&&AO.stands.length?AO.stands:[];let rows=0,ok=0;
 for(const sd of st){if(!sd.live)continue;for(const ac of sd.accepts){const m=g77Match(sd,ac);if(!m.ok)continue;for(const k of ['catering','cleaning','water','lavatory','gpu','belt']){const v=m.svc[k];if(!v)continue;rows++;
  if(v==='ok')ok++;else if(!(sd.kind==='cargo'&&v==='S4'))issues.push('SVC '+sd.id+'/'+ac.slice(3,5)+' '+k+' '+v)}}}
 if(g77BeaconSet().has('ARFF')||g77BeaconSet().has('EMS')||g77BeaconSet().has('POL'))issues.push('LIGHTS emergency fleet with a service beacon');
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues,fleet:n,rows,working:ok,routes:st.length?'checked':'QA-54'}}

function s6aRR(g,x,y,w,h,r){r=Math.min(r,w/2,h/2);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x+r,y);g.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);g.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);g.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);g.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);g.closePath()}
function s6aGrad(g,y0,y1,c0,c1,c2){const q=g.createLinearGradient(0,y0,0,y1);q.addColorStop(0,c0);q.addColorStop(.5,c1);q.addColorStop(1,c2||c0);return q}

// the bitmap of a type in a look at a detail scale k (1 · 2 · 4 px per world px), with a pad for the shadow and the parts that stick out
function s6aSprite(type,st,k){const key=type+'|'+st+'|'+k;let s=S6A_CACHE.get(key);if(s)return s;const D=s6aDimOf(type),fam=S6A_TYPES[type][3];if(!D)return null;
 const L=D[0]/2,W=D[1]/2,pad=4,cv=window.document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=Math.ceil((L*2+pad*2)*k);cv.height=Math.ceil((W*2+pad*2)*k);const g=cv.getContext('2d');g.scale(k,k);g.translate(L+pad,W+pad);
 const K=s6aKit(g,L,W);K.type=type;try{S6A_PAINT[fam](g,L,W,st,K)}catch(e){S6A_STATS.err=String(e)}
 s={cv,L,W,pad,k};S6A_CACHE.set(key,s);S6A_STATS.bitmaps++;S6A_STATS.bytes+=cv.width*cv.height*4;return s}
const S6A_STATS={bitmaps:0,bytes:0,drawn:0,err:null};

// the per-frame draw: the cached bitmap, then the parts that move

// GATE-77 S6a M2: the library assets resized to the real sizes — the body, the footprint and the anchors scale together (x along, y across)
const S6A_REAL={'LV-FT-01':[75,19],'LV-SH-01':[90,20],'VS-GS-01':[37,15],'VS-TW-01':[41,15],'VS-AM-02':[56.32,24.9],'VS-PL-02':[37,18.32],'VS-FR-02':[81.84,29.14]};   // p440: the last three — today's field footprint (R-32)
function s6aRealize(veh){for(const id in S6A_REAL){const v=veh[id];if(!v||v.real)continue;const [L,W]=S6A_REAL[id],sx=L/v.fp[2],sy=W/v.fp[3];

// ==== GATE-77 S6a · M3 (D-104 · §6.6 · D-57): what each service vehicle does at the aircraft — the part that moves between the vehicle and
// the aircraft, drawn per frame in world space on top of the vehicle's cached bitmap. "A timer or a 'working' status is not an action": the
// hose, the cable, the box, the cart and the bag are drawn and move. The vehicle itself keeps ≥ AO.M (6 px) from the fuselage (the conflict
// rules); the moving part bridges that gap, as a real hose, cable or catering platform does.
// The job of a vehicle now: its task, the flight it serves (task.code), the aircraft's pose, and the phase u — 0 → 1 while connecting (the
// first 4 s of the first service leg), 1 while working, 1 → 0 while disconnecting (the short service leg after it, or the last 4 s).
const S6A_ACT={on:true,drawn:0,ramp:4};
function s6aFlightOf(code){for(const f of AO.flights)if(f.code===code)return f;return null}
function s6aJob(a){const v=a.v;if(!v||a.lt==null||!a.tr||!a.tr.seq)return null;const t=APT_OPS.clk;let k=null;for(const q of v.tasks)if(t>=q.t0&&t<q.t1){k=q;break}
 if(!k||k.code==null)return null;const S=k.tr.seq,L=S.legs,q=S.legAt(t-k.t0);if(!q||L[q.i].kind!=='svc')return null;let i0=-1;for(let i=0;i<L.length;i++)if(L[i].kind==='svc'){i0=i;break}
 const f=s6aFlightOf(String(k.code).split('/')[0]);if(!f||!f.sd)return null;let ap=null;for(const r of f.tracks)if(r.tr.kind==='ac'){ap=r.tr.seq.at(t-r.t0);if(ap)break}if(!ap)return null;
 const R=S6A_ACT.ramp,next=L[i0+1]&&L[i0+1].kind==='svc',last=q.i>i0,d=q.leg.dur;
 const u=last?Math.max(0,1-q.t/Math.max(.5,d)):Math.min(1,q.t/R,next?1:(d-q.t)/R);
 return{f,ac:f.ac,sd:f.sd,ap,role:k.role,u:Math.max(0,u),work:!last&&q.t>=R&&(next||d-q.t>R),t:q.t,dur:d,prog:last?1:Math.min(1,q.t/Math.max(1,d)),last,next}}
// a point on the aircraft in its own frame: a = along from the nose gear (+ towards the nose), d = across (+ the side given)
function s6aAcPt(ap,a,d){const c=Math.cos(ap[2]),s=Math.sin(ap[2]);return[ap[0]+c*a-s*d,ap[1]+s*a+c*d]}
// the service points of each type, from the drawings of AIR-56 (fractions of the fuselage from the nose; the fuel coupling under the wing)
function s6aPortAD(ac,kind){const g=apttAcGeom(ac),L=g.nose-g.tail,hw=g.F[3];
 switch(kind){case'water':return[g.nose-.80*L,hw*.78];case'lav':return[g.nose-.86*L,hw*.78];case'gpu':return[g.nose-.09*L,hw*.3];
  case'fuel':{const W=g.W;return W?[W[1]-.42*(W[1]-W[0]),Math.min(W[3]*.36,hw+46)]:[g.nose-.45*L,hw+20]}
  case'door':return[g.nose-(({'AC-NB-01':.116,'AC-RJ-01':.109,'AC-TP-01':.123,'AC-MW-01':.109,'AC-LG-01':.121,'AC-CG-01':.16,'AC-TB-01':.6})[ac]??.22)*L,hw];   /* p406: the door at its station (p404) */case'aft':return[g.nose-.88*L,hw];default:return null}}
// the nearer side of the aircraft to a world point (+1 / -1 in the aircraft's frame)
function s6aSide(ap,x,y){const c=Math.cos(ap[2]),s=Math.sin(ap[2]);return(-(x-ap[0])*s+(y-ap[1])*c)>=0?1:-1}
function s6aPort(j,kind,x,y){const ad=s6aPortAD(j.ac,kind);if(!ad)return null;const sd=s6aSide(j.ap,x,y);return s6aAcPt(j.ap,ad[0],ad[1]*sd)}
// a point of the vehicle in world space from its local frame (front at +x)
function s6aLoc(p,lx,ly){const c=Math.cos(p[2]),s=Math.sin(p[2]);return[p[0]+c*lx-s*ly,p[1]+s*lx+c*ly]}
function s6aLocal(p,x,y){const c=Math.cos(p[2]),s=Math.sin(p[2]),dx=x-p[0],dy=y-p[1];return[dx*c+dy*s,-dx*s+dy*c]}
// a hose / cable on the ground from p0 to p1, laid out to u, a gentle sag; flow dashes running towards dir (+1: to p1)
function s6aHose(g,p0,p1,u,col,w,flow,dir,now,ring){const dx=p1[0]-p0[0],dy=p1[1]-p0[1],len=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(len<.5||u<=0)return;
 const nx=-dy/len,ny=dx/len,sg=Math.min(9,len*.16),cx=(p0[0]+p1[0])/2+nx*sg,cy=(p0[1]+p1[1])/2+ny*sg,N=Math.max(6,Math.ceil(len/3)),P=[];
 for(let i=0;i<=N;i++){const t=i/N*u,a=(1-t)*(1-t),b=2*(1-t)*t,c=t*t;P.push(a*p0[0]+b*cx+c*p1[0],a*p0[1]+b*cy+c*p1[1])}
 const path=(ox,oy)=>{g.beginPath();g.moveTo(P[0]+ox,P[1]+oy);for(let i=2;i<P.length;i+=2)g.lineTo(P[i]+ox,P[i+1]+oy)};
 g.save();g.lineCap='round';g.lineJoin='round';g.strokeStyle='rgba(8,18,26,.3)';g.lineWidth=w+.5;path(.5,.8);g.stroke();g.strokeStyle=col;g.lineWidth=w;path(0,0);g.stroke();
 g.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.22)';g.lineWidth=w*.35;path(-w*.15,-w*.15);g.stroke();
 if(flow){g.strokeStyle=flow;g.lineWidth=w*.5;g.setLineDash([1.1,2.9]);g.lineDashOffset=-dir*((now/55)%4);path(0,0);g.stroke();g.setLineDash([])}
 const e=[P[P.length-2],P[P.length-1]];if(u>=1&&ring){g.fillStyle=ring;g.beginPath();g.arc(e[0],e[1],w*.95,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();g.strokeStyle='#1a1d20';g.lineWidth=.35;g.stroke()}
 else{g.fillStyle='#2a2f35';g.beginPath();g.arc(e[0],e[1],w*.75,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill()}
 g.restore()}
// the open service panel on the fuselage (its lid swung out), drawn while connected
function s6aPanel(g,p,th,u,col){if(u<=0)return;g.save();g.translate(p[0],p[1]);g.rotate(th);g.fillStyle='#1d252d';g.fillRect(-1.6,-1.1,3.2,2.2);g.fillStyle=col||'#d9dee2';

const S6R_PPL={n:0};
function s6rHoseEnd(p0,p1,u){const dx=p1[0]-p0[0],dy=p1[1]-p0[1],len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,nx=-dy/len,ny=dx/len,sg=Math.min(9,len*.16),cx=(p0[0]+p1[0])/2+nx*sg,cy=(p0[1]+p1[1])/2+ny*sg,a=(1-u)*(1-u),b=2*(1-u)*u,c=u*u;return[a*p0[0]+b*cx+c*p1[0],a*p0[1]+b*cy+c*p1[1]]}

var G77_CAB={on:true,fams:{water:1,lav:1,gpu:1,fuel:1},min:1.2,max:4.5,n:0};
function g77CabRemap(j,a,type,fam){const p=a.pose,D=s6aDimOf(type);if(!D||!j.ap)return;const kind=fam==='lav'?'lav':fam,port=s6aPort(j,kind,p[0],p[1]);if(!port)return;
 const R=S6A_ACT.ramp,L=D[0]/2,W=D[1]/2,lp=s6aLocal(p,port[0],port[1]),side=Math.sign(lp[1]||1);
 const o=fam==='gpu'?s6aLoc(p,Math.sign(lp[0]||1)*(L-1),0):s6aLoc(p,-L+(fam==='fuel'?2:3),side*(W-1)),door=s6aLoc(p,L*.55,side*(W+1.4)),dist=Math.hypot(o[0]-door[0],o[1]-door[1]);
 let c=Math.max(G77_CAB.min,Math.min(G77_CAB.max,dist/G77_WALK));const t=j.t,d=j.dur;
 // the main service leg holds all of it — out of the cab, the hose out, the work, the hose in, back into the cab (always at walking pace);
 // the short service leg after it (the slack before the vehicle leaves) finds the operator already in the cab
 if(!j.last){c=Math.max(0,Math.min(c,(d-2*R-2)/2));
  const tt=t-c,u=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,tt/R),Math.max(0,(d-c-t)/R));j.u=Math.max(0,u);j.work=tt>=R&&d-c-t>R;
  j.cab={k:c>0?Math.min(1,t/c):1,b:c>0?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(t-(d-c))/c)):0,door,o}}
 else{j.u=0;j.work=false;j.cab={k:1,b:1,door,o}}
 G77_CAB.n++}
// the operator on the way between the cab door and the reel (k: out, b: back); fades only at the door (getting in / out of the cab)
function g77CabWalker(g,j,now){const C=j.cab;if(!C)return false;let f=null,out=true;if(C.k<1){f=C.k;out=true}else if(C.b>0){f=C.b;out=false}if(f==null)return false;
 const a=out?C.door:C.o,b=out?C.o:C.door,x=a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*f,y=a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*f,th=Math.atan2(b[1]-a[1],b[0]-a[0]),al=out?Math.min(1,f/.12):Math.min(1,(1-f)/.12);
 if(al>0){g.save();g.globalAlpha*=al;G77_PE.w=true;s6aDrawLoader(g,x,y,th,now/1000);g.restore();S6R_PPL.n++}return true}
function s6rOp(g,o,port,j,now){if(j.cab&&g77CabWalker(g,j,now))return;   // GATE-77 S6c · p168
 const u=Math.max(.02,Math.min(1,j.u)),dx=port[0]-o[0],dy=port[1]-o[1],L=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,ux=dx/L,uy=dy/L;let x,y,th,walk;
 if(j.work){x=port[0]-ux*3.2-uy*2.4;y=port[1]-uy*3.2+ux*2.4;th=Math.atan2(uy,ux);walk=false}
 else{const e=s6rHoseEnd(o,port,u);x=e[0]-uy*1.5;y=e[1]+ux*1.5;th=Math.atan2(uy,ux)+(j.last?Math.PI:0);walk=true}

// the reservation of the walkway for the two windows (every second slice, a box every 6 px along the path)
function s6rWalkCommit(R,code){if(!R)return;const pts=[];for(let i=1;i<R.path.length;i++){const a=R.path[i-1],b=R.path[i],L=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]),n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(L/6));for(let k=0;k<=n;k++)pts.push([a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*k/n,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*k/n])}
 for(const w of [R.arr,R.dep]){const s0=aoSlUp(w.at),s1=aoSl(w.done);for(let s=s0;s<=s1;s+=2){let bk=AO.B.get(s);if(!bk){bk=[];AO.B.set(s,bk)}for(const p of pts){const o=apttObb(p[0],p[1],0,[-3,3,-3,3],'P','walk-'+code);o.own=code;bk.push(o)}AO.LOG.push(s)}}}
// the people now (for drawing): arrival from the door to the terminal, departure the other way
function s6rWalkers(t=APT_OPS.clk){const out=[];for(const f of AO.flights){const R=f.walk;if(!R||t<R.open||t>R.close)continue;
  for(const [w,inbound] of [[R.arr,true],[R.dep,false]]){if(t<w.at||t>w.done+1)continue;const P=inbound?R.path:R.path.slice().reverse(),travel=R.len/S6R_NB.v;
   for(let i=0;i<w.n;i++){const lt=t-w.at-S6R_NB.pre-i*S6R_NB.gap;if(lt<0||lt>=travel)continue;let d=lt*S6R_NB.v,k=1;while(k<P.length-1&&d>Math.hypot(P[k][0]-P[k-1][0],P[k][1]-P[k-1][1])){d-=Math.hypot(P[k][0]-P[k-1][0],P[k][1]-P[k-1][1]);k++}
    const a=P[k-1],b=P[k],L=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])||1,u=Math.min(1,d/L),x=a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*u,y=a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*u,dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1];
    const face=Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)?(dx>0?'east':'west'):(dy>0?'south':'north'),edge=Math.min(1,lt/.8,(travel-lt)/.8);out.push({x,y,face,asset:G2_PAX_ASSETS[(g2Hash(f.code)+i*3)%G2_PAX_ASSETS.length],alpha:Math.max(0,edge),walkTime:lt})}}}return out}
// the bridge swings aside while a walk-out visit is at the stand (0 → 1 over 8 s before on-block, back after the aircraft leaves)
function s6rAside(sid,t=APT_OPS.clk){let k=0;if(!AO||!AO.flights)return 0;for(const f of AO.flights){const R=f.nb;if(!R||R.stand!==sid)continue;
  let tOB=null,tOut=null;for(const q of f.states){if(q[1]==='ON_BLOCK'&&tOB==null)tOB=q[0];if((q[1]==='PUSHBACK'||q[1]==='TAXI_OUT')&&tOut==null)tOut=q[0]}if(tOB==null)continue;if(tOut==null)tOut=f.t1;
  const a=tOB-45,b=tOut+20,sw=S6R_NB.swing;k=Math.max(k,Math.min(apttSm((t-a)/sw),apttSm((b-t)/sw)))}return Math.max(0,Math.min(1,k))}
// the airstair of the turboprop folded out of the door towards the walkway side (dir +1 east / −1 west)

// ==== GATE-77 S6r · M2 · K-78 (owner 18.10 23:56): the belt loader stays for the loading too ============================================
// "מעלית הכבודה רק מורידה מהמטוס לרכב אבל לא מעלה ממנו למטוס — הוא יושב שם המון זמן ושנייה לפני ההעמסה הוא עוזב, והמזוודות נזרקות מרחוק".
// Before: the belt's hold ended near the end of the dwell, the departure trains were planned after the latest early service (= the belt's
// own end), and the last train (coupled to the pushback) came 28–110 s before the push — after the belt had gone; its bags flew in from the
// train's column. Now: (1) the departure trains load from 40 % of the dwell, inside the belt's stay; (2) the belt stays until ~4 s before
// ready; (3) the last train is accepted only inside the belt's window — earlier befores let it load while the belt is still there; if the
// push is much later, the belt comes back for it (a late belt task coupled to the push, like the train). The fly fallback is no longer
// planned for: s6rBeltGapAt counts any bag moving at a belt aircraft without the belt (QA: 0).
const S6R_BW={w:null};
function s6rBeltWin(a,b){const w=S6R_BW.w;return!w||(a>=w[0]&&b<=w[1])}
function s6rBeltWinOf(P){const q=(P.svcQ||[]).find(x=>x.svc==='belt');return q?[q.at+2,q.done-2]:null}
function s6rBeltAc(sd,ac){return!!(sd&&sd.tpl==='bridge'&&S6A_BELT[ac]&&!s6rNoBridge(sd,ac))}
// at time t: bags moving at a belt aircraft (its train at the aircraft, bags in flight) while no belt loader of that flight is at the hold
function s6rBeltGapAt(t){const out=[];
 for(const v of AO.fleet){if(v.type!=='BT')continue;for(const k of v.tasks){if(t<k.t0||t>=k.t1||k.code==null)continue;const st=f2BagState(k.tr,t-k.t0);if(!st||st.f.at!=='ac'||!st.fly)continue;
  const code=String(k.code).split('/')[0],f=s6aFlightOf(code);if(!f||!f.sd||!s6rBeltAc(f.sd,f.ac))continue;let ok=false;
  for(const w of AO.fleet){if(w.type!=='BL')continue;for(const q of w.tasks){if(t<q.t0||t>=q.t1||String(q.code).split('/')[0]!==code)continue;const L=q.tr.seq.legAt(t-q.t0);if(L&&L.leg.kind==='svc'){ok=true;break}}if(ok)break}
  if(!ok)out.push({code,stand:f.sd.id,ac:f.ac,bt:v.id,t:+t.toFixed(1),dir:st.f.fill})}}
 return out}

// ==== GATE-77 S6c · p166 · D-172: the caterers go into the aircraft — two workers (the box, the door), one or two trolleys a trip =====

function g77CatRn(key,i){const s=key+'#'+i;let h=2166136261;for(let k=0;k<s.length;k++){h^=s.charCodeAt(k);h=Math.imul(h,16777619)}h^=h>>>13;h=Math.imul(h,0x5bd1e995);h^=h>>>15;return (h>>>0)/4294967296}
// the plan of one visit: trips of 1 or 2 trolleys; per trip: P pulled to the door · E in (the worker first) · I inside · X out (the trolleys
// first, the worker behind) · B back to the box · S the box worker swaps (the used ones into the rows, the next full ones into the aisle)
function g77CatPlan(sd,ac,code){const key=(sd?sd.id:'')+'|'+ac+'|'+(code==null?'':String(code).split('/')[0]),C=G77_CAT.cache;let P=C.get(key);if(P)return P;if(C.size>4000)C.clear();
 const N=s6rCatTrolleys(sd,ac),D=s6aDimOf('CT'),Lh=D?D[0]/2:31.5,pt=G77_CAT.pitch,run=Math.max(8,(Lh+S6R_CAT.gap-.1-2.6)-(Lh*.5-2.2)),r=i=>g77CatRn(key,i),cs=[];

  const sp=q(1)<.35?.4+.8*q(2):0,sb=q(3)<.3?.3+.7*q(4):0,dE=.4+.7*c,dX=.5+.7*c;
  const dP=run/G77_CAT.vPush*(1+.15*(c-1))+sp,dI=1.8+2.6*q(5)+1.1*(c-1),dB=Math.max(.6,run+2.6+pt*(c-1)-G77_CAT.vIn*dX)/G77_CAT.vBack+sb,dS=(cn?.9+.5*(c+cn):.8+.5*c)+.4*q(6);
  const T=dP+dE+dI+dX+dB+dS;trips.push({c,cn,n0:n,t0:t,dP,sp,spAt:.3+.4*q(7),dE,dI,dX,dB,sb,sbAt:.3+.4*q(8),dS,T});t+=T;n+=c}

  for(let m=0;m<q.c;m++){q.stg.push(s0+sw*(a+(.95-a)*m/q.c));q.bk.push(e0+q.dS*.4*(m+1)/q.c)}}   // per trolley: out of the row / back in the row

// ==== GATE-77 S6r · M4 · D-112 (owner 20.10 09:07): "מעברי חצייה בשביל השירות — זה לא טוב" — the bus and the airstair at P2 / P3 ===========
// Between the fuselage and the rotunda there is no room for a 12 m bus to turn in (its ends sweep the rotunda's column — measured), so the
// bus takes "the place of another service vehicle" (the owner's fallback): the ground-power spot in front of the nose, unused at the bridge
// stands (K-77 — power from the pit).  The turboprop and the four-engine jet stop 10–20 px further north at P2 / P3 (stopBy) so the bus
// stands between the nose and lane L, parallel to the lane, heading west, its east end 6 px short of the rotunda.  The bridge swings aside;
// the aircraft's own airstair at the bridge-side door; the passengers walk on the apron between the airstair and the bus — never on lane L.
// P2 (rotunda east of the slot): the bus passes on lane L, backs into the slot from the west, leaves forward to the west and turns round in
// the column between P1 and P2.  P3 (rotunda west): it drives in from the east, backs out east and into the column between P3 and P4, and
// leaves forward to the east.  P1: the rail corridor west of the stand leaves no room to turn — the bridge (never a crosswalk).

function* s6rNbServeG(kind,sd,ac,L,win,hold,meta,extra){let best=null;

// the passengers: the arrival group from the airstair into the bus, the departure group from the bus up the airstair; and at the bus gate
function s6rNbPassengers(t=APT_OPS.clk,flights=AO.flights){const out=[];
 for(const f of flights){const r=f.nb;if(!r)continue;const tA=Math.min(r.open,r.gateDep.at),tB=Math.max(r.close,r.gateArr.done);if(t<tA-1||t>tB+1)continue;
  for(const ph of['arr','dep','gateArr','gateDep']){const w=r[ph];if(!w||t<w.at||t>w.done)continue;const gate=ph==='gateArr'||ph==='gateDep';
   const P=gate?g2GatePath(APL.bays.find(b=>b.id===w.bay)):r.path,L=g2PathLen(P),pts=(ph==='arr'||ph==='gateArr')?P:P.slice().reverse(),travel=L/G2_WALK.v;
   for(let i=0;i<w.n;i++){const lt=t-w.at-G2_WALK.pre-i*G2_WALK.gap;if(lt<0||lt>=travel)continue;let d=lt*G2_WALK.v,k=1;
    while(k<pts.length-1&&d>Math.hypot(pts[k][0]-pts[k-1][0],pts[k][1]-pts[k-1][1])){d-=Math.hypot(pts[k][0]-pts[k-1][0],pts[k][1]-pts[k-1][1]);k++}
    const a=pts[k-1],b=pts[k],sl=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])||1,u=Math.min(1,d/sl),dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1];
    out.push({id:f.code+'-nb-'+ph+'-'+i,flight:f.code,stand:f.stand,phase:ph,gate,asset:G2_PAX_ASSETS[(i+g2Hash(f.code))%G2_PAX_ASSETS.length],x:a[0]+dx*u,y:a[1]+dy*u,face:Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)?(dx>0?2:6):(dy>0?4:0),walkTime:lt+i*.21,alpha:Math.min(1,lt*3,(travel-lt)*3)})}}}
 return out}

// QA (D-112 (5), review 19.10 · 5): the four counters + 0 people on lane L + 0 other vehicle in the bus's place while it is there
function s6rNbStats(all,T){const issues=[],why={},vis=[];let elig=0,bus=0,bridge=0,tp=0,qj=0,pax=0,shuttles=0;
 for(const f of all){if(f.never||f.heli||!S6R_NB.stands.includes(f.stand)||!S6R_NB.ac[f.ac])continue;if(f.tOB==null||f.tOB>T)continue;elig++;
  const r=f.nb;if(!r){bridge++;const w=f.nbWhy||(f.bridge?'bridge':'none');why[w]=(why[w]||0)+1;if(!f.bridge)issues.push(f.code+':no-bus-no-bridge');continue}
  bus++;if(f.ac==='AC-TP-01')tp++;else qj++;pax+=r.arr.n+r.dep.n;shuttles+=2;
  if(!(r.arr.at>=f.tOB&&r.arr.done<r.dep.at))issues.push(f.code+':bus-order');{const sv=(f.svcQ||[]).filter(q=>q.svc==='cleaning'||q.svc==='catering');for(const q of sv)if(q.done>r.dep.at+.5)issues.push(f.code+':boarding-before-'+q.svc)}vis.push([f.code,f.ac.slice(3,5),f.stand,Math.round(f.tOB),Math.round(r.arr.at-f.tOB),Math.round(r.arr.done-f.tOB),Math.round(r.dep.at-f.tOB),Math.round(r.dep.done-f.tOB),Math.round((f.tPush??f.t1)-f.tOB)]);if(f.tPush!=null&&r.close>f.tPush+.5)issues.push(f.code+':airstair-at-push');
  for(const p of r.path)if(p[1]>AF.L-14)issues.push(f.code+':walk-on-lane-L');
  const [xc,yc]=r.bus,pz=(v,t)=>{for(const k of v.hist.concat(v.tasks))if(t>=k.t0&&t<k.t1&&k.tr&&k.tr.seq){const p=k.tr.seq.at(t-k.t0);if(p)return p}return v.home};
  for(const w of[r.arr,r.dep])for(let t=w.at;t<=w.done;t+=2)for(const v of AO.fleet){if(v.id===w.v)continue;const p=pz(v,t);if(!p)continue;
   if(Math.abs(p[0]-xc)<45+8&&Math.abs(p[1]-yc)<10+8){issues.push(f.code+':'+v.id+' in the bus slot @'+t.toFixed(0));break}}
  {const pb=w=>{const v=AO.fleet.find(q=>q.id===w.v);const p=v&&pz(v,(w.at+w.done)/2);return p&&Math.hypot(p[0]-xc,p[1]-yc)<2};if(!pb(r.arr)||!pb(r.dep))issues.push(f.code+':bus-not-in-slot')}}
 return{ok:!issues.length,elig,bus,bridge,tp,qj,pax,shuttles,why,notAdmitted:((AO.stats.why||{})['no-nb-bus']||0)+((AO.stats.why||{})['no-nb-bus-dep']||0),visits:vis.slice(0,8),issues:[...new Set(issues)].slice(0,10)}}

// Elevated bridge, anchored at the terminal and the actual aircraft's passenger door.
function f2BridgeFlight(standId,t){return AO.flights.find(f=>f.stand===standId&&f.bridge&&t>=f.t0&&t<f.t1)||null}
function f2BridgeGeometry(s,f,ext=1){
 const ac=f?.ac||s.aircraft,S=APTT_SPEC.ac[ac],ng=S.an['Nose Gear'],d=S.an.Door,ngy=f?.sd?.ngy??s.ng;
 {const v=f&&f.sd&&f.sd.viewFor===ac?f.sd:null;if(v&&(v.cx!==s.cx||v.door!==s.door))s=Object.assign({},s,{cx:v.cx,door:v.door,svcSide:v.svcSide})}   // GATE-77 S5b: MARS line
 const th=f?.sd?.th??Math.PI/2,c=Math.cos(th),sn=Math.sin(th),dx=d[0]-ng[0],dy=g73DoorDy(s,ac,th,ngy,dx,d[1]-ng[1]),ey=dy+(Math.sign(dy)||1)*APT_JB_CAB;   // GATE-73 S2: door L or R (AIR-22)
 // dock = the cab centre, one cab half width out from the fuselage skin at the door; the sprite's Door End lies APT_JB_CABC (scaled) short of it
 const terminal=[s.gateX,APT_BRIDGE_Y],door=[s.cx+dx*c-dy*sn,ngy+dx*sn+dy*c],dock=[s.cx+dx*c-ey*sn,ngy+dx*sn+ey*c],vx=dock[0]-terminal[0],vy=dock[1]-terminal[1],length=Math.hypot(vx,vy);
 const nat=APTT_SPEC.jb.an.find(q=>q[0]==='Terminal End')[2]-APTT_SPEC.jb.an.find(q=>q[0]==='Door End')[2],reach=length*nat/(nat+APT_JB_CABC),u=(18+(reach-18)*ext)/length;
 return{terminal,door,dock,end:[terminal[0]+vx*u,terminal[1]+vy*u],length,reach,ac};
}

// ==== GATE-77 S3 · AIR-09: the jet bridge with a rotunda — fixed section · rotunda · telescopic tunnel turning about it · cab facing the door
const G77_SM=x=>{x=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,x));return x*x*(3-2*x)},G77_ANG=(a,b)=>Math.atan2(Math.sin(b-a),Math.cos(b-a));
function g77BridgePoseOld(s,f,ext){
 const B=f2BridgeGeometry(s,f,1),T=B.terminal,R=[T[0],T[1]-14],cd=[B.door[0]-B.dock[0],B.door[1]-B.dock[1]],cl=Math.hypot(cd[0],cd[1])||1,cu=[cd[0]/cl,cd[1]/cl];
 const ce=[B.dock[0]-cu[0]*9,B.dock[1]-cu[1]*9],Ld=Math.hypot(ce[0]-R[0],ce[1]-R[1]),thd=Math.atan2(ce[1]-R[1],ce[0]-R[0]),thc=Math.atan2(cu[1],cu[0]);
 // at rest: shorter, straight out of the terminal (along the stand axis, beside the arriving aircraft's nose, clear of the bus bays)
 const B0=f2BridgeGeometry(s,null,1),thr=Math.atan2(B0.dock[1]-R[1],B0.dock[0]-R[0]),Lr=Math.max(30,Ld*.55);   // GATE-77 S5c · D-78: at rest along the angled line (toward the design aircraft's door)
 let L,th,ca;const e=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,ext));
 if(e<=.45){L=Lr+(Ld*.9-Lr)*G77_SM(e/.45);th=thr;ca=th}                                       // extend
 else if(e<=.75){L=Ld*.9;th=thr+G77_ANG(thr,thd)*G77_SM((e-.45)/.3);ca=th}                      // rotate the outer half about the rotunda
 else if(e<=.9){L=Ld*.9;th=thd;ca=th+G77_ANG(th,thc)*G77_SM((e-.75)/.15)}                       // align the cab with the door
 else{th=thd;ca=thc;L=Ld*(.9+.1*G77_SM((e-.9)/.1))}                                            // dock
 const end=[R[0]+Math.cos(th)*L,R[1]+Math.sin(th)*L],cab=[end[0]+Math.cos(ca)*9,end[1]+Math.sin(ca)*9];
 return{T,R,th,L,end,ca,cab,docked:e>.98,B}}
