// ==== GATE-77 S6c · p170 · AIR-64: the crew shuttle — a crew change at the remote stands ===============================================
var G77_SH={on:true,after:8,before:20,gap:.8,door:12,ok:0,skip:0,noWin:0};
// the stop at the aircraft: the departing crew out and up, then the crew that landed down and in (each group: the path at walking pace + the spacing)
function g77ShWalk(sd,ac){const P=g2PaxPath(sd,ac);let L=G77_SH.door;for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++)L+=Math.hypot(P[i][0]-P[i-1][0],P[i][1]-P[i-1][1]);return L/G77_WALK}
function g77ShHold(sd,ac){return Math.ceil(3+2*(g77ShWalk(sd,ac)+(g77ShN(ac)-1)*G77_SH.gap))}
function g77ShN(ac){const P=G77_AC[ac];const seats=(P&&P.seats)||90;return 2+Math.max(1,Math.ceil(seats/50))}
// the destination: the stand's bus stop (free between the arrival and the departure bus). P5 — the bus column x 7797 from the hardstand
// lane HW north to the stop, a turn on the spot, south down the column and east on HE home. P6 (the bus comes from the east spine) — not yet (no route from the yard rows).
function g77ShDest(sd,ac){if(!G77_SH.on)return null;const R=G2_REM[sd.id];if(R&&R.via==='EAST'&&G77_EAST.on){const SO=APL.lanes.spineOut,SI=APL.lanes.spineIn;   // GATE-77 S6c · p173 · K-127: P6 — the east spine and the bus approach
  return{spot:[R.busX,R.busY],node:afNodeEast(),inn:[[SO,R.uy,24],[R.ux,R.uy,20],[R.ux,R.busY,14],[R.busX,R.busY,0]],back:[[R.busX,R.busY,0],[8150,R.busY,12],[8150,R.uy,12],[SI,R.uy,16]]}}
 if(!R||R.via!=='AL2')return null;
 return{spot:[R.x,R.busY],node:{inX:R.x,outX:R.x+40},inn:[[R.x,1000,16],[R.x,R.busY,0]],mode:'pivot',dir:1,back:[[R.x,R.busY,0],[R.x,AF.HE,16]]}}   // turn on the spot at the stop (as the bus), south down the column, east on HE
// the walk of one crew group: the shuttle door → the passengers' path (bus stop → stairs → the aircraft door), or back
function g77ShPath(j,a){const f=j.f,r=f&&f.g2;if(!r||!r.path)return null;const p=a.pose,D=s6aDimOf('SH'),L=D[0]/2,W=D[1]/2,P=r.path.slice().reverse(),e=P[0],lp=s6aLocal(p,e[0],e[1]),side=Math.sign(lp[1]||1);
 return[s6aLoc(p,L*.2,side*(W+.9)),...P]}
function g77ShAt(P,u){let tot=0;const seg=[];for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++){const l=Math.hypot(P[i][0]-P[i-1][0],P[i][1]-P[i-1][1]);seg.push(l);tot+=l}let d=u*tot;
 for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++){const l=seg[i-1];if(d<=l||i===P.length-1){const k=l?Math.min(1,d/l):1;return[P[i-1][0]+(P[i][0]-P[i-1][0])*k,P[i-1][1]+(P[i][1]-P[i-1][1])*k,Math.atan2(P[i][1]-P[i-1][1],P[i][0]-P[i-1][0])]}d-=l}
 return[P[P.length-1][0],P[P.length-1][1],0]}
function g77ShLen(P){let t=0;for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++)t+=Math.hypot(P[i][0]-P[i-1][0],P[i][1]-P[i-1][1]);return t}
// a pilot / flight attendant seen from above: navy jacket, white shirt collar, a cap for the pilots; a trolley bag behind
function g77DrawFlightCrew(g,x,y,th,t,pilot,al,f){if(al<=0)return;if(G77_PE.on){g77PeDraw(g,pilot?G77_PE.role.pilot:G77_PE.role.cabin,x,y,th,t,true,Math.min(1,al),g77Uniform(f,pilot));if(typeof S6R_PPL!=='undefined')S6R_PPL.n++;return}   // GATE-77 S6d-a · p178
 g.save();g.globalAlpha*=Math.min(1,al);g.translate(x,y);g.rotate(th);
 g.fillStyle='rgba(8,18,26,.3)';g.beginPath();g.ellipse(.8,.9,2.2,1.7,0,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();const s=Math.sin(t*7)*.5;g.fillStyle='#141c2c';g.fillRect(-1.6+s,-.95,1.3,.75);g.fillRect(-1.6-s,.2,1.3,.75);
 g.fillStyle=pilot?'#1b2540':'#2a3f6e';g.beginPath();g.ellipse(0,0,1.6,1.9,0,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();g.fillStyle='#f2f4f6';g.fillRect(.3,-.5,.7,1);
 g.fillStyle=pilot?'#11161f':'#3a2a20';g.beginPath();g.arc(.15,0,.95,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();if(pilot){g.fillStyle='#e8c25a';g.fillRect(.6,-.25,.35,.5)}
 g.fillStyle='#2b2f36';g.fillRect(-3.4,-.6,1.3,1.2);g.restore();if(typeof S6R_PPL!=='undefined')S6R_PPL.n++}
// the shuttle at the aircraft: the first half — the departing crew out and up; the second half — the crew that landed down and in
function g77ShAct(g,a,j,now){const P=g77ShPath(j,a);if(!P)return;const n=g77ShN(j.ac),T=j.dur,half=T/2,tw=g77ShLen(P)/G77_WALK;
 for(const grp of ['dep','arr']){const t0=grp==='dep'?1:Math.max(1,T-1-tw-(n-1)*G77_SH.gap);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const lt=j.t-t0-i*G77_SH.gap;if(lt<0||lt>tw)continue;const u=lt/tw,q=g77ShAt(P,grp==='dep'?u:1-u),al=Math.min(1,lt/.4,(tw-lt)/.4);
  const st=P.length>=2&&g77UpSegD(q[0],q[1],P[P.length-2],P[P.length-1])<G77_UP.w;g77UpPush(g,q[0],q[1],()=>g77DrawFlightCrew(g,q[0],q[1],grp==='dep'?q[2]:q[2]+Math.PI,now/1000,i<2,al,j.f),st)}}}   // GATE-77 S7-a · p183
// QA: the crew changes of a run
function g77ShAudit(all){const o={visits:0,served:0,people:0,skip:G77_SH.skip,noWin:G77_SH.noWin,issues:[]};for(const f of all){if(!f.g2)continue;o.visits++;if(f.sh){o.served++;o.people+=2*f.sh.n;
  if(f.g2.dep&&f.sh.done>f.g2.dep.at-2&&o.issues.length<6)o.issues.push(f.code+':late');if(f.g2.arr&&f.sh.at<f.g2.arr.done&&o.issues.length<6)o.issues.push(f.code+':early')}}
 o.ok=!o.issues.length;return o}

// ==== GATE-77 S6c · p175 · AIR-65: FOLLOW ME (V-MX2) leads the arrivals of the remote stands ==============================================
var G77_FM={on:true,ids:['V-MX2'],st:{P5:1,P6:1},a:28,gap:14,out:8,pre:30,wMin:150,hMin:3,hMax:40,step:5,tries:4,cuts:[0,45,90,135],yLY:86,dt:.05,ok:0,skip:0,noRoom:0,late:0,why:{},diag:false,dl:[]};
function g77FmHx(){const D=s6aDimOf('MX');return D?D[0]/2:11}
// the lead leg: from the arrival leg (τ=0 at tA) — the straight lead-in, the wait point W, the launch and the peel-off
function g77FmLead(sd,ac,arr,tA,cut){const F=G77_FM,g=apttAcGeom(ac),th=sd.th,u=[Math.cos(th),Math.sin(th)],dt=F.dt,n=Math.ceil(arr.dur/dt),hx=g77FmHx();
 const X=new Float64Array(n+1),Y=new Float64Array(n+1),R=new Float64Array(n+1);
 for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const p=arr.pose(Math.min(i*dt,arr.dur));X[i]=p[0];Y[i]=p[1]}
 for(let i=n-1;i>=0;i--)R[i]=R[i+1]+Math.hypot(X[i+1]-X[i],Y[i+1]-Y[i]);
 const sx=X[n],sy=Y[n];let i0=n;
 for(let i=n;i>=0;i--){const dx=X[i]-sx,dy=Y[i]-sy,lat=Math.abs(-dx*u[1]+dy*u[0]),al=dx*u[0]+dy*u[1];if(lat>.8||al>1)break;i0=i}   // the straight lead-in, back from the stop
 const lead=g.F[1]+F.gap+hx,dN=u[1]>.9?sy-(APTT_X.LY+F.yLY):Infinity,dW=Math.min(R[i0]-lead-F.pre,dN)-(cut||0);if(dW<F.wMin)return null;   // south of taxiway L: the car never waits on it, its turn-in (W − 70) stays F.yLY − 70 px south of it
 const W=[sx-u[0]*dW,sy-u[1]*dW],xa=i=>dW-R[i],vA=i=>i<n?(R[i]-R[i+1])/dt:0,xEnd=dW+g.F[1]+F.out+hx;
 let iS=-1;for(let i=0;i<=n;i++)if(xa(i)+lead>=0){iS=i;break}if(iS<0)return null;
 for(let k=iS;k>=Math.max(0,iS-Math.round(10/dt));k--){let xf=0,vf=0,G=null,ok=true,iP=-1;const xs=[0];
  for(let i=k+1;i<=n;i++){if(G==null){vf+=F.a*dt;xf+=vf*dt;if(vf>=vA(i))G=xf-xa(i)}else xf=xa(i)+G;
   if(xf-xa(i)<lead-1e-6){ok=false;break}xs.push(xf);if(xf>=xEnd){iP=i;break}}
  if(!ok)continue;if(iP<0)return null;
  const dur=(iP-k)*dt,v1=Math.max(4,(xs[xs.length-1]-xs[xs.length-2])/dt);
  const pose=t=>{const j=Math.max(0,Math.min(xs.length-1.000001,t/dt)),j0=Math.floor(j),x=xs[j0]+(xs[Math.min(xs.length-1,j0+1)]-xs[j0])*(j-j0);return[W[0]+u[0]*x,W[1]+u[1]*x,th,0,1]};
  return{W,th,lead,dW,tL:tA+k*dt,tP:tA+iP*dt,dur,pose,v1}}
 return null}
// the routes: in — up the corridor between P5 and P6 (the P5 bus column, x 7797) to above W, round into the line (facing the stand);
// back — straight out of the stand front, round to the column and down to HE (one way for both stands: an `east` node would also send
// the way in through the east exit of the yard — straight across hangar S1; QA-54 Matrix P6:RJ / QJ caught it).
function g77FmDests(sd,ac,L){const R=G2_REM[sd.id],C=G2_REM.P5;if(!R||!C||C.x==null)return[];const CX=C.x,cx=L.W[0],Wy=L.W[1],yU=Wy-70,yX=Math.max(sd.ngy+apttAcGeom(ac).F[1]+40,840),LN=APL.lanes;
 const inn=[[CX,1000,16],[CX,yU,26],[cx,yU,26],[cx,Wy,0]],o=[{node:{inX:CX,outX:CX+40},inn,mode:'lead',back:[[cx,yX,22],[CX,yX,22],[CX,AF.HE,16]]}];
 return o}
// the visit: the van leaves its bay so that it waits at W `hMin`…`hMax` s and pulls away exactly at the launch time
function* g77FmServeG(sd,ac,arr,tA,meta,extra){const F=G77_FM;let late=true,room=false;
 for(const cut of F.cuts){const L=g77FmLead(sd,ac,arr,tA,cut);if(!L)continue;room=true;
  for(const D of g77FmDests(sd,ac,L))for(const v of AO.fleet){if(!F.ids.includes(v.id))continue;const B0=afBuild(v,D,F.hMin,{lead:L}),sHi=Math.floor((L.tL-B0.dOut-F.hMin)/AO.DT+1e-9),sLo=Math.max(afSEarliest(),Math.ceil((L.tL-B0.dOut-F.hMax)/AO.DT-1e-9));

// QA (VQA-01, the baggage): every service leg of every train at the aircraft, sampled every 0.2 s
function g77BwAudit(all,t0,t1){const o={legs:0,samples:0,bags:0,belt:0,three:0,two:0,throwMax:0,throwDist:0,pressed:0,holdMin:1e9,holdMax:0,issues:[],ok:true},bad=m=>{if(o.issues.length<10)o.issues.push(m)};

   for(let tt=ta+.05;tt<tb;tt+=.2){const G=geo(tt);if(!G)continue;o.samples++;if(first){first=false;o[G.mode]++;if(G.k>1.02){o.pressed++}}
    for(const b of G.bags){o.bags++;const w=b.w!=null?G.W[b.w]:null;
     if(b.s==='lift'){if(!w||g77BwD(b.p,w.p)>13.5)bad('BAG-OUT-OF-REACH '+v.id+' '+G.st+' @'+tt.toFixed(1))}

// ==== GATE-77 S7-a · p188 · a vehicle parked in its bay is an obstacle in the reservation search ===================================
var G77_IH={on:true,dye:true,hit:0,jump:0,last:false,until:0,F:null,nF:0,R:null};
function g77IhRows(){if(G77_IH.R&&G77_IH.F===AO.fleet&&G77_IH.nF===AO.fleet.length)return G77_IH.R;

  const key=w.bay&&w.bay.row||'_',G=by[key]||(by[key]={x0:1e9,x1:-1e9,y0:1e9,y1:-1e9,h:[]});G.h.push({v:w,id:w.id,q,x0,x1,y0,y1});G.x0=Math.min(G.x0,x0);G.x1=Math.max(G.x1,x1);G.y0=Math.min(G.y0,y0);G.y1=Math.max(G.y1,y1)}

// idle at t: no task covers t (afPose / afShapes use the same rule) → the slice at which the idle stretch ends (its next task), or -1 when busy
function g77IhIdleTo(w,t){let nx=Infinity;for(const k of w.tasks){if(t>=k.t0&&t<k.t1)return -1;if(k.t0>t&&k.t0<nx)nx=k.t0}return nx}
function g77IhHit(a,s){if(!G77_IH||!G77_IH.on||!AO.fleet)return false;const L=a.L;if(L==='S'||L==='R'||L==='A'||!(a.x0<=a.x1))return false;

 for(const G of R){if(a.x0>G.x1+m||a.x1<G.x0-m||a.y0>G.y1+m||a.y1<G.y0-m)continue;
  for(const h of G.h){if(h.id===a.t||a.x0>h.x1+m||a.x1<h.x0-m||a.y0>h.y1+m||a.y1<h.y0-m)continue;
   let hit=false;for(const b of h.q)if(aoC(a,b)){hit=true;break}if(!hit)continue;
   if(t==null)t=aoT(s);const nx=g77IhIdleTo(h.v,t);if(nx<0)continue;
   G77_IH.hit++;G77_IH.last=true;G77_IH.w=AO.work;G77_IH.until=nx===Infinity?s+4000:Math.max(s+1,aoSlUp(nx));return true}}

 return C}
// the covered parts of the moving baggage trains at clock t: [{v, part (OBB), cover}]
function g77SilParts(t,C){const out=[];if(!AO.fleet)return out;
 for(const v of AO.fleet){if(!G77_SIL.types[v.type])continue;const r=afPose(v,t);if(!r.task)continue;const la=r.task.tr.seq.legAt(t-r.task.t0);if(!la||!G77_SIL.legs[la.leg.kind])continue;
  const sh=[];apttShapes(r.tr,r.pose,sh,t-r.task.t0);
  for(let i=0;i<sh.length;i++){const a=sh[i];for(const c of C){if(a.x0>c.x1||a.x1<c.x0||a.y0>c.y1||a.y1<c.y0)continue;if(apttObbHit(a,c,0)){out.push({v,a,c,tug:i===0,pose:r.pose,hx:r.tr.hx||10,hy:r.tr.hy||6});break}}}}
 return out}
function g77SilPoly(g,a){const c=a.c,s=a.s,X=[1,-1,-1,1],Y=[1,1,-1,-1];g.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const x=a.x+c*a.hx*X[i]-s*a.hy*Y[i],y=a.y+s*a.hx*X[i]+c*a.hy*Y[i];i?g.lineTo(x,y):g.moveTo(x,y)}g.closePath()}
function g77SilDraw(now,view){if(!G77_SIL.on||typeof AO==='undefined'||!AO.flights)return;if(typeof Camera!=='undefined'&&Camera.zoom<G77_SIL.minZ)return;
 const t=APT_OPS.clk,P=g77SilParts(t,g77SilCovers(t));G77_SIL.n=P.length;if(!P.length)return;G77_SIL.frames++;
 const g=ctx;g.save();g.lineJoin='round';
 const z=(typeof Camera!=='undefined'&&Camera.zoom)||1;
 for(const q of P){g.save();g77SilPoly(g,q.c);g.clip();   // only the hidden part: clipped to the cover
  g77SilPoly(g,q.a);g.fillStyle='rgba(28,34,44,.32)';g.fill();g.lineWidth=1.5;g.strokeStyle='rgba(20,24,30,.55)';g.stroke();g.setLineDash([2.4,1.5]);g.lineWidth=.95;g.strokeStyle='rgba(255,212,80,.98)';g.stroke();g.setLineDash([]);
  if(q.tug&&typeof g77VcCode==='function'&&typeof G77_VC!=='undefined'&&G77_VC.on&&z>=G77_VC.minZ){   // the code at the same place as p181 draws it: the part outside the cover is the original, the hidden part continues it
   const code=g77VcCode(q.v),[x,y,th]=q.pose,hx=q.hx,hy=q.hy,k=(G77_VC.off[q.v.type]!=null?G77_VC.off[q.v.type]:G77_VC.def),px=x+Math.cos(th)*k*hx,py=y+Math.sin(th)*k*hx,sn=Math.abs(Math.sin(th)),
    avail=Math.min(2*hy/Math.max(sn,.2),2*hx*(1-Math.abs(k))+hx*.4),cap=G77_VC.fit*avail/(G77_VC.cw*code.length),f2=Math.max(G77_VC.fs,Math.min(G77_VC.px/z,cap));
   g.font='bold '+f2.toFixed(2)+'px sans-serif';g.textAlign='center';g.textBaseline='middle';g.lineWidth=Math.max(1.1,f2*.24);g.strokeStyle='rgba(14,18,24,.92)';g.strokeText(code,px,py);g.fillStyle='#ffffff';g.fillText(code,px,py)}
  g.restore()}
 g.restore()}
// QA (offline): every second a moving train is covered, and the silhouette path finds a part for it
function g77SilAudit(t0,t1){const o={samples:0,covered:0,arm:0,ac:0,parts:0,ok:true,issues:[]};
 for(let t=t0;t<t1;t+=.5){const C=g77SilCovers(t),P=g77SilParts(t,C);o.samples++;if(P.length){o.covered+=.5;o.parts+=P.length;for(const q of P){if(String(q.c.t).startsWith('ARM:'))o.arm+=.5/P.length;else o.ac+=.5/P.length}}}
 o.arm=+o.arm.toFixed(1);o.ac=+o.ac.toFixed(1);return o}

// ==== GATE-77 S7-a · p190 · the departure train loads at the end of the main loader's stay when the push comes later ===============
var G77_BLW={on:true,n:0,step:2,back:60};   // the search walks back from the loader's end in 2 s steps, at most 60 s (search granularity, not a game time)
// the lead (s) that puts the train's work [a, a+hold] at the end of the loader window S6R_BW.w, k steps back (a+hold = w1 − k·step); null if outside
function g77BlwBf(c,sP,k){const w=S6R_BW.w;if(!w)return null;const h=c.B.hold||0,a=w[1]-k*G77_BLW.step-h;if(a<w[0])return null;const bf=aoT(sP)-a;return bf>0?bf:null}
function g77BlwList(){const o=[];for(let k=0;k*G77_BLW.step<=G77_BLW.back;k++)o.push({w:k});return o}

// ==== GATE-77 S7-a · p191 · AIR-55 / QA-63: the big flight board at the terminal entrances ========================================

const G77_FIDS_AL=['אורליה','מקור השמש','זברנו','חוף האלמוגים','רוח הגאות','מיראז׳','קונפטי','קו הרקיע'];   /* p351 · D‑245 (6) */

function g77FidsAirline(f){if(!f)return'';if(/^AC-(PR|BJ|LT|CN|AM)/.test(f.ac||''))return'תעופה כללית';return G77_FIDS_AL[(g77Livery(f)%16)%8]}
function g77FidsT(f,k){const q=(f.states||[]).find(x=>x[1]===k);return q?q[0]:null}
function g77FidsBoarding(f){const p=f.pax&&f.pax.dep;if(p&&p.start!=null)return[p.start,p.end];
 const n=f.nb&&(f.nb.gateDep||f.nb.dep);if(n&&n.at!=null)return[n.at,n.done!=null?n.done:n.at+60];

function g77FidsStatus(f,kind,now){
 if(kind==='arr'){const ld=g77FidsT(f,'LANDING_ROLL');if(ld!=null&&now>=ld)return'landed';return(f.states||[]).some(x=>x[1]==='GO_AROUND')?'late':'ontime'}
 const to=g77FidsT(f,'TAKEOFF_ROLL'),push=g77FidsT(f,'PUSHBACK')??g77FidsT(f,'TAXI_OUT'),rdy=g77FidsT(f,'TURNAROUND_READY'),b=g77FidsBoarding(f);
 if(to!=null&&now>=to)return'dep';if(push!=null&&now>=push)return'gone';if(b&&now>=b[0]&&now<=b[1])return'board';
 return push!=null&&rdy!=null&&push-rdy>G77_FIDS.late?'late':'ontime'}
// the rows at clock `now`: {arr:[...], dep:[...]} — the passenger stands P1–P6, the next G77_FIDS.rows of each, by time
function g77FidsRows(now=APT_OPS.clk,flights=AO.flights){const arr=[],dep=[];if(!flights)return{arr,dep,now,ready:false};
 for(const f of flights){if(f.heli||f.never||!(f.states&&f.states.length)||!/^P[1-6]$/.test(f.stand||''))continue;
  const inbound=f.states[0][1]==='INBOUND',ob=g77FidsT(f,'ON_BLOCK'),push=g77FidsT(f,'PUSHBACK')??g77FidsT(f,'TAXI_OUT'),to=g77FidsT(f,'TAKEOFF_ROLL');
  const base={code:f.code,ac:f.ac,stand:f.stand,airline:g77FidsAirline(f),f};
  if(inbound&&ob!=null&&ob>=now-120)arr.push(Object.assign({kind:'arr',city:f2City(f.code+'A'),t:ob,ts:g77FwSchedA(f,ob),st:g77FidsStatus(f,'arr',now)},base));
  if(push!=null&&to!=null&&to>=now-60&&!(inbound&&ob!=null&&now<ob))dep.push(Object.assign({kind:'dep',city:f2City(f.code+'D'),t:push,ts:g77FwSchedD(f,push),st:g77FidsStatus(f,'dep',now)},base))}
 arr.sort((a,b)=>a.t-b.t||(a.code<b.code?-1:1));dep.sort((a,b)=>a.t-b.t||(a.code<b.code?-1:1));
 return{arr:arr.slice(0,G77_FIDS.rows),dep:dep.slice(0,G77_FIDS.rows),now,ready:!!(typeof APT_OPS==='undefined'||APT_OPS.ready)}}
function g77FidsWhen(t,now){const d=Math.round(t-now),a=Math.abs(d),m=Math.floor(a/60),s=a%60,ms=m+':'+String(s).padStart(2,'0');return d>2?'בעוד '+ms:d>=-2?'עכשיו':'לפני '+ms}

// QA (offline, in a run): every 10 s — each row's status agrees with its flight's state, the gate is the stand, rows by time, phone = board
function g77FidsAudit(t0,t1){const o={samples:0,rows:0,arr:0,dep:0,st:{},issues:[],ok:true},bad=m=>{if(o.issues.length<8)o.issues.push(m)};
 const all=(AO.hist||[]).concat(AO.flights);   // the run is over: the departed flights are in the history
 for(let t=t0+30;t<t1;t+=10){const B=g77FidsRows(t,all);o.samples++;
  for(const [kind,list] of [['arr',B.arr],['dep',B.dep]]){let prev=-Infinity;
   for(const q of list){o.rows++;o[kind]++;o.st[q.st]=(o.st[q.st]||0)+1;const f=q.f,s=aoStateOf(f,t)||f.states[0][1];
    if(q.t<prev-1e-6)bad('ORDER '+kind+' '+q.code+' @'+t);prev=q.t;
    if(q.stand!==f.stand)bad('GATE '+q.code);
    if(q.st==='dep'&&!['TAKEOFF_ROLL','DEPARTED'].includes(s)&&!(t>=f.t1))bad('DEP '+q.code+' '+s+' @'+t);
    if(q.st==='gone'&&!['PUSHBACK','TAXI_OUT','HOLD_SHORT','RUNWAY_RESERVED','LINE_UP'].includes(s))bad('GONE '+q.code+' '+s+' @'+t);
    if(q.st==='landed'&&['INBOUND','APPROACH','LANDING_RESERVED','GO_AROUND'].includes(s))bad('LANDED '+q.code+' '+s+' @'+t);
    if(q.st==='board'&&!['ON_BLOCK','TURNAROUND_READY','PUSHBACK_RESERVED'].includes(s))bad('BOARD '+q.code+' '+s+' @'+t);
    if(!q.airline)bad('AIRLINE '+q.code);if(q.ts==null||q.ts>q.t+1e-6)bad('SCHED '+q.code)}}}
 o.ok=!o.issues.length;return o}

// ==== GATE-77 S7-b · p192 · AIR-53 / QA-59: the control tower — glazed cab, antennas, more floors, a long shadow ===================
var G77_TWR={on:true,x0:7098.6,x1:7143.4,yRoof:785.6,yBase:944,shadow:{len:190,dx:.80,dy:.42,a:.30},cab:{over:4.5,h:22,slab:5},mast:[[-9,11],[10,8]],roadEdge:768,minZ:.3,n:0};
function g77TwrGeo(){const T=G77_TWR,cx=(T.x0+T.x1)/2,w=T.x1-T.x0,cw=w+2*T.cab.over,cy0=T.yRoof+2,cy1=cy0+T.cab.h,slab=cy0-T.cab.slab,top=slab-Math.max(...T.mast.map(m=>m[1]));return{cx,w,cw,cy0,cy1,slab,top}}
// (1) the long shadow: the shaft's ground footprint swept to the south-east, fading out
function g77TwrShadow(now){if(!G77_TWR.on||typeof ctx==='undefined')return;if(typeof Camera!=='undefined'&&Camera.zoom<G77_TWR.minZ)return;const T=G77_TWR,S=T.shadow,g=ctx;

 if(typeof aptView==='function'&&typeof portVis==='function'&&!portVis(aptView(40),bx0-10,by0-10,ex+60,ey+50))return;
 g.save();const gr=g.createLinearGradient(bx1,by0,bx1+ex,by0+ey);gr.addColorStop(0,'rgba(10,16,24,'+S.a+')');gr.addColorStop(.85,'rgba(10,16,24,'+(S.a*.55).toFixed(3)+')');gr.addColorStop(1,'rgba(10,16,24,0)');g.fillStyle=gr;
 g.beginPath();g.moveTo(bx1,by0);g.lineTo(bx1+ex,by0+ey);g.lineTo(bx1+ex-(bx1-bx0)*.8,by1+ey);g.lineTo(bx0,by1);g.closePath();g.fill();

// (2)(3) the cab, the antennas and the floors — over the building
function g77TwrTop(now,v){if(!G77_TWR.on||typeof ctx==='undefined')return;if(typeof Camera!=='undefined'&&Camera.zoom<G77_TWR.minZ)return;const T=G77_TWR,G=g77TwrGeo(),g=ctx;

function g77TvLegIx(f){const L=f.legs;let i=1;while(i<L.length&&L[i].h==null)i++;const h1=i,taxi=i+1;i=taxi;while(i<L.length&&L[i].h==null)i++;const h2=i,app=L.findIndex(g=>g.z0>0&&g.z1===0);return{h1,taxi,h2,line:h2+1,roll:h2+2,app,land:app+1,vac:app+2}}
function g77TvDir(g){const P=g&&g.p;return P&&P.length>1&&P[P.length-1][0]<P[0][0]?'27':'09'}
function g77TvS15Cyc(n){const C=G77_S15.cache;if(C.has(n))return C.get(n);const T=S15SIM.T,b=n*T,t=x=>+(b+x).toFixed(2),out=[];

  const A=typeof S15GR_AL!=='undefined'?S15GR_AL[f.airline]:null,no=100+((typeof s15Hash==='function'?s15Hash(f.id):0)%800),pre=A?A[1]:'GA',al=A?A[0]:(f.airline||''),lu=L[ix.line];
  out.push({uid:f.id+'#D'+n,code:pre+' '+(no+1),stand:f.home,al,s15:f,rwy:g77TvDir(L[ix.roll]),states:[[t(L[0].t0-30),'TURNAROUND_READY'],[t(L[0].t0-2),'PUSHBACK_RESERVED'],[t(L[ix.h1].t0),'PUSHBACK'],[t(L[ix.taxi].t0),'TAXI_OUT'],[t(L[ix.h2].t0),'HOLD_SHORT'],[t(lu.t0),'RUNWAY_RESERVED'],[t(lu.t0+Math.min(5,(lu.t1-lu.t0)/2)),'LINE_UP'],[t(L[ix.roll].t0),'TAKEOFF_ROLL']]});
  out.push({uid:f.id+'#A'+n,code:pre+' '+no,stand:f.home,al,s15:f,rwy:g77TvDir(L[ix.land]),states:[[t(L[ix.app].t0-30),'INBOUND'],[t(L[ix.app].t0),'LANDING_RESERVED'],[t(L[ix.land].t0),'VACATE_RUNWAY'],[t(L[ix.vac].t1),'TAXI_IN']]})}

// the flights of the shift at clock `now`: the rotation before, this one and the next (S15) — or the old AO list
function g77TvFl(now){if(!g77TvS15())return AO.flights;const n=Math.floor(now/S15SIM.T);return g77TvS15Cyc(n-1).concat(g77TvS15Cyc(n),g77TvS15Cyc(n+1))}
// who holds the runway at `now` (S15): the aircraft whose pose is on the runway strip, on the ground
function g77TvS15Rwy(now,f){const R=typeof S15D!=='undefined'&&S15D.rwy,tc=s15Tc(now),own=[];if(R)for(const a of S15SIM.flights){if(a===f.s15||(a.kind&&a.kind!=='ac'))continue;const p=s15PoseAt(a,tc);if(p&&p[0]>=R[0]&&p[0]<=R[2]&&p[1]>=R[1]&&p[1]<=R[3]&&(p[3]||0)<3){const c=g77TvS15Cyc(Math.floor(now/S15SIM.T)).find(q=>q.s15===a);own.push(c?c.code:a.id)}}return{owners:own,phase:own.length?'על המסלול':'פנוי'}}

function g77TvT(f,k){const q=(f.states||[]).find(x=>x[1]===k);return q?q[0]:null}
function g77TvRwy(f){if(f.rwy)return f.rwy;const t=g77TvT(f,'LANDING_ROLL')??g77TvT(f,'TAKEOFF_ROLL');if(t==null)return'09';for(const q of f.tracks||[]){if(q.tr.kind!=='ac')continue;const p=q.tr.seq.at(t-q.t0+1);if(p)return Math.cos(p[2])>=0?'09':'27'}return'09'}
// the requests of the flights at clock `now`: one per (flight, kind) between its ask and its ready + the miss window
function g77TvCards(now,flights=g77TvFl(now),done={}){const out=[];
 for(const f of flights||[]){if(f.heli||f.never||!(f.states&&f.states.length))continue;
  for(const k in G77_TV_KIND){const K=G77_TV_KIND[k],ta=g77TvT(f,K.ask),tr=g77TvT(f,K.ready);if(ta==null||tr==null||tr<ta-1e-6)continue;const id=(f.uid||f.code)+':'+k;if(done[id])continue;
   if(now<ta||now>tr+G77_TV.miss)continue;
   const al=f.al!=null?f.al:typeof g77FidsAirline==='function'?g77FidsAirline(f):'',where=k==='taxiin'?' '+f.stand:k==='push'?' מ-'+f.stand:'',rw=K.rwy?g77TvRwy(f):'';
   const hint=k==='land'?f.code+' בגישה — מבקש נחיתה במסלול '+rw+'. המסלול פנוי?':k==='taxiin'?f.code+' פינה את המסלול — מבקש הסעה לעמדה '+f.stand+'. הדרך פנויה?':k==='push'?f.code+' מוכן בעמדה '+f.stand+' — מבקש דחיפה. הגורר והדרך מאחוריו פנויים?':k==='taxiout'?f.code+' נדחף — מבקש הסעה לנקודת ההמתנה.':k==='lineup'?f.code+' בנקודת ההמתנה — מבקש כניסה למסלול '+rw+'. אין נחיתה ואין המראה?':f.code+' על המסלול '+rw+' — מבקש אישור המראה. המסלול לפניו פנוי?';
   out.push({id,f,k,name:K.name+where,btn:K.btn,ask:ta,ready:tr,airline:al,hint})}}
 out.sort((a,b)=>a.ready-b.ready);return out}
// the controller's reason why it is not safe yet (the real state at `now`)
function g77TvWhy(c,now){const K=G77_TV_KIND[c.k],dt=Math.max(1,Math.round(c.ready-now));let s=null;try{s=c.f.s15?g77TvS15Rwy(now,c.f):f1Snapshot(now)}catch(e){}
 if(K.rwy&&s&&s.owners&&s.owners.length&&!s.owners.includes(c.f.code)){const o=s.owners[0],ph=typeof F1_PHASE_LABELS!=='undefined'&&F1_PHASE_LABELS[s.phase]?F1_PHASE_LABELS[s.phase]:s.phase;return'המסלול תפוס: '+o+' ('+ph+'). הבקר משחרר בעוד '+dt+' שנ׳.'}
 if(c.k==='push'||c.k==='taxiout'||c.k==='taxiin')return'דרך ההסעה עדיין בשימוש — הבקר משחרר בעוד '+dt+' שנ׳.';
 if(c.k==='takeoff')return'עוד לא — המטוס מתיישר על המסלול ('+dt+' שנ׳).';
 return'עוד לא בטוח — מרווח בטיחות; הבקר משחרר בעוד '+dt+' שנ׳.'}

function g77TvState(){const m=PlayerProfile.activeMission;return m&&m.id==='M-F1-TOWER'?m:null}
function g77TvStart(d){   /* missions 11.11 (R26‑7.4 / R26‑8): לחיצה אחת, מכל מקום — המגדל של S15 בתוך אגף השערים, השחקן לא מגיע אליו ברגל */

  tv:{correct:0,errors:0,misses:0,holds:0,score:0,resp:[],done:{},held:{},log:[]}};
 SaveManager.save('mission-start',{backup:true,silent:true});

function g77TvResume(m){m.tv||={correct:0,errors:0,misses:0,holds:0,score:0,resp:[],done:{},held:{},log:[]};m.tv.done={};m.tv.held={};g77TvEnter(false)}
function g77TvEnter(brief){G77_TV.on=true;G77_TV.saved={x:Camera.x,y:Camera.y,zoom:Camera.zoom};State.mapQa=true;State.mapOpen=false;try{setMapOpen(false)}catch(e){}Input.held.clear();
 const B=G77_TV.bounds;G77_TV.zFit=Math.max(.18,Math.min(innerWidth/(B.x1-B.x0),innerHeight/(B.y1-B.y0)));Camera.x=(B.x0+B.x1)/2;Camera.y=(B.y0+B.y1)/2;Camera.zoom=G77_TV.zFit;
 G77_TV.brief=!!brief;G77_TV.sel=null;try{updateMapQaButton()}catch(e){}g77TvRender()}
function g77TvExit(){if(!G77_TV.on)return;G77_TV.on=false;State.mapQa=false;const a=playerActor();Camera.x=a.x;Camera.y=a.y;if(G77_TV.saved)Camera.zoom=G77_TV.saved.zoom;G77_TV.brief=false;try{updateMapQaButton()}catch(e){}g77TvRender()}
function g77TvClamp(){const B=G77_TV.bounds;Camera.zoom=Math.max(G77_TV.zFit,Math.min(G77_TV.zMax,Camera.zoom));const hw=innerWidth/2/Camera.zoom,hh=innerHeight/2/Camera.zoom;
 Camera.x=(B.x1-B.x0)<=2*hw?(B.x0+B.x1)/2:Math.max(B.x0+hw,Math.min(B.x1-hw,Camera.x));Camera.y=(B.y1-B.y0)<=2*hh?(B.y0+B.y1)/2:Math.max(B.y0+hh,Math.min(B.y1-hh,Camera.y))}
function g77TvMsg(t,kind){G77_TV.msg={t,kind:kind||'info'};G77_TV.msgT=performance.now()}
function g77TvAct(id,what){const m=g77TvState();if(!m||G77_TV.brief)return;const now=g77TvNow(),c=g77TvCards(now,g77TvFl(now),m.tv.done).find(q=>q.id===id);if(!c)return;const T=m.tv,safe=now>=c.ready-G77_TV.early;
 if(what==='ok'){if(!safe){T.errors++;T.score-=40;T.log.push({id,k:c.k,t:+now.toFixed(1),r:'blocked'});g77TvMsg('נחסם: '+g77TvWhy(c,now)+' (טעות · ‎−40)','err')}
  else{const rt=Math.max(0,now-c.ready);T.correct++;T.resp.push(+rt.toFixed(1));const pts=Math.max(40,100-Math.round(rt*4));T.score+=pts;T.done[id]=1;T.log.push({id,k:c.k,t:+now.toFixed(1),r:'ok',rt:+rt.toFixed(1)});g77TvMsg('✓ '+c.name+' — '+c.f.code+' (+'+pts+')','ok');
   if(T.correct>=G77_TV.target)return g77TvFinish(true)}}
 else{if(!safe){if(!T.held[id]){T.held[id]=1;T.holds++;T.score+=10;g77TvMsg('נכון — '+c.f.code+' ממתין. '+g77TvWhy(c,now)+' (+10)','ok')}else g77TvMsg(c.f.code+' כבר ממתין.','info')}
  else g77TvMsg('עכשיו זה בטוח — הבקר פינה את הדרך ל-'+c.f.code+'. אשר.','info')}
 G77_TV.sel=id;g77TvRender()}
function g77TvTick(dt){const m=g77TvState();if(!m){if(G77_TV.on)g77TvExit();return}if(!G77_TV.on)g77TvEnter(false);g77TvClamp();if(G77_TV.brief){g77TvRender(true);return}
 m.timeRemaining=Math.max(0,m.timeRemaining-dt);const now=g77TvNow(),T=m.tv;
 for(const c of g77TvCards(now,g77TvFl(now),T.done))if(now>c.ready+G77_TV.miss-.05){T.done[c.id]=1;T.misses++;T.score-=20;T.log.push({id:c.id,k:c.k,t:+now.toFixed(1),r:'miss'});g77TvMsg('המפקח אישר במקומך: '+c.name+' — '+c.f.code+' (‎−20)','err')}
 if(m.timeRemaining<=0)return g77TvFinish(false);g77TvRender(true)}
function g77TvFinish(ok){const m=g77TvState();if(!m)return;const T=m.tv,avg=T.resp.length?+(T.resp.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/T.resp.length).toFixed(1):null;
 const p=PlayerProfile.worldPersistent.towerShifts||(PlayerProfile.worldPersistent.towerShifts={runs:0,best:null,last:null});p.runs++;p.last={at:iso(),ok,score:T.score,correct:T.correct,errors:T.errors,misses:T.misses,avg};if(ok&&(p.best==null||T.score>p.best))p.best=T.score;
 G77_TV.sum={ok,score:T.score,correct:T.correct,errors:T.errors,misses:T.misses,holds:T.holds,avg,reward:ok?MISSION_DEFS['M-F1-TOWER'].reward:0};G77_TV.sumT=performance.now();

// QA (offline, after a run): every card has a ready time inside its flight's states; an eager controller (approves on sight) is
// blocked on every early approval with a reason; a perfect controller (approves at ready) makes 0 errors
function g77TvAudit(t0,t1){const all=g77TvS15()?(()=>{const a=[];for(let n=Math.floor(t0/S15SIM.T)-1;n<=Math.floor(t1/S15SIM.T)+1;n++)a.push(...g77TvS15Cyc(n));return a})():(AO.hist||[]).concat(AO.flights),o={cards:0,byKind:{},early:0,blockedWithWhy:0,perfectErrors:0,issues:[],ok:true},seen={};
 for(let t=t0+30;t<t1;t+=2){for(const c of g77TvCards(t,all,seen)){if(seen[c.id])continue;seen[c.id]=1;o.cards++;o.byKind[c.k]=(o.byKind[c.k]||0)+1;
   const ix=k=>c.f.states.findIndex(s=>s[1]===k),ia=ix(G77_TV_KIND[c.k].ask),ir=ix(G77_TV_KIND[c.k].ready);if(ia<0||ir<0||ir<ia)o.issues.push('ORDER '+c.id);
   if(c.ready-c.ask>G77_TV.early+.5){o.early++;const w=g77TvWhy(c,c.ask);if(w&&w.length>8)o.blockedWithWhy++;else o.issues.push('WHY '+c.id)}
   if(c.ready<c.ask-1e-6)o.perfectErrors++}}
 if(o.issues.length>8)o.issues=o.issues.slice(0,8);o.ok=!o.issues.length&&o.perfectErrors===0&&o.blockedWithWhy===o.early;return o}

// ==== GATE-77 S7-b · p196 · S7 (D-99 / D-105): the live maintenance — out of the hangar, a check on the apron, back in ==================
var G77_MLV={on:true,first:{M1:150,M2:480,M3:810},every:1500,jit:420,run:{M1:[50,75],M2:[40,70],M3:[40,70]},v:5,gap:6,tugGap:7,tries:200,step:2,ok:0,
 what:{'AC-BJ-01':'בדיקת מערכות אחרי טיפול','AC-PR-01':'הנעת מנוע אחרי טיפול'}};
function g77MlvS(){return AO.mlv||(AO.mlv={next:{},n:0,fail:0,why:{},list:[],cur:{}})}   // the state lives on AO (sandboxed with it, reset by aoInit)
function g77MlvH(a,b){return((a*2654435761)^(b*40503))>>>0}   // a deterministic spread — nothing is drawn from AO.rng, the airport's random sequence stays as it was
// the aircraft: from the bay (nose north at the door) straight out until the tail is G77_MLV.gap px clear of the door line, the check, back in
function g77MlvLeg(sd,ac,run){const g=apttAcGeom(ac),M=G77_MLV,yIn=sd.ngy,yOut=G77_MAINT.front-M.gap+g.tail,d=yIn-yOut,T=d/M.v+6,x=sd.ngx,th=sd.th,P=u=>[x,yIn-d*u,th,0,1];
 return{T,run,d,yIn,yOut,dur:2*T+run,pose:t=>t<T?P(apttSm(Math.max(0,t)/T)):t<T+run?P(1):P(1-apttSm(Math.min(T,t-T-run)/T))}}
function g77MlvTugs(){return(AO.fleet||[]).filter(v=>v.type==='PT'&&v.bay&&v.bay.row==='NB')}
// the tug (business jet): out of the near tug park (as every near tug), east on its exit lane, down to the nose; attached through the tow
// out, the check and the push back in; a reverse arc off the door, west on the return lane, home
function g77MlvTug(v,sd,ac,L,hold0){const b=v.bay,N=G77_NB,vm=AF.VMAX[v.type],g=apttAcGeom(ac),hx=afPtHx(),off=Math.max(g.nose+G77_MLV.tugGap+hx,sd.ngy-(G77_MAINT.front-2)+hx),x=sd.ngx,TL=sd.ngy-off,nbX=b.x-N.dx;
 const pre=apttVehMove([[nbX,N.yW],[b.x,N.yW],[b.x,b.yc]],[N.r],vm*.4,{th0:b.th,rev:true,v0:3,v1:6});pre.kind='out';
 const out=afMv([[nbX,N.yW,0],[x,N.yW,22],[x,TL,0]],vm,{th0:pre.endPose()[2],blend:30,v1:3});out.kind='out';
 const hd=apttHold(out.endPose(),hold0,'svc');
 const tp={kind:'push',towOff:off,dur:L.dur,pose:t=>{const p=L.pose(t),c=Math.cos(p[2]),s=Math.sin(p[2]);return[p[0]+c*off,p[1]+s*off,p[2]+Math.PI,0,1]}};
 const rv=apttVehMove([[x+40,N.yE],[x,N.yE],[x,TL]],[20],vm*.35,{rev:true,v0:2,v1:3});rv.kind='back';
 const home=afMv([[x+40,N.yE,0],[b.x,N.yE,16],[b.x,b.yc,0]],vm,{th0:rv.endPose()[2],blend:20,v0:3});home.kind='back';
 const trk=afTrackOf(v,[pre,out,hd,tp,rv,home]);return{trk,dOut:pre.dur+out.dur,off,TL,dur:trk.seq.dur}}
// one visit: the first slice at which the aircraft (and the tug) fit; nothing is committed unless everything fits
function g77MlvPlan(sd,now,n){const M=G77_MLV,ac=sd.accepts[0],R=M.run[sd.id]||[45,70],run=R[0]+(g77MlvH(n+1,sd.id.charCodeAt(1))%1000)/1000*(R[1]-R[0]);
 const L=g77MlvLeg(sd,ac,run),tr={kind:'ac',id:ac,nm:'MX-'+sd.id,seq:apttSeq([{kind:'mlv',dur:L.dur,pose:L.pose}])},smA=aoSamp(tr,aoSeqLeg(tr.seq)),s0=Math.max(afSEarliest(),aoSlUp(now+2));
 if(sd.id!=='M1'){for(let i=0,s=s0;i<M.tries;i++,s+=M.step)if(aoFreeK(smA,s)<0){aoCommit(smA,s);return{sd,ac,tA:aoT(s),L,tr,tug:null,task:null}}return'no-window'}   // the light aircraft: towed by hand
 const T=g77MlvTugs();if(!T.length)return'no-tug';
 for(const v of T){let B=g77MlvTug(v,sd,ac,L,0);const lead=aoSlUp(B.dOut+2);B=g77MlvTug(v,sd,ac,L,aoT(lead)-B.dOut);const smT=aoSamp(B.trk,aoSeqLeg(B.trk.seq));
  for(let i=0,s=s0;i<M.tries;i++,s+=M.step){const t0=aoT(s);if(!afFreeAt(v,t0,t0+B.dur))continue;if(aoFreeK(smT,s)>=0)continue;if(aoFreeK(smA,s+lead)>=0)continue;
   aoCommit(smA,s+lead);const k=afCommit(v,B.trk,smT,s,'mlv',{code:'MX-'+sd.id,mlv:sd.id});return{sd,ac,tA:aoT(s+lead),L,tr,tug:v,task:k,off:B.off}}}
 return'no-window'}
function g77MlvStep(now){const M=G77_MLV,S=g77MlvS();if(!M.on||!APL||!AO.fleet||!AO.stands)return;

  const c=S.cur[id];if(c&&now<c.tA+c.L.dur+2)continue;if(now<S.next[id])continue;
  const r=g77MlvPlan(sd,now,S.n);if(typeof r==='string'){S.fail++;S.why[r]=(S.why[r]||0)+1;S.next[id]=now+30;continue}
  S.n++;M.ok++;r.n=S.n;S.cur[id]=r;S.list.push(r);S.next[id]=r.tA+r.L.dur+M.every+g77MlvH(S.n,id.charCodeAt(1))%M.jit-M.jit/2}}

  const R=belt?Q:(()=>{const d=g77BwD(P,T);return d<=X.meet?P:g77BwL(T,P,X.meet/d)})(),carry=g77BwD(P,R)/wk,from=Wk[w].pos,f0=Wk[w].f,back=from?g77BwD(from,P)/wk:0;
  const c=Math.max(f0+back,stFree+X.gapSt-t.lift-carry),ta=c+t.lift+carry,ps=Math.max(ta+X.turn,belt?lastOp+B.belt.cad:dw),pe=ps+(belt?t.place:X.pass);   /* the turn to the belt / to the door worker before the op */
  const x={j,w,f0,from,back,P,sp:S.p,c,R,carry,ta,ps,pe};
  if(belt){x.b1=pe+ride;x.d1=x.b1+t.inn}else{x.h1=pe+t.hold;x.d1=x.h1+t.inn;dw=x.d1+X.turn}
  lastOp=ps;stFree=pe;Wk[w].f=pe;Wk[w].pos=R;J.push(x)}

// the whole scene at one moment (the drawing and the QA) — the same answer as g77BwGeo, from the schedule above
function g77BxGeo(pose,tr,lt,carts,st,clk){
 const f=st.f,code=String(f.code).split('/')[0],fl=s6aFlightOf(code)||(AO.hist||[]).find(q=>q.code===code);if(!fl||!fl.sd||!carts.length)return null;
 let ap=null;for(const r of fl.tracks||[])if(r.tr.kind==='ac'){ap=r.tr.seq.at(clk-r.t0);if(ap)break}if(!ap)return null;
 const B=G77_BW,X=G77_BX,tt=B.t,n=Math.max(1,f.n|0),out=f.fill==='out',dur=st.leg.dur,t=st.t,Ly=g77BwLay(fl.sd,fl.ac,ap,pose,carts,n,g77BwBeltOf(code,clk),tr),Sc=g77BwSched(Ly,n),J=Sc.X,nC=Sc.nC;
 const E=g77BwE(Ly,Sc,dur),A=Math.max(.5,dur-2*E),k=Sc.total>A?Sc.total/A:1,tw=t-E,tl=Math.max(0,Math.min(Sc.total,(out?tw:A-tw)*k)),inWork=tw>=0&&tw<=A;
 const fa=(p,q)=>Math.atan2(q[1]-p[1],q[0]-p[0]),walkTh=(a,b)=>out?fa(a,b):fa(b,a),belt=Ly.belt,tgt=belt?Ly.Bp:Ly.T;
 const handOf=w=>[w.p[0]+Math.cos(w.th)*X.hand,w.p[1]+Math.sin(w.th)*X.hand];
 // a cart worker at schedule time τ
 const Cat=(w,tau)=>{const mine=J.filter(x=>x.w===w);if(!mine.length)return{p:Ly.seat,th:0,walk:false,ph:'none',cr:false};
  for(let i=0;i<mine.length;i++){const x=mine[i],thS=fa(x.P,x.sp),thW=x.carry>1e-6?walkTh(x.P,x.R):thS,thT=fa(x.R,tgt);
   if(tau<x.f0+x.back&&x.from&&x.back>1e-6)return{p:g77BwL(x.from,x.P,(tau-x.f0)/x.back),th:walkTh(x.from,x.P),walk:true,ph:'back',cr:false};
   if(tau<x.c){const th0=x.from&&x.back>1e-6?walkTh(x.from,x.P):thS;return{p:x.P,th:g77BxAng(th0,thS,(tau-x.f0-x.back)/X.turn),walk:false,ph:'wait',cr:false}}
   if(tau<x.c+tt.lift)return{p:x.P,th:thS,walk:false,ph:'lift',cr:true};
   if(tau<x.ta)return{p:g77BwL(x.P,x.R,(tau-x.c-tt.lift)/(x.carry||1)),th:g77BxAng(thS,thW,(tau-x.c-tt.lift)/X.turn),walk:true,ph:'carry',cr:false};
   if(tau<x.pe||i===mine.length-1)return{p:x.R,th:g77BxAng(thW,thT,(tau-x.ta)/X.turn),walk:false,ph:tau<x.ps?'hold':tau<x.pe?(belt?'place':'pass'):'done',cr:belt&&tau>=x.ps&&tau<x.pe}}
  const x=mine[mine.length-1];return{p:x.R,th:fa(x.R,tgt),walk:false,ph:'done',cr:false}};
 // the door worker (by hand): faces the giver while taking the bag, turns to the door, bends and puts it in, turns back
 const Dw=tau=>{const p=Ly.T,thD=fa(p,Ly.D);let th=null,cr=false,last=null;
  for(const x of J){if(tau<x.ps){const toR=fa(p,x.R);th=last?g77BxAng(thD,toR,(tau-last.d1)/X.turn):toR;break}
   if(tau<x.pe){th=fa(p,x.R);break}
   if(tau<x.d1){th=g77BxAng(fa(p,x.R),thD,(tau-x.pe)/X.turn);cr=tau>=x.h1;break}last=x}
  if(th==null)th=last?thD:fa(p,J.length?J[0].R:Ly.seat);return{p,th,walk:false,ph:'door',cr}};
 const wk=(p0,p1)=>{if(t<E)return[g77BwL(Ly.seat,p0,t/E),p0];if(t>dur-E)return[g77BwL(p1,Ly.seat,(t-(dur-E))/E),Ly.seat];return null};
 const W=[];
 for(let w=0;w<nC;w++){const C=Cat(w,tl),pre=out?Cat(w,0).p:Cat(w,Sc.total).p,post=out?Cat(w,Sc.total).p:Cat(w,0).p,r=wk(pre,post);
  W.push(r?{k:'tr',p:r[0],walk:true,th:fa(r[0],r[1]),pose:'walking'}:{k:'tr',p:C.p,walk:C.walk,th:C.th,ph:C.ph,pose:C.walk?'walking':C.cr?'crouch':'idle'})}
 let iD=-1;if(!belt){const C=Dw(tl),r=wk(Ly.T,Ly.T);iD=W.length;W.push(r?{k:'door',p:r[0],walk:true,th:fa(r[0],r[1]),pose:'walking'}:{k:'door',p:C.p,walk:false,th:C.th,ph:'door',pose:C.cr?'crouch':'idle'})}
 for(const w of W)w.tgt=[w.p[0]+Math.cos(w.th),w.p[1]+Math.sin(w.th)];
 // the bags in the work
 const bags=[];
 if(inWork)for(let j=0;j<n;j++){const x=J[j],tau=tl,c=F2_BAG_COLORS[(j*3+n*7)%F2_BAG_COLORS.length];if(tau<x.c)continue;const Wc=W[x.w];let b=null;
  if(tau<x.c+tt.lift)b={p:g77BwL(x.sp,handOf(Wc),(tau-x.c)/tt.lift),s:'lift',u:.12,w:x.w};
  else if(tau<x.ps)b={p:handOf(Wc),s:'hand',u:.12,w:x.w};
  else if(belt){const ride=x.b1-x.pe;
   if(tau<x.pe)b={p:g77BwL(handOf(Wc),Ly.Bp,(tau-x.ps)/tt.place),s:'lift',u:.06,w:x.w};
   else if(tau<x.b1)b={p:g77BwL(Ly.Bp,Ly.Fp,(tau-x.pe)/(ride||1)),s:'belt',u:0};
   else if(tau<x.d1){const s=(tau-x.b1)/tt.inn;b={p:g77BwL(Ly.Fp,Ly.D,s),s:'door',u:0,al:1-s}}}
  else{const Wd=W[iD];
   if(tau<x.pe)b={p:g77BwL(handOf(Wc),handOf(Wd),(tau-x.ps)/X.pass),s:'pass',u:.12,a:x.w,z:iD};
   else if(tau<x.h1)b={p:handOf(Wd),s:'hand',u:.12,w:iD};
   else if(tau<x.d1){const s=(tau-x.h1)/tt.inn;b={p:g77BwL(handOf(Wd),Ly.D,s),s:'door',u:.1,al:1-s,w:iD}}}
  if(!b)continue;b.j=j;b.c=c;bags.push(b)}
 let onTrain;if(inWork){onTrain=0;for(const x of J)if(x.c>tl)onTrain++}else onTrain=out?(tw<0?n:0):(tw<0?0:n);
 return{W,bags,onTrain,belt,three:Ly.three,mode:Ly.mode,E,k,dur,t,D:Ly.D,seat:Ly.seat,n,out,code,st:fl.stand+':'+fl.ac.slice(3,5),total:Sc.total}}
// VQA-01 (p217): at every sample — the bag on the cart / in a hand / on the belt / at the door, never in the air; continuity between samples
function g77BxCheck(o,G,pv,tt,id,bad,Gp,geo){const X=G77_BX,tag=id+' '+G.st+' '+(G.out?'out':'in')+' '+G.mode,cur=new Map();o.bx=o.bx||{throw:0,face:0,passGap:0,jump:0,wjump:0,appear:0,vanish:0,count:0,end:0};
 if(Gp&&Gp.W.length===G.W.length)for(let i=0;i<G.W.length;i++)if(g77BwD(Gp.W[i].p,G.W[i].p)>X.wjump){o.bx.wjump++;bad('WORKER-JUMP '+tag+' '+G.W[i].k+' '+g77BwD(Gp.W[i].p,G.W[i].p).toFixed(1)+'px in 1/30 s')}
 for(const b of G.bags){cur.set(b.j,b);
  if(b.s==='throw'){o.bx.throw++;bad('THROW '+tag)}
  if(b.s==='hand'&&b.w!=null&&G.W[b.w]){const w=G.W[b.w],a=Math.atan2(b.p[1]-w.p[1],b.p[0]-w.p[0]),da=Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(a-w.th),Math.cos(a-w.th)));if(da>X.face){o.bx.face++;bad('FACING '+tag+' '+(da*57.3|0)+'°')}}
  if(Gp){const q=Gp.bags.find(y=>y.j===b.j);if(q&&g77BwD(q.p,b.p)>X.jump){o.bx.jump++;bad('BAG-JUMP '+tag+' '+q.s+'→'+b.s+' '+g77BwD(q.p,b.p).toFixed(1)+'px in 1/30 s')}}
  if(b.s==='pass'&&G.W[b.a]&&G.W[b.z]){const A=G.W[b.a],Z=G.W[b.z],ha=[A.p[0]+Math.cos(A.th)*X.hand,A.p[1]+Math.sin(A.th)*X.hand],hz=[Z.p[0]+Math.cos(Z.th)*X.hand,Z.p[1]+Math.sin(Z.th)*X.hand];if(g77BwD(ha,hz)>X.passGap){o.bx.passGap++;bad('PASS-GAP '+tag+' '+g77BwD(ha,hz).toFixed(1)+'px')}}}
 if(pv&&Math.abs(tt-pv.tt-.2)<.05){
  for(const [j,b] of cur)if(!pv.m.has(j)){const s1=G77_VQF.on&&geo?g77BxEdge(geo,pv.tt,tt,j,'appear',null)||b.s:b.s;if(G.out?s1!=='lift':s1!=='door'){o.bx.appear++;bad('APPEAR '+tag+' as '+s1)}}   /* p219 */
  for(const [j,q] of pv.m)if(!cur.has(j)){const s0=G77_VQF.on&&geo?g77BxEdge(geo,pv.tt,tt,j,'vanish',q.s):q.s;if(G.out?s0!=='door':s0!=='lift'){o.bx.vanish++;bad('VANISH '+tag+' last '+s0)}}
  if(G.out?G.onTrain>pv.on:G.onTrain<pv.on){o.bx.count++;bad('COUNT '+tag+' '+pv.on+'→'+G.onTrain)}}
 if(G.onTrain+G.bags.length>G.n){o.bx.count++;bad('COUNT-OVER '+tag)}
 return{tt,m:cur,on:G.onTrain}}

// the bags of a make-up leg at the leg's time: [{j,x,y,th,c,where:'belt'|'slide'|'cart'}]
function g77MubBags(st,carts){const f=st.f,n=f.n|0,T=f2BagTimes(st.leg.dur,n),t=st.t,cap=F2_BAG.cap,out=[],sp=G77_MUB.speed,xb=f.beltX-4.5,y0=F2_BAG.belt0+1,y1=F2_BAG.belt1-1,load=f.fill==='in';

  const yb=Math.max(y0,Math.min(y1,py)),ride=(yb-y0)/sp,s0=T.t0+j*T.step,fl=Math.max(T.fly,Math.hypot(px-xb,py-yb)/38),s=load?s0+T.fly-fl:s0,e=load?s0+T.fly:s0+fl,col=g77MubColor(n,j),th=c[2];   /* p406: a long slide — loading: it starts earlier and reaches the cart as scheduled; unloading: it leaves the cart as scheduled and reaches the belt later */
  if(load){if(t<s-ride)continue;
   if(t<s){out.push({j,x:xb,y:y0+(t-(s-ride))*sp,th,c:col,where:'belt'});continue}
   if(t<e){const u=(t-s)/fl;out.push({j,x:xb+(px-xb)*u,y:yb+(py-yb)*u,th,c:col,where:'slide'});continue}
   out.push({j,x:px,y:py,th,c:col,where:'cart'})}
  else{if(t<s){out.push({j,x:px,y:py,th,c:col,where:'cart'});continue}
   if(t<e){const u=(t-s)/fl;out.push({j,x:px+(xb-px)*u,y:py+(yb-py)*u,th,c:col,where:'slide'});continue}
   if(t<e+ride)out.push({j,x:xb,y:yb-(t-e)*sp,th,c:col,where:'belt'})}}

// ==== 27.10 · p321 · the owner 25.10 14:04 + 18:03: close pictures of every zone, drawn by the game itself (R26 · WDA-01) ====
// The camera goes over the whole map in a grid (overlap 18%, the zoom of the owner's example 2.85 — or 2 for a faster run), one picture of
// every zone, and one picture centred on every place where a road crosses from one zone to the next.  The simulation is paused and the
// autosave is off for the whole run: the game state does not change (the saves are checked before and after).  Every picture goes to the
// browser's own storage (IndexedDB 'turbo_city_zones', not the saves) as soon as it is taken — nothing is kept in memory, a run that was
// cut can continue where it stopped.  At the end: ZIP files of up to 24 MB (index.html + index.json in the first), downloaded by a button.
var G77_ZONES={on:true,lv:{hi:2.85,fast:2},overlap:.18,q:.82,type:'image/webp',ext:'webp',partMB:24,minMs:350,maxMs:7000,stable:6,
 key:'turbo_city_zs_run',dbName:'turbo_city_zones',busy:false,abort:false,run:null,cv:null,crcT:null,dbP:null,estS:1.2,estKB:50};
function g77ZnCrc(u8){let T=G77_ZONES.crcT;if(!T){T=G77_ZONES.crcT=new Uint32Array(256);for(let n=0;n<256;n++){let c=n;for(let k=0;k<8;k++)c=c&1?0xEDB88320^(c>>>1):c>>>1;T[n]=c>>>0}}
 let c=0xFFFFFFFF;for(let i=0;i<u8.length;i++)c=T[(c^u8[i])&255]^(c>>>8);return (c^0xFFFFFFFF)>>>0}
function g77ZnDb(){if(G77_ZONES.dbP)return G77_ZONES.dbP;G77_ZONES.dbP=new Promise(res=>{try{const r=indexedDB.open(G77_ZONES.dbName,1);
 r.onupgradeneeded=()=>{const db=r.result;if(!db.objectStoreNames.contains('shots'))db.createObjectStore('shots')};r.onsuccess=()=>res(r.result);r.onerror=()=>res(null)}catch(e){res(null)}});return G77_ZONES.dbP}
function g77ZnTx(mode,fn){return g77ZnDb().then(db=>new Promise(res=>{if(!db)return res(null);try{const tx=db.transaction('shots',mode),st=tx.objectStore('shots');let out=null;const r=fn(st);
 if(r)r.onsuccess=()=>{out=r.result};tx.oncomplete=()=>res(out);tx.onerror=tx.onabort=()=>res(null)}catch(e){res(null)}}))}
function g77ZnPut(k,v){return g77ZnTx('readwrite',st=>st.put(v,k))}
function g77ZnKeys(){return g77ZnTx('readonly',st=>st.getAllKeys())}

function g77ZnZoneAt(Z,x,y){for(const c of Z)if(x>=c.x&&x<c.x+c.w&&y>=c.y&&y<c.y+c.h)return c;return null}
// ---- the plan: the zone pictures, the grid over the whole map, the border pictures, and the check that no part of a zone is left out ----
function g77ZnPlan(lv){const Z=g77ZnZones(),W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight,zg=G77_ZONES.lv[lv]||G77_ZONES.lv.hi,ov=G77_ZONES.overlap,S=[];
 for(const c of Z)S.push({n:c.id+'_all',k:'zone',x:Math.round(c.x+c.w/2),y:Math.round(c.y+c.h/2),z:+(Math.min(W/c.w,H/c.h)*.95).toFixed(3),zones:[c.id],p:c.id});
 const X0=Math.min(...Z.map(c=>c.x)),X1=Math.max(...Z.map(c=>c.x+c.w)),Y0=Math.min(...Z.map(c=>c.y)),Y1=Math.max(...Z.map(c=>c.y+c.h)),vw=W/zg,vh=H/zg;
 const fit=(L,v)=>{if(L<=v)return[1,0];const n=Math.ceil((L-v)/(v*(1-ov)))+1;return[n,(L-v)/(n-1)]},[nc,sx]=fit(X1-X0,vw),[nr,sy]=fit(Y1-Y0,vh),G=new Map();
 for(let r=0;r<nr;r++)for(let q=0;q<nc;q++){const x0=X0+q*sx,y0=Y0+r*sy,R={x:x0,y:y0,w:vw,h:vh},zs=Z.filter(c=>c.x<R.x+R.w&&c.x+c.w>R.x&&c.y<R.y+R.h&&c.y+c.h>R.y);if(!zs.length)continue;
  const cx=x0+vw/2,cy=y0+vh/2;let pz=g77ZnZoneAt(Z,cx,cy);if(!pz){let best=-1;for(const c of zs){const o=(Math.min(c.x+c.w,R.x+R.w)-Math.max(c.x,R.x))*(Math.min(c.y+c.h,R.y+R.h)-Math.max(c.y,R.y));if(o>best){best=o;pz=c}}}
  const s={n:pz.id+'_g'+String(r).padStart(2,'0')+'_'+String(q).padStart(2,'0'),k:'grid',x:+cx.toFixed(1),y:+cy.toFixed(1),z:zg,zones:zs.map(c=>c.id),p:pz.id,r,c:q};S.push(s);G.set(r*1000+q,s)}
 const B=[];try{const N=new Map(NODES.map(n=>[n.id,n]));for(const e of EDGES){const a=N.get(e.a),b=N.get(e.b);if(!a||!b)continue;const n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y)/8));
  let prev=g77ZnZoneAt(Z,a.x,a.y),px=a.x,py=a.y;for(let i=1;i<=n;i++){const x=a.x+(b.x-a.x)*i/n,y=a.y+(b.y-a.y)*i/n,cz=g77ZnZoneAt(Z,x,y);
   if(prev&&cz&&cz!==prev){const mx=(x+px)/2,my=(y+py)/2,pair=[prev.id,cz.id].sort().join('-');if(!B.some(o=>o.pair===pair&&Math.hypot(o.x-mx,o.y-my)<300))B.push({pair,x:Math.round(mx),y:Math.round(my),road:e.name||e.id})}
   if(cz)prev=cz;px=x;py=y}}}catch(e){}
 const cnt={};for(const o of B){cnt[o.pair]=(cnt[o.pair]||0)+1;S.push({n:'B_'+o.pair+'_'+cnt[o.pair],k:'border',x:o.x,y:o.y,z:zg,zones:o.pair.split('-'),p:o.pair.split('-')[0],road:o.road})}
 // coverage: every 20 px cell of every zone must lie whole inside one grid picture
 const cell=20,tol=.5;let tot=0,cov=0;const miss=[],inside=(s,x,y,x1,y1)=>s&&x>=s.x-vw/2-tol&&x1<=s.x+vw/2+tol&&y>=s.y-vh/2-tol&&y1<=s.y+vh/2+tol;
 for(const c of Z)for(let y=c.y;y<c.y+c.h;y+=cell)for(let x=c.x;x<c.x+c.w;x+=cell){tot++;const x1=Math.min(x+cell,c.x+c.w),y1=Math.min(y+cell,c.y+c.h);
  const qa=sx?Math.max(0,Math.ceil((x1-X0-vw)/sx-1e-9)):0,qb=sx?Math.min(nc-1,Math.floor((x-X0)/sx+1e-9)):0,ra=sy?Math.max(0,Math.ceil((y1-Y0-vh)/sy-1e-9)):0,rb=sy?Math.min(nr-1,Math.floor((y-Y0)/sy+1e-9)):0;let ok=false;
  for(let r=ra;r<=rb&&!ok;r++)for(let q=qa;q<=qb&&!ok;q++)ok=inside(G.get(r*1000+q),x,y,x1,y1);if(ok)cov++;else if(miss.length<50)miss.push([c.id,x,y])}
 return{lv,zg,vw:Math.round(vw),vh:Math.round(vh),W,H,dpr:devicePixelRatio||1,ov,nc,nr,shots:S,cov:{tot,cov,pct:+(100*cov/tot).toFixed(3),miss},
  count:{zone:S.filter(s=>s.k==='zone').length,grid:S.filter(s=>s.k==='grid').length,border:S.filter(s=>s.k==='border').length},zones:Z,bbox:[X0,Y0,X1,Y1]}}

function g77ZnName(R,i,n){return 'owner_zones_'+g77OtShort(R.build)+'_'+R.stamp+'_part'+(i+1)+'of'+n+'.zip'}
function g77ZnDl(R,parts,i){const enc=new TextEncoder(),files=parts[i].map(r=>({name:r.n+'.'+G77_ZONES.ext,blob:r.blob,crc:r.crc,size:r.size}));
 if(i===0){const meta=g77ZnMeta(R,parts);for(const [nm,txt] of [['index.json',JSON.stringify(meta)],['index.html',g77ZnHtml(R,meta)]]){const u=enc.encode(txt);files.unshift({name:nm,blob:new Blob([u]),crc:g77ZnCrc(u),size:u.length})}}
 const z=g77ZnZip(files),u=URL.createObjectURL(z),a=window.document.createElement('a');a.href=u;a.download=g77ZnName(R,i,parts.length);window.document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();
 setTimeout(()=>{try{URL.revokeObjectURL(u);a.remove()}catch(e){}},20000);return z.size}
function g77ZnZip(files){const enc=new TextEncoder(),out=[],cd=[],d=new Date();let off=0;const dt=((d.getFullYear()-1980)<<9)|((d.getMonth()+1)<<5)|d.getDate(),tm=(d.getHours()<<11)|(d.getMinutes()<<5)|(d.getSeconds()>>1);
 for(const f of files){const nm=enc.encode(f.name),h=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(30));h.setUint32(0,0x04034b50,true);h.setUint16(4,20,true);h.setUint16(6,0x0800,true);h.setUint16(8,0,true);h.setUint16(10,tm,true);h.setUint16(12,dt,true);
  h.setUint32(14,f.crc,true);h.setUint32(18,f.size,true);h.setUint32(22,f.size,true);h.setUint16(26,nm.length,true);h.setUint16(28,0,true);out.push(h.buffer,nm,f.blob);
  const c=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(46));c.setUint32(0,0x02014b50,true);c.setUint16(4,20,true);c.setUint16(6,20,true);c.setUint16(8,0x0800,true);c.setUint16(10,0,true);c.setUint16(12,tm,true);c.setUint16(14,dt,true);
  c.setUint32(16,f.crc,true);c.setUint32(20,f.size,true);c.setUint32(24,f.size,true);c.setUint16(28,nm.length,true);c.setUint32(42,off,true);cd.push(c.buffer,nm);off+=30+nm.length+f.size}
 let cl=0;for(const x of cd)cl+=x.byteLength;const e=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(22));e.setUint32(0,0x06054b50,true);e.setUint16(8,files.length,true);e.setUint16(10,files.length,true);e.setUint32(12,cl,true);e.setUint32(16,off,true);
 return new Blob(out.concat(cd,[e.buffer]),{type:'application/zip'})}

function g77ZnMeta(R,parts){const where=new Map();parts.forEach((p,i)=>p.forEach(r=>where.set(r.n,i+1)));const recs=new Map();parts.forEach(p=>p.forEach(r=>recs.set(r.n,r)));
 return{v:1,kind:'owner-zones',build:R.build,at:R.at,endAt:R.endAt||null,stamp:R.stamp,lv:R.lv,zoom:R.plan.zg,overlap:R.plan.ov,view:{w:R.plan.W,h:R.plan.H,dpr:R.plan.dpr,worldW:R.plan.vw,worldH:R.plan.vh},
  grid:{cols:R.plan.nc,rows:R.plan.nr,bbox:R.plan.bbox},coverage:R.plan.cov,count:R.plan.count,done:R.done,taken:R.n,ms:R.ms,settleMs:R.settleMs,slow:R.slow,fails:R.fails,savesKept:R.savesKept,
  env:{ua:navigator.userAgent,screen:screen.width+'×'+screen.height,cores:navigator.hardwareConcurrency||null},
  zones:R.plan.zones,shots:R.plan.shots.map(s=>{const r=recs.get(s.n);return Object.assign({},s,{file:s.n+'.'+G77_ZONES.ext,part:where.get(s.n)||null,kb:r?Math.round(r.size/1024):null,settleMs:r?r.ms:null,settled:r?r.ok:null})})}}

 svg+='</svg>';const img=s=>s.part?'<figure><a class="f" href="'+esc(s.file)+'">'+esc(s.file)+'</a><figcaption>'+esc(s.n)+(s.road?' · '+esc(s.road):'')+' · x '+Math.round(s.x)+' y '+Math.round(s.y)+' · חלק '+s.part+(s.settled===false?' · <b>לא נטען עד הסוף</b>':'')+'</figcaption></figure>':'<figure class="miss"><figcaption>'+esc(s.n)+' — לא צולם</figcaption></figure>';

  '.g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(420px,1fr));gap:10px}figure{margin:0;background:#12232f;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}figure img{width:100%;display:block}'+
  'figcaption{padding:4px 8px;font-size:12px;color:#9fb6c8}.miss{padding:10px}nav a{color:#8fd0ff;margin-left:8px}</style></head><body>'+
  '<h1>צילומי האזורים · '+esc(g77OtShort(M.build))+'</h1><div>'+esc(M.at)+' · מסך '+M.view.w+'×'+M.view.h+' · זום '+M.zoom+' · חפיפה '+Math.round(M.overlap*100)+'% · '+M.taken+' צילומים ('+M.count.zone+' של אזור שלם, '+M.count.grid+' ברשת, '+M.count.border+' על גבולות) · כיסוי '+M.coverage.pct+'%'+(M.savesKept===true?' · השמירות לא השתנו':'')+'</div>'+

function g77Bw(){return window.__G77BW||(window.__G77BW={pole:0,refit:0,roads:0,animN:0,animMs:0,animHit:0,flN:0,flMs:0,f50:0,fmx:0,end:false})}
// the nearest free curb point of all the roads (as before: every road, both sides, the first clear point from the projection; the nearest wins,
// ties — the first road in EDGES, the side −1 first).  A road whose curb line is farther than the best point found is not tried.
function g77PoleBest(x,y,occ,acc=false,gap=20,ns=false){   /* p365: acc — clearCurbPoint skips the access bands */const E=EDGES,n=E.length,lb=new Float64Array(n),ix=new Array(n),W=g77Bw();W.refit++;
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const e=E[i],a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,L2=dx*dx+dy*dy;let d=-Infinity;
  if(L2>1e-9){let u=((x-a.x)*dx+(y-a.y)*dy)/L2;u=u<0?0:u>1?1:u;d=Math.hypot(x-(a.x+dx*u),y-(a.y+dy*u))-Math.abs(_ROAD_HALF(e)+10)}
  lb[i]=d>-Infinity?d:-Infinity;ix[i]=i}
 ix.sort((p,q)=>(lb[p]-lb[q])||(p-q));let best=null,bi=-1;
 for(const i of ix){if(best&&lb[i]-1e-6>best.d)break;W.roads++;const e=E[i],a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],len=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y),along=Math.max(8,Math.min(len-8,((x-a.x)*(b.x-a.x)+(y-a.y)*(b.y-a.y))/len));

// the drawing functions of a layer, in order: the calls of the layer function one by one (read from the function itself, each made a small
// function in the game's own scope by a direct eval); a body that is not a plain list of calls — one step (the whole function, as before)
function g77ZpParse(fn,inner){const Z=G77_ZP,C=Z.parsed||(Z.parsed={}),nm=fn.name;if(C[nm]!==undefined)return C[nm];let out=[];
 try{const s=String(fn);let b=s.slice(s.indexOf('{')+1,s.lastIndexOf('}'));if(inner){const a=b.indexOf('try{'),e=b.lastIndexOf('}finally{');if(a<0||e<a)throw 0;b=b.slice(a+4,e)}
  for(const st of b.split(';').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean)){if(/[{}]/.test(st)||!/^[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\(/.test(st)){out=null;break}const f=eval('(function(now){'+st+'})');out.push([f,true,st.slice(0,st.indexOf('('))])}}

function g2Door(sd,ac){
 const S=APTT_SPEC.ac[ac],ng=S.an['Nose Gear'],d=S.an.Door,th=sd.th,c=Math.cos(th),sn=Math.sin(th),dx=d[0]-ng[0],dy=d[1]-ng[1];
 return[sd.cx+dx*c-dy*sn,sd.ngy+dx*sn+dy*c];
}
function g2Hash(s){let h=0;for(const ch of String(s||'X'))h=(h*31+ch.charCodeAt(0))>>>0;return h}
const G77_BUS_CAP=60;
function g2PaxN(code,phase,ac){const n=g77Pax(code,ac,phase==='dep'?'dep':'arr');return n?Math.min(G77_BUS_CAP,n):(ac==='AC-RJ-01'?14:10)}
function g2UsesTruck(sd,ac){return(sd.id==='P6'&&(ac==='AC-RJ-01'||ac==='AC-NB-01'||ac==='AC-QJ-01'))||(sd.id==='P5'&&ac==='AC-RJ-01')}   // GATE-77 S5b · D-67
function g2Rear(sd,ac){return sd.id==='P6'&&ac==='AC-QJ-01'}   /* p402: the A320 one stairs at P6 */   // two stairs: front and rear door
function g2Door2(sd,ac){const A=g77Anchors(ac)||{},d=A['Door L2'];if(!d)return g2Door(sd,ac);const th=sd.th,c=Math.cos(th),sn=Math.sin(th);return[sd.cx+d[0]*c-d[1]*sn,sd.ngy+d[0]*sn+d[1]*c]}
function g2Remote(sd,ac){return!!(sd&&sd.remote&&sd.kind==='pax'&&G2_REMOTE_AC.has(ac)&&G2_REM[sd.id])}
// passenger path at the aircraft: door → foot of the stairs → bus door
function g2PaxPath2(sd,ac){const door=g2Door2(sd,ac),R=G2_REM[sd.id],foot=[door[0]+G2_STAIR_GAP+64,door[1]],bus=[R.busX-26,R.busY+13];return[door,foot,[foot[0]+10,door[1]+12],[foot[0]+10,R.busY+13],bus]}   // GATE-77 S5b: the rear stairs
function g2PaxPath(sd,ac){
 const door=g2Door(sd,ac),R=G2_REM[sd.id];
 const foot=g2UsesTruck(sd,ac)?[door[0]+G2_STAIR_GAP+64,door[1]]:[door[0]+17,door[1]];
 const bus=sd.id==='P5'?[R.x+13,R.busY-26]:[R.busX-26,R.busY+13];
 const mid=sd.id==='P5'?[Math.max(R.x+13,foot[0]+8),door[1]+8]:[foot[0]+10,R.busY+13];
 return[door,foot,mid,bus];
}
const g2PathLen=p=>{let l=0;for(let i=1;i<p.length;i++)l+=Math.hypot(p[i][0]-p[i-1][0],p[i][1]-p[i-1][1]);return l};
const G2_WALK={v:22,gap:.95,pre:2.5,post:2.5};
function g2BoardDur(sd,ac,n){if(g2Rear(sd,ac))return G2_WALK.pre+Math.max(g2PathLen(g2PaxPath(sd,ac)),g2PathLen(g2PaxPath2(sd,ac)))/G2_WALK.v+(Math.ceil(n/2)-1)*G2_WALK.gap+G2_WALK.post;   // two doors
 return G2_WALK.pre+g2PathLen(g2PaxPath(sd,ac))/G2_WALK.v+(n-1)*G2_WALK.gap+G2_WALK.post}
// S2 GROUND OPS (AIR-27) · the T3 bus gate: the apron buses load and unload at their home bays in pocket S.  Arriving passengers step out of
// the bus door (east side of a nose-north bus), walk south along the bay, along the walkway y 923 to the zebra across the service road L and
// into the terminal door at x 6945; departing passengers come out of the door and walk the same way back to the bus.  Both are hold legs of
// the bus task (the bus stays reserved in its bay while people are on the walkway).
const G2_GATE={door:[7092,779],walkY:779,zebra:null,offX:-11,label:'BUS GATE · T3',he:'שער אוטובוס · טרמינל 3'};   // GATE-77 S5c · D-84: the yard beside the tower — no zebra
function g2GatePath(bay){const D=APTT_SPEC.veh['LV-SH-01'],fx=D.fp[0]+D.fp[2]/2,fy=D.fp[1]+D.fp[3]/2,dx=D.an.Door[0]-fx,dy=D.an.Door[1]-fy,c=Math.cos(bay.th),sn=Math.sin(bay.th),door=[bay.x+dx*c-dy*sn,bay.yc+dx*sn+dy*c];
 if(bay.row2||bay.id==='F2-AB2'){const hx=D.fp[2]/2,sg=Math.sign(dy)||1,out=[door[0]-sn*sg*6,door[1]+c*sg*6],gy=((G77_YARD.busYc+hx)+(G77_YARD.row2Yc-hx))/2,wx=G77_YARD.x0+4;   // GATE-77 S6b · p145 · K-105: beside the bus, behind bus 1
  return[door,out,[out[0],gy],[wx,gy],[wx,G2_GATE.walkY],[G2_GATE.door[0],G2_GATE.walkY],[G2_GATE.door[0],G2_GATE.door[1]]]}
 return[door,[g77WalkX(bay),door[1]],[g77WalkX(bay),G2_GATE.walkY],[G2_GATE.door[0],G2_GATE.walkY],[G2_GATE.door[0],G2_GATE.door[1]]]}
function g2GateDur(bay,n){return G2_WALK.pre+g2PathLen(g2GatePath(bay))/G2_WALK.v+(n-1)*G2_WALK.gap+G2_WALK.post}
// ---- home pocket S: back out onto lane L (facing east), come back north into the bay ---------------------------------------------
const g2SExit=(b,vm)=>{const m=apttVehMove([[b.x-40,AF.L],[b.x,AF.L],[b.x,b.yc]],[18],vm*.45,{rev:true,v0:3,v1:4});m.kind='out';return m};
const g2SHome=b=>b.row2?[[AF.GLN,AF.HW,50],[AF.GLN,b.yc,16],[b.x,b.yc,0]]:[[AF.GLN,AF.HW,50],[AF.GLN,AF.L,22],[b.x,AF.L,18],[b.x,b.yc,0]];   /* GATE-77 S6b-c · p152 · K-104: r 22 → 50 */   // GATE-77 S6r · M5e: the second row stops on the yard lane, then backs in
const g2Out0=b=>b.row2?[[AF.GLN,b.yc+16,0],[AF.GLN,AF.L,18],[AF.GLS,AF.L,18],[AF.GLS,AF.HE,22]]:[[b.x-40,AF.L,0],[AF.GLS,AF.L,22],[AF.GLS,AF.HE,22]];   // GATE-77 S6r · M5e
function g2RemoteBuild(v,sd,ac,kind,hold,meta){
 const b=v.bay,vm=AF.VMAX[v.type],R=G2_REM[sd.id],door=g2Door(sd,ac),tag=(leg,g2)=>{leg.g2=g2;return leg};
 const base={kind,stand:sd.id,code:meta&&meta.code||null,ac,door};
 const home=[b.x,b.yc,b.th,0,1],gateN=meta&&meta.n||0,hG=b.pocket==='MS'?0:g2GateDur(b,gateN);
 const legs=[];
 if(kind==='bus-dep'){const l=tag(apttHold(home,hG,'svc'),{...base,at:'gate',gate:'load',n:gateN});legs.push(l)}   // S2 GROUND OPS: loading at the bus gate before leaving
 if(b.pocket!=='MS'&&!b.row2)legs.push(g2SExit(b,vm));if(b.row2){const m=apttVehMove([[AF.GLN,b.yc+16],[AF.GLN,b.yc],[b.x,b.yc]],[16],vm*.45,{rev:true,v0:3,v1:4});m.kind='out';legs.push(m)}   /* GATE-77 S6b-c · p152 */   // GATE-77 S6r · M5e: the second row drives out forward (g2Out0)
 let e=legs.length&&legs[legs.length-1].endPose?legs[legs.length-1].endPose():home,dOut=0,clear=0;   // GATE-77 S6r · M5e
 const fwd=(list,o={})=>{const m=afMv(list,vm,{th0:e[2],blend:o.blend??28,v0:o.v0??5,v1:o.v1??4});m.kind=o.kind||'out';legs.push(tag(m,base));e=m.endPose();return m};
 const rev=(list,f=.45)=>{const {pts,rad}=afPL(list);const m=apttVehMove(pts,rad,vm*f,{rev:true,v0:3,v1:3});m.kind='back';legs.push(tag(m,base));e=m.endPose();return m};
 const turn=(dir)=>{const p=e.slice(),th0=p[2];const l={kind:'turn',dur:AF.PIV,pose:t=>[p[0],p[1],th0+Math.PI/2*dir*apttSm(t/AF.PIV),0,1]};legs.push(tag(l,base));e=l.pose(AF.PIV);return l};
 const svc=()=>{const h=tag(apttHold(e,hold,'svc'),{...base,at:'ac'});legs.push(h);return h};
 if((kind==='stairs'||kind==='stairs2')&&b.pocket==='MS'&&(sd.id==='P5'||g2UsesTruck(sd,ac))){   // GATE-77 S5b · D-67
  const K=G2_STAIR_PARK,dr=kind==='stairs2'?g2Door2(sd,ac):door,sx=dr[0]+G2_STAIR_GAP+32,y=dr[1];base.door=dr;
  if(sd.id==='P5'){const cA=7791,yF=862,cC=8040,yL=790;
   fwd([[b.x,b.yc,0],[K.exitX,b.yc,16],[K.exitX,yF,14],[cA,yF,18],[cA,y,16],[sx,y,0]]);dOut=legs.reduce((a,l)=>a+l.dur,0);svc();
   rev([[cA,y],[sx,y]]);clear=legs[legs.length-1].dur;turn(-1);
   fwd([[cA,y,0],[cA,yF,16],[cC,yF,18],[cC,yL,16],[K.entryX,yL,16],[K.entryX,b.yc,16],[b.x,b.yc,0]],{kind:'back',v0:4});
  }else{const cC=8040,yL=790;
   fwd([[b.x,b.yc,0],[K.exitX,b.yc,16],[K.exitX,yL,16],[cC,yL,16],[cC,y,16],[sx,y,0]]);dOut=legs.reduce((a,l)=>a+l.dur,0);svc();
   rev([[cC,y],[sx,y]]);clear=legs[legs.length-1].dur;turn(-1);
   fwd([[cC,y,0],[cC,yL,16],[K.entryX,yL,16],[K.entryX,b.yc,16],[b.x,b.yc,0]],{kind:'back',v0:4});
  }
 }else if(kind==='stairs'){
  const sx=door[0]+G2_STAIR_GAP+32,y=door[1];
  if(R.via==='EAST'&&b.pocket==='MS'){
   const K=G2_STAIR_PARK;
   fwd([[b.x,b.yc,0],[K.exitX,b.yc,16],[K.exitX,y,16],[sx,y,0]]);dOut=legs.reduce((a,l)=>a+l.dur,0);svc();
   rev([[R.pivotX,y],[sx,y]]);clear=legs[legs.length-1].dur;turn(2);
   fwd([[R.pivotX,y,0],[K.entryX,y,16],[K.entryX,b.yc,16],[b.x,b.yc,0]],{kind:'back',v0:4});
  }else throw new Error('G2 stairs: P6 from the stair park only');
 }else{
  if(R.via==='EAST'){
   fwd([...g2Out0(b),[R.xN,AF.HE,16],[R.xN,R.uy,16],[R.ux,R.uy,24],[R.ux,R.busY,24],[R.busX,R.busY,0]]);dOut=legs.reduce((a,l)=>a+l.dur,0);svc();
   const c1=fwd([[R.busX,R.busY,0],[8150,R.busY,12],[8150,R.uy,12],[R.xS,R.uy,16],[R.xS,1060,0]],{kind:'back',v0:4});clear=c1.dur;   // GATE-77 S5b
   fwd([[R.xS,1060,0],[R.xS,AF.HW,16],...g2SHome(b)],{kind:'back',v0:6});
  }else{
   fwd([...g2Out0(b),[R.x,AF.HE,16],[R.x,R.busY,0]]);dOut=legs.reduce((a,l)=>a+l.dur,0);svc();
   const c1=rev([[R.x,AF.HE],[R.x,R.busY]]);clear=c1.dur;
   fwd([[R.x,AF.HE,0],[R.x,AF.HW,14],...g2SHome(b)],{kind:'back',v0:4});
  }
 }
 if(kind==='bus-arr'){const l=tag(apttHold(home,hG,'svc'),{...base,at:'gate',gate:'unload',n:gateN});legs.push(l)}   // S2 GROUND OPS: unloading at the bus gate after the return
 const trk=afTrackOf(v,legs);trk.g2=kind;trk.gateHold=hG;
 return{trk,dOut,hold,clear,dur:trk.seq.dur,gate:hG};
}
// flexible remote task: forward search inside [sLo, sHi] (slices of the vehicle's start); the least recently used vehicle first
function* g2ServeG(kind,sd,ac,win,hold,meta,extra){
 const type=kind==='stairs'||kind==='stairs2'?'MS':'AB';let best=null;
 for(const v of afCands(type,3)){if(type==='AB'&&v.bay&&v.bay.id==='F2-AB1')continue;   /* p406 */
  if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())yield 0;
  const B=g2RemoteBuild(v,sd,ac,kind,hold,meta),sm=(yield* aoSampG(B.trk,aoSeqLeg(B.trk.seq)));
  const sLo=Math.max(aoSlUp(win.at0-B.dOut),afSEarliest());
  let sHi=aoSl(win.at1-B.dOut);if(win.clearBy!=null)sHi=Math.min(sHi,Math.floor((win.clearBy-B.dOut-hold-B.clear)/AO.DT));
  if(best)sHi=Math.min(sHi,best.s-1);
  const s=sHi>=sLo?(yield* afSearchG(v,B.trk,sm,sLo,sHi,extra,Math.round((B.dOut+hold+16)/AO.DT))):-1;
  if(s<0){const w=aoWhy(sm,sLo);const key='remote-'+kind+':'+(w?w.b.replace(/\d+/g,'#'):'busy/none');AF.fails[key]=(AF.fails[key]||0)+1;continue}
  if(!best||s<best.s)best={v,B,sm,s};
 }
 if(!best){AF.stats.fail++;return null}
 const at=aoT(best.s)+best.B.dOut,task=afCommit(best.v,best.B.trk,best.sm,best.s,'remote-'+kind,{code:meta&&meta.code,stand:sd.id,at});
 return{t0:task.t0,end:task.t1,at,done:at+hold,clear:best.B.clear,v:best.v,task,gate:best.B.gate||0};
}
// all remote services of one visit; returns {end, plan} or null (the caller rolls the visit back)
function* g2RemoteServicesG(sd,ac,tOB,dwell,meta,extra){const m0=AO.LOG.length;for(const ex of [0,150,300]){if(ex)aoRoll(m0);const r=yield* g2RemoteServices1G(sd,ac,tOB,dwell,meta,extra,ex);if(r){if(ex)AO.stats.g2Ext=(AO.stats.g2Ext||0)+1;return r}}return null}
function* g2RemoteServices1G(sd,ac,tOB,dwell,meta,extra,ex){
 const truck=g2UsesTruck(sd,ac),nA=g2PaxN(meta.code,'arr',ac),nD=g2PaxN(meta.code,'dep',ac),hA=g2BoardDur(sd,ac,nA),hD=g2BoardDur(sd,ac,nD);
 let st=null,st2=null,winEnd;
 if(truck){
  const Hs=Math.max(dwell-20,hA+hD+190)+(ex||0);
  st=yield* g2ServeG('stairs',sd,ac,{at0:tOB+4+G77_CHOCK,at1:tOB+70+G77_CHOCK},Hs,meta,extra);if(!st)return null;
  winEnd=st.done-2;
  if(g2Rear(sd,ac)){st2=yield* g2ServeG('stairs2',sd,ac,{at0:st.at+6,at1:st.at+70},Hs,meta,extra);if(!st2)return null;winEnd=Math.min(winEnd,st2.done-2)}   // GATE-77 S5b · D-67
 }
 const ba=yield* g2ServeG('bus-arr',sd,ac,{at0:(st2?Math.max(st.at,st2.at):st?st.at:tOB+G77_CHOCK)+5,at1:(st2?Math.max(st.at,st2.at):st?st.at:tOB+G77_CHOCK)+95,clearBy:st?st.done-hD-60:null},hA,{...meta,n:nA},extra);if(!ba)return null;
 // departure bus: preferably late (boarding just before the stairs leave), otherwise as soon as the arrival bus has cleared
 const depLo=ba.done+ba.clear+25,depHi=st?winEnd:tOB+dwell+120,want=Math.max(depLo,(st?st.done-hD-55:tOB+dwell-hD-30));
 let bd=null;
 if(want>depLo+8)bd=yield* g2ServeG('bus-dep',sd,ac,{at0:want,at1:Math.max(want,depHi),clearBy:st?winEnd:null},hD,{...meta,n:nD},extra);
 if(!bd)bd=yield* g2ServeG('bus-dep',sd,ac,{at0:depLo,at1:Math.max(depLo,depHi),clearBy:st?winEnd:null},hD,{...meta,n:nD},extra);
 if(!bd)return null;
 const end=Math.max(st?st.done+st.clear+6:0,st2?st2.done+st2.clear+6:0,bd.done+bd.clear+4);
 // S2 GROUND OPS: the gate windows — unloading at the end of the arrival bus task, loading at the start of the departure bus task
 const gateArr={v:ba.v.id,bay:ba.v.bay.id,at:ba.end-ba.gate,done:ba.end,n:nA},gateDep={v:bd.v.id,bay:bd.v.bay.id,at:bd.t0,done:bd.t0+bd.gate,n:nD};
 return{end,plan:{stand:sd.id,ac,truck,door:g2Door(sd,ac),path:g2PaxPath(sd,ac),stairs:st&&{v:st.v.id,at:st.at,done:st.done},stairs2:st2&&{v:st2.v.id,at:st2.at,done:st2.done},door2:st2?g2Door2(sd,ac):null,path2:st2?g2PaxPath2(sd,ac):null,arr:{v:ba.v.id,at:ba.at,done:ba.done,n:nA},dep:{v:bd.v.id,at:bd.at,done:bd.done,n:nD},gateArr,gateDep,open:(st?st.at:ba.at-6),close:(st?st.done:bd.done+6)}};
}
// ---- visible passengers between the aircraft door and the bus (arrival group, then departure group) -----------------------------
const G2_PAX_ASSETS=['PE-43','PE-44','PE-09','PE-10','PE-19','PE-04','PE-40','PE-41'];
function g2RemotePassengers(t=APT_OPS.clk,flights=AO.flights){
 const out=[];
 for(const f of flights){const r=f.g2;if(!r)continue;const tA=Math.min(r.open,r.gateDep?r.gateDep.at:1e9),tB=Math.max(r.close,r.gateArr?r.gateArr.done:-1e9);if(t<tA-1||t>tB+1)continue;
  for(const ph of['arr','dep','gateArr','gateDep']){const w=r[ph];if(!w||t<w.at||t>w.done)continue;
   const gate=ph==='gateArr'||ph==='gateDep',two=!gate&&!!r.path2;
   for(let i=0;i<w.n;i++){const P=gate?g2GatePath(APL.bays.find(b=>b.id===w.bay)):two&&i%2?r.path2:r.path,L=g2PathLen(P),pts=(ph==='arr'||ph==='gateArr')?P:P.slice().reverse(),travel=L/G2_WALK.v;   // GATE-77 S5b: two doors
    const lt=t-w.at-G2_WALK.pre-(two?i>>1:i)*G2_WALK.gap;if(lt<0||lt>=travel)continue;let d=lt*G2_WALK.v,k=1;
    while(k<pts.length-1&&d>Math.hypot(pts[k][0]-pts[k-1][0],pts[k][1]-pts[k-1][1])){d-=Math.hypot(pts[k][0]-pts[k-1][0],pts[k][1]-pts[k-1][1]);k++}
    const a=pts[k-1],b=pts[k],sl=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])||1,u=Math.min(1,d/sl),dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1];
    out.push({id:f.code+'-'+ph+'-'+i,flight:f.code,stand:f.stand,phase:ph,gate,asset:G2_PAX_ASSETS[(i+g2Hash(f.code))%G2_PAX_ASSETS.length],x:a[0]+dx*u,y:a[1]+dy*u,face:Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)?(dx>0?2:6):(dy>0?4:0),walkTime:lt+i*.21,alpha:Math.min(1,lt*3,(travel-lt)*3)})}
  }
 }
 return out;
}
function g2DrawAirstair(g,x,y,al){ // the turboprop's own short airstair, folded out of the door towards the east
 g.save();g.globalAlpha=al;g.fillStyle='rgba(8,18,26,.22)';g.fillRect(x+1,y-3,17,8);g.fillStyle='#d8dde2';g.fillRect(x,y-4,16,8);g.strokeStyle='#6b747c';g.lineWidth=.8;
 for(let sx=x+2;sx<x+16;sx+=2.6){g.beginPath();g.moveTo(sx,y-3.4);g.lineTo(sx,y+3.4);g.stroke()}g.fillStyle='#e07a2a';g.fillRect(x,y-4.4,16,1);g.fillRect(x,y+3.4,16,1);g.restore();
}

 }

// sandbox statistics for QA: every TP/RJ visit of P6/P5 has a bus each way (and stairs for the RJ), in the right order
function g2RemoteStats(T){
 const all=AO.hist.concat(AO.flights).filter(f=>(f.stand==='P6'||f.stand==='P5')&&!f.never&&!f.heli),issues=[];let visits=0,served=0,pax=0,trucks=0;
 const tasks=[];for(const v of AO.fleet)for(const k of v.hist.concat(v.tasks))if(String(k.role).startsWith('remote-'))tasks.push({v:v.id,role:k.role,code:k.code,t0:k.t0,t1:k.t1,at:k.at});
 for(const f of all){if(!G2_REMOTE_AC.has(f.ac)||f.states?.[0]?.[1]!=='INBOUND')continue;if(f.tOB==null||f.tOB>T)continue;visits++;const r=f.g2;if(!r){issues.push(f.code+':no-remote-plan');continue}served++;
  if(r.truck){trucks++;if(!(r.stairs.at<r.arr.at&&r.dep.done<r.stairs.done))issues.push(f.code+':stairs-window');if(r.stairs2){trucks++;if(!(r.stairs2.at<r.arr.at&&r.dep.done<r.stairs2.done))issues.push(f.code+':rear-stairs-window')}}
  if(!(r.arr.at>=f.tOB&&r.arr.done<r.dep.at))issues.push(f.code+':bus-order');
  if(f.tPush!=null&&r.close>f.tPush+.5)issues.push(f.code+':open-at-push');pax+=r.arr.n+r.dep.n;
  const mine=tasks.filter(k=>k.code===f.code);if(mine.length!==(r.truck?(r.stairs2?4:3):2))issues.push(f.code+':task-count '+mine.length)}
 const shuttles=tasks.filter(k=>/remote-bus/.test(k.role)&&k.t0<=T).length,stairsUses=tasks.filter(k=>/remote-stairs/.test(k.role)&&k.t0<=T).length;   // GATE-77 S5b: owner 06:41 — 6–8 shuttles / 30 min
 return{ok:issues.length===0,visits,served,trucks,pax,tasks:tasks.length,shuttles,stairsUses,issues};
}

function g2PaintRemoteMarks(g){
 const A=aptReady(),SH=APTT_SPEC.veh['LV-SH-01'],L=SH.fp[2]+8,W=SH.fp[3]+6,st=id=>A.stands.find(s=>s.id===id);
 g.save();
 const box=(cx,cy,vert,lab)=>{const w=vert?W:L,h=vert?L:W;g.strokeStyle='rgba(244,211,94,.8)';g.lineWidth=1.4;g.setLineDash([6,4]);g.strokeRect(cx-w/2,cy-h/2,w,h);g.setLineDash([]);
  g.fillStyle='rgba(244,211,94,.10)';g.fillRect(cx-w/2,cy-h/2,w,h);aptTxt(g,lab,cx,cy,8,'rgba(244,211,94,.9)',700)};
 const walk=P=>{g.strokeStyle='rgba(246,244,232,.62)';g.lineWidth=1.1;g.setLineDash([3,3]);
  for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++){const a=P[i-1],b=P[i],l=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]);if(l<2)continue;const nx=-(b[1]-a[1])/l*3,ny=(b[0]-a[0])/l*3;
   for(const s of[-1,1]){g.beginPath();g.moveTo(a[0]+nx*s,a[1]+ny*s);g.lineTo(b[0]+nx*s,b[1]+ny*s);g.stroke()}}g.setLineDash([])};
 // P5: the bus waits in alley AL2 (nose north), the turboprop's own airstair faces east
 const p5=st('P5'),p6=st('P6');
 if(p5){box(G2_REM.P5.x,G2_REM.P5.busY,true,'BUS');walk(g2PaxPath(p5,'AC-TP-01'))}
 // P6: the bus stops east of the stand after its U-turn; the RJ gets the mobile stairs, the TP uses its own airstair
 if(p6){box(G2_REM.P6.busX,G2_REM.P6.busY,false,'BUS');walk(g2PaxPath(p6,'AC-RJ-01'));
  const d=g2Door(p6,'AC-RJ-01');g.strokeStyle='rgba(244,242,232,.75)';g.lineWidth=1.2;g.strokeRect(d[0]+G2_STAIR_GAP,d[1]-10,70,20);aptTxt(g,'STAIRS',d[0]+G2_STAIR_GAP+35,d[1]+17,7,'rgba(244,242,232,.8)',700)}
 // the stair park: two drive-through lanes north of the fuel depot
 const S=G2_STAIR_PARK;g.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.07)';g.fillRect(S.x0-14,S.lanes[0]-16,S.x1-S.x0+28,S.lanes[S.lanes.length-1]-S.lanes[0]+32);
 for(const b of A.bays.filter(b=>b.kind==='MS'&&b.zone==='G2')){g.strokeStyle='rgba(244,242,232,.8)';g.lineWidth=1.3;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(b.x0,b.y0);g.lineTo(b.x1,b.y0);g.moveTo(b.x0,b.y1);g.lineTo(b.x1,b.y1);g.stroke();aptTxt(g,b.id.replace('G2-',''),b.x0-9,b.yc,7,'rgba(244,242,232,.85)',700)}
 aptTxt(g,'STAIRS · P6',S.x,S.lanes[0]-22,8,'rgba(244,242,232,.7)',700);
 g.restore();
}

function g2GeometryAudit(){
 const A=aptReady(),issues=[],over=aptOver,inside=q=>q.x>=7200-.01&&q.y>=850-.01&&q.x+q.w<=8400+.01&&q.y+q.h<=1700+.01;
 const roads=aptRoadRects(),fps=APT_BUILDINGS.map(aptFp);
 for(const q of[...G2_STALLS,...G2_SHUTTLE_SPACES,...G2_PROPS.map(f2SpriteBox),...G2_BUILDINGS.map(aptFp),G2_LOT,G2_PLATFORM])if(!inside(q))issues.push('outside-G2:'+(q.id||q.x));
 // lots never on a road (with its sidewalks) and never under a building; stalls never overlap, never in an aisle or on the walkway
 const lots=[{id:'lot',...G2_LOT},{id:'AW',x:G2_AW.x,y:1318,w:G2_AW.w,h:58},{id:'AE',x:G2_AE.x,y:1318,w:G2_AE.w,h:58},{id:'staff',x:7800,y:1376,w:68,h:316}];
 for(const L of lots){for(const r of roads)if(over(L,r))issues.push('lot-on-road:'+L.id+'/'+r.id);for(const f of fps)if(over(L,f))issues.push('lot-under-building:'+L.id+'/'+f.id);if(over(L,{x:7869,y:1150,w:531,h:550}))issues.push('lot-in-yard:'+L.id)}
 for(let i=0;i<G2_STALLS.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<G2_STALLS.length;j++)if(over(G2_STALLS[i],G2_STALLS[j]))issues.push('stall-overlap:'+G2_STALLS[i].id+'/'+G2_STALLS[j].id);
 const walk={x:G2_FOOT.x,y:G2_FOOT.y,w:G2_FOOT.w,h:G2_FOOT.y1-G2_FOOT.y};
 for(const s of G2_STALLS){for(const a of G2_AISLES)if(over(s,a))issues.push('stall-in-aisle:'+s.id);if(over(s,walk))issues.push('stall-on-walkway:'+s.id);for(const h of G2_HEDGES)if(over(s,h))issues.push('stall-on-hedge:'+s.id)}
 // every lot stall is reached from an aisle (R1/R2 from A1, R3 from A2); staff stalls from the east connector
 for(const s of G2_STALLS){if(s.staff){if(s.x!==G2_AE.x+G2_AE.w)issues.push('staff-access:'+s.id);continue}const a=s.row==='R3'?G2_AISLES[1]:G2_AISLES[0];if(!(s.y+s.h===a.y||s.y===a.y+a.h))issues.push('aisle-access:'+s.id)}
 // parked cars fit their stall
 for(const c of PARKED_CARS.filter(c=>/^PC-G2-/.test(c.id))){const I=TurboCity.info(c.asset,{scale:roadVehicleScaleFor(c.asset,c.ref)}),r=c.slotRect,vert=Math.abs(Math.sin(c.heading||0))>.5,len=I.w-4,wid=I.h-4;if(!r)continue;if(vert?(wid>r.w+1||len>r.h+1):(len>r.w+1||wid>r.h+1))issues.push('car-clearance:'+c.id)}
 // shuttle lay-by inside the south sidewalk band, clear of the driveways
 const Lb=G2_SHUTTLE_LAYBY,lay={id:'layby',x:Lb.x0,y:Lb.y0,w:Lb.x1-Lb.x0,h:Lb.y1-Lb.y0};
 if(Lb.y0<1298||Lb.y1>1346)issues.push('layby-band');for(const c of G2_CUTS.slice(0,2))if(over(lay,c))issues.push('layby-on-driveway:'+c.id);
 // props, trees, lamps and street lights never block a stall, aisle, driveway, lay-by or the gate lane
 const blockers=[...G2_STALLS,...G2_AISLES,lay,...G2_CUTS,{id:'AW',x:G2_AW.x,y:1318,w:G2_AW.w,h:58},{id:'AE',x:G2_AE.x,y:1318,w:G2_AE.w,h:58},walk];
 for(const o of G2_PROPS){const q=f2SpriteBox(o);for(const b of blockers)if(over(q,b)&&!(o.id==='G2-GATE-BARRIER'&&b.id==='G2-GATE-LANE'))issues.push(o.id+':blocks '+(b.id||'area'));if(q.y<1318&&o.id!=='G2-GATE-BARRIER'&&o.id!=='G2-GATE-STOP')issues.push(o.id+':in-road-band')}
 for(const o of[...G2_TREES,...G2_LAMPS]){const q={x:o.x-6,y:o.y-6,w:12,h:12};for(const r of roads)if(over(q,r))issues.push(o.id+':on-road');for(const b of blockers)if(over(q,b))issues.push(o.id+':blocks '+(b.id||'area'))}
 for(const l of STREET_LIGHTS.filter(l=>l.x>=7200&&l.x<7880&&l.y>1140&&l.y<1700)){const q={x:l.x-5,y:l.y-5,w:10,h:10};for(const b of blockers)if(over(q,b))issues.push(l.id+':blocks '+(b.id||'area'))}
 for(const id of['APT-LONG','APT-LONG-STOP','APT-STAFF-GATE']){const p=APT_INTERACTIONS[id];if(personBlockedAt(p.x,p.y,5))issues.push(id+':blocked-poi')}
 // service link from the F2 bus plaza: aligned with lane A3 and aisle A1, reaches the west connector, nothing standing in it
 const lk=G2_CUTS.find(c=>c.id==='G2-F2-LINK');
 if(!(lk.y>=F2_A3.y&&lk.y+lk.h<=F2_A3.y+F2_A3.h&&lk.y===G2_AISLES[0].y&&lk.h===G2_AISLES[0].h&&lk.x<=F2_A3.x+F2_A3.w&&lk.x+lk.w>=G2_AW.x))issues.push('f2-link-alignment');
 for(const o of[...F2_PROPS.map(f2SpriteBox),...[...F2_TREES,...F2_LAMPS,...G2_TREES,...G2_LAMPS,...STREET_LIGHTS].map(o=>({id:o.id,x:o.x-6,y:o.y-6,w:12,h:12}))])if(over(o,lk))issues.push('f2-link-blocked:'+o.id);
 // remote stands: P6/P5 are passenger remote stands; two buses in pocket S, two mobile stairs in the G2 stair park; homes intact
 for(const id of['P6','P5']){const s=A.stands.find(q=>q.id===id);if(!s||!s.remote||s.kind!=='pax')issues.push(id+':not-remote-pax')}
 const ab=A.bays.filter(b=>b.kind==='AB'),ms=A.bays.filter(b=>b.kind==='MS');
 if(ab.length!==G2_S_BAYS.length||ab.some(b=>!G2_S_BAYS.some(q=>q.id===b.id&&q.x===b.x)))issues.push('apron-bus-bays');   // GATE-77 S6r · M5eif(ms.length!==4||ms.some(b=>b.zone!=='G2'))issues.push('stair-bays');
 for(const v of A.fleet.filter(f=>f.type==='AB'||f.type==='MS')){const b=A.bays.find(q=>q.id===v.bay);if(!b||b.kind!==v.type)issues.push('home:'+v.id)}
 if(A.bays.filter(b=>b.zone!=='F2').length<24)issues.push('ground-ops-bays<24');
 const lotStalls=G2_STALLS.filter(s=>!s.staff).length,total=APT_STALLS.length+F2_STALLS.length+G2_STALLS.length;
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:[...new Set(issues)].slice(0,30),scope:'G2',gate:'GATE-69',parking:{lot:lotStalls,staff:G2_STALLS.length-lotStalls,accessible:G2_STALLS.filter(s=>s.accessible).length,ev:G2_STALLS.filter(s=>s.ev).length,airportTotal:total,parked:PARKED_CARS.filter(c=>/^PC-G2-/.test(c.id)).length},
  shuttle:G2_SHUTTLE_SPACES.length,props:G2_PROPS.length,trees:G2_TREES.length,lamps:G2_LAMPS.length,remote:{stands:['P6','P5'],aircraft:[...G2_REMOTE_AC],apronBuses:ab.map(b=>b.id),stairs:ms.map(b=>b.id)},yardBays:A.bays.filter(b=>b.zone!=='F2').length,fleet:A.fleet.length,next:'AIRPORT-FINISH'}
}
function g2OpsQa(minutes=20,seed=777){

 if(act==='buy'&&id==='E2W-CAFE'){const it=EW2_CAFE_ITEMS.find(q=>q[0]===arg);if(!it||PlayerProfile.money<it[2])return toast('אין מספיק כסף');PlayerProfile.money-=it[2];PlayerProfile.inventory[arg]=(PlayerProfile.inventory[arg]||0)+1;recordTransaction('shop-purchase',-it[2],{shop:id,item:arg});SaveManager.save('airport-cafe',{silent:true,backup:false});renderPhone();return true;}
 if(id==='E2W-GARAGE'&&['repair','fuel'].includes(act)){if(Math.hypot(PlayerCar.x-5118,PlayerCar.y-1250)>180||carKmh()>1)return toast('חנה את הרכב קרוב למוסך');const cost=act==='repair'?120:80;if(PlayerProfile.money<cost)return toast('אין מספיק כסף');PlayerProfile.money-=cost;const v=activeVehicleEco();if(act==='repair')v.damage=0;else v.fuel=100;recordTransaction('vehicle-service',-cost,{service:act,shop:id});SaveManager.save('airport-service',{silent:true,backup:false});renderPhone();return true;}return false;
}
